EG Union serves as both the governing authority in Grom-controlled systems and the military arm of his challenge to Federal influence in the frontier, embodying his strategy of leveraging independent pilot support to secure territorial gains against superpower opposition.

vitadyne-labs.name: Vitadyne Labs
vitadyne-labs.bio: Vitadyne Labs is a organization active in Elite Dangerous lore from 3304-12-06 to 3306-06-09. Frequently associated with Interstellar Health Organisation, Utopia. Key activities include: Weekly summary covering Juanita Bishop's call to ban the Far God book, new asteroid-mining equipment from the Industrial Mining Guild, Princess Ais...; Weekly summary covering Isolde Rochester's appointment as Shadow Vice President, Imperial senators demanding Hadrian Duval's recognition with Chanc...
vitadyne-labs.bio_full:
Vitadyne Labs is an independent pharmaceutical company led by Professor Katrien Rook, best known for its development of advanced nanomedicines announced in December 3304. The firm claimed its nanomeds could repair cellular damage on a molecular level, cure diseases and infections, and extend human lifespans by 30 to 50 years.

The announcement triggered a protracted legal dispute when Simguru Pranav Antal of Utopia accused Vitadyne of stealing technology from a crashed Utopian transport. Rook admitted the original compounds had been obtained as salvage but argued that Vitadyne's recreated derivatives constituted independent intellectual property. The Interstellar Health Organisation ruled in Vitadyne's favour in January 3305, approving distribution through established pharmaceutical partners. After a year of negotiations, Vandermeer Corporation began manufacturing the nanomeds for galactic release in June 3306, despite continued condemnation from Utopia.

neo-marlinist-liberation-army.name: Neo-Marlinist Liberation Army
neo-marlinist-liberation-army.bio: The Neo-Marlinist Liberation Army (NMLA) is a terrorist organisation dedicated to overthrowing the Imperial Duval dynasty and restoring Marlin Duval's republican vision. It radicalised into a violent paramilitary group in 3306, using caustic enzyme bombs incorporating Thargoid technology. The deadliest attack, "Nine Martyrs" on 11 March 3307, involved simultaneous bombings of nine starports across all three superpowers including their capitals, killing over half a million people. The organisation was led by John Tyburn ("Theta Seven"), a former Imperial Intelligence prisoner, and was ultimately dismantled by ACT.
neo-marlinist-liberation-army.bio_full:
The NMLA emerged in 3306 as the armed wing of Marlinism — a political tradition tracing back to Marlin Duval's vision of a democratic republic. The organisation operated through extreme compartmentalisation, using a "dark-comms" network that eluded conventional surveillance. Its bomb-making division, Theta Group, was led by John Tyburn ("Theta Seven"), a former prisoner at Serene Harbour who adopted his designation as a political statement.

The NMLA's signature caustic enzyme bombs first struck four Imperial starports in September 3306, killing over sixty thousand. The deadliest attack, "Nine Martyrs" on 11 March 3307, involved simultaneous bombings of nine starports across all three superpowers including their capitals, killing over half a million people and derailing the Galactic Summit. The Cornelius-Lasky Convention established ACT in response, though co-leader Captain Niamh Seutonia was killed in an ambush.

Theta Seven was cornered aboard the Far God megaship Sacrosanct in December 3307, destroying the vessel rather than surrendering. While the NMLA was ultimately dismantled, its ideology exposed deep tensions within Imperial society between the Duval dynasty and republican dissent.

epsilon-fornacis-empire-group.name: Epsilon Fornacis Empire Group
epsilon-fornacis-empire-group.bio: Epsilon Fornacis Empire Group is a organization active in Elite Dangerous lore from 3307-04-01 to 3307-12-16. Frequently associated with NMLA, Neo-Marlinist Order of Mudhrid, Mudhrid. Key activities include: The Epsilon Fornacis Empire Group attacks the Neo-Marlinist Order of Mudhrid after ACT confirms the faction provided logistical support for the NML...; The Neo-Marlinist Order of Mudhrid is defeated in the Mudhrid system by Imperial forces.
epsilon-fornacis-empire-group.bio_full:
The Epsilon Fornacis Empire Group is an Imperial faction loyal to Senator Denton Patreus that serves as a key military force in the Empire's campaigns against both external and internal threats. The faction orchestrated its operations from Payne-Scott City starport during the critical Battle of Mudhrid in late 3307, where it engaged the Neo-Marlinist Order of Mudhrid in open warfare.

Senator Patreus requested that Imperial auxiliaries provide combat support to the Epsilon Fornacis Empire Group during the Mudhrid campaign, which aimed to prevent NMLA leader Theta Seven from escaping aboard the Sacrosanct megaship. In December 3307, the faction defeated the Neo-Marlinist forces with the aid of independent pilots and ACT commandos led by Milo Castile, who retook the Steel Majesty megaship from NMLA troops. The Epsilon Fornacis Empire Group's victory represented a significant blow to the NMLA's operational capacity and demonstrated Patreus's ability to mobilise Imperial military resources against terrorist threats.

herculean-machines.name: Herculean Machines
herculean-machines.bio: Herculean Machines is a technology company that developed the Duradrive personal computer, defeating rival Supratech at the Rackham Ultratech Expo.
herculean-machines.bio_full:
Herculean Machines is a technology company that rose to prominence in 3304 through its development of the Duradrive personal computer. Founded and led by CEO Maddox Hurd, the company engaged in a fierce rivalry with Supratech over competing designs for next-generation computing devices. Herculean Machines' Duradrive ultimately proved superior to Supratech's Torc at the Rackham Ultratech Expo, functioning perfectly where its rival's holographic systems induced nausea in users.

The company's trajectory was nearly derailed when declassified Federal Security Service records revealed that Hurd had accepted financial contributions from organised-crime-connected individuals when establishing the firm. Hurd dismissed the revelation as a smear campaign by Supratech, and Herculean Machines recovered to dominate the expo and secure corporate funding. The affair illustrated both the cutthroat nature of the Federal technology sector and the resilience of Herculean Machines under public scrutiny.

rewired.name: Rewired
rewired.bio: An independent news feed known for prolific output and guerrilla-style journalism, Rewired has broken major stories across the galaxy despite criticism over its rapid-fire publishing pace.
rewired.bio_full:
Rewired is an independent news channel known across the galaxy for its extraordinary publishing volume, sometimes releasing hundreds of stories in a single day. While critics have accused the feed of prioritising speed over accuracy, its guerrilla-style approach has allowed it to react faster than larger, more established rivals and break several significant stories.

In mid-3302, Rewired was the first to report that engineers Broo Tarquin and Didi Vatermann had significantly reduced their material requirements for ship modifications, a development that made engineering services far more accessible to independent pilots. The channel's coverage of the Socho system crisis and its connections to Aegis Core operations further demonstrated its ability to report on sensitive military-industrial topics.

league-of-reparation.name: League of Reparation
league-of-reparation.bio: League of Reparation is a organization active in Elite Dangerous lore from 3304-05-05 to 3304-11-21. Frequently associated with Alliance, Imperial Internal Security Service. Key activities include: This week's major stories include the murder of Fleet Admiral Tulimaq Buchanan of the Alliance Council of Admirals by the League of Reparation, lin...; Weekly summary covering the Socho system being overtaken by the Socho Gold Raiders, Aegis's Eagle Eye success in repelling Thargoids, five ships de...
league-of-reparation.bio_full:
The League of Reparation is a terrorist organisation that emerged in 3304 with a singular, chilling mandate: to execute the descendants of individuals who served in the Intergalactic Naval Reserve Arm (INRA) during the First Thargoid War. Operating across all three superpowers, the League employs nerve agents and ship-to-ship attacks, claiming its murders are acts of historical justice for INRA's alleged crimes — including the deployment of biological weapons and the betrayal of human colonies.

The group was dismantled later in 3304 following a coordinated investigation by Alliance Interpol, the Imperial Internal Security Service, and the Federal Intelligence Agency. Its leader, Riri McAllister, was exposed as a descendant of INRA personnel herself — a tortured irony that suggested the League's ideology was as much personal vengeance as political statement. The case forced uncomfortable public reckonings with INRA's legacy and whether historical atrocities could ever justify contemporary terrorism.

defence-force-of-amitrite.name: Defence Force of Amitrite
defence-force-of-amitrite.bio: The local security force of the Amitrite system, the Defence Force found itself overwhelmed in September 3301 when pirates attacked refugees fleeing the Pegasi Pirate War.
defence-force-of-amitrite.bio_full:
In September 3301, the Defence Force of Amitrite confronted a crisis that exposed the limits of local security capabilities. As refugees fleeing the Pegasi Pirate War poured into the system, pirate gangs from the Kumo Crew and other predatory factions began attacking the vulnerable convoys. The Defence Force issued a stark warning: their resources were stretched too thin to protect everyone, and refugees should either avoid Amitrite entirely or travel in heavily armed convoys.

The plea revealed both the humanity and the helplessness of a small security force facing a crisis far beyond its design capacity. Controlled by Lavigny's Legion within an Imperial patronage system, the Defence Force lacked the personnel and equipment to simultaneously maintain order and provide comprehensive escort services. Their warning, though necessary, amounted to an admission that the state could not protect its most vulnerable residents — a grim reality that refugee populations across the galaxy would encounter repeatedly during the turbulent years that followed.

wolf-406-transport-co.name: Wolf 406 Transport Co
wolf-406-transport-co.bio: Wolf 406 Transport Co is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-23 to 3301-07-23. Frequently linked with Alliance Defence Force, Alliance, Wolf 406. Victoria Wolf VI of Wolf 406 Transport Co and Commodore Helena Stone of the Alliance Defence Force launched Operation Augeas to rid BD-22 3573 of criminal elements troubling miners and traders.

rackham-capital-investments.name: Rackham Capital Investments
rackham-capital-investments.bio: Rackham Capital Investments is the vast corporate empire of billionaire Zachary Rackham, marked by hacking, boardroom battles and major public initiatives including Colonia region shipyards and exploration campaigns.
rackham-capital-investments.bio_full:
Rackham Capital Investments is the vast corporate empire of billionaire Zachary Rackham, a former independent trader rumoured to have operated as the pirate known as "Calico Zack". Established following his lucrative trading career, the company grew into one of the Federation's most prominent investment firms, acquiring assets including Kavanagh Spaceframes Ltd—renamed Rackham Spaceframes—which propelled Rackham's personal fortune past one trillion credits in 3308.

The company's history has been marked by internal power struggles and criminal intrigue. In 3304, hackers known as The Collective withdrew one billion credits from Rackham's personal account and redistributed it to former employees denied pensions. The sudden death of long-serving CFO Aaron Salazar in 3305 triggered a boardroom battle with his replacement Taja Gavaris, who resigned weeks later amid allegations that Rackham used imposter intelligence agents to blackmail her. Rackham Capital has also funded major public initiatives, including new shipyards in the Colonia region and a galaxy-wide exploration campaign to investigate anomalous readings in the permit-locked HIP 87621 system.

keltim-empire-league.name: Keltim Empire League
keltim-empire-league.bio: Keltim Empire League is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3306-10-01 to 3306-10-08. Frequently linked with Liz Ryder, Pilots Federation, Eurybia.

league-of-mandu.name: League of Mandu
league-of-mandu.bio: A Federal-backed faction active in the Paresa system in mid-3307, the League of Mandu was swiftly defeated by Nova Imperium in a brief but decisive conflict.
league-of-mandu.bio_full:
In May 3307, the League of Mandu became the instrument of Federal policy in the Paresa system, where Nova Imperium had established a powerful base of support among Imperial traditionalists. The faction's Federal backing reflected Washington's determination to counter Nova Imperium's growing influence, but the intervention was poorly planned and inadequately supported.

Open warfare erupted when Nova Imperium forces attacked League of Mandu positions across Paresa. Within a week, the League had been decisively defeated — a humiliation that forced Ambassador Catherine Carlisle of the Federal Diplomatic Corps to admit that Federal intermediaries had acted hastily. The League of Mandu's rapid collapse demonstrated both Nova Imperium's military competence and the Federation's miscalculation in assuming that proxy forces could defeat an organisation with genuine grassroots support. The defeat in Paresa became a turning point in the Nova Imperium crisis, emboldening Imperial hardliners and weakening Federal prestige.

imperial-slavers-association.name: Imperial Slavers Association
imperial-slavers-association.bio: Imperial Slavers Association is a organization active in Elite Dangerous lore from 3301-03-01 to 3301-06-13. Frequently associated with Lagerkvist Gateway, Synteini. Key activities include: Senator Zemina Torval defeated Aisling Duval in their slavery wager, with the Imperial Slavers Association acquiring 2,387,567 unregulated slaves c...; The 'Great Slaver Showdown' between Zemina Torval and Aisling Duval concluded with Torval's victory.
imperial-slavers-association.bio_full:
The Imperial Slavers Association is the official guild that regulates the practice of Imperial slavery, a sanctioned form of indentured servitude permitted within the Empire's borders. The ISA operates under Senate authority and certifies the training and sale of Imperial slaves, ensuring that the practice adheres to Imperial law and tradition.

In June 3301, the ISA condemned the mass sale of Imperial slaves to Kumo Crew black markets on the fringes of Imperial space, issuing a statement that "the sale of Imperial Slaves outside of the borders of Imperial space is strictly prohibited by order of the Senate." The guild warned that any members caught engaging in such activity would be removed from the guild and reported to authorities. The incident exposed the tensions between the ISA's regulatory role and the reality of frontier enforcement, where Imperial security services sometimes turned a blind eye to illegal slave trading. The ISA's public stance reinforced the Empire's formal position that Imperial slavery was a regulated institution distinct from the unregulated chattel slavery practised by criminal organisations.

newton-dock-medical.name: Newton Dock Medical
newton-dock-medical.bio: Newton Dock Medical is the medical authority at Newton Dock in the BD-02 4304 system. Led by Chief Medical Officer Carl Simmons, it coordinated the initial response to the Cerberus Plague outbreak and later confirmed that Ceremonial Heike Tea contained ingredients capable of curing the pathogen.
newton-dock-medical.bio_full: Newton Dock Medical is the medical authority responsible for healthcare at Newton Dock in the BD-02 4304 system. Led by Chief Medical Officer Carl Simmons, the organisation found itself at the epicentre of the Cerberus Plague outbreak in July 3301. Simmons coordinated initial containment efforts and confirmed the disease's spread to neighbouring systems including Dajoar, Eleu, and 20 Ophiuchi. Newton Dock Medical ultimately played a pivotal role in ending the crisis when Simmons verified that Ceremonial Heike Tea—offered originally just to lift patients' spirits—contained ingredients capable of curing the pathogen.

nova-fleet.name: Nova Fleet
nova-fleet.bio: Nova Fleet is a naval in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-14 to 3301-07-14. Frequently linked with Pilots Federation, Frontier, Alliance. The Nova Fleet has grown to over 100 ships and attracted political interest from both Empire and Federation.

obotrima-organisation.name: Obotrima Organisation
obotrima-organisation.bio: Obotrima Organisation is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-09-15 to 3302-09-15. Frequently linked with Chimechilo Empire League, Obotrima, Thoreau Orbital. Federal intelligence has uncovered an Imperial plot by the Chimechilo Empire League to destabilise Thoreau Orbital in Obotrima by flooding it with explosives. The Obotrima Organisation has countered by requesting Federation-aligned pilots deliver skimmer components and robotics to maintain production.

social-falisci-partnership.name: Social Falisci Partnership
social-falisci-partnership.bio: Social Falisci Partnership is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-04 to 3301-03-04. Frequently linked with Falisci Purple Gang, Falisci, Citizens of Tradition. Imperial forces decimated the Falisci Purple Gang's fleet five days after the Citizens of Tradition declared war against them. Only a handful of pirates remain to defend their territory against the Citizens of Tradition and thousands of loyal Imperial citizens who flocked to Falisci.

nehet-silver-ring.name: Nehet Silver Ring
nehet-silver-ring.bio: Nehet Silver Ring is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-04-16 to 3301-04-16. Frequently linked with Almad, Mictlan Cartel, Facece. Arissa Lavigny-Duval directed attacks on the Nehet Silver Ring under Patrons of Law guidance, bringing crime to manageable levels.

ndozins-state-inc.name: Ndozins State Inc
ndozins-state-inc.bio: A corporate faction in the Geras system, Ndozins State Inc fought an all-out war against Geras First in late 3304 after months of escalating reciprocal attacks.
ndozins-state-inc.bio_full:
Ndozins State Inc represented the corporate establishment in the Geras system when long-simmering tensions with rival faction Geras First finally erupted into open warfare in November 3304. Months of reciprocal attacks — sabotage, asset seizures and proxy skirmishes — had depleted both sides' reserves, yet neither faction had achieved sufficient advantage to force a settlement.

The declaration of all-out war transformed a low-intensity conflict into a system-wide crisis that drew attention from the Federal Security Service and Sirius Corporation. Within days, however, hostilities concluded as abruptly as they had intensified, suggesting that external pressure or mutual exhaustion had overcome the factions' determination to destroy each other. Ndozins State Inc's experience illustrated the precariousness of corporate governance in independent systems, where market dominance provided no guarantee of military superiority against determined ideological or populist opponents.

true-chapters.name: True Chapters
true-chapters.bio: The True Chapters is a radical sect that broke away from the Far God cult in 3308 following the Battle of HIP 22460. Its members abandoned orthodox hive-chapels to worship the First Apostle as a holy messenger of the Far God.
true-chapters.bio_full:
The True Chapters is a radical sect that broke away from the Far God cult in the aftermath of the Battle of HIP 22460 in 3308. Unlike orthodox Far God worshippers who passively await the Thargoids' apocalyptic arrival, True Chapters adherents hail the First Apostle as a holy messenger and have abandoned traditional hive-chapels for more militant devotion.

Dr Alfred Ulyanov, the leading academic authority on the Far God faith, noted that the Thargoid victory in HIP 22460 triggered unprecedented excitement among cultists but also caused discord, with worshippers defecting to the True Chapters in significant numbers. The Federal Intelligence Agency monitored the sect closely, concerned by its radicalisation and the Testament megaship's efforts to locate a permanent base for new converts.

imperial-science-academy.name: Imperial Science Academy
imperial-science-academy.bio: Imperial Science Academy is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-09-05 to 3308-09-05. Frequently linked with HIP 22460, Holloway Bioscience Institute.

house-of-duval.name: House of Duval
house-of-duval.bio: House of Duval is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-04-10 to 3301-04-10. Frequently linked with Imperial Court. Senator Arissa Lavigny-Duval's office revealed that interrogation of the would-be assassin yielded the name of the organisation behind the attack on Emperor Hengist Duval.

imperial-court.name: Imperial Court
imperial-court.bio: The Imperial Court is the governing and advisory body surrounding the Emperor of the Empire, composed of loyal senators, counts and other nobility who serve the House of Duval. In early 3301 its members played a central role in investigating the assassination attempt on Emperor Hengist Duval, dispatching investigators to pursue leads extracted from the captured would-be assassin.
imperial-court.bio_full:
The Imperial Court functions as the inner circle of Imperial governance, comprising nobles and officials loyal to the House of Duval who advise the Emperor and manage affairs of state. Following the foiled assassination attempt on Emperor Hengist Duval in April 3301, members of the Imperial Court were instrumental in the subsequent investigation, with Count von Auerburg, Earl Rednam and Earl Khaelmin dispatched to follow up on intelligence obtained from the interrogation of the captured attacker.

The Court's actions during the crisis underscored its role as both a political instrument and a security apparatus, with Princess Arissa Lavigny-Duval relying on its loyal members to coordinate efforts outside the traditional channels of the Imperial Senate. The investigation revealed the existence of a broader conspiracy against the Emperor, prompting Arissa to warn enemies of the Court that they would not receive a second chance to strike.

bentons-natural-remedies.name: Benton's Natural Remedies
bentons-natural-remedies.bio: Benton's Natural Remedies is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-04-10 to 3301-04-10. Frequently linked with Worster Insurance, Better Green Developments.

sepp.name: SEPP
sepp.bio: SEPP is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-11-05 to 3302-11-05. Frequently linked with 9th Legion, Colonia Citizens Network, Earth Defense Fleet.

the-rewired.name: The Rewired
the-rewired.bio: The Rewired is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-01-19 to 3305-05-25. Frequently linked with The Sovereign, Diso.
the-rewired.bio_full:
The Rewired operated as an independent organisation active in systems including Diso and Vega during 3305. Little public information exists about their specific activities or ideological orientation, though their connections to both The Sovereign and Jokers' Deck suggest involvement in the galaxy's shadow economy of gambling, information brokering, and high-stakes social manoeuvring. These associations placed them within a network of entities that thrived outside conventional legal and political structures.

Their brief period of documented activity coincided with a broader expansion of independent factions seeking to carve out niches in the increasingly crowded political landscape of the mid-3300s. The Rewired's obscurity may itself have been a strategic choice, allowing them to conduct operations without attracting the attention of major powers or law enforcement agencies. Their existence illustrated how countless smaller organisations contributed to the galaxy's complex social fabric without ever achieving the prominence of corporate giants or superpower institutions.

kuk-silver-fortune-company.name: Kuk Silver Fortune Company
kuk-silver-fortune-company.bio: Kuk Silver Fortune Company is a corporate in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-08-18 to 3303-08-25. Frequently linked with Vercors Station, Kaal. The Kuk Silver Fortune Company has issued a kill order on wanted ships and promised rewards for bounty vouchers delivered to Vercors Station. The Kuk Silver Fortune Company announces the successful conclusion of its campaign to clear the Kaal system of agitators.

emerald-security.name: Emerald Security
emerald-security.bio: Emerald Security is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-02-21 to 3301-02-21. Frequently linked with Emerald, Cemiess. Crime on Emerald in Cemiess has risen over 300% following the influx of emancipated Imperial Slaves.

wyrd-jet-power-industries.name: Wyrd Jet Power Industries
wyrd-jet-power-industries.bio: Wyrd Jet Power Industries is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-10-06 to 3303-10-06. Frequently linked with Wyrd, Vonarburg Co-operative, Aegis.

null.name: NULL
null.bio: NULL is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-07-14 to 3303-07-21. Frequently linked with LTT 4961, Greg's Legacy, Conway City. NULL, an independent organisation based in LTT 4961, announces plans to build a new base at Greg's Legacy and has placed open orders for titanium, aluminium, copper and tea. NULL announces the successful conclusion of its commodities appeal and system security campaign in LTT 4961.

church-of-the-eternal-void.name: Church of the Eternal Void
church-of-the-eternal-void.bio: Church of the Eternal Void is a religious in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-05-19 to 3304-05-19. Frequently linked with Generation Omega. Groups such as the Church of the Eternal Void and Generation Omega are attracting thousands of followers, with some planning mass euthanasia centres.

independents-of-daramo.name: Independents of Daramo
independents-of-daramo.bio: Independents of Daramo is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-06-23 to 3302-06-27. Frequently linked with Daramo, Federal Navy, Kumo Crew.

universal-liberty.name: Universal Liberty
universal-liberty.bio: Universal Liberty is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-05-26 to 3304-06-17. Frequently linked with Unchain. Princess Aisling Duval's anti-slavery campaign merges with independent charity Universal Liberty to form Unchain. Jarl Toredo, former head of Universal Liberty who was born into slavery, announces the union and calls for the abolition of legal slavery across the Empire.
universal-liberty.bio_full:
Universal Liberty operated as an independent charitable organisation dedicated to the abolition of slavery throughout Imperial space. Founded by individuals with direct experience of bondage, including Jarl Toredo who was born into slavery, the group advocated for legal reform through public campaigns and political pressure. Their work challenged one of the Empire's most entrenched institutions, making them both celebrated among reformers and controversial among traditionalists who viewed Imperial Slavery as an essential economic and social pillar.

In mid-3304, Universal Liberty merged with Princess Aisling Duval's personal anti-slavery initiative to form Unchain, a unified movement combining royal patronage with grassroots activism. Toredo announced the union publicly, calling for the complete abolition of legal slavery across the Empire. This collaboration demonstrated how independent charities could amplify their influence by aligning with sympathetic figures within the Imperial establishment, while also highlighting the growing tensions between progressive and conservative elements of Imperial society.

citizens-forum.name: Citizens' Forum
citizens-forum.bio: Citizens' Forum is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-04-21 to 3301-04-21. Frequently linked with Eotienses, Parkinson Dock. Senator Denton Patreus announced an initiative to rejuvenate Parkinson Dock in Eotienses to promote high-tech goods development, overseen by the Citizens' Forum. The Citizens' Forum has placed large orders for industrial materials to begin repurposing the facilities.

union-party-of-ambika.name: Union Party of Ambika
union-party-of-ambika.bio: Union Party of Ambika is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-08-04 to 3302-08-11. Frequently linked with Ambika, Goulart City. Authorities in the Ambika system report severe famine and civil unrest. The Union Party of Ambika has launched a campaign requesting pilots deliver food to Goulart City and neutralise pirates operating in the system.
union-party-of-ambika.bio_full:
Union Party of Ambika served as the governing authority in the Ambika system during the early 3300s, operating from Goulart City as their administrative centre. In mid-3302, the system experienced a severe humanitarian crisis when famine and civil unrest threatened the population's survival. The Party's response illustrated both the challenges facing frontier system governments and their dependence on external support from independent pilots to address crises beyond local logistical capacity.

The organisation launched an emergency campaign requesting food deliveries to Goulart City alongside security operations to neutralise pirates exploiting the chaos. This dual approach — combining humanitarian relief with military action — reflected a pragmatic understanding that stability required both addressing immediate needs and removing threats to supply lines. Their experience in Ambika demonstrated how quickly frontier systems could destabilise and how crucial independent pilot support remained to regional governance.

aeternitas-industries.name: Aeternitas Industries
aeternitas-industries.bio: Aeternitas Industries is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-12-08 to 3302-12-15. Frequently linked with Aeternitas, Houtman City. Aeternitas Industries has issued a kill order on wanted ships in the Aeternitas system to counter a sharp rise in criminal activity disrupting trade and attacking pilots. Aeternitas Industries has successfully cleared the Aeternitas system of agitators with the help of hundreds of pilots, and rewards are now available at Houtman City.

united-german-commanders.name: United German Commanders
united-german-commanders.bio: United German Commanders is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-01-12 to 3302-01-12. Frequently linked with Adle's Armada, Guardians of Harmony, Utopia.

gluscap-labour.name: Gluscap Labour
gluscap-labour.bio: A Federal faction that seceded from the Federation in 3307 in protest against the Proactive Detection Bureau surveillance laws, joining a wave of independence declarations across Federal space.
gluscap-labour.bio_full:
Gluscap Labour was a Federal-aligned faction whose systems declared independence from the Federation in July 3307, inspired by Azaladshu Free's successful military defence against Federal forces. The secession formed part of a broader constitutional crisis triggered by widespread opposition to the Proactive Detection Bureau's mass civilian surveillance programme.

The faction's departure from the Federation, alongside the Coalition of Uteran and Lp 726-6 Free, demonstrated the depth of resistance to the PDB within systems traditionally aligned with Shadow President Felicia Winters. President Zachary Hudson's inability to prevent or reverse these secessions undermined his administration and marked one of the most serious challenges to Federal unity in decades.

red-family-cartel.name: Red Family Cartel
red-family-cartel.bio: A powerful narcotics cartel active in mid-3305, the Red Family developed a genetically engineered designer drug and became embroiled in a deadly confrontation with the Federal Intelligence Agency.
red-family-cartel.bio_full:
In July 3305, the Red Family Cartel revealed its most terrifying product yet: a genetically engineered designer narcotic far more addictive than any existing substance. Co-founder Jan Sandoval's disclosure sent shockwaves through law enforcement agencies, prompting the Federal Intelligence Agency to place her in protective custody at its Olympus Village headquarters in the Sol system.

The cartel responded with chilling efficiency. A mercenary hit squad infiltrated FIA headquarters in an audacious assassination attempt against Sandoval — an operation that demonstrated both the Red Family's resources and its willingness to strike at the heart of Federal power. The Federal Times covered the crisis extensively, transforming a narcotics investigation into a national security emergency. The Red Family Cartel's ability to challenge the FIA on its home turf established it as one of the most dangerous criminal organisations in Federal territory, capable of operating at a level previously associated only with superpower intelligence agencies.

imperial-navy.name: Imperial Navy
imperial-navy.bio: The Imperial Navy is the military force of the Empire, tracing its origins to the victorious defence of Achenar in 2325. Its flagship Majestic-class Interdictors serve as both warships and symbols of Imperial power, while its decentralised structure reflects the Empire's feudal character with senators commanding private fleets that supplement central forces.
imperial-navy.bio_full:
The Imperial Navy traces its origins to the Battle of Achenar in 2325, when Henson Duval's forces annihilated a Federal expeditionary fleet, securing the Empire's independence. Its flagship, the Majestic-class Interdictor, serves as both warship and symbol of Imperial grandeur, with senators commanding these vessels as mobile palaces and military headquarters. The Navy's structure reflects the Empire's feudal character: while a central command reports to the Emperor and Senate, many forces are effectively private armies raised by individual senators, providing flexibility but creating tensions between central and provincial forces.

In the 34th century, the Navy has fought campaigns against Emperor's Dawn (3301), Nova Imperium (3304-3305), the Kumo Crew, and contributed to anti-Thargoid operations. Its relationship with the Imperial Family is intimate and sometimes tragic — Emperor Hengist Duval died en route to the Imperial Navy Medical Facility after his assassination in 3301. Its rivalry with the Federal Navy is centuries old, continuing through proxy conflicts even as both forces cooperate against the Thargoids.

independents-of-parun.name: Independents of Parun
independents-of-parun.bio: Independents of Parun is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-01-12 to 3303-01-19. Frequently linked with Parun, Laksmii Jet Power Industries, Underwood Port. Laksmii Jet Power Industries plans to smuggle weapons into Underwood Port in Parun for guerrilla attacks against the Independents of Parun, the system's controlling faction. The Independents of Parun foil Laksmii Jet Power Industries' plot to smuggle weapons into Underwood Port by placing bounties on their ships, destroying hundreds of vessels.

winged-hussars.name: Winged Hussars
winged-hussars.bio: Winged Hussars is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-09-29 to 3303-10-06. Frequently linked with HIP 110028, Zander Dock. The Winged Hussars announce plans to establish a recreational installation and tourist beacon in the HIP 110028 system near an Earth-like world. The Winged Hussars' appeal for rare liquors concluded successfully, resulting in a massive influx of deliveries to Zander Dock.

starship-enterprises-corporation.name: Starship Enterprises Corporation
starship-enterprises-corporation.bio: Starship Enterprises Corporation is a corporate in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-12-15 to 3302-12-22. Frequently linked with LP 339-7 4 A, LP 339-7, Whitson Orbital. The Starship Enterprises Corporation's wildlife reserve campaign in the LP 339-7 system has concluded successfully, with commodities delivered to Whitson Orbital for a reserve on LP 339-7 4 A.

banki-gold-gang.name: Banki Gold Gang
banki-gold-gang.bio: Banki Gold Gang is a criminal in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-09 to 3301-03-09. Frequently linked with Gold Advanced Partners, Federal Navy, Banki. The Federation won the war in Banki by offering greater incentives to commanders, but survivors face a struggle for survival. The Banki Gold Gang suffered hundreds killed and thousands wounded, with medical supplies stretched thin.

new-kuwembaa-labour.name: New Kuwembaa Labour
new-kuwembaa-labour.bio: New Kuwembaa Labour is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-07-21 to 3307-07-30. Frequently linked with Azaladshu Free, Sol, Gluscap Labour. New Kuwembaa Labour secedes from the Federation, affecting five systems. President Hudson orders her to abide by constitutional law and redirects the Fortress Liberty megaship to Kuwembaa.

independent-pilots-consortium.name: Independent Pilots Consortium
independent-pilots-consortium.bio: Independent Pilots Consortium is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-01-12 to 3302-01-12. Frequently linked with Adle's Armada, Guardians of Harmony, Utopia.

blood-brothers.name: Blood Brothers
blood-brothers.bio: Blood Brothers is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-03-16 to 3302-03-16. Frequently linked with Adle's Armada, Alrai, Contrail. Competitors included Blood Brothers from Alrai, Ronin of Amarak, Triadius, Contrail, and the Balkan Intergalactic Guerrillas.

auger-vision.name: Auger Vision
auger-vision.bio: Auger Vision is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-09-30 to 3308-09-30. Frequently linked with Pilots Federation, Universal Cartographics, Jick Nackson Enterprises.

liberal-party.name: Liberal Party
liberal-party.bio: Liberal Party is a organization active in Elite Dangerous lore from 3301-06-01 to 3309-02-27. Frequently associated with Sol, Mars. Key activities include: Members of Congress gathered on Mars for Shadow President Zachary Hudson's Vote of No Confidence against the Liberal Administration.; Zachary Hudson won the Vote of No Confidence with 66% of Congress voting to remove the Liberal Administration.
liberal-party.bio_full:
The Liberal Party is a Federal political faction that became embroiled in the Marlinist refugee crisis of late 3306. Vice President Brad Mitchell accused the Liberal Party of inviting NMLA terrorists into Federal communities after the Federal Security Service uncovered nine NMLA members hiding among Marlinist asylum-seekers.

The party's support for refugee resettlement made it a target for anti-immigration rhetoric during a period of heightened fear of Neo-Marlinist infiltration. The Liberal Party's position on the refugee issue highlighted the tension between Federal humanitarian obligations and security concerns, with protestors on several Federal worlds demanding that all refugees be sent back to the Empire while counter-protestors called for welcoming Marlinists as fellow believers in democratic government.

mercenaries-of-mikunn.name: Mercenaries of Mikunn
mercenaries-of-mikunn.bio: Mercenaries of Mikunn is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-06-08 to 3301-07-27. Frequently linked with Sefrys, Dukes of Mikunn, HR 7327. The Dukes of Mikunn mobilised their mercenaries to assist Cerberus Plague-affected systems. Drawing on experience from a similar plague in HR 7327, Mikunn, Sukua, and Sefry, they are moving stockpiled medicine and medical scientists to find the source.

vestani-conservatives.name: Vestani Conservatives
vestani-conservatives.bio: Vestani Conservatives is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-02-09 to 3303-02-16. Frequently linked with Vestani, Rose Terminal. Vestani Conservatives' Valentine's Day appeal concludes successfully with hundreds of pilots delivering commodities to Rose Terminal. Retailer Vestani Conservatives appeals for luxury commodities including Thrutis Cream, Deuringas Truffles and Esuseku Caviar to meet Valentine's Day demand.

technology-brokers.name: Technology brokers
technology-brokers.bio: Technology brokers is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-03-07 to 3304-04-07. Frequently linked with Ram Tah, Guardian drones. He is liaising with technology brokers to manufacture and distribute these devices. Engineer Ram Tah has developed new Guardian-inspired modules now available from technology brokers, following his acquisition of data from Guardian sites.

alliance-elite-diplomatic-corps.name: Alliance Elite Diplomatic Corps
alliance-elite-diplomatic-corps.bio: Alliance Elite Diplomatic Corps is a corporation active in Elite Dangerous lore from 3301-04-26 to 3302-06-30. Frequently associated with Social Eleu Progressive Party, Interstellar Communist Union, The Sovereign. Key activities include: After three weeks of operations, the Alliance Elite Diplomatic Corps returned control of Reorte to an Alliance-aligned faction.; Silver United Solutions deputised 5,535 pilots over a weekend to crush the Zaonce Jet Gang and other pirate crews terrorising the Old Worlds.
alliance-elite-diplomatic-corps.bio_full:
The Alliance Elite Diplomatic Corps is a diplomatic and paramilitary organisation affiliated with the Alliance that operates to secure Alliance interests across disputed territories. In July 3301, Victoria Wolf VI of Wolf 406 Transport Co and Commodore Helena Stone of the Alliance Defence Force — both board members of the Alliance Elite Diplomatic Corps — launched Operation Augeas, a campaign to rid BD-22 3573 of criminal elements troubling local miners and traders.

The operation offered bounty bonuses for all bounties cashed at Planck Orbital, with the ADF observing the situation and intervening only in case of escalation, as the system did not fall under Alliance jurisdiction. The Corps has also been involved in returning control of systems such as Reorte to Alliance-aligned factions and deputising pilots to combat pirate crews terrorising the Old Worlds. The Alliance Elite Diplomatic Corps represents the Alliance's preferred approach to conflict: diplomatic engagement backed by measured military support, in contrast to the Empire's overt imperialism or the Federation's corporate-driven interventions.

iridium-wing.name: Iridium Wing
iridium-wing.bio: Iridium Wing is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-11-05 to 3302-11-05. Frequently linked with 9th Legion, Colonia Citizens Network, SEPP.

nijotec-syndicate.name: Nijotec Syndicate
nijotec-syndicate.bio: Nijotec Syndicate is a criminal in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-02-20 to 3301-02-20. Frequently linked with Federal Navy, Sol, Nijotec. Nijotec, home to 21,500 people, was once rich in minerals but has been strip-mined to near exhaustion. The Lycan Moon Mining Corporation's abandonment of the region allowed the Syndicate to flourish.

balones-gold-touch-systems.name: Balones Gold Touch Systems
balones-gold-touch-systems.bio: Balones Gold Touch Systems is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-01-05 to 3303-01-12. Frequently linked with Tiedemann Dock, Balones, Synuefe. Balones Gold Touch Systems appeals for mined osmium, praseodymium, and methanol monohydrate crystals to develop advanced deep-space probes, citing alien shipwrecks and Synuefe ruins as motivation. Balones Gold Touch Systems' appeal for materials to build deep-space probes concludes successfully.

reorte-mining-coalition.name: Reorte Mining Coalition
reorte-mining-coalition.bio: Reorte Mining Coalition is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-12-12 to 3305-12-12. Frequently linked with Alliance, Reorte. The Alliance hosts end-of-year festivities in the Reorte system, with billions of attendees expected.

federal-state-police.name: Federal State Police
federal-state-police.bio: Federal State Police is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-10 to 3301-08-10. Frequently linked with Judas Syndicate, Jackson’s Lighthouse, Beta Hydri. This article profiles bounty hunter Ziva Eschel, who began her career in the Federal State Police as a Viper pilot in Beta Hydri.

social-falisci-partnership-party.name: Social Falisci Partnership Party
social-falisci-partnership-party.bio: Social Falisci Partnership Party is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-07 to 3301-03-07. Frequently linked with Phillips Landing, Falisci Purple Gang, Ngaiawang. Senator Patreus and the Citizens of Tradition successfully defeated the Falisci Purple Gang, assimilating Falisci into Imperial society. However, civil war is brewing between the Citizens of Tradition and the Federal Social Falisci Partnership Party over Phillips Landing, potentially allowing Federation control.

hallowed-chapter-of-lhs-2094.name: Hallowed Chapter of LHS 2094
hallowed-chapter-of-lhs-2094.bio: Hallowed Chapter of LHS 2094 is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-10-27 to 3303-10-27. Frequently linked with Patterson Vision, Maia, LHS 2094. The Hallowed Chapter of LHS 2094 is hosting the galaxy's biggest Halloween party, featuring apple bobbing and other festivities.

workers-of-gooheimar-alliance.name: Workers of Gooheimar Alliance
workers-of-gooheimar-alliance.bio: Workers of Gooheimar Alliance is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-08-04 to 3302-08-05. Frequently linked with Gooheimar, Brady Horizons, Federation. Pilots are requested to deliver autofabricators, tantalum, and superconductors to Brady Horizons in the Gooheimar system.

republican-party.name: Republican Party
republican-party.bio: The Republican Party is one of the two major political parties in the Federation, alongside the Liberal Party. It advocates for military expansion, corporate alignment, and strong executive power. President Zachary Hudson is its most prominent leader.
republican-party.bio_full: The Republican Party is one of the Federation's two major political parties, alongside the Liberal Party led by Shadow President Felicia Winters. Republicans advocate for increased military spending, corporate alignment, and strong executive authority. President Zachary Hudson has been the party's dominant figure since 3301, steering its agenda toward militarism and security expansion. The party has faced internal dissent over Hudson's more authoritarian measures, including his attempt to remove the eight-year presidential term limit in 3308. Despite this, analysts believe Hudson maintains the support of his Cabinet and a majority of Republican congressmen.

marlinist-constabulary.name: Marlinist Constabulary
marlinist-constabulary.bio: Marlinist Constabulary is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-06-14 to 3307-06-14. Frequently linked with Alliance Interpol, NMLA, Imperial Internal Security Service.

narri-justice-party.name: Narri Justice Party
narri-justice-party.bio: A local faction in the Narri system, the Narri Justice Party oversaw construction of a Utopian military installation to defend the Sim-Archive from Thargoid attack in mid-3304.
narri-justice-party.bio_full:
In May 3304, the Narri Justice Party assumed responsibility for one of Utopia's most strategically sensitive projects: constructing a military installation to defend the Sim-Archive from potential Thargoid attack. The Sim-Archive, which contained the digitised consciousness patterns of Utopian citizens, represented a unique cultural and technological asset that Pranav Antal was determined to protect at all costs.

The Justice Party coordinated material deliveries to Bobko City and organised trader protection against pirate raids that sought to exploit the construction traffic. Their connections to Aegis and the Imperial Internal Security Service hinted at broader defensive coordination beyond Utopia's usual isolationist posture. The Narri Justice Party's role demonstrated how even local factions could be drawn into galaxy-spanning strategic concerns when their territory housed assets of universal significance.

federal-navy.name: Federal Navy
federal-navy.bio: The Federal Navy is the military arm of the Federation, operating capital ships and fighter squadrons across Federal space. Its flagship is the Farragut Battle Cruiser, a two-kilometre-long warship capable of carrying multiple Corvettes and fighter squadrons. The Navy suffered a historic humiliation at the Battle of Achenar (2325) and later became embroiled in the Starship One conspiracy, when Fleet Admiral Lucas Vincent conspired with Core Dynamics CEO Jupiter Rochester to assassinate President Jasmina Halsey in 3301. It operates under civilian control through the Federal Congress.
federal-navy.bio_full:
The Federal Navy traces its origins to the Federation's founding in 2242. It suffered a historic humiliation at the Battle of Achenar in 2325, where an expeditionary fleet was annihilated by Henson Duval's forces — a defeat that ensured the Empire's independence and prompted the Federal capital's relocation to Mars.

By the 34th century, the Navy's pinnacle vessel is the Farragut Battle Cruiser, a two-kilometre-long capital ship whose deployment is generally sufficient to end all but the largest engagements. Its relationship with civilian government has been fraught: during the Lugh campaign in 3301, President Halsey's order to attack an unarmed refugee convoy killed an estimated 9,322 civilians, causing senior commanders to shift loyalty to Zachary Hudson. Fleet Admiral Lucas Vincent's subsequent conspiracy with Core Dynamics CEO Jupiter Rochester to destroy Starship One — exposed in 3307 — further damaged the Navy's reputation.

During the Thargoid conflicts, the Federal Navy contributed to Aegis and later operated independent anti-xeno task forces after Aegis's dissolution in 3308. It remains the dominant military power in Federal space, though its association with the Hudson administration's controversial policies continues to shadow its standing.

alliance-of-independent-systems.name: Alliance of Independent Systems
alliance-of-independent-systems.bio: The governing body of the Alliance in early 3301, the Alliance of Independent Systems under Prime Minister Edmund Mahon maintained strict neutrality during the Lugh secession crisis.
alliance-of-independent-systems.bio_full:
In March 3301, Prime Minister Edmund Mahon delivered a blunt message to the Crimson State Group and other Lugh separatists: the Alliance would not intervene in Federal governance of the system. Mahon stated that no laws had been broken and no rights abused, and he declared that until Lugh fully seceded from the Federation, any application to join the Alliance would be automatically rejected.

The position reflected both the Alliance's legalistic approach to inter-superpower relations and its strategic caution. Unlike the Empire, which might have exploited Federal weakness to expand its influence, the Alliance of Independent Systems under Mahon prioritised stable diplomatic boundaries over territorial opportunism. The stance disappointed Lugh separatists who had hoped for Alliance backing, but it preserved the superpower's reputation for principled non-intervention — a reputation that would later attract systems seeking refuge from Imperial and Federal internal conflicts.

military-militia.name: Military Militia
military-militia.bio: Military Militia is a naval in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-03-09 to 3303-03-16. Frequently linked with XI-2 Lupi, Pellegrino Hub. The Military Militia's appeal for construction materials concluded successfully.

taskforce-athena.name: Taskforce Athena
taskforce-athena.bio: Taskforce Athena is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-07-11 to 3302-07-11. Frequently linked with Future of Segovan, Federal Security Service, Ramsbottom Hub. A coalition of Empire-aligned commanders known as Taskforce Athena has declared the Segovan system a no-fly zone and placed Ramsbottom Hub in lockdown.

league-of-zearla.name: League of Zearla
league-of-zearla.bio: League of Zearla is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-01-03 to 3305-01-10. Frequently linked with Federal Navy, Sirsir, Imperial Navy. The League of Zearla and Sirsir Co run parallel military supply campaigns for the Federal and Imperial navies respectively, delivering battle weapons, armour and supplies.

federal-grand-lottery.name: Federal Grand Lottery
federal-grand-lottery.bio: Federal Grand Lottery is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-07-14 to 3304-08-17. Frequently linked with Federal Times, Rackham Capital Investments. The Federal Grand Lottery launches an appeal to find the owner of an unclaimed one billion credit Galactic Jackpot ticket. Spokesperson Tori Theopolis asks citizens to check with lottery players they know.

didiomanja-emperors-grace.name: Didiomanja Emperor's Grace
didiomanja-emperors-grace.bio: An Imperial faction active in the Didiomanja system, Didiomanja Emperor's Grace established the Tiverion Academy flight school for naval cadets in July 3304.
didiomanja-emperors-grace.bio_full:
In July 3304, the Didiomanja Emperor's Grace faction completed construction of the Tiverion Academy, a dedicated flight school designed to train the next generation of Imperial naval cadets. The inaugural banquet at Leydenfrost Dock drew dignitaries from across the Empire, celebrating an institution that promised to combine rigorous combat training with the philosophical indoctrination expected of Imperial officers.

The Academy's successful conclusion represented more than a construction milestone; it demonstrated the faction's capacity to secure long-term investment in military education even as the Empire faced existential threats from both the Thargoids and internal dissent. By aligning itself with the broader Emperor's Grace network, the Didiomanja faction ensured its cadets would graduate with connections that extended far beyond their home system, embedding themselves within the Empire's military aristocracy from their first day of training.

arque-commodities.name: Arque Commodities
arque-commodities.bio: Arque Commodities is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-08-18 to 3302-08-25. Frequently linked with Arque, Austen Town Station. Authorities in the Arque system report a sharp increase in criminal activity disrupting trade. Arque Commodities has issued a kill order on wanted ships and will reward pilots who deliver bounty vouchers to Austen Town Station.

intergalactic-naval-reserve-arm.name: Intergalactic Naval Reserve Arm
intergalactic-naval-reserve-arm.bio: The Intergalactic Naval Reserve Arm (INRA) was a joint Federal-Imperial initiative established in the 3100s to address Thargoid incursions into human space. It developed chemical weapons including the mycoid fungus designed to target Thargoid technology, and tested them on living Thargoid specimens. The organisation was disbanded and its activities covered up for centuries. abandoned planetary outpost controlled by the Intergalactic Naval Reserve Arm (INRA) has been discovered in the Hermitage system.
intergalactic-naval-reserve-arm.bio_full:
The Intergalactic Naval Reserve Arm (INRA) was a secret joint military initiative established by the Federation and Empire in 3125 to combat the Thargoids during the First Thargoid War. Tasked with identifying and exploiting Thargoid weaknesses by any means necessary, INRA operated outside normal military oversight and public accountability.

In 3308, an abandoned INRA outpost was discovered in the Hermitage system, revealing the organisation's continued existence in secret facilities. The discovery reignited interest in INRA's history, particularly its role in developing the mycoid bioweapon that ended the First Thargoid War. Evidence later linked INRA to Azimuth Biochemicals and the mysterious figure known as Salvation, suggesting that the organisation's xenological weapons research had continued for two centuries in the shadows of galactic politics.

frontline-solutions.name: Frontline Solutions
frontline-solutions.bio: Frontline Solutions is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-12-26 to 3308-06-24. Frequently linked with none specified, Hind Mine, INRA. A cryptic poem attributed to the Winking Cat references Frontline Solutions and the mercenary industry, promising rewards for those who solve the riddle.

kumo-council.name: Kumo Council
kumo-council.bio: Kumo Council is a government active in Elite Dangerous lore from 3307-04-15 to 3311-06-12. Frequently associated with Pilots Federation, Pegasi Sector PN-T c3-14, Kumo Crew. Key activities include: The Kumo Crew syndicate launches a campaign to construct up to five new Orbis starports in uninhabited systems near key trading regions.; The Kumo Crew's starport construction campaign concludes successfully.
kumo-council.bio_full:
The Kumo Council is the ruling body of the Kumo Crew syndicate, formed by pirate warlord Archon Delaine to delegate control over his criminal empire. Each member of the council holds the title of corsair and oversees a region or system within Kumo territory, while Delaine's most trusted advisers — known as arch-corsairs — work with him on strategic goals.

In April 3308, Delaine appointed Callan Salamanca as a new arch-corsair following the death of his father Gideon "Soulless" Salamanca, one of the most infamous warlords in the Pegasi sector. The council's inner circle at that time included Vidar Trask, an expert administrator who had been close to Delaine for many years, and Kay Volantyne, originally part of the Blue Viper Club Dredger clan before negotiating its alliance with the Kumo Crew. The council has also assumed control of systems invaded by Thargoids, coordinating anti-xeno initiatives from the Mictlan megaship in the California Nebula — a move that Harrison Gladstone of the Turner Research Group condemned as an illegal occupation of Allied territory. Delaine's use of the Kumo Council reinforces his self-styled position as "sovereign ruler of the Kumo nation," though the council is frequently called upon to justify or deny their regent's brutal excesses.

federal-liberal-party.name: Federal Liberal Party
federal-liberal-party.bio: Federal Liberal Party is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-06-10 to 3301-06-12. Frequently linked with Oduduro, Sirius Corporation, Tascheter.

broadcast-cobra.name: Broadcast Cobra
broadcast-cobra.bio: An independent media organisation active in late 3304, Broadcast Cobra sought to revolutionise galactic journalism by constructing a mobile broadcasting megaship capable of reaching frontier systems.
broadcast-cobra.bio_full:
In October 3304, Broadcast Cobra announced an ambitious plan to construct a megaship in the HIP 16038 system that would serve as a mobile broadcasting studio. Journalist Alessandra Koa, speaking for the organisation, explained that the vessel would allow transmission to systems beyond the reach of conventional broadcasters — a significant expansion of media access for frontier populations routinely ignored by the major networks based in Sol and Achenar.

The project attracted support from both the Alliance and Federal Security Service, suggesting that even official institutions recognised the value of independent media infrastructure. Though the megaship's operational lifespan proved brief, Broadcast Cobra's model inspired later efforts to decentralise galactic news distribution. The organisation demonstrated that journalism in the 34th century required mobility as much as credibility, and that the farthest systems had stories worth telling.

gyvatices-crimson-advanced-holdings.name: Gyvatices Crimson Advanced Holdings
gyvatices-crimson-advanced-holdings.bio: Gyvatices Crimson Advanced Holdings is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-10-20 to 3302-10-27. Frequently linked with Gyvatices, Walter Dock, Wonderful Walter's Fish and Coffee Emporium.

candy-crew-guild.name: Candy Crew Guild
candy-crew-guild.bio: A criminal faction with unorthodox ambitions, the Candy Crew Guild combined illegal activities with legitimate racing and scientific endeavours between 3302 and 3303.
candy-crew-guild.bio_full:
The Candy Crew Guild defied easy categorisation as a criminal organisation. While firmly classified as illegal, its activities ranged from traditional smuggling to sponsoring Buckyball racers — including Commander Nookie Mr.Smith, who led the Kick The Alien race at its midpoint, followed by fellow guild members Raijiin and Rewision. This dual identity allowed the faction to operate in plain sight while maintaining profitable criminal sidelines.

In late 3303, the Guild announced even more ambitious plans: establishing a capital shipyard and scientific research vessel in the Irusan system. The proposal suggested long-term strategic thinking unusual for criminal organisations, positioning the Candy Crew Guild as a faction that sought legitimacy through infrastructure rather than through political alliances. Whether the shipyard was ever completed remains unclear, but the announcement alone demonstrated how the boundaries between criminal and corporate enterprise had blurred in the frontier systems of the early 3300s.

nova-imperium.name: Nova Imperium
nova-imperium.bio: Nova Imperium is a organization active in Elite Dangerous lore from 3304-11-01 to 3308-02-21. Frequently associated with Paresa. Key activities include: Weekly summary covering the conclusion of the Fazia Silva homicide investigation with no convictions and Tashmira Silva assuming control of her sis...; Nova Imperium broadcasts a message to Imperial citizens via public media.
nova-imperium.bio_full:
Nova Imperium is an isolationist movement that challenged the Empire's traditional engagement with the galaxy, founded by Kaeso Mordanticus and claiming Imperator Hadrian Duval — the illegitimate grandson of Emperor Hengist — as its figurehead. The group argued that the Empire should withdraw from foreign wars and focus on internal strength, a position that drew support from senators disillusioned with Arissa Lavigny-Duval's aggressive policies. In 3305, Imperial forces defeated Nova Imperium in the Battle of Paresa, and Mordanticus was executed by Senator Denton Patreus on the Senate floor.

The movement survived its founder's death, with Hadrian Duval eventually seeking reintegration into the Imperial Family as Prince Hadrian. An NMLA assassination attempt in 3306 nearly killed him, but Princess Aisling Duval's intervention saved his life and paved the way for his acceptance as a legitimate Duval heir. Though Nova Imperium as an armed insurrection was crushed, its isolationist ideology continues to influence Imperial political discourse.

wolf-359.name: Wolf 359
wolf-359.bio: Wolf 359 is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-05-19 to 3302-05-19. Frequently linked with Hutton Orbital Truckers, Wyrd system, Lomas Station. Pirate leader Don Antonaci of Wolf 359 calls for an 'anything goes' battle royale against the Hutton Orbital Truckers in the Wyrd system.

fuel-rats.name: Fuel Rats
fuel-rats.bio: Fuel Rats is a organization active in Elite Dangerous lore from 3301-06-24 to 3303-01-12. Frequently associated with Pilots Federation, Sagittarius A*, Fuel Rats Mischief. Key activities include: Jaques Station, the galaxy's only travelling starport, prepares for an ambitious long-distance jump from Gliese 1269 to Beagle Point.; The Fuel Rats announce that Jaques Station has received sufficient fuel for its proposed jump to Beagle Point.
fuel-rats.bio_full:
The Fuel Rats are an independent search-and-rescue collective of volunteer pilots dedicated to saving commanders stranded without fuel in deep space. Founded in June 3301 and formally recognised by the Pilots Federation, the group patrols the outer fringes of civilisation to provide emergency refuelling before life support fails. At the time of their founding, an estimated 63% of deep space losses were attributed to fuel exhaustion, making their humanitarian mission critical to explorers and traders alike.

The collective rapidly expanded from anarchic beginnings into a highly organised cooperative. They completed their 1,000th rescue by August 3301, reached 10,000 by April 3302, and celebrated their 20,000th rescue in January 3303. Operating with a success rate exceeding 95%, they have conducted complex relay operations thousands of light years from civilisation, including rescues near Sagittarius A* and during the search for Jaques Station. The Fuel Rats maintain strict neutrality, serving all pilots regardless of allegiance.

eotienses-silver-universal-plc.name: Eotienses Silver Universal PLC
eotienses-silver-universal-plc.bio: Eotienses Silver Universal PLC is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-04-20 to 3301-04-20. Frequently linked with Friends of Kui Hsien, Conservatives of BV Phoenicis, Kui Hsien.

lavignys-legion.name: Lavigny's Legion
lavignys-legion.bio: Lavigny's Legion is a organization active in Elite Dangerous lore from 3301-06-08 to 3308-09-29. Frequently associated with Kumo Crew, Kamadhenu, Imperial Navy. Key activities include: Princess Aisling Duval launches a fundraiser in Cemiess, requesting rare luxury items to fund the Citizens' Relief Trust supporting families of Imp...; Senators Patreus and Lavigny-Duval launched a united Imperial offensive against the Kumo Crew after Cuchua came under attack.
lavignys-legion.bio_full:
Lavigny's Legion is an Imperial military force loyal to Senator Arissa Lavigny-Duval, formed from her supporters and retainers to project her power both within Imperial territory and abroad. The Legion played a significant role in Operation Davy Jones — the Imperial offensive into the Pegasi Sector to combat Archon Delaine's Kumo Crew piracy — while simultaneously conducting anti-corruption operations in home systems such as Kamadhenu.

The Legion's dual mandate of external military intervention and internal security enforcement exemplifies the Imperial patronage system, whereby powerful senators maintain private military capabilities independent of the formal Imperial Navy chain of command. Under Arissa's direction, Lavigny's Legion replaced corrupt and repressive local governments with traditional patronages in several systems, demonstrating how Imperial power politics operates through a combination of military force and personal loyalty networks.

federal-security-service.name: Federal Security Service
federal-security-service.bio: The Federal Security Service is the Federation's domestic intelligence agency, responsible for counter-terrorism, internal surveillance and protecting Federal institutions from subversion.
federal-security-service.bio_full:
The Federal Security Service (FSS) is the Federation's domestic intelligence agency, responsible for counter-terrorism, internal surveillance, and protecting Federal institutions from subversion. Operating under the authority of the President and Congress, the FSS has broad powers to monitor civilian communications, investigate threats, and coordinate with Federal law enforcement. Its jurisdiction covers all Federal systems, making it one of the most powerful security organisations in the galaxy.

The FSS gained notoriety during the Nine Martyrs crisis when it established the Proactive Detection Bureau, a mass surveillance programme that scans billions of civilian communications for terrorist activity. While the FSS defended the PDB as essential for national security, civil liberties groups and the Federal Times condemned it as unconstitutional overreach. The agency's close relationship with the Mars Tribune and other corporate media outlets has also raised concerns about the blurring of intelligence and propaganda in Federal politics.

ant-hill-mob.name: Ant Hill Mob
ant-hill-mob.bio: Ant Hill Mob is a organization active in Elite Dangerous lore from 3302-10-27 to 3302-11-17. Frequently associated with Pleiades Resource Enterprise, Maia, Obsidian Orbital. Key activities include: The Ant Hill Mob, Maia's controlling faction, launched an offensive against the Pleiades Resource Enterprise after the Federation stationed a Farra...; The Pleiades Resource Enterprise has successfully overcome resistance from the Ant Hill Mob to gain a foothold in the Maia system.
ant-hill-mob.bio_full:
The Ant Hill Mob is an independent faction that has repeatedly challenged the Pleiades Resource Enterprise's control of the Maia system in the Pleiades Nebula. In November 3302, the Mob instigated a military campaign designed to weaken the Federal-aligned Enterprise's position in Maia, with hundreds of independent pilots supporting the effort by targeting PRE fighters and delivering battle weapons to system security forces.

Despite sustained independent opposition, the Pleiades Resource Enterprise maintained its position and emerged victorious from the conflict. A PRE spokesperson declared that "the galactic community supports our position in Maia" and that "the Ant Hill Mob needs to accept that the Pleiades Resource Enterprise is here to stay." The Ant Hill Mob's resistance represented one of the early attempts by independent factions to contest Federal expansion into the Pleiades — a region that would soon become the epicentre of the Thargoid conflict and one of the most strategically contested sectors in the galaxy.

mehet-ltd.name: Mehet Ltd
mehet-ltd.bio: Mehet Ltd is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-06-02 to 3302-06-09. Frequently linked with Mehet, Schwann Dock, Pilots Federation. Mehet Ltd announces the successful conclusion of its campaign to clear the Mehet system of criminals and agitators, with hundreds of Pilots Federation commanders responding to the appeal.

80-dd-d-774-ce-2-faction.name: 80 DD-D 774-CE-2 faction
80-dd-d-774-ce-2-faction.bio: 80 DD-D 774-CE-2 faction is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-09-01 to 3302-09-02. Frequently linked with Jaques Station, Eol Prou RS-T d3-94.

darkwater-inc.name: Darkwater Inc
darkwater-inc.bio: Darkwater Inc is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-02-17 to 3308-02-17. Frequently linked with NMLA, Imperial Navy, Summerland. The Empire declares Darkwater Inc a hostile military target for abducting Emperor Arissa.

chimechilo-empire-league.name: Chimechilo Empire League
chimechilo-empire-league.bio: Chimechilo Empire League is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-09-15 to 3302-09-15. Frequently linked with Obotrima, Thoreau Orbital, Obotrima Organisation. Federal intelligence has uncovered an Imperial plot by the Chimechilo Empire League to destabilise Thoreau Orbital in Obotrima by flooding it with explosives.

tenche-universal-holdings.name: Tenche Universal Holdings
tenche-universal-holdings.bio: Tenche Universal Holdings is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3306-09-17 to 3306-09-17. Frequently linked with Kavanagh Spaceframes Ltd, Steel Castle Inc, Pilots Federation.

sons-of-conn.name: Sons of Conn
sons-of-conn.bio: Sons of Conn is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-24 to 3301-03-26. Frequently linked with Crimson State Group, Lugh, Lugh for Equality. The Crimson State Group and Sons of Conn captured Hartsfield Market from the Lugh for Equality Party in a devastating blow for the Federation. Federal pilots dominated the skies initially, with the Sons of Conn suffering heavy casualties.

kuiper-mining-inc.name: Kuiper Mining Inc.
kuiper-mining-inc.bio: Kuiper Mining Inc. is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-10-05 to 3304-10-05. Frequently linked with Achilles Corporation, Federal Security Service, Columbus Station. Two owners are identified: Don Zhao, CEO of Kuiper Mining Inc., and Anya Blackriver, a public-relations consultant.

colonia-research-division.name: Colonia Research Division
colonia-research-division.bio: Colonia Research Division is a research in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-08-17 to 3304-08-24. Frequently linked with Colonia Council, Randgnid, Templar Barracks. Colonia authorities decide to build a state-of-the-art hydroponics facility due to research projecting possible food shortages. The Colonia Research Division asks pilots to deliver mined resources to Templar Barracks in the Randgnid system.

eg-pilots.name: EG Pilots
eg-pilots.bio: EG Pilots is a organization active in Elite Dangerous lore from 3302-06-09 to 3304-03-23. Frequently associated with Social Eleu Progressive Party, The Sovereign, GalCop. Key activities include: Yuri Grom has announced an initiative to create a new shipyard in the CPC 20 6743 system to produce capital ships for defending human space from hu...; The EG Pilots received the largest quantity of gold in the first Dangerous Games Wildcard event, though ultimate victory will not be determined unt...
eg-pilots.bio_full:
EG Pilots is an independent pilot faction that won the Dangerous Games Wildcard competition in June 3302, earning the right to compete against five major factions for official power status. The group accumulated the most conductive fabrics across three heats of the competition, demonstrating their ability to attract considerable support from the independent pilot community.

Following their wildcard victory, EG Pilots entered the main Dangerous Games to compete with the Alliance Elite Diplomatic Corps, Border Coalition, GalCop, Interstellar Communist Union and Social Eleu Progressive Party. Reporter Trinity Avon of The Sovereign noted that while EG Pilots had proven their organisational capacity, the true test would be whether they could challenge established powers for a permanent place among the galaxy's most influential factions.

federal-republican-association.name: Federal Republican Association
federal-republican-association.bio: Federal Republican Association is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-06-02 to 3301-06-10. Frequently linked with Liberal Party, Sol. Even known Liberal supporters voted against their own leadership, reflecting Halsey's unpopularity and the Federal government's declining support among frontier systems. The Federal Republican Association gained massive support, signalling a more aggressive decision-making stance from Mars.

adad-exchange.name: Adad Exchange
adad-exchange.bio: Adad Exchange is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-02-16 to 3303-02-23. Frequently linked with Sutekh, United Sutekh Future, Federation. A Federal convoy is destroyed in the Sutekh system and the Imperial faction Adad Exchange attempts to recover military intelligence from the wreckage. United Sutekh Future triumphs over the Adad Exchange in the Sutekh system, preventing Imperial forces from recovering sensitive Federal military intelligence from a destroyed convoy.

kavanagh-spaceframes-ltd.name: Kavanagh Spaceframes Ltd
kavanagh-spaceframes-ltd.bio: An independent construction firm specialising in Orbis starports, Kavanagh Spaceframes Ltd has been contracted for major infrastructure projects by both legitimate corporations and criminal syndicates.
kavanagh-spaceframes-ltd.bio_full:
Kavanagh Spaceframes Ltd is an independent construction company specialising in the design and assembly of Orbis-class starports. In late 3306, the firm partnered with Brewer Corporation and Steel Castle Inc to upgrade refinery outposts into fully functional starports, a project aimed at improving refuelling access for the growing fleet carrier market.

The company's expertise in orbital habitat construction attracted further attention in 3307, when the Kumo Crew syndicate privately contracted Kavanagh Spaceframes to build up to five new Orbis stations in strategically significant regions including the California Nebula, Coalsack Nebula, and Colonia. This contract demonstrated the firm's willingness to work across the political spectrum, from legitimate corporate partnerships to criminal syndicate projects.

alliance-salvage-guild.name: Alliance Salvage Guild
alliance-salvage-guild.bio: Alliance Salvage Guild is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3306-10-29 to 3307-04-08. Frequently linked with Pilots Federation, Chukchan, HIP 64011. The Alliance Salvage Guild investigates.

thargoid-advocacy-project.name: Thargoid Advocacy Project
thargoid-advocacy-project.bio: Thargoid Advocacy Project is a organization in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-09-06 to 3308-09-14. Frequently linked with The Sovereign, HIP 22460, Proactive Detection Bureau. A grassroots xeno-peace movement gains traction following the Battle of HIP 22460, promoting diplomatic dialogue with Thargoids through media figures like Joy Senne and Heimar Borichev. Xeno-peace activist Timothy Culver argues that Thargoid incursions are defensive reprisals for the Proteus Wave and mycoid bioweapon, calling for diplomatic dialogue rather than military action.

carmack-intergalactic-mining-association.name: Carmack Intergalactic Mining Association
carmack-intergalactic-mining-association.bio: An independent mining consortium active in early 3302, the Carmack Intergalactic Mining Association organised a prospectors' competition that doubled the number of known pristine metallic ring locations.
carmack-intergalactic-mining-association.bio_full:
The Carmack Intergalactic Mining Association understood that exploration and commerce were two sides of the same coin. In February 3302, Benjamin Gorrister launched an initiative calling on pilots to discover pristine metallic ring locations — asteroid fields rich in valuable minerals that had not yet been exploited by major mining corporations. The response exceeded all expectations.

By May, Maxim "VicTic" Kammerer announced that the CIMA prospectors' competition had doubled the number of known pristine metallic ring locations in galactic databases. The achievement represented a triumph of crowdsourced cartography, demonstrating how independent pilots could advance collective knowledge faster than corporate survey teams operating within traditional hierarchies. The Association's work fundamentally expanded the economic map of the galaxy, identifying new resource frontiers that would support decades of subsequent mining operations.

federal-navy-criminal-court.name: Federal Navy Criminal Court
