## Description

Mictlan is a populous Imperial industrial system with over 32 million inhabitants. In 3309, the Kumo Crew megaship of the same name was deployed to the California Nebula to coordinate anti-Thargoid defence operations, though the Turner Research Group accused Archon Delaine of using the crisis as a pretext for territorial expansion.

The system itself has a medium-security environment with an industrial and extraction economy, controlled by the G.O.M. Collective. Mictlan's dual identity as both an Imperial system and the namesake of a Kumo Crew megaship illustrates the complex overlap between legitimate governance and criminal enterprise in the galaxy's border regions.

lesheima.name: Lesheima
lesheima.bio: Lesheima is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3308-04-28 to 3308-05-12.

eranin.name: Eranin
eranin.bio: Eranin is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3301-06-10 to 3302-04-01. Associated with Alliance. Following the failed Federal invasion of Eranin in late 3300, Federal and Alliance campaigners clashed politically in the Dahan sector.

moon-prospect.name: Moon Prospect
moon-prospect.bio: Moon Prospect is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3302-07-18 to 3302-07-18. Associated with Buckyball Racing Club, Ex Luna Scientia.

hip-62154.name: HIP 62154
hip-62154.bio: An Alliance corporate system in the Coalsack Nebula, HIP 62154 was selected as one of five locations for new Kumo Crew starports in 3307.
hip-62154.bio_full:
HIP 62154 is an Alliance corporate system with an industrial economy, controlled by the Alliance Expeditionary Pact faction. In April 3307, Archon Delaine's Kumo Council selected it as one of five sites for new Orbis starports, a choice that placed criminal infrastructure deep within Alliance territory in the Coalsack Nebula.

The system's selection was notable for its strategic significance — the Coalsack Nebula was rapidly becoming a focal point of human expansion and Thargoid activity alike. When Kavanagh Spaceframes Ltd completed construction in May 3307, the new starport gave the Kumo Crew a permanent foothold in a region traditionally outside their sphere of influence, demonstrating Delaine's ambition to extend pirate power across the galaxy.

orcus-crag.name: Orcus Crag
orcus-crag.bio: Orcus Crag is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3304-03-02 to 3304-03-04. Associated with Empire.

pellegrino-hub.name: Pellegrino Hub
pellegrino-hub.bio: Pellegrino Hub is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3303-03-09 to 3303-03-16. Associated with Military Militia.

kappa-fornacis.name: Kappa Fornacis
kappa-fornacis.bio: Kappa Fornacis is a system in Elite Dangerous, significant from 3301-02-24 to 3307-07-20. Associated with Kappa Fornacis Farmers Union. Notable events include: Federal Congress shows rare unity as members rally around President Zachary Hudson following reports of Thargoid attacks in the Pleiades.; Six months after Onionhead was made illegal in Federal space, the Federation launched a violent campaign against Kappa Fornacis farmers led by Geor...
kappa-fornacis.bio_full:
Kappa Fornacis is a Federal system best known as the ancestral home of the Onionhead narcotic trade. The Kappa Fornacis Farmers Union has cultivated the crop for generations, resisting Federal prohibition efforts with a defiant independence ethos. In 3301, union representative Georgio Algeria publicly declared "you can't stop the crop" as Onionhead sales resumed around Panem, defying President Halsey's administration and provoking demands for military intervention from Shadow President Hudson.

The system's resistance to Federal drug policy made Kappa Fornacis a symbol of the limitations of superpower authority over local agricultural economies. Despite repeated crackdowns, the Farmers Union maintained production by exploiting jurisdictional gaps and the logistical challenges of policing billions of cubic kilometres of space. Kappa Fornacis remains synonymous with the Onionhead conflict — one of the most persistent law enforcement challenges in Federal history.

onnes-gateway.name: Onnes Gateway
onnes-gateway.bio: Onnes Gateway is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3302-02-04 to 3302-05-20. Associated with Paladin Consortium, Diamond Frogs. Ackerman Market, Gabriel Enterprise, Weyn Dock, and Onnes Gateway are now fully operational, while other stations remain affected. The Paladin Consortium liberated Imperial slaves at Onnes Gateway in LFT 37 but bureaucratic delays prevent them from legally obtaining housing or employment.
onnes-gateway.bio_full: Onnes Gateway is a starport in the LFT 37 system that was affected by the technological plague of 3302, when Unknown Artefact interference disabled station systems across inhabited space. The station was among those restored to full operational status after the crisis. The starport also gained attention when the Paladin Consortium liberated Imperial slaves there, though bureaucratic delays prevented the freed individuals from legally obtaining housing or employment — highlighting the gap between humanitarian ideals and bureaucratic reality in Federal systems.

muller-terminal.name: Muller Terminal
muller-terminal.bio: Muller Terminal is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3309-05-25 to 3309-09-14. Associated with Aegis, Sirius Corporation.

redi-market.name: Redi Market
redi-market.bio: Redi Market is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3304-04-06 to 3304-04-15. Associated with Atlas Corporation, Aegis, Pegasi Sector security forces. Hundreds of pilots delivered commodities to Redi Market and eliminated agitators in Lambda Arae to protect traders.

beagle-2-landing.name: Beagle 2 Landing
beagle-2-landing.bio: Beagle 2 Landing is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3303-07-07 to 3303-07-07. Associated with Pilots Federation.

effinger-port.name: Effinger Port
effinger-port.bio: Effinger Port is a starport in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3301-02-17 to 3301-02-26. Associated with Furbaide CDC. A rapid response team has been established aboard Effinger Port in Furbaide to find a cure. Dr Miriam Fletcher, head of the Furbaide CDC, requested that anyone shipping basic medicines divert to Effinger Port to donate supplies needed to stop the Blight's spread.

kandulas-truth.name: Kandula's Truth
kandulas-truth.bio: Kandula's Truth is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3308-04-13 to 3308-04-13. Associated with Alliance, Sirius Corporation.

hip-22550.name: HIP 22550
hip-22550.bio: HIP 22550 is a system in Elite Dangerous, significant from 3307-07-15 to 3308-04-21. Associated with NMLA. Notable events include: The NMLA bombs Stillman Hub in HIP 22550 and Tilman Point in Hyades Sector RO-P b6-6, killing tens of thousands.; The Steel Majesty megaship is transferred from Mudhrid to HIP 22550, renamed Fairfax Vision, and becomes the Marlinist Colonies' diplomatic flagship.
hip-22550.bio_full:
HIP 22550 is an independent system that became a tragic symbol of NMLA terrorism and later a cornerstone of the Marlinist Colonies' diplomatic infrastructure. In July 3307, the NMLA bombed Stillman Hub in HIP 22550 along with Tilman Point in Hyades Sector RO-P b6-6, killing tens of thousands in one of the most devastating coordinated attacks of the terrorist campaign.

By April 3308, the system had been transformed into a diplomatic hub when the Steel Majesty megaship was transferred from Mudhrid to HIP 22550, renamed Fairfax Vision, and designated as the Marlinist Colonies' diplomatic flagship. The transition from terrorist target to diplomatic centre exemplified the complex evolution of Marlinist politics — from the extremist violence of the NMLA to the diplomatic engagement of the Marlinist Consulate under Prime Consul Kayode Tau. HIP 22550's dual history as both a site of mass casualty terrorism and a seat of interstellar diplomacy reflects the turbulent political realignments of the late 3300s.

fousang.name: Fousang
fousang.bio: Fousang is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3304-06-29 to 3304-06-29. Associated with Blue Creative Company, Fousang security. Criminal organisations are exploiting the Thargoid threat to increase raids on civilian traffic in the Fousang system.

tarach-tor.name: Tarach Tor
tarach-tor.bio: Tarach Tor is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3303-11-17 to 3303-11-24. Associated with Independent Leesti for Equality, Guardians of Tranquillity. Spokesperson General Hunter O'Brien stated the festival will showcase regional cuisine and libations from Tarach Tor's vineyards and breweries.

nerah-city.name: Nerah City
nerah-city.bio: Nerah City is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3303-05-21 to 3303-10-28.

pre-logistics-support-gamma.name: PRE Logistics Support Gamma
pre-logistics-support-gamma.bio: A starport serving the Pleiades Resource Enterprise and Merope Expeditionary Fleet, PRE Logistics Support Gamma operated as a critical logistics node in the Pleiades region between late 3302 and mid-3303.
pre-logistics-support-gamma.bio_full:
PRE Logistics Support Gamma anchored one corner of the Pleiades Resource Enterprise's supply network during the critical early period of Thargoid incursions. Operating in coordination with the Merope Expeditionary Fleet, the starport handled the movement of combat materiel, rescue supplies and personnel transfers that sustained Imperial operations across multiple threatened systems.

The station's location near Merope and Pleiades Sector IH-V c2-5 placed it within easy reach of both the combat front and the resource extraction facilities that powered the war effort. Though never as celebrated as forward outposts like Orcus Crag or Moni's Hub, PRE Logistics Support Gamma performed the essential but unglamorous work of maintaining supply lines. Its nine-month period of active mention in GalNet records corresponded almost exactly to the most intense phase of the initial Thargoid offensive.

noctrach-ihazevich-research-facility.name: Noctrach-Ihazevich Research facility
noctrach-ihazevich-research-facility.bio: Noctrach-Ihazevich Research facility is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3302-11-22 to 3302-11-22. Associated with Buckyball Racing Club. The event starts at the Noctrach-Ihazevich Research facility and involves driving to a nearby crash site and back.

g-139-50.name: G 139-50
g-139-50.bio: G 139-50 is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3301-07-30 to 3301-08-06. Fresh Cerberus Plague outbreaks have appeared in Chongguls, Xamentii, G 139-50, Cantjarisni, Rajukru, HIP 10175, Amahu, Leerham, BD-11 4280, and Louguala. The plague has been eradicated from Dajoar, Bastes, Maheou Ti, Eleu, Ochoeng, 20 Ophiuchi, Una, Santjalan, BD-02 4304, Chongguls, Xamentii, and G 139-50.

quator.name: Quator
quator.bio: Quator is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3305-10-22 to 3305-10-28. Associated with Scythe of Panem, Federal Intelligence Agency, Bruthanvan Co. Militant members respond with violence in the Quator system. Scythe of Panem militants are defeated in the Quator system.

eratosthenes-ring.name: Eratosthenes Ring
eratosthenes-ring.bio: Eratosthenes Ring is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3307-07-08 to 3307-07-08. Associated with Gluscap Labour, Neche Inc.

la-cosa-city.name: la Cosa City
la-cosa-city.bio: la Cosa City is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3302-01-21 to 3302-01-21. Associated with Green Party of HIP 112974, Onionhead. Traders delivered the narcotic to la Cosa City while combat pilots defended the spaceways.

malaikudi.name: Malaikudi
malaikudi.bio: Malaikudi is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3303-02-23 to 3303-02-23. Associated with Buckyball Racing Club. The Buckyball Racing Club announces its first full-length race of 3303, Tunnel Vision, requiring competitors to navigate tunnels at scientific and military installations between Malaikudi and Parutis.

cook-gateway.name: Cook Gateway
cook-gateway.bio: Cook Gateway is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3302-09-07 to 3302-09-07. Associated with Buckyball Racing Club, Pilots Federation.

exigus-campus.name: Exigus campus
exigus-campus.bio: Exigus campus is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3302-02-15 to 3302-03-11. Associated with Buckyball Racing Club, Pilots Federation, Grant Academics. Veteran pilots will escort students from the Exigus campus to tourism hotspots in the region from 18-26 March, with Commander Seneh coordinating the event.

hip-16753.name: HIP 16753
hip-16753.bio: HIP 16753 is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3303-12-15 to 3303-12-15. The affected stations are Titan's Daughter in Taygeta, Liman Legacy in HIP 16753, and the Oracle in Pleiades Sector IR-W d1-55.

gnosis.name: Gnosis
gnosis.bio: Gnosis is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3303-06-21 to 3303-06-21. Associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group, LTT 377 Allied Co. Dr Arcanonn of the Canonn Interstellar Research Group issued a statement from the Gnosis regarding the confirmation that Unknown Ships are of Thargoid origin. The Canonn Interstellar Research Group announced plans to construct the deep-space research vessel Gnosis, with open orders for indium, computer components, and tea.

new-rossyth.name: New Rossyth
new-rossyth.bio: New Rossyth is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3304-06-28 to 3304-07-06. Associated with Federal Intelligence Agency, League of Reparation. The trap was sprung in an abandoned foundry in New Rossyth on Turner's World after Kilbride acted on false intelligence about a League cell.

nahuatl.name: Nahuatl
nahuatl.bio: Nahuatl is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3306-09-30 to 3306-10-16. Associated with Imperial Senate, NMLA. Martial law is declared in Ackwada, Beatis, Chana and Nahuatl.

brett-high.name: Brett High
brett-high.bio: An Alliance system with close ties to the Pilots Federation, Gateway and Tionisla, Brett High featured briefly in Alliance strategic communications during mid-3307.
brett-high.bio_full:
Brett High occupied a position of moderate strategic importance within the Alliance's network of systems, situated near Gateway and maintaining close ties to both the Pilots Federation and Tionisla. In mid-3307, the system appeared in Alliance communications with unusual frequency, suggesting either a temporary logistical concentration or a shift in regional defence posture.

The system's proximity to Dublin Citadel — another key Alliance location — placed it within a cluster of politically significant territories that formed the backbone of Alliance expansion in that sector. Though Brett High itself never became the focal point of a major campaign or crisis, its repeated appearance alongside better-known systems indicated that Alliance planners viewed it as a reliable node in their broader strategic architecture.

townshend-hub.name: Townshend Hub
townshend-hub.bio: Townshend Hub is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3301-05-09 to 3301-05-31. Associated with Alioth Independents. Mayor Andrew Bailey of Townshend Hub welcomed the attention but regretted she would not visit Alioth.

manite.name: Manite
manite.bio: An Imperial industrial system, Manite was among the systems affected by the technological plague that crippled starports across inhabited space in early 3302.
manite.bio_full:
Manite is an Imperial industrial system with a medium security rating and an economy based on industrial production and extraction. In early 3302, the system was affected by the technological plague when Iren's Dock, its primary orbital station, began experiencing the mysterious malfunctions later linked to Unknown Artefact interference.

While some starports were restored through the application of meta-alloys by May 3302, Iren's Dock in Manite remained among those still closed, highlighting both the patchy availability of the cure and the persistent vulnerability of orbital infrastructure to alien technological disruption during the first wave of Thargoid-related phenomena.

darnielles-progress.name: Darnielle's Progress
darnielles-progress.bio: Darnielle's Progress is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3302-05-27 to 3303-03-24. Business leaders at Darnielle's Progress in the Maia system announce a sale of meta-alloys from their stockpile. A carefully orchestrated heist steals a large quantity of meta-alloys from Darnielle's Progress in the Maia system.

dheneb.name: Dheneb
dheneb.bio: Dheneb is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3301-04-15 to 3301-04-15.

ngun.name: Ngun
ngun.bio: Ngun is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3301-03-06 to 3301-03-06. Stop Slavery Stupid announced it would accept Imperial slaves for emancipation at Mackenzie Relay in Cemiess, Thiele Orbital in Ngun and Naubakht City in Eta Horologii.

garay-terminal.name: Garay Terminal
garay-terminal.bio: Garay Terminal is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3304-06-29 to 3304-07-01. Associated with Aegis. Thargoid vessels are congregating in large numbers, threatening Garay Terminal starport and several megaships.

sosong.name: Sosong
sosong.bio: Sosong is a system in Elite Dangerous, significant from 3308-04-21 to 3308-06-29. Associated with Salvation, Alliance. Notable events include: Thargoid fleets invade the Didio, Novas, and Sosong systems, placing over ten billion lives at risk.; Sirius Corporation claims the Thargoid incursions prove the necessity of its strategic defence pact with the Alliance.
sosong.bio_full:
Sosong is a Federation-aligned system that was one of three superpower core systems invaded by Thargoid fleets in April 3308, alongside Didio and Novas. The simultaneous attack placed over ten billion lives at risk and starports were directly struck with caustic enzyme weapons, causing hundreds of thousands of deaths.

The invasion occurred shortly after Aegis was officially disbanded, leaving Frontline Solutions to temporarily operate the former Aegis fleet with volunteer pilots. The Alliance, Empire and Federation liaised with Salvation, whose Guardian-derived superweapons had proved effective against similar incursions. Sosong's invasion exemplified the catastrophic vulnerability of human space after Aegis's dissolution and the superpowers' desperate reliance on unproven weapons and mercenary logistics to defend their core territories.

234-g-carinae.name: 234 G. Carinae
234-g-carinae.bio: 234 G. Carinae is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3306-10-16 to 3306-10-16.

sopwith-dock.name: Sopwith Dock
sopwith-dock.bio: Sopwith Dock is a starport in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3304-10-04 to 3304-10-11. Associated with Broadcast Cobra. An open order is placed for thorium, indium, and superconductors to be delivered to Sopwith Dock. Vast quantities of thorium, indium, and superconductors were delivered to Sopwith Dock in the HIP 16038 system.

vancouver-ring.name: Vancouver Ring
vancouver-ring.bio: Vancouver Ring is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3302-11-24 to 3302-12-01. Associated with Tchernobog Free. Pilots are asked to deliver goods to Vancouver Ring. Tchernobog Free's appeal for consumer goods was enthusiastically received, with pilots delivering huge quantities to Vancouver Ring to meet high demand from recent one-day deals.

contiku.name: Contiku
contiku.bio: Contiku is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3301-08-22 to 3301-08-22. Associated with Kumo Crew, Interstellar Press. The campaign successfully pushed Contiku into turmoil.

bulychev-hub.name: Bulychev Hub
bulychev-hub.bio: Bulychev Hub is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3304-02-02 to 3304-02-09. Associated with Alliance. Huge quantities of raw materials were delivered to Bulychev Hub.

gali.name: Gali
gali.bio: Gali is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3301-08-06 to 3301-08-06. Associated with Union of Bast Liberals. Newly affected systems include Altair, 39 Tauri, Kamorin, Delta Phoenicis, Kappa Ophiuchi, Murung, LTT 14850, Gali, Cauani, LTT 6705, Watha, Asgaa, and Svent.

narri.name: Narri
narri.bio: Narri is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3304-05-04 to 3304-05-13. Associated with Utopia, Narri Justice Party. The Utopia commune has launched a project to build a military installation in the Narri system to defend the Sim-Archive from potential Thargoid attack. The Narri Justice Party is overseeing construction and has requested pilots deliver materials to Bobko City while protecting traders from pirates.
narri.bio_full:
Narri is an independent corporate system governed by Zentech Enterprises, home to nearly five million inhabitants with a high-security industrial economy supported by extraction operations. Located within reach of both Utopia and core Federal territories, the system features Bobko City as a primary installation and has served as a flashpoint for competing political visions. Its substantial population and strategic positioning have made it a significant node in regional trade and security networks.

In mid-3304, the Utopia commune launched an ambitious project to construct a military installation in Narri to defend the Sim-Archive from potential Thargoid attack, with the Narri Justice Party overseeing construction efforts. The project requested pilot deliveries of materials to Bobko City alongside protection for traders from pirate activity. This initiative illustrated how even nominally pacifist communities like Utopia recognised the necessity of military preparedness during the escalating alien conflict, while also demonstrating the reliance on independent pilots for large-scale logistical operations.

nelder-city.name: Nelder City
nelder-city.bio: An orbital station in the Wangal system, Nelder City became the unlikely construction site for one of the galaxy's more whimsical community projects.
nelder-city.bio_full:
Nelder City orbits in the Wangal system, a location that in early 3304 found itself at the centre of an unexpectedly cheerful initiative. Angeli Imperial Enterprises chose the station as the delivery point for construction materials needed to build DaMorg's Bar and BBQ, an orbital family restaurant intended to showcase Wangal's culinary offerings to passing spacers.

The company paid well above market rates for outfitting materials, drawing independent traders to Nelder City in large numbers. A spokesperson quoted an ancient proverb to explain the venture: "When there is plenty of wine, sorrow and worry take wing." The project offered a rare moment of levity amid the galactic tensions of the period, proving that even in an era of Thargoid conflict and superpower rivalry, there was still demand for good food and convivial atmosphere.

modigi.name: Modigi
modigi.bio: Modigi is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3308-11-30 to 3308-11-30. Associated with Imperial Navy.

morrina-system.name: Morrina system
morrina-system.bio: An Alliance system with nearly a billion inhabitants, Morrina experienced severe civil unrest in early 3302 due to rampant criminal activity that prompted the Pro-Alliance Party to issue system-wide kill orders.
morrina-system.bio_full:
By April 3302, the Morrina system had descended into chaos. Widespread civil unrest, fuelled by rampant criminal activity, threatened to destabilise a population of nearly a billion people. The Morrina Pro-Alliance Party, working with the Spinward Marches Alliance Concern, responded with extraordinary measures: kill orders on all wanted ships and substantial rewards for pilots delivering bounty vouchers to Barjavel Vision.

The campaign reflected both the severity of the crisis and the Alliance's characteristic reliance on independent pilots for internal security. Unlike the Empire or Federation, which might have deployed uniformed troops, the Alliance delegated law enforcement to bounty hunters and volunteer combatants. The Morrina system's experience demonstrated how this model could succeed under extreme pressure — provided enough pilots answered the call. Within weeks, the Pro-Alliance Party announced significant progress in restoring order.

grant-dock.name: Grant Dock
grant-dock.bio: Grant Dock is a starport in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3303-11-10 to 3303-11-17. Associated with Wolves of Jonai, Jonai Merchant's Guild. Hundreds of pilots delivered construction materials to Grant Dock and eliminated agitators in the HR 7047 system.

barnards-star.name: Barnard's Star
barnards-star.bio: Barnard's Star is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3310-12-06 to 3311-01-09. Associated with Aegis, Wolf 359.

akkadia.name: Akkadia
akkadia.bio: Akkadia is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3301-06-10 to 3301-07-09. Associated with Sirius Corporation, Federal Liberal Party. Meanwhile, Sirius Corporation representatives have been negotiating potential mergers with Akkadia Inc and Akkadia Crimson Allied Organisation in neighbouring Akkadia.

austen-town-station.name: Austen Town Station
austen-town-station.bio: Austen Town Station is a starport in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3302-08-18 to 3302-08-25. Associated with Arque Commodities. Arque Commodities has issued a kill order on wanted ships and will reward pilots who deliver bounty vouchers to Austen Town Station. Hundreds of pilots participated in the operation, and rewards are now available for collection at Austen Town Station.

synuefe-zl-j-d10-119.name: Synuefe ZL-J d10-119
synuefe-zl-j-d10-119.bio: Synuefe ZL-J d10-119 is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3303-01-24 to 3303-01-24.

mehet.name: Mehet
mehet.bio: Mehet is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3302-06-02 to 3302-06-09. Associated with Mehet Ltd, Pilots Federation. Mehet Ltd announces the successful conclusion of its campaign to clear the Mehet system of criminals and agitators, with hundreds of Pilots Federation commanders responding to the appeal.

ito-orbital.name: Ito Orbital
ito-orbital.bio: Ito Orbital is a starport in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3307-04-29 to 3307-05-06. Associated with Pilots Federation.

dulos.name: Dulos
dulos.bio: Dulos is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3308-01-11 to 3308-01-20. Senator Zemina Torval's company bids to acquire a mining contract from Caine-Massey in the Dulos system. Caine-Massey and Torval Mining Ltd compete for a decade-long mining contract in the Dulos system.

ross-47.name: Ross 47
ross-47.bio: Ross 47 is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3302-08-05 to 3302-08-05. Associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group.

mars.name: Mars
mars.bio: Mars is the capital world of the Federation and the first planet successfully terraformed by humanity, with the process completed in 2291. Following the Federation's defeat at the Battle of Achenar in 2325, the Federal capital was relocated from Earth to Mars. Today it hosts the Federal Congress, government institutions, and major corporate headquarters, supporting a population in the billions with a diversified economy.
mars.bio_full:
Mars holds the distinction of being the first planet successfully terraformed by humanity, with the process completed in 2291. An earlier experimental attempt in the 2170s had been abandoned, but the second effort established the template for subsequent terraforming projects across human space.

The planet's political significance increased dramatically after the Battle of Achenar in 2325. To stabilise the Federation amid discontent with Earth's leadership, the capital was relocated from Earth to Mars — a move that maintained Sol's central position while symbolising a fresh start. The Federal Congress now meets on Mars, alongside major government institutions and corporate headquarters.

Mars has been the backdrop for pivotal political moments, most notably in 3301 when Shadow President Zachary Hudson announced his bid for a Vote of No Confidence against President Jasmina Halsey — a successful manoeuvre that installed him as President and shifted Federal politics toward Republican militarism. Despite the shift of galactic commerce to systems like Alioth and Cubeo, Mars remains the administrative centre of the largest superpower in human space.

synuefai-pi-i-c26-8.name: Synuefai PI-I c26-8
synuefai-pi-i-c26-8.bio: Synuefai PI-I c26-8 is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3302-07-01 to 3302-07-01.

hip-17692.name: HIP 17692
hip-17692.bio: HIP 17692 is a system in Elite Dangerous, significant from 3303-06-16 to 3304-03-10. Associated with Merope Expeditionary Fleet, Pleiades Resource Enterprise. Notable events include: The Federation announces plans to construct a survey outpost in HIP 17692 to monitor Thargoid activity near the Pleiades.; The Federation announces the successful conclusion of its campaign to construct a new outpost in HIP 17692 for monitoring Thargoid activity.
hip-17692.bio_full:
HIP 17692 is an independent system in the Pleiades region with a population of approximately 900,000, controlled by the Anti Xeno Initiative under a patronage government. Located near the frontier of Thargoid space, the system's strategic position made it a focal point for superpower military expansion during the early Thargoid conflict.

In June 3303, the Federation announced plans to establish an asteroid base among the rings of HIP 17692 A4 to monitor Thargoid activity, with the Pleiades Resource Enterprise overseeing construction. The Empire simultaneously announced a competing initiative to bolster its Navy with a new Wells-class Carrier, coordinated by the Merope Expeditionary Fleet. Both superpowers placed open orders for construction materials, turning HIP 17692 into a flashpoint for the escalating rivalry between the Federation and Empire as each sought to consolidate influence in the Pleiades. The completed Federal outpost provided a permanent military presence in a region that would become one of the most contested sectors of the Thargoid war.

zaonce.name: Zaonce
zaonce.bio: Zaonce is a system in Elite Dangerous, significant from 3301-05-01 to 3308-11-15. Associated with Alliance, Alliance Assembly, Bank of Zaonce. Notable events include: President Gibson Kincaid is removed from office by the Alliance Assembly on charges of treason, murder and corruption, and is detained while attemp...; The announcement that the rogue signal sources heading towards the core systems are Thargoid in origin has caused unease within the general public.
zaonce.bio_full:
Zaonce is a major industrial system in the Alliance and a founding member of the Old Worlds, located within the Lave cluster. Home to Ridley Scott Station and the influential Bank of Zaonce, the system has long served as a financial and industrial hub. In 3301, it was at the centre of pilot-driven anti-piracy efforts when Silver United Solutions deputised thousands of commanders to crush the Zaonce Jet Gang and restore order to the sector.

The system's political significance deepened when former governor Gibson Kincaid became Alliance President in 3303. Kincaid's 3305 attempt to commandeer the Zaonce fleet and his subsequent impeachment for treason, murder and corruption marked the Alliance's gravest constitutional crisis, with the Bank of Zaonce implicated in his conspiracy. Zaonce remains an Alliance stronghold and continues to play a key role in galactic finance, monitoring interstellar markets during crises such as the 3308 Thargoid threat.

aries-dark.name: Aries Dark
aries-dark.bio: Aries Dark is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3301-10-13 to 3301-10-13. Associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group.

dijkstra.name: Dijkstra
dijkstra.bio: Dijkstra is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3302-06-18 to 3302-06-18.

lp-855-34.name: LP 855-34
lp-855-34.bio: A small independent system that became a battleground in 3311 when a platinum rush drew competing power-play forces into open conflict.
lp-855-34.bio_full:
LP 855-34 is a minor independent system with a population of barely sixty thousand, a democracy controlled by the Sidewinder Syndicate. Its obscurity ended in May 3311 when a platinum rush triggered by local construction demands attracted the attention of two galactic powers: Yuri Grom's independent forces and Felicia Winters' Federal loyalists.

Grom's representative accused Federal factions of "cornering the market" unfairly, and combat zones erupted throughout the system as pilots clashed over strategic mining sites. The conflict, though brief, illustrated how even the smallest systems could become flashpoints in the post-Thargoid War scramble for resources and influence, with Winters' supporters ultimately prevailing.

sereborv-terminal.name: Sereborv Terminal
sereborv-terminal.bio: Sereborv Terminal is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3302-12-01 to 3302-12-01. Associated with Federation, The Children of Raxxla. Contributing pilots can now collect rewards at Sereborv Terminal in HR 6421.

hip-104292.name: HIP 104292
hip-104292.bio: HIP 104292 is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3303-10-06 to 3303-10-13. Associated with Kuun-Lan.

chargaff-orbital.name: Chargaff Orbital
chargaff-orbital.bio: Chargaff Orbital is a starport in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3304-02-09 to 3304-02-16. Associated with Utopia, The Official Airman Di Front. A huge influx of deliveries to Chargaff Orbital will be used for essential maintenance.

hip-17862.name: HIP 17862
hip-17862.bio: HIP 17862 is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3302-11-05 to 3303-01-06. Commentators note similarities to shipwrecks in the Pleiades Sector AB-W B2-4 and HIP 17862 systems. A shipwreck bearing strong similarities to one recently found in the Pleiades Sector AB-W B2-4 has been discovered on planetoid 6 C A in the HIP 17862 system.

hez-ur.name: Hez Ur
hez-ur.bio: Hez Ur is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3307-04-02 to 3307-04-02.

aramzahd.name: Aramzahd
aramzahd.bio: Aramzahd is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3302-10-13 to 3302-10-20. Associated with Aramzahd Empire Party, Annual Galactic Games Organisation. The Annual Galactic Games Organisation will hold the Gathering 3302 at Norman–Mavis's Bingo Palace in the Aramzahd system. The Aramzahd Empire Party has requested rare foods and alcohol, and issued a kill order on wanted ships for event security.

stapledon-dock.name: Stapledon Dock
stapledon-dock.bio: Stapledon Dock is a starport in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3301-05-05 to 3301-05-11. Associated with People's Quivira for Equality Party, Quivira Electronics Plc. After Imperial ground troops seized Godel Dock, the People's Quivira for Equality Party retreated to Brendan Gateway before launching a counterattack with independent and Federal pilots. They successfully forced Quivira Electronics Plc back to Stapledon Dock, reigniting the war with no quarter offered.

balaikda.name: Balaikda
balaikda.bio: Balaikda is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3301-02-08 to 3301-02-08. Associated with Chelomy Vision Fight Club. The Chelomy Vision fight club in Balaikda hosts unsanctioned aerial brawls where pilots engage in unsafe combat above the station.

lomonosov-city.name: Lomonosov City
lomonosov-city.bio: Lomonosov City is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3303-10-13 to 3303-10-13. Associated with Kuun-Lan. The Kuun-Lan's appeal for commodities concluded successfully with a massive influx of deliveries to Lomonosov City.

hip-8830.name: HIP 8830
hip-8830.bio: HIP 8830 is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3301-04-15 to 3301-04-15.

rhea.name: Rhea
rhea.bio: Rhea is a system in Elite Dangerous, significant from 3301-07-31 to 3311-05-15. Associated with Sirius Corporation. Notable events include: The Reorte Mining Coalition succeeds in forcing Sirius Corporation to withdraw from the Reorte system.; Sirius Corporation organises humanitarian support for the Didio system under Thargoid attack.
rhea.bio_full:
Rhea is a heavily populated Federal agricultural and tourism system with nearly thirteen billion inhabitants, governed under corporate administration by the Federal Liberal Command. Located strategically between the core Federal territories and the Pleiades region, Rhea has served as both a logistical hub for Sirius Corporation operations and a flashpoint in disputes over corporate influence in Federal space.

The system's political significance intensified during the Reorte crisis of 3308, when the Reorte Mining Coalition successfully forced Sirius Corporation to withdraw from the neighbouring Reorte system — a rare popular victory against corporate expansion that resonated across Rhea and other Federal systems. Rhea's dual economy of agriculture and tourism makes it economically resilient, while its high security rating reflects both its Federal affiliation and its importance as a waypoint for travellers heading toward Thargoid-affected regions.

beta-3-tucani.name: Beta-3 Tucani
beta-3-tucani.bio: Beta-3 Tucani is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3311-06-12 to 3311-06-26. Associated with Imperial Navy. Imperial forces launch a surprise assault on Archon Delaine's flagship, the Mictlan, in Beta-3 Tucani. The conflict between Imperial forces and Archon Delaine in Beta-3 Tucani concluded with an Imperial victory.

milelbis.name: Milelbis
milelbis.bio: Milelbis is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3301-03-03 to 3301-03-03. Associated with Alliance, Big G Corporation. The first set includes Djaujas A 1, Khona 3, Dohkwithi A 1, Hip 54692 3 and Milelbis 4.

mu-koji.name: Mu Koji
mu-koji.bio: An Imperial agricultural system with over a billion inhabitants, Mu Koji became a battleground in 3302 when rival superpowers launched competing military operations to seize control.
mu-koji.bio_full:
During September 3302, the Empire and Federation simultaneously deployed military forces to Mu Koji, each seeking to install a friendly government. The Xuangu Crimson Major Network spearheaded the Imperial campaign, while the Mu Koji Resistance represented Federal interests. For weeks, the system became a microcosm of superpower rivalry as both factions offered combat bonds and material incentives to independent pilots willing to fight on their behalf.

The Xuangu Crimson Major Network eventually prevailed, announcing the successful extraction of intelligence from captured Federal convoys. Imperial victory in Mu Koji demonstrated how the Powers' Cold War frequently erupted into proxy conflicts in strategically valuable systems, with local populations caught between competing visions of governance.

unkulcay.name: Unkulcay
unkulcay.bio: Unkulcay is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3302-01-22 to 3302-01-22. Associated with Buckyball Racing Club.

arek.name: Arek
arek.bio: Arek is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3304-03-02 to 3304-03-09. Associated with Arek Crimson Vision Corporation. Arek Crimson Vision Corporation has launched a campaign to boost Colonia's military strength by providing weapons to the region, in direct response to ongoing Thargoid hostility. Arek Crimson Vision Corporation has announced the successful conclusion of its weapons appeal, with a massive influx of deliveries to the organisation's base.

toolfa.name: Toolfa
toolfa.bio: Toolfa is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3301-02-25 to 3301-02-25. Raw gold from Stone's discovery was found aboard his abandoned Sidewinder at Crook's Hub in Toolfa.

ogmar.name: Ogmar
ogmar.bio: Ogmar is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3303-12-15 to 3303-12-22. Associated with GalCop Colonial Defence Commission. The GalCop Colonial Defence Commission has launched Operation Whirling Dervish, a campaign to establish a new Coriolis starport in the Ogmar system to support further expansion in the Colonia region. A huge number of deliveries to Dervish Platform will be used to build a new Coriolis starport in the Ogmar system.

hip-21559.name: HIP 21559
hip-21559.bio: HIP 21559 is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3304-03-30 to 3304-03-31. Associated with Aegis. The Vanguard and Acropolis will remain on standby in HIP 21559 and Irandan until needed.

carthage.name: Carthage
carthage.bio: Carthage is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3302-07-21 to 3302-07-28. Associated with Lavigny's Legion. Authorities in Carthage report a sharp increase in criminals and issue a kill order on all wanted ships to prevent disruption of Lavigny's Legion's Majestic-class Interdictor campaign.

mullag.name: Mullag
mullag.bio: Mullag is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3309-06-16 to 3309-06-23. Associated with Federal Navy.

new-yembo.name: New Yembo
new-yembo.bio: New Yembo is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3301-02-18 to 3301-03-05. Associated with Universal Cartographics, EAUC, Explorers' Association. The first Deep Space Exploration Platform sponsored by the Explorers' Association and Universal Cartographics officially opened in New Yembo. Universal Cartographics thanked the committee for choosing the mineral-rich HIP 101110 system (now named New Yembo) as the launch site, and Zimm_Macugz for organising 150,000 tonnes of raw materials.

guuguyni.name: Guuguyni
guuguyni.bio: Guuguyni is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3304-01-19 to 3304-01-26. Associated with Guuguyni Empire Consulate. Princess Aisling Duval has announced plans to fund a peacekeeping operation in the Guuguyni system to neutralize an illegal slave-trading ring. Princess Aisling Duval's anti-slavery campaign in the Guuguyni system has concluded successfully.
guuguyni.controlling_faction: The Guard of Outer Imperial Colonies

on-t-b3-1.name: ON-T B3-1
on-t-b3-1.bio: ON-T B3-1 is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3302-02-18 to 3302-02-18. Associated with Federal research team.

hip-8887.name: HIP 8887
hip-8887.bio: HIP 8887 is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3308-12-01 to 3310-03-18. Associated with Aegis. Titan Leigong is destroyed in the HIP 8887 system, becoming the second of eight Titans to fall.

chukchan-5-b.name: Chukchan 5 b
chukchan-5-b.bio: Chukchan 5 b is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3307-04-08 to 3307-04-19. Associated with Pilots Federation, Pharmasapien. A dormant communications beacon aboard the 200-year-old ghost ship Adamastor in the Chukchan system suddenly activates, receiving and rebroadcasting an encrypted interstellar signal.

klimuk-ring.name: Klimuk Ring
klimuk-ring.bio: Klimuk Ring is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3303-12-22 to 3303-12-29. Associated with Core Dynamics, Guaras Blue Creative Partners. Hundreds of pilots delivered materials to Klimuk Ring and eliminated agitators in the Guaras system. The materials will support a new wave of manufacturing to replace ships lost in Thargoid attacks.

freng.name: Freng
freng.bio: Freng is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3302-09-01 to 3302-09-02. Associated with United Research Council.

ngaliba.name: Ngaliba
ngaliba.bio: Ngaliba is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3301-06-22 to 3301-06-22. Associated with Adle's Armada, Federation. They will now operate as their own power primarily in Ngaliba, Mbukuravi, and Kremainn, creating their own governance system.

betel.name: Betel
betel.bio: A small independent agricultural democracy, Betel experienced a brief but intense civil conflict in late 3304 between the Silver Creative Network and Betel Free factions.
betel.bio_full:
August 3304 brought open warfare to Betel when the Silver Creative Network and Betel Free clashed for control of the tiny agricultural democracy. With barely four hundred thousand inhabitants and a low-security environment managed by Flotta Stellare, the system offered limited resources but significant symbolic value to both factions seeking to expand their influence.

By early September, authorities confirmed the conflict had ended. General Hollis of Betel security issued a statement expressing hope for prolonged peace, though the brevity of the war suggested neither side had achieved decisive victory. Betel's experience illustrated how even the smallest independent systems could become battlegrounds for proxy conflicts between factions whose ambitions far outstripped the territory's actual strategic importance.

lambardellis-legacy.name: Lambardelli's Legacy
lambardellis-legacy.bio: Lambardelli's Legacy is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3301-05-13 to 3301-05-13. Aisling's agents operate from Henry O'Hare's Hanger in Summerland, while Arissa's agents work aboard Lambardelli's Legacy in Persephone.

kappa-ophiuchi.name: Kappa Ophiuchi
kappa-ophiuchi.bio: Kappa Ophiuchi is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3301-08-06 to 3301-08-06. Associated with Union of Bast Liberals. Newly affected systems include Altair, 39 Tauri, Kamorin, Delta Phoenicis, Kappa Ophiuchi, Murung, LTT 14850, Gali, Cauani, LTT 6705, Watha, Asgaa, and Svent.

brendan-gateway.name: Brendan Gateway
brendan-gateway.bio: Brendan Gateway is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3301-05-05 to 3301-05-05. Associated with Nationalists of Quivira. After Imperial ground troops seized Godel Dock, the People's Quivira for Equality Party retreated to Brendan Gateway before launching a counterattack with independent and Federal pilots.

jones-estate.name: Jones Estate
jones-estate.bio: Jones Estate is a star system in the Elite Dangerous universe, significant from 3302-02-29 to 3302-02-29. Associated with Kruger 60 Free. Kruger 60 Free funds the one-day appeal, with deliveries requested at Jones Estate in the Groombridge 34 system.

commander-kyrthak.name: Commander Kyrthak
commander-kyrthak.bio: Commander Kyrthak is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-07-11 to 3302-07-11. Closely associated with Future of Segovan, Federal Security Service, Taskforce Athena. A coalition of Empire-aligned commanders known as Taskforce Athena has declared the Segovan system a no-fly zone and placed Ramsbottom Hub in lockdown. Commander Kyrthak stated the group is combating Federal security services to halt construction of new Federal outposts.

commander-kligg.name: Commander Kligg
commander-kligg.bio: Commander Kligg is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-22 to 3301-05-22. Closely associated with Buckyball Run. Commander Alot broke the galactic record for the Buckyball Run A* rally race twice in less than a month, reducing his time to Sagittarius A* from 11 hours 46 minutes to 9 hours 39 minutes. Commander Kligg subsequently surpassed Alot's record by 8 minutes using an Anaconda named 'Rub Tub'.

corrigendum.name: Corrigendum
corrigendum.bio: Corrigendum is a Commander in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3301-07-24 to 3302-05-14. Affiliated with Kumo Crew, Imperial Navy, Lavigny's Legion. Notable activities include: Two weeks into Operation Davy Jones, Imperial forces continue their siege of the Pegasi sector.; Debate rages in the Pegasi sector over Senator Arissa Lavigny-Duval's invitation for Federation systems to become Imperial citizens.
corrigendum.bio_full:
Corrigendum is the military callsign of a commander within Lavigny's Legion, the Imperial forces loyal to Senator Arissa Lavigny-Duval. During Operation Davy Jones in July 3301, Corrigendum served as a frontline officer in the Imperial campaign against the Kumo Crew in the Pegasi sector, reporting that Archon Delaine's forces had been routed from Imperial space with heavy clashes in Anedjete, Sopontet and Huichi.

Corrigendum publicly rejected any diplomatic settlement with the Kumo Crew, stating that the Empire "refuses to negotiate with captors" — a hardline position reflecting Lavigny-Duval's uncompromising stance against piracy and slavery. As both a combat leader and spokesperson for Lavigny's Legion, Corrigendum exemplified the Imperial Navy's aggressive posture during the Pegasi sector campaigns.

lady-zi.name: Lady Zi
lady-zi.bio_full: Lady Zi is a rogue pirate admiral and the suspected leader of a criminal syndicate that conducted coordinated attacks on military installations and starport facilities in the core systems during 3312. Her true identity remains unknown, with underworld sources unwilling to divulge information about her origins or motives.

kate-panamen.name: Kate Panamen
kate-panamen.bio: Kate Panamen is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-02-25 to 3303-02-25. Closely associated with Mars High Astrocartography Institute. Kate Panamen of the Mars High Astrocartography Institute calls the event peculiar.

fightingcookie.name: FightingCookie
fightingcookie.bio: FightingCookie is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-01-12 to 3303-01-12. Closely associated with Fuel Rats.

kaii.name: Kaii
kaii.bio: Kaii is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-01-04 to 3305-03-07. Closely associated with Deep Space Surveys.

commander-nightwulf.name: Commander Nightwulf
commander-nightwulf.bio: Commander Nightwulf is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-20 to 3301-03-20. President Halsey honoured Federal commanders who made the greatest contributions to the Lugh war effort. Commander Nightwulf removed almost 14,000 enemy combatants.

paul-wiggins.name: Paul Wiggins
paul-wiggins.bio: Paul Wiggins is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-04-10 to 3301-04-10. Closely associated with Worster Insurance, Better Green Developments. Shadow President Hudson attended the 153rd annual Exphiay Bankers' Ball alongside Frank Hall of Gallant Investment, Paul Wiggins of Wiggins Development Trust, and Patricia Spellman of Sirius Finance.

natalia-lee.name: Natalia Lee
natalia-lee.bio: Natalia Lee is a admiral in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-05-06 to 3307-05-06. Closely associated with League of Mandu, Pilots Federation, NMLA. Admiral Natalia Lee of the Harmony's Shield declares the Federation will enact justice for the NMLA bombings, while Hadrian Duval calls for Imperial defence under the Treaty of Paresa.

arnold-cochran.name: Arnold Cochran
arnold-cochran.bio: Arnold Cochran is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-05-11 to 3304-05-18. Closely associated with Moritasgus Imperial Corporation. Superintendent Arnold Cochran stated the expanded facilities can now safely contain some of the Empire's worst criminals.

quinn-damico.name: Quinn Damico
quinn-damico.bio: Quinn Damico is a councillor in the Aranbarahun system who defended the Far God cult's right to freedom of religion in 3304. While acknowledging the worshippers were strange, he insisted they were essentially harmless and warned that criminal acts against them, including incitement to violence, could result in prosecution.
quinn-damico.bio_full:
Quinn Damico serves as a councillor in the Aranbarahun system and became a notable defender of religious freedom during the controversy over the Far God cult in 3304. As public hostility toward the Thargoid-worshipping sect mounted—with anti-xeno campaigner Juanita Bishop demanding their expulsion—Damico took a measured stance. He acknowledged the cultists were strange but insisted they were essentially harmless, warning citizens that criminal acts against them, including incitement to violence, could result in prosecution.

Damico's defence of the Far God worshippers was grounded in the principle that freedom of religion was protected by law in all systems where the sect had a presence. His position contrasted sharply with more reactionary voices and demonstrated that even in times of heightened xenophobia, some officials remained committed to constitutional protections. The cult's later victimisation by other doomsayer groups and anti-xeno activists would validate Damico's assessment that they posed no security threat.

first-apostle.name: First Apostle
first-apostle.bio: First Apostle is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-09-15 to 3308-10-06. Closely associated with True Chapters, Vox Galactica.
first-apostle.bio_full: The First Apostle is the highest-ranking leader of the True Chapters, a sect of the Far God cult that interprets the Thargoids as divine harbingers of apocalypse. In 3308, the First Apostle claimed that the mysterious 'Thargoid roar' detected during the Battle of HIP 22460 was 'the voice of the Far God calling to the faithful,' asserting that the manifestation had begun. The First Apostle's rhetoric exemplifies how the Far God cult transforms military defeats into theological affirmations, framing humanity's destruction as a sacred transition rather than a catastrophe.

gibson-kincaid.name: Gibson Kincaid
gibson-kincaid.bio: Gibson Kincaid is a President in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-09-01 to 3305-07-27. Affiliated with Alliance. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering the appearance of Thargoid Hydra vessels in the Pleiades Nebula and core systems, Aegis Core's relocation from Socho to Sol...; Weekly summary covering the Alliance Assembly's agreement to vote on Kincaid's constitutional changes, the fire destroying Supratech's facility, in...
gibson-kincaid.bio_full:
Gibson Kincaid served as President of the Alliance from 3304 to 3305, winning office on a platform of strengthening the Alliance's executive branch. His presidency was dominated by a controversial constitutional reform campaign that sought to transform the largely ceremonial office into a powerful executive position with direct command of military forces — a move critics condemned as a creeping authoritarianism alien to the Alliance's consensual traditions.

Kincaid's downfall came in 3305 when investigations revealed a conspiracy involving murder, treason, and corruption. Admiral Frederick Yamamoto's testimony and a Wallglass Investigations Agency report exposed Kincaid's role in the assassination of his political rival Fazia Silva and his attempts to flee Zaonce during impeachment proceedings. The Alliance Assembly abolished the presidency entirely in the aftermath, making Kincaid both the first and last holder of an office that lasted barely a year.

arvan-corto.name: Arvan Corto
arvan-corto.bio: Arvan Corto is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-08-12 to 3302-08-12. Closely associated with Intergalactic Naval Reserve Arm, Imperial Navy.

lord-roland-holloway.name: Lord Roland Holloway
lord-roland-holloway.bio: Lord Roland Holloway is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-11-10 to 3307-11-10. Closely associated with Holloway Bioscience Institute. Independent pilots locate an abandoned Holloway Bioscience research facility in the Snake Sector GW-W c1-1 system after detecting a distress call from a Colonia Bridge megaship.

gianna-tachibana.name: Gianna Tachibana
gianna-tachibana.bio: Gianna Tachibana is a senator in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-02-16 to 3304-02-16. Closely associated with Aegis, Imperial Herald. As Thargoid attacks continue in the Pleiades, Imperial Senator Gianna Tachibana has criticized the lack of an effective military response.

earl-khaelmin.name: Earl Khaelmin
earl-khaelmin.bio: Earl Khaelmin is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-04-10 to 3301-04-10. Closely associated with House of Duval, Imperial Court. Investigators Count von Auerburg, Earl Rednam and Earl Khaelmin were dispatched and have identified where to concentrate efforts next.

emulatedpenguin.name: EmulatedPenguin
emulatedpenguin.bio: EmulatedPenguin is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-09-29 to 3308-09-29. Closely associated with Pilots Federation.

caleb-wycherley.name: Caleb Wycherley
caleb-wycherley.bio: Caleb Wycherley is a Scientist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3308-06-03 to 3309-12-21. Affiliated with Salvation, Aegis, INRA. Notable activities include: Professor Alba Tesreau presents evidence that Salvation is Dr Caleb Wycherley, former Azimuth Biochemicals researcher and INRA collaborator who hel...; A survivor of Azimuth Biochemicals' Project Seraph, designated D-2, reveals the location of an INRA base and confirms Salvation's identity as Dr Ca...
caleb-wycherley.bio_full:
Caleb Wycherley was the founder and original director of Azimuth Biochemicals, the corporate predecessor to Azimuth Biotech and the institutional lineage behind the anonymous scientist known as Salvation. In the early 3100s, Wycherley established Azimuth's xenological research division, acquiring the first evidence of Thargoid life and initiating the secret weapons programmes that would eventually produce the mycoid virus in collaboration with INRA.

When Azimuth Biochemicals was commercially overtaken by Pharmasapien over a century later, Wycherley ensured key assets and personnel were removed from company records prior to acquisition, allowing the research to continue in secret. In June 3308, Salvation publicly revealed himself as Wycherley's successor, claiming that "Caleb Wycherley is no more, but his accomplishments laid the foundations for the man I have become." Wycherley's legacy is thus directly tied to both the mycoid virus that ended the First Thargoid War and the Proteus Wave superweapon that catastrophically escalated the Second.

roberta-unwin.name: Roberta Unwin
roberta-unwin.bio: Roberta Unwin is a ceo in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-10-15 to 3310-09-03. Closely associated with Money Matters, Sirius Corporation. Economist Roberta Unwin characterized this as speculative expansion.
roberta-unwin.bio_full:
Roberta Unwin built a distinguished career as an economist and chief executive, most notably serving with Money Matters and maintaining professional connections to Sirius Corporation across nearly a decade of documented activity. Her analytical expertise allowed her to assess complex financial developments and provide commentary that influenced both corporate strategy and public understanding of economic trends. The longevity of her recorded presence from 3301 through 3310 suggested a figure whose insights remained relevant across multiple business cycles and political administrations.

Unwin's characterisation of certain corporate expansions as speculative demonstrated her willingness to challenge optimistic narratives that dominated financial reporting. Her association with Sirius Corporation, one of the galaxy's most powerful corporate entities, indicated that her analysis carried weight within elite decision-making circles. Through her work, Unwin contributed to more nuanced public discourse about the risks and opportunities inherent in galactic commerce, offering perspectives that balanced enthusiasm for growth against prudent assessment of market conditions.

boden-tench.name: Boden Tench
boden-tench.bio: Boden Tench is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-12-08 to 3303-12-08. Closely associated with Aegis.

li-yong-rui.name: Li Yong-Rui
li-yong-rui.bio: Li Yong-Rui is a Ceo in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3301-06-10 to 3311-07-17. Affiliated with Sirius Corporation, Alliance, Utopia. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering the Alliance Assembly's decision to create the Office of the Alliance President without executive powers, Sirius Corporatio...; Weekly summary covering the mercenary incursion against Ram Tah's Phoenix Base in Meene, the FSS suspension of Lieutenant Inspector Ramesh Thorne, ...
li-yong-rui.bio_full:
Li Yong-Rui is the CEO of Sirius Corporation and architect of many of the megacorp's most consequential political manoeuvres. He brokered the strategic defence pact with the Alliance in 3308, granting Sirius military access in exchange for economic partnerships, and proposed the establishment of independent Marlinist colonies in 3306 to defuse the refugee crisis threatening war between the Empire and Federation. His calm, business-first diplomacy has made Sirius a de facto fourth superpower.

Yong-Rui's leadership has drawn increasing criticism, particularly from Alliance Councillor Nakato Kaine, who accused him of failing to deliver promised capital ships and adequate Thargoid defence. The Alliance Assembly launched a formal evaluation of the Sirius pact in late 3309, questioning whether the partnership's returns justified its costs. Despite this pressure, Yong-Rui has maintained Sirius's influence across all three superpowers, positioning the corporation as an indispensable mediator in galactic affairs.

commander-cly.name: Commander Cly
commander-cly.bio: Commander Cly is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-06-29 to 3302-07-01.

magen-wolfe.name: Magen Wolfe
magen-wolfe.bio: Magen Wolfe is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-12-30 to 3303-12-30. Closely associated with Colonia Council.

rochelle-karim.name: Rochelle Karim
rochelle-karim.bio: Rochelle Karim is a key figure in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3305-02-08 to 3305-04-11. Affiliated with Federal Intelligence Agency, Children of Tothos. Notable activities include: The FIA confirms that a portable 300-megaton nuclear warhead codenamed the Lucifer Device has been stolen from the attacked research outpost, repre...; A Federal Navy vessel discovers an unregistered research outpost with all occupants murdered, where advanced nuclear research was being conducted a...
rochelle-karim.bio_full:
Rochelle Karim is a Senior Agent of the Federal Intelligence Agency who led operations against the Children of Tothos cult in early 3305. In February 3305, she investigated the attack on a secret Federal research outpost where a prototype nuclear weapon had been stolen. Karim later went deep undercover within the cult, posing as a Tothos worshipper to infiltrate their ranks.

In April 3305, Karim's unit prevented the cult from detonating the stolen nuclear weapon at Archambault Terminal. As cult leader Barnabas Cole prepared to activate the device, Karim — still posing as a follower — shot him dead, while other FIA operatives arrested the acolytes and secured the control deck. Her operation demonstrated the effectiveness of deep-cover infiltration in preventing mass-casualty terrorism and showcased the FIA's willingness to use lethal force when necessary to protect civilian populations.

commander-chiggy-vonrictofen.name: Commander Chiggy Vonrictofen
commander-chiggy-vonrictofen.bio: Commander Chiggy Vonrictofen is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-11-26 to 3302-11-26. Closely associated with Institute for Galactic Exploration and Research. Commander Chiggy Vonrictofen conducted a dramatic rescue of Commander Felix Macedonica, who was stranded 65,000 light years from home without sufficient germanium to synthesise an FSD injection. Chiggy traveled to Colonia, fitted a mining laser, and crossed 30,000 light years to reach Felix within 48 hours.

rici-stewart.name: Rici Stewart
rici-stewart.bio: Rici Stewart is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-09-09 to 3303-09-09. Closely associated with Imperial Herald.

sara-kulkarni.name: Sara Kulkarni
sara-kulkarni.bio: Sara Kulkarni is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-08-11 to 3304-08-16. Closely associated with MacArthur Mining Ltd. Security Chief Sara Kulkarni declares a regional state of emergency. Security Chief Sara Kulkarni reports sensor drones detected it surfacing in the Blue Peaks mountain range, where it was homing in on mineral ores.
sara-kulkarni.bio_full:
Sara Kulkarni served as Security Chief for MacArthur Mining Ltd during the mid-3300s, responsible for protecting corporate assets and personnel across multiple extraction sites and facilities. Her position demanded expertise in threat assessment, emergency response coordination, and the management of private security forces operating in environments where official law enforcement might be hours or days away. In August 3304, she demonstrated the weight of her responsibilities by declaring a regional state of emergency in response to an unprecedented threat to mining operations.

The crisis centred on sensor drone detection of an anomalous entity surfacing in the Blue Peaks mountain range, where it began homing in on mineral ore deposits. Kulkarni's rapid escalation to emergency status reflected both the potential scale of the threat and the limited information available about the phenomenon. Her handling of the incident illustrated how corporate security leaders in frontier industries regularly confronted situations that exceeded standard operational protocols, requiring decisive action based on incomplete intelligence.

lance-spacecat-d.name: Lance 'Spacecat' D.
lance-spacecat-d.bio: Lance 'Spacecat' D. is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-04-25 to 3301-04-25.

rubbernuke.name: Rubbernuke
rubbernuke.bio: Rubbernuke is a pirate in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-09-28 to 3301-09-28.

irfan-karim.name: Irfan Karim
irfan-karim.bio: A business reporter for The Alliance Tribune, Irfan Karim provided sharp analysis of the corporate struggles surrounding Lakon Spaceways and the Alliance shipbuilding sector.
irfan-karim.bio_full:
Irfan Karim built his reputation covering the intersection of corporate politics and aerospace manufacturing for The Alliance Tribune. In December 3306, he was among the first to analyse Lakon Spaceways' surprise rejection of Core Dynamics' acquisition bid, drawing on insider sources to reveal that the company was in "far greater difficulty than financial statements would suggest."

His reporting exposed tensions within Lakon's shareholder base, noting that some investors were pressuring the board to accept the Federal takeover while others accused chairperson Naomi Landseer of over-reliance on Alliance contracts. Karim's coverage helped frame the takeover battle not merely as a business dispute but as a proxy struggle between Federal and Alliance industrial interests.

cora-shaw.name: Cora Shaw
cora-shaw.bio: Cora Shaw is a Scientist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3302-04-15 to 3304-10-27. Affiliated with Palin Institute, Aegis, Cordova Group. Notable activities include: This article recounts the history of Thargoid contact from the discovery of Unknown Artefacts in 3301 through to recent attacks and the creation of...; Reports of further unprovoked Thargoid attacks in the Pleiades have reached the core systems, targeting Imperial and civilian ships in HIP 17225, H...
cora-shaw.bio_full:
Professor Cora Shaw is a scientist and the successor to Ishmael Palin as director of the Palin Institute. In April 3302, Palin announced his retirement from active research, citing "dark forces" opposing his ideals, and transferred directorship to Shaw, whom he described as his closest ally for many years.

Under Shaw's leadership, the Palin Institute continued its research into Unknown Artefacts and meta-alloys, maintaining its position as a leading authority on Thargoid-related phenomena. Shaw also collaborated with Aegis during the early Thargoid conflicts, contributing to the scientific understanding of the alien threat. Her stewardship of the Institute preserved Palin's legacy while adapting to the rapidly evolving Thargoid crisis that would dominate galactic affairs for the following decades.

deano-blake.name: Deano Blake
deano-blake.bio: Deano Blake is a senator in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-20 to 3301-03-20. Trader Deano Blake, whose Adder was impounded for weeks, praised Loren's style.

kay-kilbride.name: Kay Kilbride
kay-kilbride.bio: Kay Kilbride is a Commander in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-05-17 to 3304-07-28. Affiliated with League of Reparation, Alliance Interpol, INRA. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering Aisling Duval's anti-slavery campaign merging with Universal Liberty to form Unchain, Lori Jameson's denunciation of the Le...; Weekly summary covering Thargoids being repelled from core systems to Bhal, three starports restored to full functionality, Aisling Duval's engagem...
kay-kilbride.bio_full:
Kay Kilbride is a Chief Inspector with Alliance Interpol who led the multi-agency taskforce investigating the League of Reparation in 3304. When independent journalist Flint "Firemaker" Lafosse published theories linking the League to unsolved homicides dating back several years, Kilbride publicly cautioned against "baseless conjecture" that spread confusion while investigators pursued more concrete leads.

Kilbride's measured approach to the League investigation reflected Alliance Interpol's emphasis on evidence-based counter-terrorism during a period when the League was targeting INRA descendants across all three superpowers. Her leadership of the unified taskforce — which included cooperation with Imperial and Federal agencies — demonstrated that even amid superpower rivalry, law enforcement could coordinate against threats that transcended political boundaries.

radlok.name: Radlok
radlok.bio: Radlok is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-10-05 to 3301-10-05. Closely associated with Fuel Rats, Radio Sidewinder.

bris-dekker.name: Bris Dekker
bris-dekker.bio: Bris Dekker is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-12-19 to 3308-12-19. Closely associated with Federal Times.

lori-jameson.name: Lori Jameson
lori-jameson.bio: A renowned ship engineer and descendant of the legendary pilot Commander John Jameson, Lori Jameson publicly denounced the League of Reparation when the terrorist group claimed to be acting in her ancestor's name.
lori-jameson.bio_full:
Lori Jameson is a highly skilled ship engineer operating from Jameson Memorial in the Shinrarta Dezhra system, and the great-granddaughter of Commander John Jameson, one of the most celebrated pilots in human history. In June 3304, she found herself unwillingly drawn into the public eye when the terrorist organisation known as the League of Reparation began murdering descendants of those involved in her ancestor's famous betrayal, claiming to seek justice on his behalf.

Jameson recorded a public statement at Jameson Memorial in which she condemned the League's actions as "misguided, unnecessary and evil," directly appealing to the group's mysterious leader Nexus to cease the violence. She cooperated fully with the tri-power taskforce investigation, and authorities confirmed she had no connection to the organisation. Beyond this controversy, she continues her work as an engineer specialising in ship module upgrades.

marquis-novantico.name: Marquis Novantico
marquis-novantico.bio: Marquis Novantico is a pirate in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-05-04 to 3304-05-04. Closely associated with Narri Justice Party, Utopia. Dr Leigh Constantinides announced the project, citing strategist Marquis Novantico's observations.

dale-torrance.name: Dale Torrance
dale-torrance.bio: Dale Torrance is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-06 to 3301-07-06. Closely associated with Pangborn Dock.

oscar-goldsun.name: Oscar Goldsun
oscar-goldsun.bio: Oscar Goldsun is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-12-16 to 3307-12-24. Closely associated with Pilots Federation, Goldsun Media. A cryptic poem attributed to the Winking Cat references media mogul Oscar Goldsun and the ethics of show business, promising stolen treasures for those who solve the riddle.

polly-french.name: Polly French
polly-french.bio: Polly French is a diplomat in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-10-27 to 3308-10-27. Closely associated with Federal Congress.

exil.name: Exil
exil.bio: Exil is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-27 to 3301-07-27. Closely associated with Dukes of Mikunn.
