Arissa's reign continued through the most turbulent period in recent Imperial history, including the Thargoid invasion and the NMLA terrorist campaign that would eventually test the Empire's resilience to its core.

hanna-darrold.name: Hanna Darrold
hanna-darrold.bio: Hanna Darrold is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-08-16 to 3305-08-16. Closely associated with Alliance. Local author Hanna Darrold releases the metafictional bestseller 'Chronicles of Olgrea'.

cmdr-fathaggard.name: CMDR FatHaggard
cmdr-fathaggard.bio: CMDR FatHaggard is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-02-14 to 3301-02-14. Closely associated with Core Dynamics. CMDRs piloting Core Dynamics Eagle Fighters were spotted conducting high-speed races near Sol.

cmdr-stellarcartographer.name: CMDR StellarCartographer
cmdr-stellarcartographer.bio: CMDR StellarCartographer is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3311-06-18 to 3311-06-18. Closely associated with Thargoid, Federal Navy.

joel-xander.name: Joel Xander
joel-xander.bio: Joel Xander is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-19 to 3301-07-31. Closely associated with Federal Intelligence Agency, Justice Party. Federal Governor Joel Xander of BD-22 3573 was removed from office and arrested in a surprise Federal Intelligence Agency raid. Xander and his family were escorted off-planet.

professor-denzile-dex.name: Professor Denzile Dex
professor-denzile-dex.bio: Professor Denzile Dex is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-12 to 3301-07-12. Closely associated with Imperial Senate. Leaked technical documents linked new Imperial modules to research by discredited Professor Denzile Dex, raising safety concerns.

svetlana-zhukov.name: Svetlana Zhukov
svetlana-zhukov.bio: Svetlana Zhukov is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-09-14 to 3301-09-14. Closely associated with Imperial Slave Association, Imperial Senate, Imperial Navy. ISA chairwoman Svetlana Zhukov voiced support, though political commentators doubted the regulations would be approved.

giles-cappelleo.name: Giles Cappelleo
giles-cappelleo.bio: Giles Cappelleo is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-11-22 to 3309-12-15. Closely associated with Upaniklis Vision Incorporated. The beverage, distilled for centuries, receives praise from gourmet critic Giles Cappelleo.

guinevere-lavigny.name: Guinevere Lavigny
guinevere-lavigny.bio: Guinevere Lavigny is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-07-03 to 3309-08-18. Closely associated with Imperial Palace. Lady Florence Lavigny suffers a sudden illness, prompting Emperor Arissa to cancel all appointments; family members including Hadrian send well-wishes in an apparent reconciliation gesture. Lady Florence Lavigny's recovery prompts calls for Imperial Family unity, with speculation that she could heal rifts between Arissa, Aisling, and Hadrian Duval.

corinne-macintyre.name: Corinne Macintyre
corinne-macintyre.bio: Corinne Macintyre is a political commentator who has covered Imperial politics and the activities of Senator Kahina Tijani Loren. She provided analysis on the Prism Senator's controversial Federation tour and subsequent disappearance.
corinne-macintyre.bio_full: Corinne Macintyre is a political commentator who has covered Imperial politics, particularly the controversial career of Senator Kahina Tijani Loren of the Prism system. Macintyre provided analysis on Loren's unprecedented Federation tour in early 3301, her cryptic statements to the press, and her mysterious disappearance in the Cemiess system. Her reporting helped frame the Prism Senator affair as both a diplomatic incident and a potential harbinger of deeper political instability within the Empire.

equin0x.name: Equin0x
equin0x.bio: Equin0x is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-14 to 3301-07-14. Closely associated with Pilots Federation, Alliance, Nova Fleet. Commander Equin0x described how superpowers exploit frontier populations for cheap labour in near-slavery conditions.

captain-danvers.name: Captain Danvers
captain-danvers.bio: Captain Danvers is a pirate in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-06-23 to 3302-06-23. Closely associated with Kumo Crew, Independents of Daramo, Federal Navy.

tanya-ramirez.name: Tanya Ramirez
tanya-ramirez.bio: Tanya Ramirez is a Terrorist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-05-24 to 3307-11-19. Affiliated with League of Reparation, Imperial Internal Security Service, Federal Intelligence Agency. Notable activities include: The Alliance, Empire and Federation have created a centralised agency dedicated to investigating and eliminating the NMLA paramilitary group.; *Pilots Federation ALERT* Assistance is needed to track down an ACT operative who vanished while on a mission to identify NMLA suppliers.
tanya-ramirez.bio_full:
Senior Agent Tanya Ramirez is an officer of the Federal Intelligence Agency who served as co-leader of the Affiliated Counter-Terrorism unit (ACT) alongside Captain Niamh Seutonia during the NMLA crisis. In November 3307, Ramirez announced the capture of the NMLA's bomb-making engineers known as Theta Group, though their leader Theta Seven remained at large. She revealed that the breakthrough came from intercepting Theta Group's communications with Neo-Marlinist sympathisers.

Earlier in her career, Ramirez was a member of the tri-superpower taskforce investigating the League of Reparation in 3304, working alongside Alliance Interpol and the Imperial Internal Security Service. Her counter-terrorism expertise spanned two of the most significant threats to galactic security in the 34th century — from INRA-descendant vengeance killings to Neo-Marlinist starport bombings — making her one of the most experienced intelligence officers in the Federation.

john-jameson.name: John Jameson
john-jameson.bio: John Jameson is a Commander in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3303-12-14 to 3304-07-29. Affiliated with INRA, League of Reparation. Notable activities include: Following the discovery of further INRA outposts, Emperor Arissa Lavigny-Duval and Alliance Prime Minister Edmund Mahon have denounced the now-defu...; The murder of Imperial Senator Nestor Cartesius has sparked widespread speculation about the INRA.
john-jameson.bio_full:
Commander John Jameson was a legendary pilot of the 3100s who became a tragic symbol of the Intergalactic Naval Reserve Arm's moral bankruptcy. In the First Thargoid War, Jameson volunteered for a mission to deploy the mycoid virus — a biological weapon designed to cripple the Thargoid fleet. Unbeknownst to him, the INRA had sabotaged his ship to ensure he would not survive to reveal the truth, making him both the weapon's deliverer and its final victim.

The discovery of Jameson's ship and logs in 3304 revealed the full extent of the INRA's betrayal, sparking widespread outrage and directly motivating the League of Reparation's terrorist campaign against INRA descendants. Jameson's fate transformed him from a forgotten war hero into a martyr whose sacrifice exposed the darkest chapters of human-xeno warfare. His story remains a cautionary tale about how military institutions sacrifice individual integrity for strategic advantage.

milandu-okoro.name: Milandu Okoro
milandu-okoro.bio: Milandu Okoro is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3306-09-12 to 3306-10-09. Closely associated with Federal Navy, Federal Attorney's Office.

maxton-price.name: Maxton Price
maxton-price.bio: Maxton Price is a Admiral in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3308-04-21 to 3308-11-28. Affiliated with Alliance, Federal Navy, Imperial Navy. Notable activities include: Thargoid fleets invade the Didio, Novas, and Sosong systems, placing over ten billion lives at risk.; The superpowers offer bounties on Thargoid vessels while Salvation constructs anti-xeno superweapons.
maxton-price.bio_full:
Admiral Maxton Price is a senior officer in the Federal Navy who emerged as one of the principal military commanders during the Thargoid Titan War. In April 3308, he was selected to coordinate the Federal defense when Thargoid fleets invaded the Sosong system, part of a simultaneous three-pronged assault on superpower core systems that placed over ten billion lives at risk.

Price became a vocal proponent of Salvation's anti-xeno strategy, arguing that the superweapon was indispensable for ending the Thargoid conflict. In June 3308, he defended the superpowers' continued collaboration with Azimuth Biotech despite revelations of its INRA past, stating bluntly: "Without Salvation's superweapon, we will be locked in conflict with the Thargoids forever." He also commanded the Federal response to the Taranis rogue signal source in late 3308, ordering civilian vessels to avoid the Hyades Sector FB-N b7-6 system while military forces monitored the anomaly's arrival.

shannon-day.name: Shannon Day
shannon-day.bio: Shannon Day is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-19 to 3302-04-19. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group. Commander Josh Hawkins recovers an escape pod containing Canonn scientist Shannon Day.

nookie-mrsmith.name: Nookie Mr.Smith
nookie-mrsmith.bio: Nookie Mr.Smith is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-12-06 to 3302-12-16. Closely associated with Candy Crew Guild, Buckyball Racing Club. The Candy Crew Guild is dominating the midpoint of the Kick The Alien Buckyball race, with Commander Nookie Mr.Smith leading followed by Commanders Raijiin and Rewision.

harlan-turk.name: Harlan Turk
harlan-turk.bio: Harlan Turk is a President in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3305-11-15 to 3309-09-22. Affiliated with Empire. Notable activities include: The Empire and Federation both deploy megaships to Upaniklis with competing proposals for the Golconda crew.; The Empire and Federation launch rival initiatives to provide a new home for the Golconda crew.
harlan-turk.bio_full:
Congressman Harlan Turk is a Federal politician who served as Zachary Rackham's running mate during Rackham's presidential election campaign. In November 3305, Turk outlined the Federation's offer to the Golconda generation ship crew, proposing a modern outpost where the Golconda's spacefaring traditions could continue with vastly superior amenities and facilities for new trade relationships within Federal market guidelines.

In September 3309, when the Federal Times hired the Wallglass Investigations Agency to investigate Rackham's alleged pirate past, Turk lobbied Congress to halt the investigation. He asserted that "the Federal Times is breaching the impartiality rules of journalism, and violating the security measures afforded to all presidential candidates." Turk's defence of Rackham positioned him as a loyal political ally willing to use legislative pressure to shield his running mate from scrutiny, even as independent journalists like Flint Lafosse connected Rackham to the Jokers' Deck gambling circle and the Collective hacktivist group's billion-credit heist. Turk's role in the campaign illustrated the political alliances formed around Rackham's unconventional bid for the Federal presidency.

edwin-espinosa.name: Edwin Espinosa
edwin-espinosa.bio: Edwin Espinosa is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-03-21 to 3309-03-28.

patricia-spellman.name: Patricia Spellman
patricia-spellman.bio: Patricia Spellman is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-04-10 to 3301-04-10. Closely associated with Worster Insurance, Better Green Developments. Shadow President Hudson attended the 153rd annual Exphiay Bankers' Ball alongside Frank Hall of Gallant Investment, Paul Wiggins of Wiggins Development Trust, and Patricia Spellman of Sirius Finance.

ram-tah.name: Ram Tah
ram-tah.bio_full:
Ram Tah is a leading engineer and xenologist specialising in Guardian technology, whose research has underpinned much of humanity's anti-xeno scientific progress. He first gained prominence in 3302 by decoding Guardian artefacts and reverse-engineering their technology for human use, including the XG fighter series and various module blueprints distributed through technology brokers.

In 3305, Aegis formally partnered with Ram Tah to expand Guardian technology manufacture, leveraging his expertise for the tri-superpower war effort. His most consequential contribution came in 3308 when he confirmed that Salvation's superweapon was based on a Guardian device discovered by Azimuth Biochemicals at the Proteus site — a revelation that vindicated Admiral Aden Tanner's concerns but could not prevent Aegis's dissolution. Ram Tah continued working with Aegis through the Thargoid Titan War, co-developing the Thargoid pulse neutraliser that allowed probes to survive Maelstrom energy surges, and collaborating with Professor Ishmael Palin to analyse the rogue signal sources converging on the core systems in late 3308.

professor-melville.name: Professor Melville
professor-melville.bio: Professor Melville is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-02-10 to 3303-02-10. Personal logs surface from a clandestine expedition led by Professor Melville to find Guardian relics. The logs reveal discoveries of multiple site clusters and Melville's growing obsession, ending with a distress call.

laura-bishop.name: Laura Bishop
laura-bishop.bio: Laura Bishop is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-10-29 to 3301-10-29. Technical supervisor Laura Bishop reported power outages and widespread system failures over the past 24 hours, with the cause still under investigation.

commissioner-chamberlain.name: Commissioner Chamberlain
commissioner-chamberlain.bio: Commissioner Chamberlain is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-02-21 to 3301-02-21. Closely associated with Emerald Security.

erimus-kamzel.name: Erimus Kamzel
erimus-kamzel.bio: Erimus Kamzel is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-01-04 to 3305-07-03. Closely associated with Deep Space Surveys, Omega Mining Corporation.
erimus-kamzel.bio_full: Erimus Kamzel is a legendary explorer and community leader famous for organising the Distant Worlds expeditions — the largest collaborative exploration events in galactic history. Kamzel's leadership brought thousands of independent pilots together to journey to the far reaches of the galaxy, establishing waypoints and infrastructure that transformed deep-space exploration from a solitary activity into a mass community event.

saskia-landau.name: Saskia Landau
saskia-landau.bio: Saskia Landau is a Emperor in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3307-11-25 to 3308-04-12. Affiliated with NMLA, Far God cult. Notable activities include: The Neo-Marlinist Order of Mudhrid and the Epsilon Fornacis Empire Group declare war in the Mudhrid system, with the NMLA defending Theta Seven abo...; The Epsilon Fornacis Empire Group defeats the Neo-Marlinist Order of Mudhrid, with ACT commandos led by Milo Castile retaking the Steel Majesty meg...
saskia-landau.bio_full:
Captain Saskia Landau is the co-leader of the Affiliated Counter-Terrorism unit who played a pivotal role in dismantling both the NMLA and the secret Imperial conspiracy that had orchestrated its campaign. In February 3308, Landau provided the media with a detailed summary of ACT's investigation into the Lords of Restoration — a cabal of Imperial senators including Gereon, Jourdain, Nerva, Scordato, and Torquatus who had masterminded the NMLA's terrorist activity.

Landau revealed that the Lords had weaponised the NMLA to assassinate the Duvals and restore executive power to the Senate, abducting Emperor Arissa Lavigny-Duval in January 3307 and engineering communications via a virtual doppelganger verified by corrupt Imperial Intelligence agents. She also exposed how Marlinism was exploited as a political lever to make a senator-led Empire appear as a "moderate compromise." Landau had previously warned during the Battle of Mudhrid in November 3307 that Theta Seven's escape would perpetuate the threat of atrocities like the Nine Martyrs bombings. Her leadership in ACT demonstrated how tri-superpower cooperation could unravel even the most deeply entrenched conspiracies.

torvan-dast.name: Torvan Dast
torvan-dast.bio: Torvan Dast is a key figure in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-02-02 to 3304-08-05. Affiliated with Alliance. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering the dismantling of the League of Reparation and Riri McAllister's arrest, the Church of Eternal Void being declared illegal...; Weekly summary covering the foiled assassination attempt on Aisling Duval, Riri McAllister being shot during her trial, the FIA investigation into ...
torvan-dast.bio_full:
Torvan Dast is an Alliance official who has served as a spokesperson and project coordinator for Alliance infrastructure initiatives. In February 3304, he announced plans to build an Orbis starport in the Synuefai EB-R c7-5 system, positioned between the core systems and the Alliance's California Nebula outposts.

Dast stated that the new starport would "bridge the gap between the settlements and the galactic core, and lessen the risk to ships journeying to and from the California Nebula." The initiative was overseen by the LP 128-32 Corporation, which placed open orders for raw materials and kill orders on wanted ships to protect traders. Dast's role in the starport project exemplified the Alliance's strategy of investing in deep-space infrastructure to strengthen connectivity to its frontier territories, supporting both trade and scientific expansion into the California Nebula region.

lexi-october.name: Lexi October
lexi-october.bio: Lexi October is a Commander in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3305-01-31 to 3312-04-30. Affiliated with October Consortium, Supratech, Wallglass Investigations Agency. Notable activities include: Professor Frank Raddix demanded clarity on Terri Tora's fate as journalist Alexei Keel published evidence linking the HIP 87621 permit lock to Lexi...; Lexi October defended October Consortium's legal ownership of HIP 87621, acquired over a decade ago, and questioned why Zachary Rackham has not sha...
lexi-october.bio_full:
Lexi October is a billionaire investor and corporate executive who has built her career around acquiring and restructuring distressed technology firms. In 3305, she rescued Supratech from bankruptcy after the company's Torc personal computer design proved commercially impractical, organising a commodity drive to restart production. Her intervention demonstrated a pattern of using wealth and community resource campaigns to acquire engineering talent and intellectual property from failing competitors.

October's most significant — and controversial — corporate holding is the October Consortium's control of the HIP 87621 system, which she acquired through permit rights over a decade ago. In the 3310s, she defended her organisation's secrecy regarding anomalous exobiological readings in the system, dismissing data inconsistencies as "spoofing" and deflecting scrutiny by questioning why rival billionaire Zachary Rackham had failed to share exploration data. Her opaque management of HIP 87621 made her a central figure in one of the decade's most contentious scientific access disputes.

commander-saool.name: Commander Saool
commander-saool.bio: Commander Saool is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-28 to 3302-04-28. Closely associated with Alliance, Spinward Marches Alliance Concern. Commanders Saool and Dennehy coordinate the effort.

commander-dr-simms.name: Commander Dr Simms
commander-dr-simms.bio: Commander Dr Simms is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-06-18 to 3302-06-18.

bill-turner.name: Bill Turner
bill-turner.bio: Bill Turner is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-06-16 to 3308-06-16. Closely associated with Alliance, Sirius Corporation.

maddox-hurd.name: Maddox Hurd
maddox-hurd.bio: Maddox Hurd is a President in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-08-17 to 3305-01-03. Affiliated with Herculean Machines, Supratech, Alliance. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering Maddox Hurd's criminal connections causing investor flight from Herculean Machines, the announcement of Alliance presidenti...; Weekly summary covering Vanya Driscoll's analysis of Alliance presidential candidates, Lloyd Hardacre's arrest after his robot exposed corporate fr...
maddox-hurd.bio_full:
Maddox Hurd is the founder and CEO of Herculean Machines, a technology company that became embroiled in a high-profile rivalry with Supratech over personal computer design in 3304. Hurd's company developed the Duradrive, a robust personal computer that ultimately outperformed Supratech's rival Torc at the Rackham Ultratech Expo, securing corporate funding and market momentum.

Hurd's career faced a significant setback when declassified Federal Security Service records revealed he had accepted financial contributions from individuals connected to organised-crime networks, including the Red Family, when establishing his company five years earlier. Hurd dismissed the revelation as a smear campaign orchestrated by Supratech, and Herculean Machines recovered sufficiently to dominate the expo. His public persona is characterised by aggressive competitiveness and sharp criticism of corporate rivals.

captain-anopheles.name: Captain Anopheles
captain-anopheles.bio: Captain Anopheles is a pirate in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-24 to 3301-07-24. Closely associated with Kumo Crew, The Code. Captain Anopheles and The Code pirate crew have left Archon Delaine's Kumo Crew alliance.

commander-alec-turner.name: Commander Alec Turner
commander-alec-turner.bio: Commander Alec Turner is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-03-30 to 3302-11-22. Closely associated with Buckyball Racing Club.

commander-tverez.name: Commander T'Verez
commander-tverez.bio: Commander T'Verez is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-03-16 to 3309-03-16. Closely associated with Universal Cartographics.

missing.name: Missing
missing.bio: Missing is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-03-25 to 3307-03-25. Closely associated with NMLA, Imperial Internal Security Service, Marlinist.

marshal-cooper.name: Marshal Cooper
marshal-cooper.bio: Marshal Cooper is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-02-21 to 3305-02-28. Closely associated with Namab Purple Brothers, Drevlyada League. A long-standing personal rivalry between General Kendrick of the Namab Purple Brothers and Marshal Cooper of the Drevlyada League escalates into open conflict in the Drevlyada system.

corentin-delacroix.name: Corentin Delacroix
corentin-delacroix.bio: Corentin Delacroix is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-11-19 to 3307-11-25. Closely associated with Neo-Marlinist Order of Mudhrid, NMLA, Marlinist.

xiona.name: Xiona
xiona.bio: Xiona is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-10-05 to 3307-10-05. Closely associated with Kumo Crew.

jaya-chaudhary.name: Jaya Chaudhary
jaya-chaudhary.bio: Jaya Chaudhary is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-11-02 to 3309-11-01.

tycoon-thalios-abraxas.name: Tycoon Thalios Abraxas
tycoon-thalios-abraxas.bio: Tycoon Thalios Abraxas is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-11 to 3301-05-11. Closely associated with Alliance. Top contributors included Broker Mrozak, Broker HawX, Tycoon Ace Rimzy, Tycoon Thalios Abraxas and Broker Del Boy.

larry-oldman.name: Larry Oldman
larry-oldman.bio: Larry Oldman is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-05-27 to 3302-05-27.

commander-badbjarne.name: Commander BadBjarne
commander-badbjarne.bio: Commander BadBjarne is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-20 to 3301-03-20. President Halsey honoured Federal commanders who made the greatest contributions to the Lugh war effort. Commander Nightwulf removed almost 14,000 enemy combatants.

post-commander-crownan.name: Post Commander Crownan
post-commander-crownan.bio: Post Commander Crownan is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-20 to 3301-03-20. President Halsey honoured Federal commanders who made the greatest contributions to the Lugh war effort. Commander Nightwulf removed almost 14,000 enemy combatants.

andius-solon.name: Andius Solon
andius-solon.bio: Andius Solon is a pirate in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-10-02 to 3301-10-02. Closely associated with Bacon Cats.

dr-derthek.name: Dr Derthek
dr-derthek.bio: Dr Derthek is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-05-13 to 3302-05-13. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group, Universal Cartographics.

sean-richards.name: Sean Richards
sean-richards.bio: Sean Richards is a engineer in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-04 to 3302-03-15. Closely associated with Federal Times, Sirius Corporation, Emperor's Dawn. It alleges the deaths of Nigel Smeaton, Sean Richards, Arnold Lowe, Susan Monroe, Elaine Boyd, Emperor Hengist Duval, and the disappearances of Jasmina Halsey and Ishmael Palin are all connected.

chloe-sedesi.name: Chloe Sedesi
chloe-sedesi.bio: A starship engineer and former apprentice of Professor Ishmael Palin, Chloe Sedesi established a major engineering facility at Cinder Dock in the Witch Head Nebula in 3305.
chloe-sedesi.bio_full:
After completing her apprenticeship under Professor Ishmael Palin — one of the galaxy's foremost authorities on extraterrestrial objects and advanced materials — Chloe Sedesi sought independence from her mentor's shadow. In August 3305, she migrated to the Witch Head Nebula and established her own engineering facility at Cinder Dock, bringing Palin's rigorous methodology to a frontier region desperate for technical expertise.

The Witch Head location proved strategically astute. As Alliance colonisation accelerated through the Expeditionary Pact, Sedesi's facility became an essential stop for pilots traversing the nebula's dangerous currents. Her work on starship modifications, particularly those involving heat management and jump optimisation, addressed the specific challenges of nebula operations. By 3309, Sedesi had built a reputation distinct from Palin's, known for practical engineering solutions tailored to the hazards of deep-nebula exploration.

commander-denneb.name: Commander Denneb
commander-denneb.bio: Commander Denneb is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-11-05 to 3302-11-05.

heimar-borichev.name: Heimar Borichev
heimar-borichev.bio: Heimar Borichev is a Diplomat in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3308-07-18 to 3309-02-07. Affiliated with Salvation, Alliance Defence Force. Notable activities include: Heimar Borichev's editorial sparks widespread debate over whether humanity has the right to commit xenocide against the Thargoids.; A grassroots xeno-peace movement gains traction following the Battle of HIP 22460, promoting diplomatic dialogue with Thargoids through media figur...
heimar-borichev.bio_full:
Heimar Borichev is a political activist and writer for the independent newsfeed The Sovereign who emerged as a prominent voice in the anti-authoritarian protest movements of 3309. As the Thargoid war escalated following the arrival of the Maelstroms, Borichev blamed superpower leaders for allowing the conflict to escalate, claiming that "institutional corruption requires radical solutions."

His commentary aligned with a broader wave of activism across the Alliance, Empire and Federation that accused governments of prioritising corporate arms profits over civilian lives. While xeno-peace figureheads such as Joy Senne distanced themselves from the more radical elements of the movement, Borichev continued to advocate for direct action against what he viewed as the military-industrial complex's profiteering from the Thargoid invasion.

commander-sid-solo.name: Commander Sid Solo
commander-sid-solo.bio: Commander Sid Solo is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-06-18 to 3302-06-18.

karina-washington.name: Karina Washington
karina-washington.bio: Karina Washington is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-08-24 to 3304-08-24. Closely associated with Mars Tribune, Federal Security Service, Federal Congress.

saeed-mcnamara.name: Saeed McNamara
saeed-mcnamara.bio: Saeed McNamara is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-09-03 to 3301-09-03. Closely associated with Interstellar Press, Utopia. McNamara declined to address rumors that subjects emerge with radically altered personalities.

great-gig.name: Great Gig
great-gig.bio: Great Gig is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-29 to 3301-07-29. Closely associated with Kumo Crew, Lavigny's Legion.

rachel-young.name: Rachel Young

kingsley-cordova.bio: Kingsley Cordova is a Emperor in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-08-24 to 3304-11-24. Affiliated with Mars Tribune, Cordova Group, Federal Security Service. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering the Alliance Assembly's decision to create the Office of the Alliance President without executive powers, Sirius Corporatio...; The Mars Tribune publishes an exposé revealing Congressman Morgan Unwin's decade-long debt to the Red Family cartel and his use of political influe...
kingsley-cordova.bio_full:
Kingsley Cordova is the owner of the Mars Tribune and the Cordova Group, a Federal media conglomerate implicated in a large-scale corporate surveillance scandal in late 3304. An anonymous whistle-blower from the Achilles Corporation revealed that Cordova had blackmailed a robotics engineer into installing surveillance programs on PA912 robots belonging to well-known individuals in the Sol system.

The accumulated data was relayed to the Cordova Group for publication in the Mars Tribune. The scandal prompted Achilles Corporation to release a coreware update with a remote kill switch that deleted the spy program from all affected robots. Cordova's actions demonstrated how media corporations could leverage technology for illicit intelligence gathering, blurring the boundary between journalism and corporate espionage.

kaeso-mordanticus.name: Kaeso Mordanticus

He was executed by Senator Denton Patreus on the Senate floor in January 3305.
kaeso-mordanticus.bio_full: Kaeso Mordanticus is a former Imperial naval admiral who became the leader of Nova Imperium, a radical isolationist faction. A Duke from a long line of decorated military veterans, Mordanticus maintained contacts and influence within the Imperial Navy even after leaving service. An Imperial Internal Security Service leak confirmed that Nova Imperium ships were mostly crewed by ex-naval personnel bound by loyalty to their former commanding officer. Mordanticus's manifesto called for complete Imperial isolation from other superpowers and the installation of Hadrian Duval as Emperor. In January 3305, he was captured after the Battle of Paresa and executed by Senator Denton Patreus on the Imperial Senate floor before Emperor Arissa Lavigny-Duval.

lena-ravenhill.bio_full: Lena Ravenhill serves as Chief Editor of the Federal Times, one of the Federation's most respected news outlets. In November 3304, she published a bombshell investigative report exposing the spy robot scandal. Ravenhill revealed that an anonymous Achilles Corporation whistleblower had attested to being blackmailed by Kingsley Cordova, owner of the Mars Tribune, into installing surveillance programs on PA912 robots belonging to well-known figures in the Sol system. The accumulated data was relayed to the Cordova Group and published in the Mars Tribune. Her reporting triggered Achilles Corporation's remote kill-switch response and ultimately led to the Mars Tribune's closure.

elizabeth-perez.name: Elizabeth Perez
elizabeth-perez.bio: Elizabeth Perez is a Scientist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3305-11-11 to 3308-09-23. Affiliated with Orion University, Upaniklis Vision Incorporated, Scriveners Clan. Notable activities include: Inexplicable deep-space anomalies detected beyond the Col 70 sector generate widespread speculation, with theories ranging from Thargoid weapons to...; The crew of the generation ship Golconda migrate to their new home at Forester's Choice outpost in the Upaniklis system.
elizabeth-perez.bio_full:
Professor Elizabeth Perez is head of anthropology at Orion Independent University and a leading expert on isolated human cultures. In 3305, she conducted the first academic study of the generation ship Golconda after its discovery in the Upaniklis system, examining how the vessel's inhabitants maintained a recognisably 22nd-century society after more than a thousand years of isolation.

Perez's analysis revealed a rigidly structured community with a custodian, a chaplain, and deeply ingrained isolationist tendencies. She warned that contact with outsiders could "irrevocably damage" the Golconda's unique culture, comparing it to historical cases where isolated societies collapsed upon first contact. Her work informed the Federation's resettlement strategy, which ultimately relocated the Golconda's population to Forester's Choice while attempting to preserve their social structures. Perez's research remains a foundational text in the study of long-duration spacefaring societies.

lana-berkovich.name: Lana Berkovich
lana-berkovich.bio: Lana Berkovich is a President in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3308-09-20 to 3309-11-06. Affiliated with Order of the Far God. Notable activities include: The Order of the Far God faces Federal investigation and public backlash after HIP 22460, driving thousands of worshippers to abandon orthodox hive...; Congressman Dalton Chase has made a public statement regretting his involvement with the Thargoid Advocacy Project.
lana-berkovich.bio_full:
Lana Berkovich is the Federal Secretary of State who served under President Zachary Hudson during the Thargoid conflicts of the late 3300s. In September 3308, she sponsored a resolution petitioning Congress to make the Order of the Far God illegal, citing constitutional amendments that prevent citizens from providing aid and comfort to an enemy of the state.

Berkovich's resolution followed the Federal Navy Intelligence Office's discovery that the Far God cult was believed to be responsible for leaking classified audiovisual data from the HIP 22460 system. Her hardline stance on Thargoid worshippers aligned with Hudson's broader counter-xeno policy, though it drew condemnation from civil rights organisations including Advocacy and the Galactic Interfaith Commune. Her role in the crackdown exemplified the Federal government's willingness to treat religious dissent as treason during wartime.

rose-trebek.bio: Rose Trebek is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-02-25 to 3302-03-05. Closely associated with Blue Hand Gang, Joint Security Taskforce. Rose Trebek speculates the gang bought the escape pods without knowing their contents. Rose Trebek, a former soldier, establishes the Joint Security Taskforce to clean up the Orulas system from the ruthless Blue Hand Gang.

kahina-tijani-loren.name: Kahina Tijani Loren
kahina-tijani-loren.bio: Kahina Tijani Loren is a Senator in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3301-03-06 to 3303-05-04. Notable activities include: Senator Kahina Tijani Loren of Prism has disappeared from her Imperial suite on Capitol.; Lady Kahina Tijani Loren, former senator of the Prism system, has been charged in connection with the attempted assassination of Admiral Denton Pat...
kahina-tijani-loren.bio_full:
Kahina Tijani Loren is a former Imperial Senator who represented the remote Prism system before her dramatic disappearance in 3301. A vocal critic of Admiral Denton Patreus's expansionist campaigns, Loren cultivated a reputation as an independent voice within the Imperial Senate — one willing to challenge military adventurism despite the political risks. Her disappearance from her Imperial suite on Capitol triggered one of the galaxy's most enduring mysteries.

Loren's Imperial Courier, the *Seven Veils*, was found stripped of equipment at Capitol spaceport, containing only her tiara and a medallion bearing the word "Salomé" alongside a symbol associated with the secretive Dark Wheel organisation. She was later charged in absentia with the attempted assassination of Patreus at Mackenzie Relay in Cemiess — charges widely viewed as politically motivated. Whether she is alive, dead, or operating under another identity remains unknown, and her case continues to fuel speculation among independent pilots and conspiracy theorists alike.

ezra-lux-kumar.name: Ezra Lux-Kumar
ezra-lux-kumar.bio: Ezra Lux-Kumar is a terrorist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-05-24 to 3304-05-24. Closely associated with INRA, Pilots Federation, Federal Intelligence Agency. Ezra Lux-Kumar was found dead from nerve toxin in his home on Biggs Colony.

tom-gillespie.name: Tom Gillespie
tom-gillespie.bio: Tom Gillespie is a Federal Congressman who coordinated the Federation's involvement in Aegis reform in 3309 and oversaw the ammonia world survey.
tom-gillespie.bio_full:
Tom Gillespie is a Federal Congressman who volunteered in 3309 to coordinate the Federation's involvement in the reformation of Aegis. Following the Alliance Assembly's vote to support a collaborative anti-xeno agency, Gillespie worked to align Federal resources with the tri-superpower initiative, praising independent pilots as "absolutely unmatched in dedication and expertise."

Gillespie also oversaw the ammonia world survey conducted by Aegis and Universal Cartographics, which mapped terrestrial planets with ammonia-based atmospheres to identify potential Thargoid staging grounds. His role as a congressional liaison between the Federal government and Aegis made him a key figure in the political rehabilitation of the agency after its dissolution in 3308. Gillespie's tenure reflected the broader shift in Federal policy toward renewed multilateral cooperation against the Thargoids.

captain-smolenski.name: Captain Smolenski

edgar-starwalker.name: Edgar Starwalker
edgar-starwalker.bio: Edgar Starwalker is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-29 to 3301-08-26. Closely associated with Kumo Crew, Lavigny's Legion. Commander Edgar Starwalker, aligned with Arissa Lavigny-Duval, questioned prioritising distant systems over corruption on Imperial doorsteps.
edgar-starwalker.bio_full:
Commander Edgar Starwalker emerged as an outspoken Imperial pilot during the turbulent political climate of 3301, openly aligning himself with Senator Arissa Lavigny-Duval's campaign against corruption. His public statements challenged the Imperial establishment's tendency to prioritise distant military expeditions over addressing systemic graft within its own territories. This stance placed him at odds with more traditionalist elements of Imperial society who viewed external expansion as essential to the Empire's prestige and security.

Starwalker's associations extended beyond Imperial circles to include contacts with Kumo Crew and Lavigny's Legion, suggesting a pragmatic approach to alliance-building that transcended conventional factional boundaries. His willingness to question Imperial priorities from a position of loyalty rather than opposition distinguished him from more radical critics. In this respect, Starwalker represented a particular strain of Imperial reformism that sought to strengthen the Empire through internal purification rather than external conquest.

Notable activities include: Aegis shutdown procedures continue despite revelations that Azimuth Biochemicals was responsible for the Alexandria's loss.; Professor Alba Tesreau presents evidence that Salvation is Dr Caleb Wycherley, former Azimuth Biochemicals researcher and INRA collaborator who hel...
conrad-sterling.bio_full:
Conrad Sterling is a political correspondent for Vox Galactica who has covered major inter-superpower diplomatic events and Federal politics. He is best known for his reporting from the Galactic Summit in February 3307, where he provided detailed accounts of the first-ever face-to-face discussions between Alliance, Imperial, and Federal leaders in the Sirius system.

Sterling's journalism has tracked the rise of corporatist movements inspired by Jupiter Division, the evolving relationship between the Federation and independent powers such as Yuri Grom, and the political fallout from the Aegis dissolution. His dispatches from the Galactic Summit captured both the ceremonial optimism and underlying tensions of the conference, including the frostiness between Imperial and Marlinist delegations and the conspicuous absence of Federal Ambassador Jordan Rochester.

sal-riley.bio: Sal Riley is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-08-18 to 3303-08-18. Closely associated with Secoya Emperor's Grace.

riri-mcallister.name: Riri McAllister
riri-mcallister.bio: Riri McAllister is a Admiral in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-04-13 to 3304-11-21. Affiliated with League of Reparation, Alliance, Alliance Defence Force. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering Riri McAllister being unmasked as Nexus and framing Admiral Varma, the hunt for League strongholds in Zibal and Ienpalang, ...; Weekly summary covering the dismantling of the League of Reparation and Riri McAllister's arrest, the Church of Eternal Void being declared illegal...
riri-mcallister.bio_full:
Rear Admiral Riri McAllister was a senior officer in the Alliance Defence Force who was unmasked in July 3304 as "Nexus," the central coordinator of the League of Reparation terrorist group. McAllister had used her position to frame Admiral George Varma with false leads, misdirecting the tri-superpower taskforce investigating the League's murders of INRA descendants. She was arrested and formally charged with conspiracy to commit terrorism following a breakthrough by Deputy Inspector Mara Klatt of Alliance Interpol.

McAllister's betrayal shocked Alliance military leadership and exposed profound security vulnerabilities at the highest levels of the ADF. The decrypted data from her arrest revealed the locations of two major League enclaves, enabling the taskforce to launch operations to eradicate remaining terrorist cells. Her exposure as Nexus remains one of the most disturbing instances of senior military personnel orchestrating mass murder in modern galactic history.

jason-treeves.name: Jason Treeves
jason-treeves.bio: Jason Treeves is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-11-02 to 3301-11-02.
