susannah-haynes.bio: Susannah Haynes is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3306-09-17 to 3308-05-09. Closely associated with Kavanagh Spaceframes Ltd, Steel Castle Inc, Pilots Federation.

luria.bio: Luria is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-11-21 to 3308-11-21.

leyton-farris.name: Leyton Farris
leyton-farris.bio: Leyton Farris is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-08-16 to 3305-08-16. Closely associated with Alliance.

cornelius-gendymion.bio: Cornelius Gendymion is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-23 to 3302-04-23. Closely associated with Core Dynamics, Federal Times. Imperial investigator Cornelius Gendymion releases a statement suggesting Federal Times reporter Elaine Boyd's investigations into the Antares and Starship One disasters were suppressed.

yulia-kuriakova.name: Yulia Kuriakova
yulia-kuriakova.bio: Yulia Kuriakova is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-14 to 3302-04-21. Closely associated with Pilots Federation, United Epsilon Indi Flag. Spokesperson Yulia Kuriakova celebrates the victory over corporate interests.

patience-middleton.name: Patience Middleton
patience-middleton.bio: Patience Middleton is a Admiral in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3307-05-07 to 3307-11-18. Affiliated with Taurus Mining Ventures, Aegis, Pilots Federation. Notable activities include: The mysterious figure 'Salvation' sends a message to pilots who discovered the Hesperus, authorising Taurus Mining Ventures to pay for logs and pro...; Pilots discover the Proteus, an Anaconda from the Hesperus, at a historical battlefield on Trapezium Sector YU-X c1-2 1a.
patience-middleton.bio_full:
Patience Middleton is a representative of Taurus Mining Ventures, the commercial partner of the mysterious anti-xeno scientist known as Salvation. In May 3307, she announced that Salvation had authorised payments of two million credits or ten units of void opals for pilots who delivered logs from the Hesperus megaship to the Hind Mine asteroid base in the T Tauri system.

Middleton's role as a corporate intermediary allowed Salvation to maintain anonymity while recruiting pilots for his operations. She relayed Salvation's message that his scientific breakthroughs would "literally save all of humanity," and confirmed that further work would be offered to intrepid agents. Her position at Taurus Mining Ventures exemplified how Salvation used legitimate corporate structures to mask his Azimuth Biochemicals background and acquire resources for his Guardian-derived superweapon research.

harold-duval.name: Harold Duval
harold-duval.bio: Harold Duval was a Prince of the Imperial Duval dynasty and father of Aisling Duval. Emperor Hengist Duval declared him unfit for the throne, after which he lived out of the public eye. In September 3306, he was assassinated by NMLA terrorists while making an unpublicised journey to visit his daughter Aisling in Cemiess.
harold-duval.bio_full: Harold Duval was a Prince of the Imperial Duval dynasty and the father of Princess Aisling Duval. Emperor Hengist Duval famously declared him unfit for the throne, after which Harold lived largely out of public view on Capitol. In September 3306, he was making an unpublicised journey to visit Aisling in Cemiess following a recent terrorist attack in that system. A single NMLA assassin infiltrated his personal transport, shooting the Prince at close range before being killed by shipboard guards. The NMLA claimed responsibility, referring to the Duval family as "imperialist parasites" and demanding that Marlinists rise up to demand a democratic republic. How the NMLA learned of his itinerary remains unknown.

dinah-law.name: Dinah Law
dinah-law.bio: Dinah Law is a terrorist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-06-21 to 3304-06-24. Closely associated with Alliance Interpol, League of Reparation, INRA. Chief Inspector Kay Kilbride foils a League of Reparation assassination attempt on Dinah Law, a descendant of INRA employee Trystan Law.

aitken.name: Aitken
aitken.bio: Aitken is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-26 to 3301-08-26. Aitken and Dardevel saved Commander Ghetto King with only two seconds of emergency air remaining.

tach.name: Tach
tach.bio: Tach is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-02-18 to 3307-02-18. Closely associated with Core Dynamics.

sandra-corrs.name: Sandra Corrs
sandra-corrs.bio: Sandra Corrs is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-12-15 to 3311-12-15. Closely associated with Our Dolph's Routes, Sandra's Workshop. Sandra Corrs, CEO of the largest manufacturer of children’s toys in the core systems, has requested help this holiday season. Sandra Corrs requests pilot volunteers to deliver festive gifts to children displaced by the Thargoid invasion, with her upgraded Our Dolph's Routes fleet struggling to locate all recipients.
sandra-corrs.bio_full:
Sandra Corrs built a remarkable career as chief executive of the largest children's toy manufacturing company in the core systems, establishing her Our Dolph's Routes brand as a household name across Federal, Imperial, and independent territories. Her business acumen transformed a modest venture into an industrial powerhouse capable of producing and distributing goods across vast interstellar distances. The scale of her operations required sophisticated logistics networks and close coordination with shipping fleets, giving her unique insight into the practical challenges of galactic commerce.

Beyond her commercial success, Corrs demonstrated significant humanitarian commitment during the Thargoid invasion, when she initiated annual campaigns to deliver festive gifts to children displaced by the conflict. These efforts relied on volunteer pilots and her upgraded Our Dolph's Routes fleet, though the sheer scale of displacement often exceeded even her substantial logistical capabilities. Her charitable work illustrated how corporate leaders could leverage existing infrastructure for humanitarian purposes, providing moments of joy to young survivors amidst widespread destruction.

senator-patreus.name: Senator Patreus
senator-patreus.bio: Senator Patreus is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-04-03 to 3301-04-03. Closely associated with Imperial Palace.

octo.name: Octo
octo.bio: Octo is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-01-15 to 3302-01-15. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group. Commander Octo discovered the first barnacles on Merope 5c, with additional sites found on Pleiades Sector JC-U B3-2.

queen-jezza.name: Queen Jezza
queen-jezza.bio: Queen Jezza is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-08 to 3302-04-08. Commander Lysianassa declares herself 'Queen of Sagittarius A*' after making the 26,000 light-year journey in a heavily armed Federal Corvette.

dr-roy-casimir.name: Dr. Roy Casimir
dr-roy-casimir.bio: Dr. Roy Casimir is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3312-01-28 to 3312-04-07. Closely associated with October Consortium, Holloway Bioscience Institute. Roy Casimir publishes first public Radicoida unica study.

rachel-ziegler.name: Rachel Ziegler
rachel-ziegler.bio: Rachel Ziegler is a Admiral in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3305-05-18 to 3308-11-29. Affiliated with Alliance, Federal Navy, Salvation. Notable activities include: Thargoid fleets invade the Didio, Novas, and Sosong systems, placing over ten billion lives at risk.; Sirius Corporation claims the Thargoid incursions prove the necessity of its strategic defence pact with the Alliance.
rachel-ziegler.bio_full:
Admiral Rachel Ziegler is a senior officer in the Alliance Defence Force who publicly condemned President Gibson Kincaid's military power grab in 3305. When Kincaid assumed direct command of the Zaonce fleet through Admiral Frederick Yamamoto — a personal friend — Ziegler denounced the decision as "political grandstanding that borders on treason."

Her opposition highlighted the Council of Admirals' resistance to Kincaid's authoritarian ambitions, which included bypassing the existing ADF command structure. Ziegler's stance aligned with Prime Minister Edmund Mahon's demands for Kincaid's resignation, and her public condemnation demonstrated that senior military officers were willing to challenge political interference in the Alliance Defence Force's chain of command.

lal-candromir.name: Lal Candromir
lal-candromir.bio: Lal Candromir is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-09-20 to 3304-09-20. Closely associated with Imperial Internal Security Service. The New Dawn Collection of sculptures by legendary artist Lal Candromir, dating back nearly a thousand years, is entirely taken.

ronan-brock.name: Ronan Brock
ronan-brock.bio: Ronan Brock is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-02-17 to 3308-02-17. Closely associated with NMLA, Darkwater Inc, Imperial Navy.

f-zlim.name: F-Zlim
f-zlim.bio: F-Zlim is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-10-09 to 3301-10-09. Closely associated with Fuel Rats, Olympus Corporation. Commander F-Zlim was rescued by the Fuel Rats with only 50 seconds of oxygen remaining after a CO2 leak left his ship, the 'Korblah', stranded without fuel.

margot-hist.name: Margot Hist
margot-hist.bio: Margot Hist is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-11-17 to 3304-11-17. Closely associated with Dervish-Foss Literary Agency, Bonespire Publishing. His literary agent Margot Hist confirms he is in good health and working on a new science fiction novel. Hist explains that she was unaware of the concern because she was on holiday and there are no communication facilities at Skyglow Havens on the Rhea Archipelago.

anthony-corvus.name: Anthony Corvus
anthony-corvus.bio: A general in the Imperial Navy, Anthony Corvus publicly challenged Senator Denton Patreus's optimistic assessments of the Emperor's Dawn campaign in late 3301, warning that the insurgents operated as a resilient cell network.
anthony-corvus.bio_full:
General Anthony Corvus emerged as a rare voice of caution within the Imperial military establishment in September 3301, publicly questioning Senator Denton Patreus's confident predictions that Emperor's Dawn would be quickly eradicated. Corvus described the insurgents as a well-organised cell organisation that was "surprisingly hard to extinguish," noting that new cells appeared as soon as existing ones were destroyed.

The general's assessment proved prescient. Within months, shadow cells were discovered in Dakshmandi, Ipilyaqa and Ch'i Lin — confirming that Emperor's Dawn had prepared for decapitation by dispersing its operations across multiple hidden nodes. Corvus's willingness to contradict a politically powerful senator like Patreus demonstrated both his institutional independence and his understanding of counter-insurgency realities. While the Imperial Herald reported his comments, it was the subsequent events that vindicated his analysis, establishing Corvus as one of the few Imperial officers who accurately assessed the depth of the terrorist threat.

kay-volantyne.name: Kay Volantyne
kay-volantyne.bio: Kay Volantyne is a Pirate in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3307-04-30 to 3308-06-01. Affiliated with Kumo Crew. Notable activities include: Five new Kumo Crew starports become fully operational across the galaxy.; A Blue Viper Club dredger enters the Pegasi Sector PN-T c3-14 system and takes position near Kumo City.
kay-volantyne.bio_full:
Kay Volantyne is an Arch-Corsair of the Kumo Council who has represented the Kumo Crew's interests in the galaxy's highest-stakes gambling circles. In 3307, she was identified as a regular participant in Jokers' Deck — an exclusive casino for the super-rich organised by multi-billionaire Lexi October. Volantyne was observed at the roue mortelle tables competing against Zachary Rackham, alongside fellow Kumo Council member Trask.

Her presence in these elite social circles illustrates the complex status of the Kumo Crew under Archon Delaine's leadership: simultaneously a pirate confederation preying on shipping lanes and a political entity whose representatives mingle with senators, ambassadors, and corporate titans. Volantyne's activities suggest that the Kumo Council has evolved beyond simple piracy into a sophisticated power broker that uses wealth and social access to protect its territorial and commercial interests.

besieger.name: Besieger
besieger.bio: Besieger is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-05-04 to 3303-05-04. Commander Salomé (Kahina Tijani Loren) was killed in the Arumclaw system by a bounty hunter known as 'Besieger', while her co-conspirators remain at large.

mahina-dillon.name: Mahina Dillon
mahina-dillon.bio: Mahina Dillon is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-08-31 to 3302-08-31.

dalton-chase.name: Dalton Chase
dalton-chase.bio: Dalton Chase is a Diplomat in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3308-08-23 to 3309-02-07. Affiliated with Federal Navy. Notable activities include: Deliveries to the Andavandul system have enabled the Thargoid Advocacy Project to begin preparations for a diplomatic mission.; The rise of the xeno-peace movement has caused a number of public figures to discuss coexisting peacefully with the Thargoid race.
dalton-chase.bio_full:
Dalton Chase is a Federal Governor and congressman who emerged as a prominent advocate for xeno-diplomacy during the Thargoid conflicts of the late 3300s. In November 3308, he publicly endorsed peaceful coexistence with the Thargoids, arguing that humanity should demonstrate its capacity for non-violent relations by dispatching the pro-peace megaship Kingfisher to establish diplomatic contact. His stance positioned him as a leading voice in the xeno-peace movement alongside former President Jasmina Halsey.

Chase's advocacy translated into electoral success when he was elected to the Federal Congress as a pro-peace candidate, representing a significant constituency of voters sceptical of purely military responses to the Thargoid threat. His political career illustrates the growing influence of xeno-diplomacy advocates within Federal politics during a period when superpower leadership remained overwhelmingly focused on anti-xeno warfare.

jimmy-ice-pick-falcone.name: Jimmy 'Ice Pick' Falcone
jimmy-ice-pick-falcone.bio: Jimmy 'Ice Pick' Falcone is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-06-16 to 3302-06-16. Closely associated with Crom Silver Boys.

commander-sid-funkleton.name: Commander Sid Funkleton
commander-sid-funkleton.bio: Commander Sid Funkleton is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-06-18 to 3302-06-18.

walter-waldo.name: Walter Waldo
walter-waldo.bio: Walter Waldo is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-10-20 to 3303-10-13. Closely associated with Gyvatices Crimson Advanced Holdings, Wonderful Walter's Fish and Coffee Emporium.
walter-waldo.bio_full:
Walter Waldo gained recognition as the proprietor of Wonderful Walter's Fish and Coffee Emporium, an establishment with connections to Gyvatices Crimson Advanced Holdings. Operating during the early 3300s, his business represented the kind of independent commercial venture that flourished in systems with active mining and trade economies. The emporium's unusual combination of seafood and caffeinated beverages suggested a personality willing to blend disparate elements into something uniquely appealing.

Beyond his commercial activities, Waldo became a minor figure of interest within certain corporate circles through his association with Gyvatices Crimson Advanced Holdings. This connection hinted at relationships between seemingly mundane service businesses and the larger corporate networks that controlled resource extraction and distribution. Waldo's story illustrated how individuals running modest enterprises could find themselves linked to far-reaching economic interests simply by operating in the right place at the right time.

herman-colt.name: Herman Colt
herman-colt.bio: Herman Colt is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3310-10-29 to 3310-10-29. Treasure hunter Herman Colt goes missing during an expedition to find Captain Morrigan's final treasure hoard near Frenis, prompting concern from colleague Natasha Moore.

ihazevich.name: Ihazevich
ihazevich.bio: Ihazevich is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-08-31 to 3302-08-31. Independent pilots Noctrach and Ihazevich discovered mysterious wreckage on planet 9a in the Pleiades Sector AB-W B2-4 system after a galaxy-wide hunt coordinated by the Granger Gang.

terri-tora.name: Terri Tora
terri-tora.bio: Terri Tora is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3311-09-02 to 3311-09-25. Closely associated with October Consortium. Professor Frank Raddix's appeal to find missing exobiologist Terri Tora led thousands of pilots to the permit-locked HIP 87621. The October Consortium claimed two megaships in the region were on routine survey and denied knowledge of Tora's whereabouts.

erin-sangster.name: Erin Sangster
erin-sangster.bio: Erin Sangster is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-10-05 to 3304-10-31. Closely associated with Alliance Interpol, Alliance. Inspector Erin Sangster of Alliance Interpol suspects professional assassins. Inspector Erin Sangster officially rules the death a homicide involving sophisticated nerve toxin and professional assassins who circumvented security at Hume Orbital.

lynk1973.name: Lynk1973
lynk1973.bio: Lynk1973 is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-26 to 3301-08-26. Closely associated with XYZ Fight Club.

reegan-tanner.name: Reegan Tanner
reegan-tanner.bio: Reegan Tanner is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-08-31 to 3304-09-09. Closely associated with Far God cult, LHS 2541 Alliance Combine. Chancellor Reegan Tanner states the materials will be revered as objects of worship and not used for xenobiological experiments. Chancellor Reegan Tanner thanks contributors and firmly denies rumours that the sect experiments on willing test subjects.

adley-king.name: Adley King
adley-king.bio: Adley King is a journalist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-02-21 to 3305-02-21. Closely associated with Federal Times, Prax Incorporated.

mil1tia-six.name: MiL1TiA SiX
mil1tia-six.bio: MiL1TiA SiX is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-03-09 to 3303-03-09. Closely associated with Military Militia.

commander-egg90.name: Commander Egg90
commander-egg90.bio: Commander Egg90 is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-03 to 3301-05-03. Closely associated with The Code, East India Company. Commander Trillen attempted to coordinate with Commander Egg90, but miscommunication led to the trader boosting into Code fire.

mischief.name: Mischief
mischief.bio: Mischief is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-05-12 to 3302-05-12. Closely associated with Fuel Rats.

arlo-cortez.name: Arlo Cortez
arlo-cortez.bio: Arlo Cortez is a pirate in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-05-13 to 3302-05-13. Arlo Cortez, a member of Jasmina Halsey's personal staff, rebuffs conspiracy theorist Ricardo Bentonio's claims that Halsey has been silenced by governmental powers.

djtruthsayer.name: DJTruthsayer
djtruthsayer.bio: DJTruthsayer is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-26 to 3301-08-26. Closely associated with XYZ Fight Club.

commander-turkwinif.name: Commander turkwinif
commander-turkwinif.bio: Commander turkwinif is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-18 to 3302-04-18. Commander turkwinif becomes the first pilot to reach Rho Cassiopeiae, a class-F hypergiant visible from Earth located in the difficult-to-navigate Formidine Rift.

dr-kaii.name: Dr Kaii
dr-kaii.bio: Dr Kaii is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-08 to 3302-05-26. A transmission from Commander Salomé congratulates Dr Kaii and Commander Erimus on the Distant Worlds Expedition's colossal achievement.

jacob-harris.name: Jacob Harris
jacob-harris.bio: Jacob Harris is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-15 to 3302-04-23. Closely associated with Federal Times, Imperial Senate, Core Dynamics. Federal politician Jacob Harris claims the destruction of Starship One was deliberate sabotage by Imperial agents, not mechanical failure.

post-commander-pablo-diablo.name: Post Commander Pablo-Diablo
post-commander-pablo-diablo.bio: Post Commander Pablo-Diablo is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-20 to 3301-03-20. President Halsey honoured Federal commanders who made the greatest contributions to the Lugh war effort. Commander Nightwulf removed almost 14,000 enemy combatants.

commander-tavok.name: Commander Tavok
commander-tavok.bio: Commander Tavok is a senator in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-11 to 3301-05-11.

ogden-smith.name: Ogden Smith
ogden-smith.bio: Ogden Smith is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-07-28 to 3304-07-28. Closely associated with Andromedaries Superlative Society, Blackshadow Productions. Fan society president Ogden Smith defends the reboot as returning to the gritty drama fans enjoyed as children.

mathius-leander.name: Mathius Leander
mathius-leander.bio: Mathius Leander is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-09-07 to 3304-09-09. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group. Captain Mathius Leander reports that Thargoid vessels severely damaged multiple systems including the Frame Shift Drive.

commander-ranger-one.name: Commander Ranger-One
commander-ranger-one.bio: Commander Ranger-One is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-10-13 to 3303-10-13. Closely associated with Secret Billionaires. Commander Ranger-One thanked the community for restoring peace and stability.

lynda-amanda-ter-holt.name: Lynda Amanda ter Holt
lynda-amanda-ter-holt.bio: Lynda Amanda ter Holt is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3312-03-19 to 3312-04-26. Closely associated with Deep Space Surveys, Distant Worlds 3.

lorcan-scordato.name: Lorcan Scordato
lorcan-scordato.bio: Lorcan Scordato is an Imperial Senator who served as a key diplomat during the Neo-Marlinist crisis of 3307. He negotiated a conditional amnesty for the Neo-Marlinist Order of Mudhrid, securing intelligence that advanced the Affiliated Counter-Terrorism unit's investigation into the NMLA.
lorcan-scordato.bio_full:
Lorcan Scordato is an Imperial Senator who played a key diplomatic role in resolving the Neo-Marlinist crisis of 3307. In April 3307, he negotiated a conditional amnesty for the Neo-Marlinist Order of Mudhrid, securing an agreement where Landgrave Arastin Delacroix and his inner circle would cooperate with the Affiliated Counter-Terrorism unit to reveal NMLA leadership identities in exchange for life imprisonment.

Scordato's diplomatic efforts provided ACT with crucial intelligence on the NMLA, though the information also led to the false allegation that Hadrian Duval was the terrorist mastermind. Chancellor Anders Blaine approved Scordato's proposal as "precisely the sort of creative solution the Emperor requires." His work demonstrated how political negotiation could achieve results that military force alone could not, even as the NMLA threat continued to challenge Imperial security.

commander-santander.name: Commander Santander
commander-santander.bio: Commander Santander is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-02-23 to 3302-02-23. Closely associated with Fuel Rats. Commander Santander discovers two occupied escape pods on a rocky-ice body near the NGC 1333 nebula, over 1,000 light years from the nearest starport. The crash site was visible from high altitude, and Santander investigated in his SRV before recovering the pods in his Asp Explorer.

verity-gavroche.name: Verity Gavroche
verity-gavroche.bio: Verity Gavroche is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-02-23 to 3302-03-29. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group.
verity-gavroche.bio_full:
Verity Gavroche served as a pilot affiliated with the Canonn Interstellar Research Group during early 3302. Her involvement with the organisation placed her within one of the most active independent research communities of the era, a collective dedicated to investigating phenomena that official institutions either overlooked or classified. As a pilot-researcher, she contributed to the group's distributed efforts to document anomalies, alien artefacts, and unexplained occurrences across explored space.

Her activity during this period coincided with escalating interest in Thargoid-related discoveries and other mysteries that would dominate scientific discourse for decades. Gavroche represented the growing cohort of independent pilots who combined exploration and combat skills with genuine scientific curiosity, challenging the monopoly that corporate and government laboratories held on formal research. Her association with Canonn demonstrated how grassroots scientific communities could attract dedicated participants from diverse backgrounds.

kathy-mcbrayer.name: Kathy McBrayer
kathy-mcbrayer.bio: Kathy McBrayer is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-09-06 to 3301-09-06. Closely associated with Pilots Federation, Jameson Memorial Review, Universal Cartographics.

cormac-ui-laoghire.name: Cormac Uí Laoghire
cormac-ui-laoghire.bio: Cormac Uí Laoghire is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-26 to 3301-03-26. Closely associated with Crimson State Group. Cormac Uí Laoghire personally led the defence, achieving the Crimson State Group's first victory after several days of fighting.

admiral-kirby.name: Admiral Kirby
admiral-kirby.bio: Admiral Kirby is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-12-16 to 3301-12-16. Closely associated with Emperor's Dawn, Federal Navy.

jing-sheng-mendez.name: Jing-sheng Mendez
jing-sheng-mendez.bio: Jing-sheng Mendez is a admiral in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-08-30 to 3304-08-30. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group, Pilots Federation.

raijiin.name: Raijiin
raijiin.bio: Raijiin is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-12-06 to 3303-09-29. Closely associated with Candy Crew Guild, Buckyball Racing Club. The Candy Crew Guild is dominating the midpoint of the Kick The Alien Buckyball race, with Commander Nookie Mr.Smith leading followed by Commanders Raijiin and Rewision.
raijiin.bio_full:
Commander Raijiin established a reputation as a skilled independent pilot active within the Candy Crew Guild, an organisation known for its distinctive approach to both commerce and community engagement. During late 3302 and 3303, Raijiin participated in the Kick The Alien Buckyball race, one of the more unusual competitive events organised by the Buckyball Racing Club. This race challenged pilots to navigate through Thargoid-influenced territories at maximum speed, combining the technical demands of precision flying with the additional pressure of operating in potentially hostile space.

Raijiin's performance in the race placed him among the top competitors, trailing only Commander Nookie Mr.Smith and ahead of Commander Rewision at the midpoint. This achievement demonstrated both exceptional piloting skill and the courage to push personal and ship limits in environments where conventional wisdom would counsel caution. Through participation in such events, Raijiin exemplified the competitive spirit that drove many independent pilots to test their abilities against peers in increasingly challenging conditions.

kieran-rayne.name: Kieran Rayne
kieran-rayne.bio: Kieran Rayne is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-04-25 to 3309-04-25. The FIA reveals the assassin is a freelance mercenary named Kieran Rayne with no Imperial connections, and Caine-Massey withdraws its accusation against Torval.

commander-driggers.name: Commander Driggers
commander-driggers.bio: Commander Driggers is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-03-01 to 3302-03-01. Closely associated with Core Dynamics, Federal Navy, Federal Times.

ghetto-king.name: Ghetto King
ghetto-king.bio: Ghetto King is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-26 to 3301-08-26. Aitken and Dardevel saved Commander Ghetto King with only two seconds of emergency air remaining.

perry-hussein.name: Perry Hussein
perry-hussein.bio: Perry Hussein is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-03-20 to 3303-03-20. Federal intelligence member Perry Hussein stated the telemetry indicates it was an older vessel, perhaps Cobra class, and the ship appears to have been destroyed.

marcus-mercer.name: Marcus Mercer
marcus-mercer.bio: Marcus Mercer is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-08-15 to 3308-08-15. Closely associated with Pilots Federation.

peter.name: Peter
peter.bio: Peter is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-19 to 3301-07-19. Closely associated with Kumo Crew, Sirius Corporation, Imperial Navy.

solomon-helios.name: Solomon Helios
solomon-helios.bio: Solomon Helios is a Journalist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-05-26 to 3308-01-01. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering Aisling Duval's anti-slavery campaign merging with Universal Liberty to form Unchain, Lori Jameson's denunciation of the Le...; Weekly summary covering Riri McAllister being unmasked as Nexus and framing Admiral Varma, the hunt for League strongholds in Zibal and Ienpalang, ...
solomon-helios.bio_full:
Solomon Helios is an entertainment journalist who covers Imperial court politics and celebrity gossip, with a particular focus on Princess Aisling Duval's romantic life. In mid-3304, Helios secured exclusive coverage of Aisling's diplomatic functions with Federal Ambassador Jordan Rochester, correctly identifying Vice Admiral Juno Rochester as a potential "future in-law" before the engagement was announced.

Helios's reporting on the Aisling-Rochester romance combined entertainment journalism with genuine political insight, speculating on whether Emperor Arissa Lavigny-Duval and President Hudson would attend the wedding or intervene to prevent the union. His commentary on the cancelled wedding in August 3304 — noting the political earthquake it caused — demonstrated that Imperial entertainment media could shape public perception of superpower diplomacy.

erik-gunnarson.name: Erik Gunnarson
erik-gunnarson.bio: Erik Gunnarson is a Commander in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3307-04-02 to 3307-12-23. Affiliated with Wallglass Investigations Agency, Pilots Federation. Notable activities include: Francesca Wolfe details the discovery of the Hesperus alongside the Scriveners Clan dredger in the Perseus Dark Region.; Pilots report new contact from 'Salvation' near the Hesperus and Adamastor.
erik-gunnarson.bio_full:
Erik Gunnarson is an investigative journalist with the Wallglass Investigations Agency who specialises in uncovering hidden or forgotten human societies. In 3307, he published a groundbreaking study of the Dredger Clans — nomadic tribes that roam deep space in converted bulk cruisers, scavenging and occasionally raiding to sustain tens of thousands of inhabitants whose cultures have evolved over centuries of isolation.

Gunnarson's research revealed that these dredgers function as generation ships, with each clan hosting distinct societies that have diverged significantly from mainstream galactic culture. His work brought academic legitimacy to what had previously been dismissed as spacer folklore, including childhood nightmares about the Phagos clan's cannibalistic reputation. His article on the dredgers directly preceded the discovery of the Scriveners Clan alongside the Hesperus megaship, validating his thesis that these nomadic societies were not merely surviving but actively pursuing their own agendas in the galaxy's fringes.

casey-kilpatrick.name: Casey Kilpatrick
casey-kilpatrick.bio: Casey Kilpatrick is a freelance reporter for Vox Galactica who covered the Scriveners Clan standoff with Orion University. He witnessed Orion's megaship Scientia Aeterna remotely disable the dredger's hyperdrive, and reported on the clan's resistance including sealed airlocks and an electrified hull.
casey-kilpatrick.bio_full: Casey Kilpatrick is a freelance reporter who contributes to Vox Galactica. In October 3307, he provided an eyewitness account from the Oochost PC-C c29-0 system of the standoff between the Scriveners Clan and Orion University. Kilpatrick reported that Orion's megaship, Scientia Aeterna, had remotely disabled the dredger's hyperdrive using override codes from the university's archives. He witnessed the Scriveners' refusal to communicate and their physical resistance to boarding attempts, including sealed airlocks and an electrified hull. Kilpatrick also highlighted the university's likely interest in the clan's Knowledge Core—a database containing everything the scholarly society had learned during its long voyage.

naomi-landseer.name: Naomi Landseer
naomi-landseer.bio: Naomi Landseer is the chairperson of Lakon Spaceways who oversaw development of the Type-8 Transporter with SCO frame shift drive compatibility.
naomi-landseer.bio_full: Naomi Landseer is the chairperson of Lakon Spaceways, a major Alliance ship manufacturer known for its utilitarian and cargo-focused vessel designs. She assumed leadership during a pivotal period for the company, overseeing the development of the Type-8 Transporter — a medium-class freighter designed to accommodate the stresses of the new SCO frame shift drive. Landseer revealed that the Type-8 was moved back to the theoretical stage to properly integrate SCO technology, resulting in what became the largest medium-class freighter frame in production. Her tenure at Lakon exemplifies the Alliance industrial sector's focus on practical engineering over prestige, prioritising cargo capacity and operational efficiency.

night-furry.name: Night Furry
night-furry.bio: Night Furry is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-03-29 to 3309-03-29. Closely associated with Alliance, Empire.

nelson-de-rosa.name: Nelson De Rosa
nelson-de-rosa.bio: Nelson De Rosa is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-02-05 to 3302-02-05. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group. Nelson De Rosa, chief of security for the Canonn, reveals that Dr Arcanonn received a credible death threat warning him against visiting Professor Palin in Maia.

helena-stone.name: Helena Stone
helena-stone.bio: Helena Stone is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-23 to 3301-07-23. Closely associated with Alliance Defence Force, Wolf 406 Transport Co, Alliance. Victoria Wolf VI of Wolf 406 Transport Co and Commodore Helena Stone of the Alliance Defence Force launched Operation Augeas to rid BD-22 3573 of criminal elements troubling miners and traders. Stone clarified this is not a military operation as BD-22 3573 does not fall under Alliance jurisdiction; the ADF will observe and only intervene if escalation occurs.

commander-sam-ishum.name: Commander Sam Ishum
commander-sam-ishum.bio: Commander Sam Ishum is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-11 to 3301-03-11. Closely associated with Core Dynamics. Commander Sam Ishum braved the blockade of BD+03 2338 to deliver 86,000 tonnes of copper to Hudson Dock.

therealflame.name: TheRealFlame
therealflame.bio: TheRealFlame is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-03-31 to 3307-03-31. Closely associated with NMLA, Imperial Internal Security Service, Marlinist.

hyford.name: Hyford
hyford.bio: Hyford is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-08-31 to 3307-08-31. Closely associated with Wallglass Investigations Agency. A data cache left by Commander Hyford at a crash site in Colonia reactivates, revealing clues about mysterious deliveries to a nameless organization in the Pleiades.

bryanna-blanco.name: Bryanna Blanco
bryanna-blanco.bio: Bryanna Blanco is a Journalist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-06-20 to 3311-09-22. Affiliated with Federal Times, Rackham Capital Investments. Notable activities include: Zachary Rackham hosts a week-long trillionaire celebration in Beta Hydri, requesting rare goods from pilots.; Rackham Capital Investments concluded its galaxy-wide exploration initiative, with Rackham claiming scientists are close to cracking the HIP 87621 ...
bryanna-blanco.bio_full:
Bryanna Blanco is a financial journalist for The Federal Times known for her persistent investigative scrutiny of billionaire Zachary Rackham. In 3304, she publicly questioned the legitimacy of Rackham's billion-credit Federal Grand Lottery win, suggesting the windfall would be used to pay his company's gargantuan unpaid tax bill rather than donated to charity as he claimed. Her reporting cemented her reputation as one of the Federation's most skeptical financial commentators.

Blanco maintained her critical coverage as Rackham's public profile grew, penning opinion pieces that highlighted his extragavant self-promotion — including the towering Rackham's Spire on Homeland — and warning that his lighthearted hints about running for president in 3308 were calculated steps toward a genuine campaign. She has repeatedly reminded the public of Rackham's former identity as "Calico Zack," one of the previous century's most notorious pirates, accusing mainstream newsfeeds of sanitising his history.

jean-daniel-moulin.name: Jean-Daniel Moulin
jean-daniel-moulin.bio: Jean-Daniel Moulin is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3310-11-07 to 3310-11-07. Closely associated with Utopia.

jast-fernandez.name: Jast Fernández
jast-fernandez.bio: Jast Fernández is a senator in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-04-13 to 3304-04-28. Closely associated with Aegis, Alliance. Editor Jast Fernández suggested the killer was motivated by the discovery of Commander Jameson’s ship logs proving the INRA manipulated and sacrificed him. Media editor Jast Fernández speculated that Aisling may be maturing politically or revealing a genuine critical faculty beneath her public persona.

pal-vespasian.name: Pal Vespasian
pal-vespasian.bio: Pal Vespasian is a Senator in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-04-13 to 3305-01-25. Affiliated with Nova Imperium, Aegis. Notable activities include: The murder of Imperial Senator Nestor Cartesius has sparked widespread speculation about the INRA.; Weekly summary covering Dr Alfred Ulyanov's comments on abandoned Far God outposts in the Etain system, Aegis's breakthrough neutralising Thargoid ...
pal-vespasian.bio_full:
Pal Vespasian is an Imperial Senator who served during the turbulent period following the murder of Senator Nestor Cartesius in April 3304. Vespasian appealed for the Cartesius family to be given space to grieve, offering a measured response amid widespread speculation about the Intergalactic Naval Reserve Arm's involvement in the assassination.

Vespasian's call for restraint contrasted with the more inflammatory reactions from other quarters, including media speculation about INRA's dark history and Commander Jameson's betrayal. His role in the Senate during this period exemplified the diplomatic challenges faced by Imperial politicians when dealing with crimes that touched on sensitive historical matters, particularly those involving the Empire's past actions against the Thargoids.

rex-whitlock.name: Rex Whitlock
rex-whitlock.bio: Rex Whitlock is a former marketing director for Rockforth Corporation who was dismissed in 3305 following the company's role in the blight crisis.
rex-whitlock.bio_full: Rex Whitlock is a corporate marketing executive who served as marketing director for Rockforth Corporation, an agricultural technology firm. In 3305, he promoted the company's synthetic crop enhancement technology, which was later implicated in the blight crisis that devastated agricultural systems across the galaxy. When the full scale of the blight became apparent, Rockforth Corporation dismissed Whitlock, making him a scapegoat for the company's role in one of the most serious agricultural disasters in recent history. His case exemplifies how corporations deflect responsibility for systemic failures onto individual executives.

commander-raiko.name: Commander Raiko
commander-raiko.bio: Commander Raiko is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-08-11 to 3302-08-11. Closely associated with Buckyball Racing Club.

tyber-de-maat.name: Tyber de Maat
tyber-de-maat.bio: Tyber de Maat is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-26 to 3301-08-26. Closely associated with Emperor's Dawn, Interstellar Press.

ursula-torquatus.name: Ursula Torquatus
ursula-torquatus.bio: Ursula Torquatus is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-02-21 to 3308-02-21. Closely associated with NMLA, Nova Imperium.

nisha-devi.name: Nisha Devi
nisha-devi.bio: Nisha Devi is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-08-24 to 3307-08-24. Closely associated with Kumo Crew, Vandermeer Corporation, Interstellar Health Organisation.

doctor-elana-lorax.name: Doctor Elana Lorax
doctor-elana-lorax.bio: Doctor Elana Lorax is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-02-25 to 3302-02-25. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group. Doctor Elana Lorax, a leading xeno biologist, condemns the destruction of barnacles for meta-alloys.

luca-redondo.name: Luca Redondo
luca-redondo.bio: Luca Redondo is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-08-15 to 3309-08-15. Closely associated with Aegis.

rewision.name: Rewision
rewision.bio: Rewision is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-12-06 to 3302-12-06. Closely associated with Candy Crew Guild. The Candy Crew Guild is dominating the midpoint of the Kick The Alien Buckyball race, with Commander Nookie Mr.Smith leading followed by Commanders Raijiin and Rewision.

denzile-dex.name: Denzile Dex
denzile-dex.bio: Denzile Dex is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-12 to 3301-07-12. Closely associated with Imperial Senate. Leaked technical documents linked new Imperial modules to research by discredited Professor Denzile Dex, raising safety concerns.

mike-juliett-kilo.name: Mike Juliett Kilo
mike-juliett-kilo.bio: Mike Juliett Kilo is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-10-13 to 3301-10-13. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group. Commander Mike Juliett Kilo made the breakthrough by feeding a pre-recorded AEO signal into an antique scanner display, revealing a Vulture schematic matching his own ship at the time.

freya-taine.name: Freya Taine
freya-taine.bio: Freya Taine is the CEO of Zende Partners, a corporation that established a megaship transport service connecting Zende and Guardian space. In May 3305, she accused Segnen Exchange of attacking her convoys and called on independent pilots to support Zende Partners' efforts to control Guardian commodity trade in Synuefe EN-H d11-96.
freya-taine.bio_full: Freya Taine serves as CEO of Zende Partners, a corporation that expanded into Guardian space with a megaship transport service. In May 3305, Taine publicly accused rival Segnen Exchange of attacking Zende convoys in Synuefe EN-H d11-96, calling it a "flagrant attempt to undermine our efforts." She appealed to independent pilots for support in removing the threat, framing the conflict as necessary to protect Zende's operation and advance production of an Advanced Multi-cannon derived from Guardian technology. The corporate clash in Guardian space set a precedent for how commercial interests could trigger open warfare over access to alien resources.

klemyr.name: Klemyr
klemyr.bio: Klemyr is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-09-29 to 3308-09-29. Closely associated with Pilots Federation.

rani-zaman.name: Rani Zaman
rani-zaman.bio: Rani Zaman is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-11-24 to 3308-11-24.

broker-mrozak.name: Broker Mrozak
broker-mrozak.bio: Broker Mrozak is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-11 to 3301-05-11. Closely associated with Alliance. Top contributors included Broker Mrozak, Broker HawX, Tycoon Ace Rimzy, Tycoon Thalios Abraxas and Broker Del Boy.

commander-stern-winter.name: Commander Stern Winter
commander-stern-winter.bio: Commander Stern Winter is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-25 to 3302-04-25. Closely associated with Buckyball Racing Club.

george-varma.name: George Varma
george-varma.bio: George Varma is a Admiral in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-05-25 to 3308-11-01. Affiliated with League of Reparation, Alliance. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering Admiral Varma's arrest, the Church of Eternal Void declaring war on the Far God cult, Aisling Duval's wedding date announce...; Weekly summary covering Riri McAllister being unmasked as Nexus and framing Admiral Varma, the hunt for League strongholds in Zibal and Ienpalang, ...
george-varma.bio_full:
Admiral George Varma was a member of the Alliance Council of Admirals who was arrested in July 3304 for his alleged role as "Nexus," the coordinator of the League of Reparation terrorist organisation. Captain Niamh Seutonia and Senior Agent Tanya Ramirez confronted Varma during a meeting of admiralty staff at Donaldson starport in Alioth, placing him under arrest despite protests.

The tri-superpower taskforce investigating the League of Reparation had evidence that Varma was secretly redirecting cargo shipments from the Alliance Defence Force to terrorist cells, providing them with military-issue weapons, equipment and encryption. The arrest created diplomatic ripples, with Federal and Imperial ambassadors summoned before the Alliance Assembly. Council member Jed Trager called the arrest an "egregious transgression," though Prime Minister Edmund Mahon stated that the body of evidence against Varma was considerable. His case exposed the vulnerability of Alliance military institutions to infiltration and the challenges of coordinating counter-terrorism across superpower boundaries.

chloe-anders.name: Chloe Anders
chloe-anders.bio: Chloe Anders is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-01-31 to 3302-01-31. Chloe Anders of the Christian Dock surveillance team reported the vessel circled the station at close range before departing abruptly, leading to speculation that it was searching for something.

zuri-afolayan.name: Zuri Afolayan
zuri-afolayan.bio: Zuri Afolayan is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-08-10 to 3309-08-10. Closely associated with Aegis.

mary-silverstein.name: Mary Silverstein
mary-silverstein.bio: Mary Silverstein is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-09 to 3301-05-09. Closely associated with Alioth Independents. Mary Silverstein of the 78 Ursae Majoris for Equality Party expressed hope for productive reconciliation.

marla-poulsen.name: Marla Poulsen
marla-poulsen.bio: Superintendent of Aegis Research, Marla Poulsen coordinated humanitarian rescue operations during the Thargoid conflict in the Pleiades Nebula.
marla-poulsen.bio_full:
Marla Poulsen serves as Superintendent of Aegis Research, the scientific division of the anti-xeno organisation Aegis. In August 3304, she coordinated a major rescue operation in the Pleiades Nebula following sustained Thargoid attacks on civilian targets that left hundreds of survivors stranded in damaged escape pods across the region.

Poulsen's operation highlighted the human cost of the Thargoid conflict, as local system authorities had diverted all resources to military defence, leaving search-and-rescue efforts neglected. She mobilised independent pilots to recover occupied and damaged escape pods while simultaneously requesting food supplies to sustain the rescued civilians until they could be transferred to dedicated refugee centres.

ambassador-cuthrick-delaney.name: Ambassador Cuthrick Delaney
ambassador-cuthrick-delaney.bio: The chief diplomatic representative of Loren's Legion, Ambassador Cuthrick Delaney became a controversial figure after Senator Kahina Tijani Loren delegated Prism system responsibilities to him in 3301.
ambassador-cuthrick-delaney.bio_full:
Cuthrick Delaney served as the public face of Loren's Legion, handling external relations and resource appeals for the faction led by Senator Kahina Tijani Loren. In 3301, Loren's decision to delegate responsibility for the Prism system to Delaney triggered a severe political backlash that culminated in her being stripped of senatorial rank — a punishment many observers considered disproportionate and politically motivated.

Despite the scandal, Delaney continued his diplomatic work. In late 3302, he announced that Loren's Legion's appeal for tantalum had been enthusiastically received by the galactic community, demonstrating that the faction retained both operational capacity and public support. His career illustrated how Imperial politics could punish even routine administrative delegations when they became weapons in senatorial rivalries.

infinity1.name: Infinity+1
infinity1.bio: Infinity+1 is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-03 to 3301-08-03. Closely associated with Imperial Navy. Commander Infinity+1 commented on the lucrative trade, with profits allegedly running towards 4,000 credits per slave.

commander-alesia.name: Commander Alesia
commander-alesia.bio: Commander Alesia is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-11-01 to 3302-11-01. Closely associated with Colonia Citizens Network, Pilots Federation. Commander Alesia of the Pilots Federation recorded the first data, and mycologist Dr James Morel identified two species visually from telemetry and urged explorers to handle specimens with care.

mandelbaum.name: Mandelbaum
mandelbaum.bio: Mandelbaum is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-06-30 to 3303-06-30. Closely associated with Adle's Armada, LHS 3447 Dynamic and Co, Pilots Federation.

hadrian-duval.name: Hadrian Duval
hadrian-duval.bio: Hadrian Duval is a Emperor in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3305-01-10 to 3309-10-02. Affiliated with Nova Imperium, NMLA, Imperial Herald. Notable activities include: The Empire declares open conflict with Nova Imperium in the Paresa system, with Senator Patreus calling on Imperial auxiliaries to support Yupini L...; Nova Imperium is defeated in the Battle of Paresa by Imperial forces led by Yupini Limited, with Senator Patreus warning that the Empire will not t...
hadrian-duval.bio_full:
Hadrian Duval is the grandson of Emperor Hengist Duval and a claimant to the Imperial throne through his father, the illegitimate Prince Harold Duval. Leader of the isolationist Nova Imperium movement, Hadrian challenged Emperor Arissa Lavigny-Duval's authority from his stronghold in the Paresa system, advocating a return to traditional Imperial values and withdrawal from galactic entanglements. His execution of Imperator Kaeso Mordanticus on the Senate floor in 3305 marked the brutal suppression of his movement — though Hadrian himself survived.

After the Nova Imperium's military defeat and the purge of its supporters, Hadrian accepted a pardon from Arissa and was granted the title of Lord, effectively neutralising him as a political threat while preserving the Duval bloodline. His subsequent marriage to Lady Astrid Minerva-Duval and the birth of their son Hector in 3307 transformed Hadrian from rebel to family man, though questions about his true ambitions and lingering support among isolationist sympathisers continue to shadow his public rehabilitation.

ivan-johansen.name: Ivan Johansen
ivan-johansen.bio: Ivan Johansen is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-11-08 to 3305-11-14. Closely associated with Upaniklis Vision Incorporated, Interstellar Health Organisation.

seo-jin-ae.name: Seo Jin-ae
seo-jin-ae.bio: Seo Jin-ae is a Scientist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3308-10-04 to 3311-06-03. Affiliated with Aegis, Salvation, Azimuth. Notable activities include: The sole survivor of the notorious Project Seraph experiments has reportedly appeared at the Aegis symposium, startling the live audience.; Azimuth Biotech has publicly offered assistance to Subject D-2, the Project Seraph survivor who gate-crashed the recent Aegis symposium.
seo-jin-ae.bio_full:
Seo Jin-ae is the sole survivor of Project Seraph, a clandestine Azimuth Biochemicals programme that implanted human test subjects with Thargoid-derived neural interfaces to establish communication with the alien hive mind. Her survival came at an extraordinary cost: the experiments left her with a permanent, involuntary connection to the Thargoid collective consciousness, enabling her to perceive alien intentions and emotional states — a capability that has made her both invaluable and deeply vulnerable.

Rescued by Aegis and later the Far God cult, Seo has become a pivotal figure in humanity's efforts to understand Thargoid behaviour. Her public statements at Aegis symposia provided unprecedented insights into Thargoid psychology, while her meetings with Far God representatives — whom she described with weary frustration as expecting "divine commandments" — demonstrated both her unique access and the burden of being treated as a prophet rather than a scientist. The cult's veneration of her as "the Preceptor" underscores the blurred line between her scientific utility and religious fetishisation.

tori-theopolis.name: Tori Theopolis
tori-theopolis.bio: Tori Theopolis is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-07-14 to 3304-08-17. Closely associated with Federal Grand Lottery, Cobra Wing, Church of Eternal Void. Spokesperson Tori Theopolis asks citizens to check with lottery players they know.
tori-theopolis.bio_full:
Tori Theopolis served as a public spokesperson during the mid-3300s, most notably representing the Federal Grand Lottery during a period of significant public interest in the organisation's activities. Her role required her to communicate with citizens across Federal space, encouraging participation in lottery programmes that funded various government and charitable initiatives. The position placed her within a network of public relations professionals who shaped how Federal institutions presented themselves to the populations they served.

Beyond her work with the lottery, Theopolis maintained connections to both Cobra Wing and the Church of Eternal Void, suggesting either personal affiliations or professional relationships that spanned disparate organisational cultures. Her public appeal for citizens to check with lottery players they knew demonstrated a communications strategy designed to leverage social networks rather than relying solely on official channels. This approach reflected broader trends in Federal public engagement during an era of increasing media fragmentation and decentralised information flow.

grimnir-allvadderung.name: Grimnir Allvadderung
grimnir-allvadderung.bio: Grimnir Allvadderung is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-08 to 3301-07-24. Closely associated with Emperor's Grace, Cosmic State, Hammer Arms. Grimnir Allvadderung and Admiral Brennus celebrated with mead and an axe-throwing contest. Grimnir Allvadderung and Vaarwen Mako Brennus met in Rishair to announce the development, though the announcement was overshadowed by news of Emperor Hengist Duval's wedding.
grimnir-allvadderung.bio_full:
Grimnir Allvadderung emerged as a charismatic figure within Imperial-affiliated circles during the politically eventful period of mid-3301, maintaining documented connections to Emperor's Grace, Cosmic State, and Hammer Arms. His public appearances combined theatrical elements of Imperial tradition with an unconventional personal style that distinguished him from the typically reserved aristocratic establishment. In Rishair, he met with Admiral Vaarwen Mako Brennus to announce joint developments, though the event was notably overshadowed by concurrent news of Emperor Hengist Duval's upcoming wedding.

The celebration that followed this announcement included mead and an axe-throwing contest, activities that highlighted Allvadderung's embrace of cultural traditions that predated the Empire's more refined court conventions. His associations with organisations spanning military, mercantile, and political spheres suggested a figure who operated as a connector between disparate Imperial interests. Allvadderung's brief prominence in 3301 illustrated how the Empire accommodated diverse personalities within its broad tent, provided they demonstrated sufficient loyalty to Imperial institutions and values.

hayley-sorokin.name: Hayley Sorokin
hayley-sorokin.bio: Hayley Sorokin is a admiral in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-11-21 to 3308-11-01. Closely associated with Alliance, Sirius Corporation. Fleet Admiral Hayley Sorokin conducts the induction, praising Yamamoto's experience commanding the Alliance Defence Force in Zaonce.
hayley-sorokin.bio_full:
Fleet Admiral Hayley Sorokin occupied one of the most senior positions within the Alliance military establishment during the mid-3300s, serving as a key figure in the Council of Admirals and maintaining connections to Sirius Corporation. Her rank placed her at the apex of Alliance naval command, responsible for coordinating defence policy across a diverse coalition of independent systems that had chosen to align under the Alliance banner. The position required not only military acumen but also considerable diplomatic skill to navigate the competing interests of member systems.

In late 3304, Sorokin presided over the induction ceremony of Frederick Yamamoto, praising his experience commanding the Alliance Defence Force in Zaonce. This public endorsement highlighted her role in shaping Alliance military leadership and her willingness to recognise demonstrated competence regardless of background. Her documented activity through 3308 placed her within the Alliance's response to multiple concurrent crises, including the escalating Thargoid threat and internal security challenges that tested the loose confederation's cohesion.

archangel-evangeline.name: Archangel Evangeline
archangel-evangeline.bio: Archangel Evangeline is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-06-13 to 3305-06-20. Closely associated with Evangeline's Elite Expeditionary Force. Evangeline's Elite Expeditionary Force requests superconductors, computer components and insulating membranes from pilots to construct the megaship EFS Archangel in the Shana Bei system. Evangeline's Elite Expeditionary Force successfully completes construction of the megaship EFS Archangel in the Shana Bei system following pilot-supported material deliveries.

broker-del-boy.name: Broker Del Boy
broker-del-boy.bio: Broker Del Boy is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-11 to 3301-05-11. Closely associated with Alliance. Top contributors included Broker Mrozak, Broker HawX, Tycoon Ace Rimzy, Tycoon Thalios Abraxas and Broker Del Boy.

grace-mayweather.name: Grace Mayweather
grace-mayweather.bio: Grace Mayweather is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-08-05 to 3302-08-05. Closely associated with Tionisla government.

inspector-reeve.name: Inspector Reeve
inspector-reeve.bio: Inspector Reeve is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-16 to 3301-08-23. Closely associated with Imperial Intelligence Service. Inspector Reeve discovered encrypted data files hidden in the toys of Brendan Paul Darius's six-year-old niece, killed in the family murder. Inspector Reeve described the deaths as the most horrific he had encountered.

lady-kahina-tijani-loren.name: Lady Kahina Tijani Loren
lady-kahina-tijani-loren.bio: Lady Kahina Tijani Loren is a senator in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-08-13 to 3302-08-19. Closely associated with Imperial Citizen, Reclamists, Children of Raxxla. The Imperial Citizen published a two-part editorial alleging that Commander Salomé is actually Lady Kahina Tijani Loren, the missing Imperial senator from the Prism system.

miyu-azusa.name: Miyu Azusa
miyu-azusa.bio: Miyu Azusa is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3311-04-01 to 3311-04-01. Closely associated with Imperial Navy.

harper-vargas.name: Harper Vargas
harper-vargas.bio: Harper Vargas is a Engineer in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-10-19 to 3304-11-17. Affiliated with Meene Defence Force, Sirius Corporation. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering the mercenary incursion against Ram Tah's Phoenix Base in Meene, the FSS suspension of Lieutenant Inspector Ramesh Thorne, ...; Armed intruders attempt to access Phoenix Base in the Meene system, home of engineer Ram Tah.
harper-vargas.bio_full:
Harper Vargas is the Security Chief of Phoenix Base in the Meene system, the research facility of engineer Ram Tah. In October 3304, Vargas led the defence of Phoenix Base against armed intruders who attempted to breach the base's perimeter in an apparent attempt to steal Guardian technology research.

Vargas reported that defensive systems alerted security teams to the breach, and his teams engaged the intruders in combat and forced them back to a waiting ship. Although the intruders used explosives to sabotage the base's power network, Vargas's quick response prevented the theft of research data or Guardian technology samples. The raid highlighted the vulnerability of independent scientific operations to corporate or state-sponsored espionage, and Vargas's leadership ensured that Ram Tah's critical research into Guardian technology continued uninterrupted.

commander-erimus.name: Commander Erimus
commander-erimus.bio: Commander Erimus is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-08 to 3302-04-08. A transmission from Commander Salomé congratulates Dr Kaii and Commander Erimus on the Distant Worlds Expedition's colossal achievement.

ernest-harris.name: Ernest Harris
ernest-harris.bio: Ernest Harris is a terrorist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3306-11-05 to 3306-11-12. Closely associated with L.Y.S Corp, LTT 1935 Confederacy, Imperial Internal Security Service.

jackson-trent.name: Jackson Trent
jackson-trent.bio: Jackson Trent is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-12-23 to 3302-12-23. Closely associated with Emperor's Dawn, Children of Raxxla.

therion-cygni.name: Therion Cygni
therion-cygni.bio: Therion Cygni is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-11-16 to 3307-11-16. Closely associated with Far God cult, Pleiades Concordat, NMLA.

namin-tirel.name: Namin Tirel
namin-tirel.bio: Namin Tirel is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3310-05-09 to 3310-05-09. Closely associated with Achilles Aerospace, Faulcon DeLacy. Namin Tirel revealing the technology was developed using Thargoid drive components recovered by independent pilots.

oliver-gordon.name: Oliver Gordon
oliver-gordon.bio: Oliver Gordon is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-03-06 to 3302-03-14. Closely associated with Pan Galactic Mining Corp. Chef Oliver Gordon is served with a writ by the Pan Galactic Mining Corp demanding he change the name of his restaurant 'PanGalactic'. Chef Oliver Gordon loses his battle over the 'PanGalactic' trademark and is forced to close his restaurant due to spiralling legal costs.
oliver-gordon.bio_full:
Oliver Gordon established himself as a chef of considerable talent, founding a restaurant under the name 'PanGalactic' that attracted attention across its local region for its distinctive culinary offerings. His choice of name, apparently inspired by the vast scope of human settlement rather than any specific corporate affiliation, nevertheless drew the ire of Pan Galactic Mining Corp, one of the galaxy's larger resource extraction companies. The corporation's legal team served Gordon with a writ demanding he change the restaurant's name, claiming trademark infringement on their established brand.

The ensuing legal battle proved financially devastating for Gordon, who lacked the resources to mount a sustained defence against a major corporate entity's legal apparatus. Within days of the initial filing, mounting legal costs forced him to close his restaurant entirely, destroying a venture he had built through years of culinary dedication. His case became a minor cause célèbre highlighting the power imbalance between independent entrepreneurs and corporate legal departments, illustrating how trademark law could be weaponised against small businesses even where no genuine market confusion existed.

commander-felix-macedonica.name: Commander Felix Macedonica
commander-felix-macedonica.bio: Commander Felix Macedonica is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-11-26 to 3302-11-26. Closely associated with Institute for Galactic Exploration and Research. Commander Chiggy Vonrictofen conducted a dramatic rescue of Commander Felix Macedonica, who was stranded 65,000 light years from home without sufficient germanium to synthesise an FSD injection. Chiggy traveled to Colonia, fitted a mining laser, and crossed 30,000 light years to reach Felix within 48 hours.

commander-lone-wolfpack.name: Commander Lone WolfPack
commander-lone-wolfpack.bio: Commander Lone WolfPack is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-03-16 to 3309-03-16. Closely associated with Universal Cartographics.

gideon-salamanca.name: Gideon Salamanca
gideon-salamanca.bio: Gideon Salamanca is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-04-26 to 3308-04-26. Closely associated with Kumo Crew, Alliance. Archon Delaine appoints Callan Salamanca as a new arch-corsair on the Kumo Council.

hank-stone.name: Hank Stone
hank-stone.bio: Hank Stone is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-02-16 to 3301-02-25. A metal rush has begun in LAWD 26 after the discovery of a pristine mining site by the late prospector Hank Stone. Raw gold from Stone's discovery was found aboard his abandoned Sidewinder at Crook's Hub in Toolfa.

cmdr-silk.name: CMDR Silk
cmdr-silk.bio: CMDR Silk is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-04-03 to 3301-04-03. Closely associated with CODE, Adle's Armada, Alliance. Cosmic State asserts that CMDRs Silk and Kudach are heading the operation to free Lave and potentially Leesti from the CODE threat.

commander-afterglow.name: Commander Afterglow
commander-afterglow.bio: Commander Afterglow is a pirate in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-10-06 to 3303-10-06. Closely associated with Secret Billionaires.

dr-cooper.name: Dr Cooper
dr-cooper.bio: Dr Cooper is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-04-17 to 3309-04-17. Closely associated with Utopia, Aegis.

stateira-eleshenar.name: Stateira Eleshenar
stateira-eleshenar.bio: Stateira Eleshenar is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-24 to 3302-05-27. Closely associated with Interstellar Press, Imperial Navy, Kumo Crew. Commander Stateira Eleshenar of Patreus's forces stated the aim is to free all persons held in branded slavery by the Kumo Crew.

hermine-delarue.name: Hermine Delarue
hermine-delarue.bio: Hermine Delarue is the Executive Operative for Deep Space Surveys. In January 3312, she led the Distant Worlds 3 expedition's call for construction materials to build deep-space infrastructure beyond established survey routes.
hermine-delarue.bio_full: Hermine Delarue serves as Executive Operative for Deep Space Surveys (DSS), an organisation with extensive experience supporting large-scale exploration efforts. In January 3312, Delarue issued a public call for mined and manufactured materials to support the Distant Worlds 3 expedition's construction of a new deep-space facility. She cited DSS's prior work on Explorers' Anchorage during Distant Worlds II as precedent and invited independent pilots to help lay foundations for the next era of deep-space discovery. Her leadership in coordinating community-funded frontier infrastructure has established a model for how exploration organisations can crowdsource construction materials.

kinsley-larson.name: Kinsley Larson
kinsley-larson.bio: Kinsley Larson is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-05-26 to 3302-05-26. Closely associated with Federal Times, Distant Worlds Expedition.

morag-halloran.name: Morag Halloran
morag-halloran.bio: Morag Halloran is a Admiral in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3306-11-12 to 3308-08-25. Affiliated with Alliance, Salvation, Azimuth Biotech. Notable activities include: Salvation confirms his anti-xeno superweapons successfully routed Thargoids from Delphi, Maia and Merope, and urges unity behind his crusade while ...; Commodore Morag Halloran reveals that hundreds of naval officers from all three superpowers and Sirius have resigned to join Salvation's anti-xeno ...
morag-halloran.bio_full:
Commodore Morag Halloran is an Alliance naval officer who defected from the Alliance Defence Force to join Salvation's anti-xeno project in 3308, becoming one of hundreds of officers from all three superpowers who resigned their commissions to serve Azimuth Biochemicals' experimental weapons programme. Her defection exemplified the crisis of confidence that plagued military establishments during the Second Thargoid War, when conventional forces proved unable to halt the Maelstrom onslaught and Salvation's superweapons offered seemingly miraculous results.

Halloran's decision to abandon the ADF for Azimuth was politically explosive, forcing Alliance leaders to confront the inadequacy of their own military capabilities and the seductive appeal of unethical shortcuts. Her subsequent role in Salvation's operations — coordinating naval assets and personnel drawn from multiple superpowers — demonstrated both her tactical competence and the dangerous erosion of institutional loyalty that Azimuth's success provoked. The failure of the Proteus Wave left Halloran and her fellow defectors professionally and morally stranded.

old-sauveur.name: Old Sauveur
old-sauveur.bio: Old Sauveur is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-26 to 3301-08-26. Closely associated with XYZ Fight Club. Bodmans and Old Sauveur reached both finals, with Old Sauveur winning light-class in Eagles and Bodmans taking medium-class in Couriers after a protracted defensive battle.

dev-venkatesh.name: Dev Venkatesh
dev-venkatesh.bio: Dev Venkatesh is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-08-17 to 3309-08-31. Closely associated with Holloway Bioscience Institute.

ernesto-rios.name: Ernesto Rios
ernesto-rios.bio: Ernesto Rios is a key figure in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3307-11-30 to 3312-02-03. Affiliated with Imperial Navy, Aegis, Alliance. Notable activities include: Thargoid attacks intensify across the California, Coalsack, Pleiades, and Witch Head Nebulas, with anti-xeno squadrons struggling to repel unusuall...; Thargoid vessels continue to appear in over two dozen populated systems near nebulas, with organised pilot task forces achieving mixed success agai...
ernesto-rios.bio_full:
Ernesto Rios is a field correspondent for Vox Galactica who has reported from some of the most dangerous frontlines of the Thargoid conflicts. In August 3308, he published a widely circulated dispatch from the aftermath of the HIP 22460 massacre, describing the information blackout imposed by authorities and the refusal of medical personnel to grant press access to survivors aboard Azimuth Biotech's surviving megaships.

Rios's reporting has consistently highlighted the gap between official narratives and ground-level reality during the Thargoid war. His dispatches from HIP 22460 captured both the scale of human suffering and the deliberate obfuscation by military and corporate authorities, establishing him as one of the most courageous war correspondents covering the Second Thargoid War.

didi-vatermann.name: Didi Vatermann
didi-vatermann.bio: Didi Vatermann is a engineer in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-06-16 to 3302-06-16. Closely associated with Rewired.

aaron-whyte.name: Aaron Whyte
aaron-whyte.bio: Aaron Whyte is a Senator in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3306-12-17 to 3307-12-29. Affiliated with NMLA, Marlinist Colonies, Marlinism Reformation Party. Notable activities include: The Epsilon Fornacis Empire Group attacks the Neo-Marlinist Order of Mudhrid after ACT confirms the faction provided logistical support for the NML...; Survivors of the defeated Neo-Marlinist Order of Mudhrid arrive in the Marlinist Colonies aboard the Steel Majesty, requesting asylum.
aaron-whyte.bio_full:
Aaron Whyte was a minister in the Marlinist Parliament and a community leader among political refugees fleeing Imperial persecution in late 3306. As head of the Marlinism Reformation Party, he initially advocated for republican ideals within the new colonies. In June 3307, he declared that his faction would politically represent the Neo-Marlinist fringe, causing widespread alarm that the party might act as the NMLA's political wing.

Whyte's overtures toward the Empire and his defence of Neo-Marlinism deepened rifts within the Marlinist Colonies. Following NMLA starport bombings in July 3307, tensions erupted into civil war between his faction and the anti-NMLA Exiled Marlinist Assembly of Baltah'Sine. The conflict ended in August 3307 with the defeat of the Marlinism Reformation Party and Whyte's death, which Minister Octavia Volkov declared justice for the terrorist campaign his collaborators had begun.

uma-laszlo.name: Uma Laszlo
uma-laszlo.bio: Uma Laszlo is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-06-16 to 3308-06-16. Closely associated with Alliance, Sirius Corporation.

astrid-minerva-duval.name: Astrid Minerva-Duval
astrid-minerva-duval.bio: Astrid Minerva-Duval is a Terrorist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3307-04-05 to 3307-12-02. Affiliated with Nova Imperium, NMLA. Notable activities include: Imperator Hadrian Augustus Duval of Nova Imperium marries his consort Astrid Minerva in a closed ceremony attended by Princess Aisling Duval.; Independent journalist Flint 'Firemaker' Lafosse publishes classified ACT information allegedly from Neo-Marlinist survivors claiming that Hadrian ...
astrid-minerva-duval.bio_full:
Astrid Minerva-Duval is the consort of Imperator Hadrian Duval and a former Imperial pilot who aided Nova Imperium at the Battle of Paresa in 3305. She married Hadrian in a closed ceremony in April 3307 attended by Princess Aisling Duval, becoming Lady Astrid Minerva-Duval and drawing both congratulations and criticism from Imperial media.

The wedding became deeply suspect when allegations emerged later that month claiming Astrid was an NMLA agent who had converted Hadrian to Neo-Marlinism. These accusations, though later declared inconclusive, highlighted the vulnerability of Imperial nobility to terrorist infiltration. Astrid gave birth to a son in December 3307, securing the Duval line and placing pressure on Emperor Arissa and Princess Aisling, neither of whom had consorts. Her case remains one of the most controversial marriages in Imperial history.

yoselin-aquino.name: Yoselin Aquino
yoselin-aquino.bio: Yoselin Aquino is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-10-06 to 3309-10-06. Closely associated with Aegis.

commodore-morayo-orina.name: Commodore Morayo Orina
commodore-morayo-orina.bio: Commodore Morayo Orina is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3311-06-18 to 3311-06-18. Closely associated with Thargoid, Federal Navy. A memorial beacon near the Titan Cocijo wreckage draws visitors, while Commodore Morayo Orina honours the lost at a Sol memorial service.

commander-salome.name: Commander Salomé
commander-salome.bio: A pioneering explorer active in the early 3300s, Commander Salomé was among the first participants in the historic Distant Worlds Expedition.
commander-salome.bio_full:
Commander Salomé established herself as one of the most dedicated explorers of the early 3300s, participating in expeditions that pushed the boundaries of charted space. Her most notable achievement came with the Distant Worlds Expedition, a colossal undertaking that drew hundreds of pilots to the far reaches of the galaxy. Salomé was among the first to arrive at the expedition's destination, demonstrating both navigational skill and the endurance required for multi-month journeys beyond the galactic plane.

In a transmission congratulating Dr Kaii and Commander Erimus on the expedition's success, Salomé revealed the camaraderie that defined the exploration community during this era. Unlike the competitive power struggles dominating superpower politics, the Distant Worlds Expedition represented pure collaborative achievement — pilots sharing route data, rescue coordinates and moral support across tens of thousands of light-years. Salomé's participation embodied the spirit of exploration that would later inspire even more ambitious endeavours like Distant Worlds 2 and 3.

earl-prawnetto.name: Earl Prawnetto
earl-prawnetto.bio: Earl Prawnetto is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-16 to 3301-05-16. Closely associated with Eotienses Citizens' Forum. Top contributors honoured include Viscount Plo Koon, Baron Coiling Dragon, Earl Prawnetto, Earl Morton and Baron Kosmetas.

cassia-carvalho.name: Cassia Carvalho
cassia-carvalho.bio: Cassia Carvalho is a Emperor in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-07-07 to 3310-11-07. Affiliated with Imperial Herald, Nova Imperium, Imperial Navy. Notable activities include: Senator Denton Patreus executes Imperator Mordanticus on the Senate floor before Emperor Arissa, followed by the Imperial Guard gunning down senato...; Security forces carry out a coordinated Empire-wide purge of Nova Imperium, executing members and arresting supporters for treason, though the orga...
cassia-carvalho.bio_full:
Cassia Carvalho is a senior political correspondent for the Imperial Herald, one of the Empire's most influential news outlets. Her reporting has covered the most consequential events in recent Imperial history, including the Nova Imperium crisis, the execution of Imperator Kaeso Mordanticus on the Senate floor, and the subsequent Empire-wide purge of isolationist supporters.
