lord-corwin-ryan.bio: Lord Corwin Ryan is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-02-18 to 3302-02-18. Closely associated with Navigators Guild.

synaptic.name: Synaptic
synaptic.bio: Synaptic is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-26 to 3301-08-26. Closely associated with XYZ Fight Club.

commander-nicholas-powell.name: Commander Nicholas Powell
commander-nicholas-powell.bio: A commander with the Canonn Interstellar Research Group who helped pioneer systematic methods for locating barnacle sites across the galaxy.
commander-nicholas-powell.bio_full:
Commander Nicholas Powell was among the early members of the Canonn Interstellar Research Group who transformed barnacle hunting from chance discovery into systematic science. In mid-3302, he contributed to the publication of "Barnacle Search Criteria," a document that advised pilots on the planetary conditions most likely to host the mysterious alien growths.

His work came at a critical moment. While Commander Wobblytickle's discovery of barnacles in the California Nebula was being celebrated, Powell and his colleagues were already noting with concern the loss of several Pleiades barnacles through destruction or over-harvesting. The search criteria he helped develop enabled more efficient location of new sites, directly supporting the expanding research into meta-alloys and their role in countering the technological plague.

rusticolus.name: Rusticolus
rusticolus.bio: Rusticolus is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-21 to 3301-08-26. Closely associated with Fuel Rats.

cmdr-kudach.name: CMDR Kudach
cmdr-kudach.bio: CMDR Kudach is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-04-03 to 3301-04-03. Closely associated with CODE, Adle's Armada, Alliance. Cosmic State asserts that CMDRs Silk and Kudach are heading the operation to free Lave and potentially Leesti from the CODE threat.

aasha.name: Aasha
aasha.bio: Aasha is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-13 to 3301-08-13. Closely associated with Kumo Crew, Sirius Corporation, Imperial Slavers Associated. Former slave Aasha, a mechanical engineer originally under a Quivira contract with Silver Universal PLC, became the face of the rescue after being found in stasis among pirates.

azalea-halsey.name: Azalea Halsey
azalea-halsey.bio: Azalea Halsey is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-03-29 to 3302-03-29. Closely associated with Leoniceno Orbital medical staff, Federal Times. Former President Jasmina Halsey continues recuperating at Leoniceno Orbital, with all interview requests rebuffed by medical staff. Her sister Azalea Halsey reports that Jasmina seemed distant and spoke of stars and creation, but was remarkably lucid given her ordeal.

commander-murishani.name: Commander Murishani
commander-murishani.bio: Commander Murishani is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-06-24 to 3301-06-24. Closely associated with Pilots Federation, Fuel Rats. Commander Murishani of the Fuel Rats issued public guidance on what to do during a fuel shortage.

selena-conley.name: Selena Conley
selena-conley.bio: Selena Conley is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-09-13 to 3304-09-22. Closely associated with Libertas Cooperative, Munshin Manatee Meat. Progenitor Selena Conley states the project will bring Munshin's fine meat to a wider consumer base. Progenitor Selena Conley thanks pilots and states increased manatee meat production will boost the Munshin system's economy.
selena-conley.bio_full:
Selena Conley served as a progenitor and project leader within the Libertas Cooperative during the mid-3300s, championing an initiative to expand the distribution of Munshin Manatee Meat beyond its traditional regional market. Her vision centred on bringing the product to a wider consumer base across independent and aligned territories, requiring both logistical innovation and persuasive marketing to overcome the challenges of interstellar food distribution. The project represented a significant investment in local agricultural capacity with ambitions for galactic-scale commercial reach.

In September 3304, Conley publicly thanked the independent pilots who had supported the initiative, confirming that increased manatee meat production would generate substantial economic benefits for the Munshin system. Her statements framed the project as a model for how cooperative ventures could leverage pilot networks to achieve economic development goals that might otherwise require corporate or superpower intervention. Conley's work illustrated the entrepreneurial energy that characterised independent systems seeking to build sustainable economies through specialised agricultural and food production industries.

mordanticus.name: Mordanticus
mordanticus.bio: Mordanticus is a Senator in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3305-01-05 to 3305-04-13. Affiliated with Nova Imperium, Imperial Herald. Notable activities include: The Empire declares open conflict with Nova Imperium in the Paresa system, with Senator Patreus calling on Imperial auxiliaries to support Yupini L...; Nova Imperium is defeated in the Battle of Paresa by Imperial forces led by Yupini Limited, with Senator Patreus warning that the Empire will not t...
mordanticus.bio_full:
Mordanticus, also known as Duke Kaeso Mordanticus, was the Imperator and military commander of Nova Imperium, an isolationist faction that challenged the Empire's political establishment in early 3305. He mustered military forces in the Paresa system and declared that Hadrian Duval should be Emperor, rejecting the authority of Emperor Arissa Lavigny-Duval and the Imperial Senate.

In January 3305, the Empire declared open conflict with Nova Imperium, and Mordanticus was captured during the Battle of Paresa after his fleet was destroyed. He was brought before the full Imperial Senate to face charges of treason, with political observers speculating that Emperor Arissa intended to make a public example of him. His capture dealt a mortal blow to the isolationist cause, though Nova Imperium survived in the Paresa system and would later be integrated into the Imperial power structure under Hadrian Duval's leadership.

chase-fulbright.name: Chase Fulbright
chase-fulbright.bio: Chase Fulbright is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-09-03 to 3301-09-18. Closely associated with BlipMagnet. Director Chase Fulbright announced they had more than enough material for production but apologized for infrastructure delays.

lucius-lavigny.name: Lucius Lavigny
lucius-lavigny.bio: Lucius Lavigny is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-07-21 to 3309-08-18. Closely associated with Lavigny's Legion. Lady Florence Lavigny's recovery prompts calls for Imperial Family unity, with speculation that she could heal rifts between Arissa, Aisling, and Hadrian Duval.

jaques.name: Jaques
jaques.bio: Jaques is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-02-12 to 3302-08-10. Jaques Station, the galaxy's only travelling starport, prepares for an ambitious long-distance jump from Gliese 1269 to Beagle Point. The Fuel Rats announce that Jaques Station has received sufficient fuel for its proposed jump to Beagle Point.

carver.name: Carver
carver.bio: Carver is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-03-10 to 3308-06-23. Closely associated with Alliance.

ethan-takahashi.name: Ethan Takahashi
ethan-takahashi.bio: Ethan Takahashi is a key figure in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3305-03-08 to 3308-07-11. Affiliated with Federal Times, Federal Intelligence Agency, Children of Tothos. Notable activities include: The Children of Tothos begin ritual sacrifices at Archambault Terminal, with cult leader Barnabas Cole calling for new followers to kill a sibling ...; The Children of Tothos cult is thwarted in its attempt to detonate a nuclear weapon at Archambault Terminal when FIA Senior Agent Rochelle Karim — ...
ethan-takahashi.bio_full:
Ethan Takahashi is a crime correspondent for the Federal Times who reported on major criminal investigations in the 3300s. In April 3305, he delivered a special report on the FIA's successful prevention of a nuclear detonation at Archambault Terminal by the Children of Tothos cult, detailing how Senior Agent Rochelle Karim had infiltrated the group and shot leader Barnabas Cole dead as he prepared to activate the stolen Lucifer Device.

Takahashi's reporting highlighted the lethal threat posed by apocalyptic cults and the effectiveness of deep-cover operations in preventing mass-casualty terrorism. His work for the Federal Times made him a key chronicler of Federal law enforcement successes, providing the public with detailed accounts of operations that often remained classified until his reports brought them to light.

arnold-lowe.name: Arnold Lowe
arnold-lowe.bio: Arnold Lowe is a journalist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-11 to 3302-03-15. Closely associated with Federal Times. It alleges the deaths of Nigel Smeaton, Sean Richards, Arnold Lowe, Susan Monroe, Elaine Boyd, Emperor Hengist Duval, and the disappearances of Jasmina Halsey and Ishmael Palin are all connected. Federal Times reporter Elaine Boyd pressed authorities on whether one victim was Arnold Lowe, a senior investigator in the Starship One disappearance, but received no comment.

mira-tiverion.name: Mira Tiverion
mira-tiverion.bio: Mira Tiverion is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-07-06 to 3304-07-15. Closely associated with Didiomanja Emperor's Grace, Emperor's Grace. The Didiomanja Emperor's Grace completes the Tiverion Academy, a flight school for Imperial naval cadets, and hosts an inaugural banquet. A monument to Admiral Mira Tiverion, the organisation's founding member, will be erected at the site.

reema-falco.name: Reema Falco
reema-falco.bio: Reema Falco is a journalist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-08-09 to 3304-08-09. Closely associated with Unchain, Imperial Herald.

timothy-culver.name: Timothy Culver
timothy-culver.bio: Timothy Culver is a peace activist who has criticised superpower leadership for their handling of the Thargoid conflict. He has spoken at rallies arguing that humanity's aggressive stance toward the Thargoids is counterproductive and that diplomatic alternatives should be pursued.
timothy-culver.bio_full: Timothy Culver is a prominent peace activist who has become a vocal critic of superpower military policy toward the Thargoids. In early 3309, he spoke at rallies blaming leaders for escalating the Thargoid war, arguing that humanity's aggressive stance was counterproductive. Culver has advocated for diplomatic alternatives to military confrontation, challenging the consensus that the Thargoids are an existential threat that can only be met with force. His activism has drawn both support from those weary of the war and criticism from those who view his position as naive in the face of proven Thargoid hostility.

xdeath.name: xdeath
xdeath.bio: xdeath is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-10-31 to 3302-10-31. Independent pilot 'xdeath' discovered mysterious ruins in the Synuefe XR-H d11-102 system.

andariel.name: Andariel
andariel.bio: Andariel is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-06 to 3301-08-03. Closely associated with Aisling's 13th Legion. Aisling Duval's supporters formed the Thirteenth Legion under Commander Andariel to combat interdiction and harassment of humanitarian supply runs. Legate Andariel of Aisling's 13th Legion officially ended the ceasefire with Winters' Wolves, citing reports of Winters' supporters undermining Aisling's control systems.

micah-whitefield.name: Micah Whitefield
micah-whitefield.bio: Micah Whitefield is a Scientist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-08-04 to 3304-09-29. Affiliated with Federal Intelligence Agency, Far God cult, Alliance. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering the foiled assassination attempt on Aisling Duval, Riri McAllister being shot during her trial, the FIA investigation into ...; The FIA apprehends further Far God cult members to determine if they communicate with Thargoids.
micah-whitefield.bio_full:
Senior Agent Micah Whitefield is an officer of the Federal Intelligence Agency who led the controversial investigation into the Far God cult in 3304. Whitefield oversaw a series of raids on the cult's hive-chapels across multiple systems, arresting adherents for interrogation to determine whether they were in contact with Thargoid forces or being influenced by them. The operations involved armed Federal troops forcing entry into places of worship and dragging unresisting cultists into armoured vehicles.

The investigation divided public opinion, with some citizens attempting to shield the worshippers while others cheered the arrests. Whitefield's actions were defended as necessary security measures but condemned by civil liberties advocates as religious persecution. The Far God cult investigation became a defining case study in the tension between counter-terrorism imperatives and constitutional protections of religious freedom in the Federation.

mason-chu.name: Mason Chu
mason-chu.bio: Mason Chu is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-10-23 to 3305-10-23. Closely associated with Neomedical Industries, Scythe of Panem, Vandermeer Corporation. Lead researcher Mason Chu warns it could become a galaxy-wide scourge.

bl1p.name: BL1P
bl1p.bio: BL1P is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-09-29 to 3308-09-29. Closely associated with Pilots Federation.

emmerich-koenig.name: Emmerich Koenig
emmerich-koenig.bio: Emmerich Koenig is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-08-16 to 3307-08-26. Closely associated with Torval-Mastopolos Mining, Mastopolos Mining, Wreaken Construction.
emmerich-koenig.bio_full:
Emmerich Koenig held a senior position within Torval-Mastopolos Mining during the late 3300s, a period when the mining conglomerate pursued aggressive expansion across multiple systems. His responsibilities encompassed oversight of major extraction operations and coordination with subsidiary entities including Mastopolos Mining itself and construction partners such as Wreaken Construction. The scale of these operations placed Koenig at the centre of industrial development in regions where resource wealth attracted both corporate investment and political competition.

His documented activity in mid-3307 coincided with intensifying corporate manoeuvring as traditional mining interests confronted new challenges from emerging competitors and shifting regulatory environments. Koenig's associations with multiple corporate entities under the same umbrella illustrated the complex organisational structures that characterised large-scale resource extraction in the galaxy. His career demonstrated how executive leadership in mining required balancing operational efficiency with the political relationships necessary to secure and maintain extraction rights across contested territories.

naqan.name: Na'Qan
naqan.bio: Na'Qan is a senator in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-15 to 3301-07-15. Closely associated with Lavigny's Legion, Velites Squadron. Commander Na'Qan, a former miner from distant Imperial colonies, developed stealth combat techniques using asteroid fields to evade pirates. Na'Qan is to be awarded the Imperial Order of Merit, First Class, by Senator Arissa Lavigny-Duval at her Kamadhenu headquarters.

zander-lachance.name: Zander Lachance
zander-lachance.bio: Zander Lachance is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-10-23 to 3307-08-13. Closely associated with Neomedical Industries, Scythe of Panem, Vandermeer Corporation.

caius.bio: Caius is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-27 to 3301-07-27. Closely associated with Dukes of Mikunn.

commander-erimus-kamzel.name: Commander 'Erimus' Kamzel
commander-erimus-kamzel.bio: Commander 'Erimus' Kamzel is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-06-17 to 3302-06-17. Closely associated with FGE exploration wings, Fuel Rats.

rishi-antal.name: Rishi Antal
rishi-antal.bio: Rishi Antal is a engineer in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-06-06 to 3301-06-06. Closely associated with Utopia. Utopia's compound on Antal has long displayed technology years ahead of its time. Under Simguru Pranav Antal, the Utopian Commune Programme expanded to Polevnic, Neris, HIP 117972, and HIP 1389.

milo-vesper.name: Milo Vesper
milo-vesper.bio: Milo Vesper is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-07-06 to 3304-09-07. Closely associated with Alliance, Alliance Tribune, Alliance Defence Force. Alliance Tribune editor Milo Vesper criticises the taskforce for not focusing on Alliance territory.

commander-kitiara.name: Commander Kitiara
commander-kitiara.bio: Commander Kitiara is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-02-13 to 3301-02-13. Commander Kitiara is handling last-minute entrants.

taniyah-sharpe.name: Taniyah Sharpe
taniyah-sharpe.bio: Taniyah Sharpe is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-02-28 to 3305-03-07. Closely associated with Macrosphere, DS Leonis Industries.

commander-slk.name: Commander S!LK
commander-slk.bio: Commander S!LK is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-03-16 to 3302-03-16. Closely associated with Adle's Armada, Blood Brothers, Contrail.

nexus.name: Nexus
nexus.bio: Nexus is a terrorist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-06-16 to 3304-06-21. Closely associated with League of Reparation, Imperial Internal Security Service. Kilbride confirms the captives are being interrogated to identify Nexus, the League's coordinator, expressing confidence this marks the beginning of the end for the terrorist organisation. Recorded at Jameson Memorial, she calls the acts misguided, unnecessary and evil, and appeals directly to Nexus to stop.

bodmans.name: Bodmans
bodmans.bio: Bodmans is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-26 to 3301-08-26. Closely associated with XYZ Fight Club. Light-class rounds featured fast-paced jousting with Bodmans and Rainy Day advancing. Bodmans and Old Sauveur reached both finals, with Old Sauveur winning light-class in Eagles and Bodmans taking medium-class in Couriers after a protracted defensive battle.

marcus-orrin.name: Marcus Orrin
marcus-orrin.bio: Marcus Orrin is a pirate in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-25 to 3301-08-25. Closely associated with Stratis Information Group, Kumo Crew, Interstellar Press. Analyst Marcus Orrin stated the Imperial Navy has invested too much to simply withdraw after hostilities end, predicting a prolonged occupation.

commander-finn-mcmillan.name: Commander Finn McMillan
commander-finn-mcmillan.bio: Commander Finn McMillan is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-06-18 to 3302-10-14. Closely associated with Earth Expeditionary Fleet.

rasmus-tseng.name: Rasmus Tseng
rasmus-tseng.bio: Rasmus Tseng is a admiral in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-05-10 to 3304-05-10. Closely associated with Aegis. Councillor Rasmus Tseng expressed fears of vulnerability, but Tanner stated the reports are grossly overstated, describing only localised incidents in fringe systems.

andrew-jones.name: Andrew Jones
andrew-jones.bio: Andrew Jones is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-04-18 to 3308-04-18. Closely associated with Federal Navy, Alliance, Imperial Navy.

aoishe-quaid.name: Aoishe Quaid
aoishe-quaid.bio: Aoishe Quaid is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-09-20 to 3301-09-20. The Federal research programme studying anomalous extraterrestrial objects was abruptly terminated by Fort Harrison station governor Aoishe Quaid only one week after its inauguration. Sources suggested Quaid was pressured into the decision despite her enthusiasm for the project.

duke-tiberius-of-mikunn.name: Duke Tiberius of Mikunn
duke-tiberius-of-mikunn.bio: Duke Tiberius of Mikunn is a diplomat in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-07-07 to 3302-07-07. Closely associated with GalCop, EG Pilots, Social Eleu Progressive Party. Duke Tiberius of Mikunn swayed the vote, and a diplomatic summit is scheduled for 13 July to discuss further options.

hillbillypolenta.name: Hillbillypolenta
hillbillypolenta.bio: Hillbillypolenta is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-01-12 to 3303-01-12. Closely associated with Fuel Rats.

philippa-barlow-lyons.name: Philippa Barlow-Lyons
philippa-barlow-lyons.bio: Philippa Barlow-Lyons is the COO and acting CEO of Caine-Massey who led the corporation through the assassination of Johann Fleischer and the ensuing conflict with Torval Mining.
philippa-barlow-lyons.bio_full:
Philippa Barlow-Lyons is the Chief Operating Officer and acting CEO of Caine-Massey, a major Federal mining corporation. In 3309, she assumed leadership after the assassination of CEO Johann Fleischer at a Federal Commerce Authority seminar on Mars. Barlow-Lyons publicly condemned the murder and demanded that no effort be spared in finding the killer.

When circumstantial evidence linked the assassin to Torval Mining Ltd, Barlow-Lyons directed Caine-Massey's partner faction Tavgi Blue Life Inc into open conflict with Torval Mining in the Tavgi system. After Federal auxiliaries helped capture the Orchestral Falcon megaship, Torval Mining surrendered the assassin to Federal authorities. Barlow-Lyons declared that justice would finally be served, cementing her reputation as a decisive leader willing to use corporate warfare to protect her company's interests.

cesare-lavigny.name: Cesare Lavigny
cesare-lavigny.bio: Cesare Lavigny is a terrorist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3306-11-06 to 3306-11-06. Closely associated with Imperial Internal Security Service.

delphine-dumont.name: Delphine Dumont
delphine-dumont.bio: Delphine Dumont is a diplomat in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-09-17 to 3309-12-15. Closely associated with Federation, EG Union. The Federal Diplomatic Corps officially denounces President Hudson's attempt to capture Yuri Grom in Delta Pavonis, with Ambassador Delphine Dumont offering personal apologies.
delphine-dumont.bio_full: Delphine Dumont is a political figure active in Federal politics during the 3300s. She has been involved in various political initiatives and campaigns, reflecting the dynamic and often turbulent nature of Federal political life.

leonard-yates.name: Leonard Yates
leonard-yates.bio: Leonard Yates is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-07-22 to 3307-07-29. Closely associated with Pleiades Concordat, Pilots Federation. New convert Leonard Yates (Eighty-Ninth Adherent of the Sixtieth Chapter) expresses gratitude for galactic community support.

liam-flanagan.name: Liam Flanagan
liam-flanagan.bio: Liam Flanagan is a admiral in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-11-01 to 3308-11-01. Closely associated with Imperial Senate, Federal Navy, Alliance.

lilith-galloway.name: Lilith Galloway
lilith-galloway.bio: Lilith Galloway is a Engineer in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-06-01 to 3305-04-17. Affiliated with Aegis. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering the Socho system being overtaken by the Socho Gold Raiders, Aegis's Eagle Eye success in repelling Thargoids, five ships de...; The campaign to repair starports in the Pleiades Nebula receives huge quantities of construction materials.
lilith-galloway.bio_full:
Lilith Galloway is a Senior Engineer with Aegis who played a key role in the organisation's Guardian technology programme. In April 3305, she announced Aegis's partnership with engineer Ram Tah to manufacture Guardian-related technology on a larger scale, bringing Aegis's considerable resources to bear on the production of hybrid weaponry.

Galloway confirmed that technology brokers would remain licensed distributors of the Trident, Javelin and Lance XG fighters. Her leadership in the Aegis-Ram Tah partnership helped institutionalise Guardian technology research within humanity's primary anti-xeno organisation, ensuring sustained development of the hybrid modules that became critical in the fight against the Thargoids.

imogen-luciana.name: Imogen Luciana
imogen-luciana.bio: Imperial Ambassador who spearheaded the Empire's diplomatic offensive during the Marlinist refugee crisis of 3306.
imogen-luciana.bio_full:
Imogen Luciana served as Imperial Ambassador during one of the most delicate diplomatic crises of the 3300s. In October 3306, when hundreds of thousands of Marlinist refugees fled Imperial anti-terrorism lockdowns into Federation space, Luciana issued a formal demand for their extradition, insisting that the Federation was "harbouring potential criminals who are connected to the NMLA terrorists."

The Federation's refusal, led by Ambassador Jordan Rochester, transformed the refugee crisis into a full-blown inter-superpower dispute. Luciana later accused Federal authorities of resisting efforts to shut down NMLA bomb factories in LTT 1935, claims that Vice President Mitchell deflected by blaming Shadow President Winters for "welcoming terrorists." Luciana's tenure exemplified the sharp deterioration in Imperial-Federal relations during the NMLA emergency.

karl-devene.name: Karl Devene
karl-devene.bio: Karl Devene is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-08 to 3302-12-23. Closely associated with Mars High Astrocartography. Karl Devene, head of the Federal Astrocartography Department, warned that many explorer expeditions are poorly prepared and irresponsible.
karl-devene.bio_full:
Karl Devene served as head of the Federal Astrocartography Department during the early 3300s, overseeing the systematic mapping and cataloguing of star systems that underpinned Federal expansion, trade, and military planning. His position placed him at the centre of one of the most data-intensive operations in the Federation, coordinating thousands of explorer submissions while establishing standards for navigational accuracy and territorial documentation. The department's work directly influenced which systems received development priority and how trade routes were optimised across Federal space.

In 3302, Devene issued public warnings about the dangers of poorly prepared exploration expeditions, characterising many as irresponsible ventures that underestimated the risks of deep-space travel. His concerns reflected both genuine safety considerations and the administrative burden of rescuing or documenting lost expeditions. Devene's statements highlighted the tension between the romanticised image of independent exploration and the practical realities of operating in environments where equipment failure, navigational errors, or hostile encounters could prove fatal to those lacking adequate preparation.

jan-sandoval.name: Jan Sandoval
jan-sandoval.bio: Jan Sandoval is a Engineer in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3305-06-29 to 3305-08-02. Affiliated with Federal Intelligence Agency, Red Family Cartel. Notable activities include: Red Family co-founder Jan Sandoval reveals the cartel has developed a genetically engineered designer narcotic far more addictive than existing sub...; Red Family co-founder Jan Sandoval unexpectedly surrenders to the Federal Intelligence Agency and offers to testify against the cartel's leadership...
jan-sandoval.bio_full:
Jan Sandoval is a co-founder of the Red Family, one of the Federation's most notorious narcotics cartels. In June 3305, she unexpectedly surrendered to the Federal Intelligence Agency at its Olympus Village headquarters, offering to testify against the cartel's leadership — including kingpin Oberon Church, to whom she was believed to be second in command.

Executive Agent Viola Trask described Sandoval's surrender as "by far the most notorious" voluntary arrest in FIA history. Sandoval was placed in protective custody, but the cartel responded with a mercenary hit squad that infiltrated FIA headquarters in July 3305 in an assassination attempt. The squad carried false identification to bypass security but was neutralised before reaching Sandoval. Her testimony ultimately provided the intelligence foundation for the FIA's dismantling of the Red Family, making her one of the most consequential informants in Federal narcotics enforcement history.

professor-cora-shaw.name: Professor Cora Shaw
professor-cora-shaw.bio: Professor Cora Shaw is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-07-15 to 3302-07-15. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group. The release follows a meeting between Dr Arcanonn and Professor Cora Shaw, with Arcanonn urging that the Federation and Empire's positions are not irreconcilable.

sima-kalhana.name: Sima Kalhana
sima-kalhana.bio: Sima Kalhana is a Emperor in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3301-07-05 to 3309-01-03. Affiliated with Alliance, Federation, Sirius Corporation. Notable activities include: Historian Sima Kalhana covers the Empire's founding.; Historian Sima Kalhana covers the first Federation-Achenar war (2323-2325).
sima-kalhana.bio_full:
Sima Kalhana is a renowned historian and author whose GalNet series on defining moments in human history became one of the most widely read educational programmes of the early 3300s. Beginning in July 3301, her articles covered the founding of the Federation, the birth of the Empire, the first Federation-Achenar war, the rise of Sirius Corporation, and the history of the Thargoids and generation ships. Her work is credited with bringing foundational galactic history to a mass audience during a period of renewed interstellar tension.

Kalhana's writing is characterised by rigorous archival research and a narrative style that connects ancient events to contemporary politics. She returned to prominence in late 3307 with a multi-part retrospective of that turbulent year, analysing the NMLA crisis, the Galactic Summit, and the fall of Aegis. Her histories remain standard reference points for understanding the deep roots of superpower rivalry and corporate power in human civilisation.

trent-delaney.name: Trent Delaney
trent-delaney.bio: Trent Delaney is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3306-12-29 to 3306-12-29. Closely associated with Core Dynamics, Alliance, Lakon Spaceways.

marquis-endincite.name: Marquis Endincite
marquis-endincite.bio: Marquis Endincite is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-07-02 to 3302-07-02. Closely associated with Facece Empire Party, Allied Facece Order, Imperial Herald. Marquis Endincite coordinated the effort, while Chancellor Anders Blaine is reportedly preparing to commend those involved.

commander-falchion.name: Commander Falchion
commander-falchion.bio: Commander Falchion is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-09-09 to 3302-09-09. Closely associated with Sports Zeta Weekly. Commander Falchion of the Chi Orionis system has won the Melee Masters arena competition, using a ruse in the final bout to draw their opponent into firing range.

count-von-auerburg.name: Count von Auerburg
count-von-auerburg.bio: Count von Auerburg is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-04-10 to 3301-04-10. Closely associated with House of Duval, Imperial Court. Investigators Count von Auerburg, Earl Rednam and Earl Khaelmin were dispatched and have identified where to concentrate efforts next.

commander-gan.name: Commander Gan
commander-gan.bio: Commander Gan is a pirate in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-03-06 to 3302-07-02. Closely associated with Interstellar Press, Pan Galactic Mining Corp.
commander-gan.bio_full:
Commander Gan operated as a pirate active during early 3302, navigating the shadowy economy that existed alongside legitimate commerce in systems across human space. His activities brought him to the attention of Interstellar Press and connected him to Pan Galactic Mining Corp, suggesting his operations may have targeted corporate supply chains or resource extraction routes. The presence of piracy in well-travelled systems demonstrated the ongoing challenge that security forces faced in protecting commercial traffic despite technological advances in surveillance and defensive systems.

Gan's documented career, though brief, illustrated the diverse motivations and organisational structures within the pirate community. Some pirates operated as independent opportunists, while others maintained affiliations with larger criminal syndicates or corporate interests seeking to disrupt competitors. Gan's connections to both media coverage and major corporations hinted at a more complex operational profile than simple banditry, suggesting involvement in the grey-market activities that blurred the lines between legal commerce and criminal enterprise throughout the galaxy.

sonal-mishra.name: Sonal Mishra
sonal-mishra.bio: Sonal Mishra is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-07-30 to 3307-08-12. Closely associated with Federation, Gluscap Labour, New Kuwembaa Labour. Governor Sonal Mishra cites draconian surveillance laws.

sofia-trevino.name: Sofia Trevino
sofia-trevino.bio: Sofia Trevino is a President in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3307-07-21 to 3311-01-09. Affiliated with Federal Times. Notable activities include: The three presidential candidates ramp up campaigns for the delayed August election, with media coverage focusing on character over policy and the ...; President Hudson agrees to deport Far God cultists to the Alliance, framing it as pragmatic cost-cutting while the Dedicant is prepared for transport.
sofia-trevino.bio_full:
Sofia Trevino is a political journalist for The Federal Times who has covered the major political upheavals of the late 3300s. In September 3307, she reported extensively on the wave of Federal faction secessions triggered by the Proactive Detection Bureau surveillance programme, documenting how minor factions across the Federation were severing ties with the superpower in protest against government monitoring of private communications.

Trevino's journalism has tracked both the Hudson administration's defence of the PDB and Shadow President Felicia Winters's campaign to repeal the Domestic Counter-Terrorism Act. Her reporting highlighted the political cost of the surveillance programme, noting that while Vice President Jerome Archer dismissed the secessions as inconsequential, the rebellion represented an embarrassment for Republican governance and validated Winters's civil liberties arguments. Trevino remains a prominent voice in Federal political commentary.

commander-jack-hilding.name: Commander Jack Hilding
commander-jack-hilding.bio: Commander Jack Hilding is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-11-09 to 3301-11-09. Closely associated with Imperial Navy, Cayutorme Syndicate. Imperial Navy forces and auxiliary commanders score major victories against the Cayutorme Syndicate fleet, which may be forced to surrender or face destruction as it deploys reinforcements.

humberto-guthrie.name: Humberto Guthrie
humberto-guthrie.bio: Humberto Guthrie is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-01-05 to 3304-01-05. Closely associated with Sirius Inc. Senior Aide Humberto Guthrie stated that if the superpowers cannot protect them, they will protect themselves.

himari-grey.name: Himari Grey
himari-grey.bio: Himari Grey is a President in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-12-14 to 3309-10-10. Affiliated with Interstellar Health Organisation, Vox Galactica, Vitadyne Labs. Notable activities include: The first humans rescued from Thargoid Titans arrive and survive extraction, with Dr Grey observing their physical and psychological state.; The IHO reviews Vitadyne Labs's nanomedicines amid an ethical debate: should revolutionary healthcare technology be freely distributed despite Utop...
himari-grey.bio_full:
Dr Himari Grey is a healthcare analyst who became a prominent voice in the ethical debate surrounding Vitadyne Labs's nanomedicines in January 3305. The Interstellar Health Organisation was reviewing the company's revolutionary healthcare technology, which Vitadyne admitted was based on advanced technology originally developed by Utopia.

Grey discussed the situation via Vox Galactica, noting that Pranav Antal had formally complained that replicating Utopian technology without permission was "tantamount to theft." She outlined the competing ethical considerations: many in the medical community argued that Utopia was selfish to hoard medicines capable of treating many illnesses and injuries, while investors had pumped millions into Vitadyne Labs convinced that profits would run into the billions. Grey warned that if nanomeds became a commercial commodity, "only the very wealthy will be able to afford Vitadyne's product." Her analysis exposed the fundamental tension between proprietary communal technology and galactic healthcare needs, framing a debate that would resonate throughout the pharmaceutical industry and influence the IHO's eventual ruling.

jupiter-rochester.name: Jupiter Rochester
jupiter-rochester.bio: Jupiter Rochester is a Ceo in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-07-07 to 3307-12-28. Affiliated with Core Dynamics, Alliance. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering the dismantling of the League of Reparation and Riri McAllister's arrest, the Church of Eternal Void being declared illegal...; Weekly summary covering the Alliance Assembly's agreement to vote on Kincaid's constitutional changes, the fire destroying Supratech's facility, in...
jupiter-rochester.bio_full:
Jupiter Rochester is the CEO of Core Dynamics, one of the Federation's largest aerospace and defence conglomerates, and a scion of the powerful Rochester family. Under his leadership, Core Dynamics aggressively expanded through acquisitions — most notably the hostile takeover of Lakon Spaceways in 3306, a move that Alliance leaders condemned as a threat to their strategic shipbuilding capacity. Internal critics within Core Dynamics described the merger as driven by Rochester's personal greed rather than corporate logic.

Rochester's business practices have attracted scrutiny from the Independent Commission for Market Equality over irregular share transfers and potential criminal market manipulation. His political connections run deep through the Rochester family's influence in Federal diplomacy, though his corporate focus has often clashed with the more public-facing political careers of relatives such as Jordan Rochester.

commander-maclolie.name: Commander Maclolie
commander-maclolie.bio: Commander Maclolie is a senator in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-11 to 3301-05-11.

ewan-klein.name: Ewan Klein
ewan-klein.bio: Ewan Klein is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3310-09-17 to 3310-09-17. Closely associated with Federal Congress.

admiral-brennus.name: Admiral Brennus
admiral-brennus.bio: Admiral Brennus is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-05 to 3301-07-08. Closely associated with Emperor's Grace, Imperial Navy. Aisling Duval's anti-slavery activists were expelled from Rishair after Admiral Brennus of Emperor's Grace intervened. Grimnir Allvadderung and Admiral Brennus celebrated with mead and an axe-throwing contest.

civility-marks.name: Civility Marks
civility-marks.bio: Civility Marks is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-11-17 to 3303-11-17. Closely associated with Alliance, Spinward Marches Alliance Concern.

petra-olmanova.name: Petra Olmanova
petra-olmanova.bio: Petra Olmanova is a engineer in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-08-29 to 3309-02-20. Closely associated with Aegis.
petra-olmanova.bio_full:
Petra Olmanova established herself as a skilled engineer within Aegis, the tri-superpower organisation created to coordinate humanity's response to the Thargoid threat. Her technical expertise spanned multiple disciplines essential to anti-xeno operations, from weapons development to defensive systems integration. Working within Aegis provided Olmanova with access to resources and research facilities drawn from across Federal, Imperial, and Alliance territories, enabling her to contribute to some of the most advanced military engineering projects of the era.

Her documented career from 3304 through 3309 covered the critical early phases of sustained human-Thargoid conflict, when Aegis struggled to translate scattered encounters into coherent technological responses. Olmanova's engineering work supported the development of weapons and defensive platforms that independent pilots would deploy against alien vessels. Her contributions exemplified the scientific and technical labour that underpinned front-line combat operations, transforming raw research into practical systems capable of engaging a technologically superior adversary.

surly_badger.name: Surly_badger
surly_badger.bio: Surly_badger is a Commander mentioned in GalNet reports from the Elite Dangerous universe.

trinity-avon.name: Trinity Avon
trinity-avon.bio: Trinity Avon is a reporter for The Sovereign who covered the Dangerous Games in 3302. She reported on the competition between five major factions seeking recognition as official powers, including the Alliance Elite Diplomatic Corps and the Interstellar Communist Union.
trinity-avon.bio_full:
Trinity Avon established herself as one of *The Sovereign*'s most visible reporters during the Dangerous Games of 3302, a semi-official competition that determined which rising faction would join the galaxy's major powers. When five established factions — the Alliance Elite Diplomatic Corps, Border Coalition, GalCop, Interstellar Communist Union, and Social Eleu Progressive Party — announced they would compete for official recognition, Avon broke the story and explained how smaller factions could fight their way into the contest through a series of Wildcard events.

Her reporting followed the competition through its conclusion, including the EG Pilots' surprise victory in the Wildcard and their subsequent entry into the main tournament. Avon's commentary captured the drama of an unprecedented political experiment: 'Each faction has enjoyed its share of success, but ultimately there could be only one winner.' Her coverage demonstrated how independent media could shape public understanding of emerging power structures long before the superpowers acknowledged their significance.

jacob-morales.name: Jacob Morales
jacob-morales.bio: Jacob Morales is a Admiral in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3307-05-21 to 3308-01-31. Affiliated with Aegis. Notable activities include: The Alexandria megaship jumps from Delphi to HIP 16538, triggering a Thargoid attack.; The Federal Navy warns the Alexandria megaship not to enter any Federal system.
jacob-morales.bio_full:
Captain Jacob Morales is the commanding officer of the Alexandria, an Aegis-owned megaship that vanished in hyperspace in June 3307 with over four thousand crewmembers aboard. The Alexandria was transporting a large quantity of Guardian artefacts from the Delphi system when it triggered a Thargoid attack in HIP 16538 on 20 May 3307.

To reduce the risk of further casualties, Aegis plotted a route to a low-population prison colony in the HIP 30944 system. All independent ships were undocked before the megaship made its hyperspace jump on 3 June 3307, but the Alexandria never reached its destination and all communication ceased. Admiral Aden Tanner announced that Captain Morales and his crew would be listed as missing presumed dead, noting that "in addition to this great tragedy, Aegis's research programme into Guardian technology has been severely impacted by the loss of many precious artefacts." Morales's disappearance became a turning point for Aegis, triggering a superpower inquiry, forcing senior resignations including Professor Alba Tesreau, and creating a vacuum that Salvation's alternative anti-xeno effort rapidly began to fill.

jade-sanderlyn.name: Jade Sanderlyn
jade-sanderlyn.bio: Jade Sanderlyn is a Journalist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3308-04-28 to 3310-07-10. Affiliated with Aegis, Salvation, Imperial Navy. Notable activities include: The superpowers offer bounties on Thargoid vessels while Salvation constructs anti-xeno superweapons.; Vox Galactica's Jade Sanderlyn interviews Imperial Navy Admiral Henry Paul Atherton about the Thargoid invasion of Novas.
jade-sanderlyn.bio_full:
Jade Sanderlyn is a veteran war correspondent for Vox Galactica who has become the definitive journalistic voice of the Second Thargoid War. Her monthly frontline reports combine military analysis with human-interest storytelling, delivering updates on anti-xeno operations, scientific developments, and the civilian cost of the conflict to audiences across the bubble. Her dispatches from occupied systems and refugee evacuation zones have made her one of the most recognised names in galactic journalism.

Sanderlyn's reporting is characterised by cautious optimism tempered with unflinching realism. She has covered every major phase of the war, from the initial Maelstrom arrivals through the Aegis-Azimuth rivalry and the controversial Proteus Wave project. Her ability to contextualise complex military and scientific developments for general audiences — while maintaining the critical distance that distinguishes Vox Galactica from superpower-controlled outlets — has made her dispatches essential reading for independent pilots and civilian observers alike.

klaus-peter-sonnek.name: Klaus-Peter Sonnek
klaus-peter-sonnek.bio: Klaus-Peter Sonnek is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-11-29 to 3308-11-29. Closely associated with Sirius Corporation.

quade.name: Quade
quade.bio: Quade is a Pirate in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3301-08-13 to 3301-09-29. Affiliated with Libertas Cooperative, Kumo Crew. Notable activities include: Imperial commanders participating in the United Offensive have rescued scores of marked slaves from Kumo Crew vessels in the Pegasi sector.; Officials at Ocrinox's Orbiter announced plans to build a state-of-the-art resettlement facility for Pegasi Pirate War refugees.
quade.bio_full:
Commander Quade is a Federal pilot who participated in the United Offensive against the Kumo Crew in the Pegasi sector during August 3301. Quade signed his report from the front lines of the Pegasi Pirate War, documenting the Imperial rescue of marked slaves from Kumo Crew vessels and their relocation to safety via Sirius Corporation commanders.

Quade's dispatches highlighted the humanitarian dimension of the conflict, including the case of Aasha, a former Imperial slave and mechanical engineer who was rescued from stasis aboard a pirate vessel in Comanga. His reporting provided rare independent verification of the cooperation between Imperial and Federal forces during one of the largest anti-piracy campaigns of the early 34th century.

hengist-duval.name: Hengist Duval
hengist-duval.bio: Hengist Duval is a Emperor in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3301-04-02 to 3309-09-01. Affiliated with Imperial Palace. Notable activities include: Emperor Hengist Duval was attacked by a high-ranking official during his wedding ceremony to Florence Lavigny.; Emperor Hengist Duval died en route to the Imperial Navy Medical Facility near the Imperial Palace after being stabbed during his wedding ceremony.
hengist-duval.bio_full:
Hengist Duval was the 15th Emperor of the Empire, ruling for decades before his assassination in 3301 triggered the most severe succession crisis in Imperial history. Long in poor health and comatose for extended periods, he shocked the Empire by announcing his intention to marry Florence Lavigny — a move designed to secure the Duval bloodline and produce a legitimate heir. During the wedding ceremony on Capitol, he was stabbed by Brendan Paul Darius, a high-ranking official with ties to the isolationist insurgent group Emperor's Dawn, and died en route to medical facilities.

Hengist's reign was defined by his controversial declaration that his son Harold Duval was unfit for the throne, leaving the succession ambiguous. His death revealed the existence of an illegitimate son, whose own child — Hadrian Duval — would later become the figurehead of the Nova Imperium movement. The Emperor's assassination exposed deep fractures in Imperial stability, fractures that would widen through the NMLA crisis and the eventual Lords of Restoration scandal.

george-fallside.name: George Fallside
george-fallside.bio: George Fallside is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-09-01 to 3302-04-23. Closely associated with Federal Times, Core Dynamics. Congressman George Fallside, a non-executive director of Core Dynamics, had apparent early knowledge of the VP's death. Flight Engineer Nick Baron of Starship One previously worked at Core Dynamics, and financial records showed payments traced through a shell corporation involving Fallside.

maxim-kammerer.name: Maxim Kammerer
maxim-kammerer.bio: Maxim Kammerer is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-03-22 to 3302-05-06. Closely associated with Carmack Intergalactic Mining Association. Maxim 'VicTic' Kammerer of the Carmack Intergalactic Mining Association announces that the CIMA prospectors' competition has doubled the number of known pristine metallic ring locations.

lieutenant-severin.name: Lieutenant Severin
lieutenant-severin.bio: Lieutenant Severin is a admiral in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-21 to 3302-04-28. Closely associated with Mundjiga Patrons of Law, Imperial Navy. Lieutenant Severin calls for loyal Imperial pilots to deliver supplies to Sagan Port in the Mundjiga system.

stanley-steamer.name: Stanley Steamer
stanley-steamer.bio: Stanley Steamer is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-11-04 to 3302-11-04. Noted SRV racer Stanley Steamer has released a statement rebutting archaeologist Jeremy Grant's accusations of recklessness at the ancient ruins site. Steamer claims the rubble is the remains of an ancient racetrack and that racing honours those who built it.

cpt_shinobi.name: Cpt_Shinobi
cpt_shinobi.bio: Cpt_Shinobi is a Commander mentioned in GalNet reports from the Elite Dangerous universe.

michael-darkmoor.name: Michael Darkmoor
michael-darkmoor.bio: Michael Darkmoor is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-03-14 to 3305-03-14. Closely associated with Deep Space Surveys, Rock Rats.

allen-stroud.name: Allen Stroud
allen-stroud.bio: Allen Stroud is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-08-02 to 3305-08-02. Closely associated with Alliance, Lave Radio.

captain-gc-richards.name: Captain G.C. Richards
captain-gc-richards.bio: Captain G.C. Richards is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-03-10 to 3302-03-17. Closely associated with Federal Navy, Beta Hydri Corporation.

scorpio-devorrow.name: Scorpio DeVorrow
scorpio-devorrow.bio: Scorpio DeVorrow is a Ceo in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-08-17 to 3312-03-03. Affiliated with Supratech, Herculean Machines, Alliance. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering the appearance of Thargoid Hydra vessels in the Pleiades Nebula and core systems, Aegis Core's relocation from Socho to Sol...; Weekly summary covering the Alliance Assembly's agreement to vote on Kincaid's constitutional changes, the fire destroying Supratech's facility, in...
scorpio-devorrow.bio_full:
Scorpio DeVorrow is the CEO of Supratech, a computer technology company that engaged in a fierce rivalry with Herculean Machines during 3304 over competing personal computer designs. DeVorrow's company developed the Torc, a holographic-interface computer that malfunctioned catastrophically during the Rackham Ultratech Expo, causing nausea among users and ceding market advantage to Herculean Machines' Duradrive.

In September 3304, Supratech suffered a devastating blow when its main manufacturing complex was destroyed by fire. DeVorrow publicly expressed incredulity that the facility's fire-suppression system, security cameras, internal alarms, and thermal sensors had all failed simultaneously, strongly implying sabotage. The blaze ruined dozens of prototype Torc units and cast serious doubt on whether Supratech could recover its competitive position.

jin-rameer.name: Jin Rameer
jin-rameer.bio: Jin Rameer is a pirate in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-04-14 to 3304-04-14. Closely associated with Kumo Crew.

ines-allende.name: Ines Allende
ines-allende.bio: Ines Allende is a engineer in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-10-13 to 3311-04-08. Closely associated with Imperial Navy, Core Dynamics, Gutamaya Shipyards. Gutamaya's Corsair enters early delivery as the first commercially available multirole Imperial ship without Navy rank requirement, praised by lead engineer Ines Allende and Princess Aisling Duval. Lead engineer Ines Allende attributed the success to maintaining the Eagle Mk II's core design while improving key elements.

commander-corlas.name: Commander Corlas
commander-corlas.bio: Commander Corlas is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-07-09 to 3302-07-09. Closely associated with Federation, Federal Naval Reserve. A Federal Naval Reserve commander has expressed concerns that the Federation's expansion into the Pleiades Nebula is motivated by a desire to conceal evidence of non-human entities.

raf-von-thorn.name: Raf von Thorn
raf-von-thorn.bio: Raf von Thorn is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-05 to 3301-07-05. Closely associated with Imperial Navy, Aisling's Angels.

durien-ballas.name: Durien Ballas
durien-ballas.bio: Durien Ballas is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-09-07 to 3304-09-15. Closely associated with Alliance, Alioth Independents. Chairman Durien Ballas confirms Prime Minister Edmund Mahon and three Council of Admirals members will attend. Chairman Durien Ballas introduces candidates Fazia Silva and Elijah Beck alongside incumbent Gibson Kincaid.

simon-newell.name: Simon Newell
simon-newell.bio: Simon Newell is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-03-16 to 3302-03-16. Closely associated with Federal Times, Federal Government. Legal advisor Simon Newell believes reinstatement is unlikely given the prior vote of no confidence and official termination of her presidency.

brad-mitchell.name: Brad Mitchell
brad-mitchell.bio: Brad Mitchell is a President in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3301-06-11 to 3307-03-24. Affiliated with NMLA, Marlinist. Notable activities include: Vice President Brad Mitchell and a number of Federal Cabinet members have been killed in The recent terrorist attack on a starport orbiting Earth.; Political fallout has been intense after The NMLA simultaneously bombed nine starports in the Alliance, Empire and Federation.
brad-mitchell.bio_full:
Brad Mitchell was the Vice President of the Federation who was killed in the NMLA's Nine Martyrs terrorist attack in March 3307. The NMLA planted caustic enzyme explosives at Li Qing Jao station, where a government meeting was taking place, and Mitchell was confirmed among the tens of thousands of casualties across nine simultaneously bombed starports.

President Zachary Hudson, who was attending the Galactic Summit during the attack, declared the atrocity "nothing less than a declaration of war" and vowed to respond accordingly. Hudson described Mitchell as a "close friend" and promised to personally appoint replacements to the Cabinet positions. Mitchell's death underscored the vulnerability of Federal leadership to terrorist attacks and catalysed the Federation's hardline response to both the NMLA and Marlinist communities.

cadoc.name: Cadoc
cadoc.bio: Cadoc is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-24 to 3301-07-29. Closely associated with Kumo Crew, Lavigny's Legion.

faisal-sacranie.name: Faisal Sacranie
faisal-sacranie.bio: Faisal Sacranie is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-07-14 to 3308-07-21. Closely associated with Federal Intelligence Agency, Federal Times.

first-apostle-of-the-true-chapters.name: First Apostle of the True Chapters
first-apostle-of-the-true-chapters.bio: First Apostle of the True Chapters is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-03-23 to 3309-03-23. Closely associated with Aegis.

maugvahnna-rose.name: Maugvahnna Rose
maugvahnna-rose.bio: Maugvahnna Rose is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-10 to 3301-08-19. Closely associated with Judas Syndicate, Federal State Police. Commander Angel Rose grew up on a starport, became a trader, then was drawn into crime and reluctant assassination, ultimately joining pirates featured on the Underground Channel. Her mother Maugvahnna Rose was a ruthless social climber who became a starport captain and played a small part in her daughter’s criminal path.

felix-dyson.name: Felix Dyson
felix-dyson.bio: Felix Dyson is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-01-04 to 3302-05-17. Closely associated with Diamond Frogs, Pilots Federation.

diana-vancleef.name: Diana VanCleef
diana-vancleef.bio: Diana VanCleef is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-08-17 to 3304-08-26. Closely associated with Colonia Council, Colonia Research Division. Scientific adviser Professor Diana VanCleef states the facility will provide reliable sustainable food for the region. Professor Diana VanCleef states the facility will provide biofoods and super-grains and contain a dedicated research laboratory for developing new biotech crops.
diana-vancleef.bio_full:
Professor Diana VanCleef served as a scientific adviser to the Colonia Council and the Colonia Research Division during the critical early phases of the distant colony's development. Her expertise in agricultural biotechnology made her an essential figure in addressing one of the colony's most pressing challenges: establishing reliable food production in a region thousands of light-years from the agricultural infrastructure of the core worlds. In mid-3304, she announced plans for a facility that would provide sustainable food supplies specifically tailored to the colony's unique environmental conditions.

The proposed facility incorporated both biofoods and super-grains alongside a dedicated research laboratory for developing new biotech crops adapted to local conditions. VanCleef's vision extended beyond immediate subsistence to encompass long-term agricultural innovation that could support continued population growth and economic diversification. Her work demonstrated how scientific expertise transferred from core systems could be applied to frontier challenges, establishing foundations for self-sufficiency that would prove essential to Colonia's survival as an independent civilisation.

itsuko-harada.name: Itsuko Harada
itsuko-harada.bio: Itsuko Harada is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-11-08 to 3308-06-09. Closely associated with Upaniklis Vision Incorporated, Interstellar Health Organisation.

lara-romero.name: Lara Romero
lara-romero.bio: Lara Romero is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-05-11 to 3305-05-11. Closely associated with Fort Dixon Security, Vox Galactica. Gan Romero's wife describes his recent distracted behaviour and disturbing dreams, deepening the mystery of why an otherwise ordinary technician stole a ship from Fort Dixon.

lucina-prax.name: Lucina Prax
lucina-prax.bio: Lucina Prax is a journalist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-02-21 to 3305-02-21. Closely associated with Federal Times, Prax Incorporated.

commander-rizal72.name: Commander Rizal72
commander-rizal72.bio: Commander Rizal72 is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-07-19 to 3302-07-19. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group.

oksana-ambrose.name: Oksana Ambrose
oksana-ambrose.bio: Baroness Oksana Ambrose is the head of the Ambrose Foundation, a multi-billion credit noble institution involved in corporate investment and charity work. In February 3305 she oversaw the foundation's collapse after its entire fortune was liquidated and transferred to anonymous accounts, and subsequently hired the Wallglass Investigations Agency to locate her missing daughter.
oksana-ambrose.bio_full:
Baroness Oksana Ambrose presided over the Ambrose Foundation, a centuries-old institution that combined the wealth of multiple royal and noble houses and managed nearly three hundred billion credits in assets. In February 3305, the foundation lost its entire fortune overnight when its holdings were liquidated and transferred to anonymous accounts scattered across the galaxy, leaving the organisation effectively ruined.

Ambrose publicly stated her belief that her daughter, Lady Talitha Ambrose, had been kidnapped and tortured into surrendering authorisation codes for the family inheritance. Using the foundation's last emergency reserves, she hired the Wallglass Investigations Agency to locate and rescue Talitha, while the disappearance triggered widespread speculation about whether the heiress had been abducted or had orchestrated the loss herself.

commander-father-cool.name: Commander Father Cool
commander-father-cool.bio: Commander Father Cool is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-11-29 to 3301-11-29. Closely associated with Pilots Federation, Fuel Rats Mischief, Fuel Rats.

domaq.name: Domaq
domaq.bio: Domaq is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-21 to 3301-08-26. Closely associated with Fuel Rats. Domaq provided initial refuelling while a relay operation involving multiple ships and roughly 540 limpet drones transferred fuel. Anuranium and Domaq located a stranded commander 2,800 light years above the galactic plane near Sagittarius A* despite limited nearby stars.

jacob-chowdhury.name: Jacob Chowdhury
jacob-chowdhury.bio: Jacob Chowdhury is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-02-14 to 3305-02-21. Closely associated with Atlas Research Group.

kenji-nobu.name: Kenji Nobu
kenji-nobu.bio: Kenji Nobu is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-26 to 3301-08-26. Closely associated with Emperor's Dawn, Interstellar Press. Security pilot Kenji Nobu admits not all visitors receive full scrutiny due to overwhelming volumes.

frankxjr.name: FrankXJR
frankxjr.bio: FrankXJR is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-03-29 to 3309-03-29. Closely associated with Alliance, Empire.

morgan-unwin.name: Morgan Unwin
morgan-unwin.bio: Morgan Unwin is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-08-24 to 3304-10-20. Closely associated with Mars Tribune, Federal Security Service. The Mars Tribune publishes an exposé revealing Congressman Morgan Unwin's decade-long debt to the Red Family cartel and his use of political influence to traffic drugs to hide his own addiction. Unwin is arrested by the Federal Security Service and faces expulsion from Congress.

bitnick.name: BitNick
bitnick.bio: BitNick is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3311-12-16 to 3311-12-16. Closely associated with Zorgon Peterson. Zorgon Peterson confirmed the Caspian Explorer exceeded all internal projections during two-week field trials, with CMDR BitNick contributing the most exobiological data.

commander-felix-dyson.name: Commander Felix Dyson
commander-felix-dyson.bio: Commander Felix Dyson is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-02-11 to 3302-07-23. Closely associated with Diamond Frogs, Paladin Consortium. Commander Kermit Laphroaig praised his fellow mercenaries for their tenacity under hostile conditions.

edward-bores.name: Edward Bores
edward-bores.bio: Edward Bores is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-03-31 to 3302-04-07. Closely associated with Altair Purple Mob, Federal Government. The Federal 'Hand in the Head' campaign led by new 'Onionhead tzar' Edward Bores encourages citizens to surrender Onionhead for destruction. Edward Bores claims success in removing thousands of tonnes from circulation, while the Altair Purple Mob plans further research into Onionhead's purported health benefits.

ramon-lamor.name: Ramon Lamor
ramon-lamor.bio: Ramon Lamor is the Deputy Communications Officer of Humason Orbital in the Carns system. In July 3301, he announced plans to shift the system from mining to high-tech operations, acquiring robotics for new product lines and replacing extraction and industrial concerns.
ramon-lamor.bio_full: Ramon Lamor serves as Deputy Communications Officer of Humason Orbital in the Carns system. In July 3301, he announced ambitious plans to shift the system's economy from mining to high-tech operations after reports suggested mining would become uneconomical. Lamor outlined an extensive acquisition programme for robotics to support new product lines, which would replace both extraction and industrial concerns. He pledged financial and logistical support to existing businesses during the transition, framing the change as an opportunity for Carns to become a greater player in the regional economy.

elias-hampton.name: Elias Hampton
elias-hampton.bio: Elias Hampton is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-11-17 to 3303-11-24. Closely associated with Independent Leesti for Equality.

viscount-plo-koon.name: Viscount Plo Koon
viscount-plo-koon.bio: Viscount Plo Koon is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-16 to 3301-05-16. Closely associated with Eotienses Citizens' Forum. Top contributors honoured include Viscount Plo Koon, Baron Coiling Dragon, Earl Prawnetto, Earl Morton and Baron Kosmetas.

senator-torval.name: Senator Torval
senator-torval.bio: Senator Torval is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-04-03 to 3301-04-03. Closely associated with Imperial Palace.

meglamaniac.name: MeglaManiac
meglamaniac.bio: MeglaManiac is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-01-10 to 3302-01-10.

commander-rorican.name: Commander Rorican
commander-rorican.bio: Commander Rorican is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-06-07 to 3302-06-07. Closely associated with Fuel Rats.

naylor.name: Naylor
naylor.bio: Naylor is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-31 to 3307-01-25. Closely associated with Federal Times. Vice President Naylor publicly swore to continue supporting President Halsey following Shadow President Hudson's attack. Naylor defended Halsey's difficult decisions, stating he would have made the same choices with the same information.

alexei-de-la-vega.name: Alexei de la Vega
alexei-de-la-vega.bio: Alexei de la Vega is a Scientist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-05-18 to 3304-07-08. Affiliated with Colonia Co-operative, League of Reparation. Notable activities include: This week's major stories include the murder of Fleet Admiral Tulimaq Buchanan of the Alliance Council of Admirals by the League of Reparation, lin...; Weekly summary covering Chief Inspector Kay Kilbride's murder by the League of Reparation, reactions to Aisling Duval and Jordan Rochester's engage...
alexei-de-la-vega.bio_full:
Professor Alexei de la Vega is a scientist who led a research project for the Colonia Co-operative in the remote Colonia region. In May 3304, he oversaw a campaign to supply the project with microresources, with hundreds of independent pilots delivering materials to Foster Terminal in the Coeus system.

De la Vega stated that the materials would allow the Colonia Co-operative to "establish a framework for how the region can expand," charting a roadmap for Colonia's future growth. His work represented the scientific infrastructure development that underpinned Colonia's transformation from a remote outpost into a viable deep-space settlement, demonstrating how coordinated research programmes could sustain human expansion far beyond the core systems.

shamus-madigan.name: Shamus Madigan
shamus-madigan.bio: Shamus Madigan is a Scientist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3308-09-05 to 3310-10-16. Affiliated with Aegis. Notable activities include: Classified footage from the Battle of HIP 22460 is leaked to newsfeeds, revealing the so-called 'Thargoid roar' and fuelling public anxiety as inte...; The rise of the xeno-peace movement has caused a number of public figures to discuss coexisting peacefully with the Thargoid race.
shamus-madigan.bio_full:
Shamus Madigan is a professor of xenology at Olympus Village University and a leading academic authority on Thargoid behaviour. In September 3308, he published a paper in The Empirical analysing the Thargoids' resistance to the Proteus Wave superweapon in HIP 22460, arguing that their upgraded technology and altered behaviour indicated that humanity had become "a problem that must be dealt with."

Madigan also analysed classified footage leaked from the Battle of HIP 22460, interpreting the so-called "Thargoid roar" as "residual electromagnetic radiation from the Thargoids' energy pulse." His scholarly work provided a grounded scientific counterpoint to more alarmist theories, though he consistently warned that humanity's lack of understanding of Thargoid biology and technology left the species dangerously unprepared for the escalating conflict.

johann-fleischer.name: Johann Fleischer
johann-fleischer.bio: The recently appointed chief executive of Caine-Massey, whose assassination on Mars in 3309 triggered a corporate war and accusations of Imperial involvement.
johann-fleischer.bio_full:
Johann Fleischer had barely settled into his role as chief executive of the mining corporation Caine-Massey when he was gunned down at a Federal Commerce Authority seminar at the Olympus Village Conference Centre on Mars in March 3309. Long-range plasma fire killed him instantly in front of an audience of Federal business leaders, and the shooter melted away undetected.

The weapon recovered at the scene — a professionally modified Manticore Executioner marksman rifle — was linked to undercover Imperial agents, along with advanced ECM equipment used to disrupt security systems. Caine-Massey publicly accused Senator Zemina Torval of ordering the hit, turning Fleischer's murder into a flashpoint for corporate-political warfare that would engulf the Tavgi system in open conflict.

serena.name: Serena
serena.bio: Serena is a senator in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-30 to 3301-03-30. Closely associated with Aisling's Angels. Aisling Duval appeared on the Imperial talk show 'A Fireside Chat With Serena' and praised her 'Angels' for cleaning up unruly elements on Cemiess.

nakato-kaine.name: Nakato Kaine
nakato-kaine.bio: Nakato Kaine is a Ceo in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3306-12-24 to 3311-11-27. Affiliated with Alliance, Sirius Corporation. Notable activities include: Historian Sima Kalhana continues her review of 3307, covering the Proactive Detection Bureau, ACT's early victories, Salvation's emergence, the Ale...; The Alliance-Sirius Corporation anti-xeno defence pact enters its final approval stage before an Assembly vote.
nakato-kaine.bio_full:
Nakato Kaine is an Alliance Assembly councillor representing the Tionisla system and the most vocal critic of the Alliance-Sirius Corporation defence pact. A pragmatic politician with a background in resource management, Kaine has consistently challenged Prime Minister Edmund Mahon's reliance on corporate partnerships, arguing that the Alliance's strategic dependence on Sirius undermines both its sovereignty and its anti-xeno capabilities.

In 3309, Kaine launched a high-profile resource drive to demonstrate that the Alliance could stockpile vital military materials independently of Sirius support. Her accusations — that Li Yong-Rui negotiated favourable contracts with Allied corporations using unfair market leverage — forced a formal Assembly inquiry into the pact's true costs. While Mahon has remained characteristically cautious in his public responses, Kaine's campaign has galvanised a growing faction within the Assembly that questions whether corporate collaboration has become indistinguishable from corporate capture.

angelo-defries.name: Angelo Defries
angelo-defries.bio: Angelo Defries is a pirate in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-09-18 to 3309-09-18. Closely associated with Wallglass. Wallglass confirms Zachary Rackham was the pirate lord 'Calico Zack', with evidence from Angelo Defries's archive causing high-profile supporters to withdraw.

kelly-eldridge.name: Kelly Eldridge
kelly-eldridge.bio: Kelly Eldridge is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-09-02 to 3308-09-02. Closely associated with Universal Cartographics.

governor-deacon.name: Governor Deacon
governor-deacon.bio: Governor Deacon is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-10-26 to 3301-10-26. Closely associated with Homeland Scientific Council.

frank-endis.name: Frank Endis
frank-endis.bio: Frank Endis is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-12-09 to 3307-12-09. Closely associated with Core Dynamics, Vodel.

tulimaq-buchanan.name: Tulimaq Buchanan
tulimaq-buchanan.bio: Tulimaq Buchanan is a admiral in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-05-17 to 3304-05-25. Closely associated with Alliance Defence Force, Council of Admirals, League of Reparation. This week's major stories include the murder of Fleet Admiral Tulimaq Buchanan of the Alliance Council of Admirals by the League of Reparation, linked to his ancestor's role in INRA. Fleet Admiral Tulimaq Buchanan of the Alliance Council of Admirals has been murdered by the League of Reparation.
tulimaq-buchanan.bio_full:
Fleet Admiral Tulimaq Buchanan served on the Alliance Council of Admirals as one of the highest-ranking military officers in the confederation, responsible for shaping naval strategy and command structure across Alliance space. His distinguished career spanned decades of service, during which he rose through the ranks to attain a position of extraordinary influence over the Alliance Defence Force's operations and priorities. As a member of the Council of Admirals, he participated in decisions affecting the security of billions of citizens across dozens of member systems.

In May 3304, Buchanan became the most prominent victim of the League of Reparation, a terrorist organisation targeting descendants of INRA personnel involved in the original mycoid virus attacks against the Thargoids. His murder sent shockwaves through Alliance military and political circles, revealing that the League's grievances extended across all three superpowers regardless of contemporary political alignment. The assassination demonstrated how historical crimes could generate cycles of violence generations after the original events, ensnaring individuals whose only connection to past atrocities was blood relation.

commander-unrealization.name: Commander unrealization
commander-unrealization.bio: Commander unrealization is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-07-27 to 3302-07-27. Closely associated with Interstellar Press.

burias.name: Burias
burias.bio: Burias is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-01-10 to 3302-01-10. The first annual Galactic Base-Jumping Open begins on Planet 1 in the Njokujinun system, with base-jump champion Commander Burias authorizing jumps.

neospike.name: Neospike
neospike.bio: Neospike is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-21 to 3301-07-21. Closely associated with Fuel Rats. The Fuel Rats conducted a deep-space relay rescue of Cmdr Neospike, stranded over 3,600 light years from civilization near Sagittarius A* with a broken fuel scoop. Speed was critical as Neospike's systems were below 5% integrity.

noel-beaumont.name: Noel Beaumont
noel-beaumont.bio: Noel Beaumont is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3306-10-22 to 3306-10-29. Closely associated with Fionn Liberals.

dr-miriam-fletcher.name: Dr Miriam Fletcher
dr-miriam-fletcher.bio: Dr Miriam Fletcher is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-02-17 to 3301-02-17. Closely associated with Furbaide CDC. Dr Miriam Fletcher, head of the Furbaide CDC, requested that anyone shipping basic medicines divert to Effinger Port to donate supplies needed to stop the Blight's spread.

vernon-trask.name: Vernon Trask
vernon-trask.bio: Vernon Trask is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-07-18 to 3302-07-18.

delfina-dominguez.name: Delfina Dominguez
delfina-dominguez.bio: Delfina Dominguez is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-08-25 to 3308-08-25. Closely associated with Alliance Defence Force, Sirius Corporation, Council of Admirals.

dr-arkady-cole.name: Dr Arkady Cole
dr-arkady-cole.bio: Dr Arkady Cole is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-11-10 to 3302-11-17. Closely associated with Zosi Major Corporation. Dr Arkady Cole, the organisation's chief research scientist, confirmed participating pilots should deliver resources to Citi Enterprise in the Zosi system. Dr Arkady Cole announced that the Zosi Major Corporation's request for thermic alloys, chemical manipulators and industrial firmware was warmly received by the galactic community.

alex-snoori.name: Alex Snoori
alex-snoori.bio: Alex Snoori is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-28 to 3301-05-28. Alex Snoori, host of 'Beyond Top Secret', spread conspiracy theories about Starship One's disappearance, rejecting the Frame Shift Drive failure explanation.

ricardo-bentonio.name: Ricardo Bentonio
ricardo-bentonio.bio: Ricardo Bentonio is a Pirate in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3301-08-14 to 3303-01-28. Affiliated with Federal Navy, Kruger 60 Free. Notable activities include: Conspiracy theorist Ricardo Bentonio claims on his programme 'Behind the Curtain' that Thargoids are exerting direct influence over human society.; Conspiracy theorist Ricardo Bentonio claimed on his show The Hidden World that President Halsey was kidnapped by aliens when Starship One disappeared.
ricardo-bentonio.bio_full:
Ricardo Bentonio is a conspiracy theorist and host of the investigative show "The Hidden World" who has promoted fringe theories about alien influence over human society. In August 3301, he claimed on his programme that President Jasmina Halsey had been kidnapped by aliens when Starship One disappeared, dismissing the official report findings.

Bentonio's theories gained enough traction that Federal Navy officials were forced to refuse comment on his allegations, while some congressmen openly mocked him.
