In early 3303, he resurfaced with claims that Thargoids were exerting direct influence over human society and walking among the population. While widely dismissed as a "loon" by mainstream politicians, Bentonio's show attracted a dedicated following among those suspicious of official narratives, making him a persistent if marginal figure in galactic media.

frederick-yamamoto.name: Frederick Yamamoto
frederick-yamamoto.bio: Frederick Yamamoto is a President in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-11-21 to 3305-06-21. Affiliated with Alliance, Alliance Defence Force. Notable activities include: President Gibson Kincaid is removed from office by the Alliance Assembly on charges of treason, murder and corruption, and is detained while attemp...; President Gibson Kincaid assumes direct command of the Zaonce fleet through Admiral Frederick Yamamoto, bypassing the ADF command structure in a sh...
frederick-yamamoto.bio_full:
Admiral Frederick Yamamoto was the head of the Alliance fleet in Zaonce who was arrested in June 3305 for the assassination of former Alliance presidential candidate Fazia Silva. A private investigation by Tashmira Silva, Fazia's sister and CEO of Silva Holdings Inc, hired the Wallglass Investigations Agency to uncover the truth after the official inquiry closed without resolution.

The Wallglass report identified that Yamamoto had personally arranged to have Fazia killed during the presidential election campaign, presumably to remove her political threat to his friend Gibson Kincaid. Alliance Interpol verified the report and detained Yamamoto pending trial, placing the Zaonce fleet under joint command of the Council of Admirals. Yamamoto's arrest exposed a deep conspiracy within the Alliance military-political establishment and triggered the eventual impeachment of President Kincaid.

commander-lysianassa.name: Commander Lysianassa
commander-lysianassa.bio: Commander Lysianassa is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-08 to 3302-04-08. Commander Lysianassa declares herself 'Queen of Sagittarius A*' after making the 26,000 light-year journey in a heavily armed Federal Corvette.

gino-borstein.name: Gino Borstein
gino-borstein.bio: Gino Borstein is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-10-20 to 3305-10-28. Closely associated with Federal Intelligence Agency, Rockforth Corporation, Scythe of Panem.

arissa-lavigny-duval.name: Arissa Lavigny-Duval
arissa-lavigny-duval.bio: Arissa Lavigny-Duval is the 16th Emperor of the Empire, crowned in October 3301 after a turbulent succession crisis. Born in 3243 as the illegitimate daughter of Emperor Hengist Duval and Florence Lavigny, she was raised as a Lavigny and became a respected Senator before revealing her true parentage in December 3300. She is the first woman to hold the Imperial Throne. Her reign has been marked by Thargoid conflicts, the Marlinist refugee crisis, and challenges from Imperial hardliners including Nova Imperium and the NMLA.
arissa-lavigny-duval.bio_full:
Arissa Lavigny-Duval was born in 3243 during an affair between Emperor Hengist Duval and Florence Lavigny. Raised as a Lavigny, she became a senator and built a reputation for tackling corruption and championing honour. In December 3300, she publicly declared her true parentage after Hengist decreed his legitimate son Harold unfit to rule.

Following Hengist's assassination by Emperor's Dawn in August 3301, the Senate deliberated for two months before electing Arissa on 6 October 3301. She became the first woman on the Imperial Throne, defeating competing claims from Aisling Duval and Denton Patreus.

Her reign faced immediate existential challenges: Thargoid incursions from 3303, the Marlinist refugee crisis of 3306-3307, and her own abduction by the Lords of Restoration in January 3307 — a conspiracy covered up for over a year using a body double. Arissa's governance combines cautious conservatism with rigorous emphasis on honour and anti-corruption, making her one of the most consequential rulers in Imperial history.

paul-kavinsky.name: Paul Kavinsky
paul-kavinsky.bio: Paul Kavinsky is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-21 to 3301-08-26. Closely associated with Fuel Rats.

eugene-cooper.name: Eugene Cooper
eugene-cooper.bio: Eugene Cooper is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-30 to 3301-05-30. The last such mid-term transition occurred in 3264 when Antonia Madison ousted Eugene Cooper.

frank-hall.name: Frank Hall
frank-hall.bio: Frank Hall is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-04-10 to 3301-04-10. Closely associated with Worster Insurance, Better Green Developments. Shadow President Hudson attended the 153rd annual Exphiay Bankers' Ball alongside Frank Hall of Gallant Investment, Paul Wiggins of Wiggins Development Trust, and Patricia Spellman of Sirius Finance.

yaro-kenyatta.name: Yaro Kenyatta
yaro-kenyatta.bio: Yaro Kenyatta is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-11-04 to 3308-11-04. Closely associated with Universal Cartographics, Canonn.

general-alexander-lee.name: General Alexander Lee
general-alexander-lee.bio: General Alexander Lee is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-07-08 to 3302-07-08. Closely associated with Federation, Empire, United Teaka First. Retired General Alexander Lee of United Teaka First argued on Affairs of State that the Federation's presence at barnacle sites is strategic resource denial.

baron-coiling-dragon.name: Baron Coiling Dragon
baron-coiling-dragon.bio: Baron Coiling Dragon is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-16 to 3301-05-16. Closely associated with Eotienses Citizens' Forum. Top contributors honoured include Viscount Plo Koon, Baron Coiling Dragon, Earl Prawnetto, Earl Morton and Baron Kosmetas.

kristine-lasky.name: Kristine Lasky
kristine-lasky.bio: Kristine Lasky is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-03-01 to 3310-10-31. Closely associated with Federal Navy.
kristine-lasky.bio_full:
Kristine Lasky attained the rank of president within a Federal military or governmental context during the early 3300s, maintaining close associations with the Federal Navy throughout her documented career. Her longevity in the records — spanning from 3302 through 3310 — suggests a figure of considerable institutional staying power, navigating multiple administrations and strategic shifts within the Federation's complex political-military landscape. The title of president indicated senior leadership responsibility, whether within a specific naval division, a defence contractor, or a related Federal agency.

Her career trajectory mirrored the Federation's own evolution during this period, from conventional superpower competition through the emergence of the Thargoid threat and the subsequent reorganisation of Federal defence priorities. Lasky's sustained prominence demonstrated how certain individuals managed to retain influence across changing political climates, adapting their expertise to new challenges while maintaining core institutional relationships. Her association with the Federal Navy underscored the military's central role in Federal governance and identity throughout this transformative era.

arturo-durant.name: Arturo Durant
arturo-durant.bio: Arturo Durant is a senator in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-05-02 to 3309-03-06. Closely associated with Marlinist, Imperial Herald. Senator Arturo Durant argues the Marlinist Colonies should have accepted Imperial protectorate status for protection against the Thargoids.

kommodore.name: Kommodore
kommodore.bio: Kommodore is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-10-04 to 3301-10-04. Closely associated with Core Dynamics, Universal Cartographics. Commander Kommodore returned from a ten-month journey to Sagittarius A* in an Eagle-class starship, cataloguing nearly 3,900 star systems and earning 123 million credits from Universal Cartographics.

leigh-constantinides.name: Leigh Constantinides
leigh-constantinides.bio: Leigh Constantinides is a pirate in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-05-04 to 3304-05-11. Closely associated with Narri Justice Party, Utopia. Dr Leigh Constantinides announced the project, citing strategist Marquis Novantico's observations. Dr Leigh Constantinides thanked supporters on behalf of Utopia.

varrwen-mako-brennus.name: Varrwen Mako Brennus
varrwen-mako-brennus.bio: Admiral Varrwen Mako Brennus is a senior Imperial Navy officer and the leader of Emperor's Grace, an influential Imperial faction. In mid-3301 he ordered all members of Emperor's Grace to support Senator Denton Patreus after Patreus defended the organisation against false treason charges, and later blocked anti-slavery activists from operating in his headquarters system of Rishair.
varrwen-mako-brennus.bio_full:
Varrwen Mako Brennus serves as an admiral in the Imperial Navy and commands Emperor's Grace, a powerful faction loyal to the Imperial throne. In June 3301, he issued a personal order directing all Emperor's Grace members to support Senator Denton Patreus, rewarding the senator's earlier defence of the organisation against unfounded treason accusations before the Imperial Senate.

Beyond political alliances, Brennus demonstrated a hardline approach to maintaining order in his systems. In July 3301, when anti-slavery activists affiliated with Aisling Duval attempted to disrupt the slave trade in Rishair, Brennus intervened directly; after diplomatic mediation failed, he arranged for Senator Patreus to establish the system as a military preparation site under Operation BBH, legally suspending protest rights and expelling the activists.

donal-varden.name: Donal Varden
donal-varden.bio: Donal Varden is a journalist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-11-01 to 3304-11-10. Closely associated with Ndozins State Inc, Geras First. Journalist Donal Varden describes the aftermath as an uneasy peace that came at a dreadful cost. Independent journalist Donal Varden predicts the space lanes will soon be littered with wreckage.
donal-varden.bio_full:
Donal Varden established himself as an independent journalist operating during the politically volatile period of late 3304, maintaining connections to both Ndozins State Inc and Geras First that provided access to diverse regional perspectives. His reporting focused on the aftermath of military conflicts and power transitions, offering analysis that challenged official narratives promoted by factional leadership. The independence of his journalism allowed him to document the human costs of political manoeuvring in ways that aligned media outlets could not or would not pursue.

Varden's commentary during this period captured the uneasy nature of post-conflict stability, describing peace that had been achieved at dreadful cost and predicting that competition in contested space lanes would produce widespread destruction. His assessments proved prescient as tensions continued to simmer beneath superficial calms. Through his work, Varden demonstrated how independent journalists could serve as crucial witnesses to historical moments, preserving accounts that might otherwise be sanitised by interests seeking to control public memory of controversial events.

han-zen.name: Han Zen
han-zen.bio: Han Zen is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-09-02 to 3302-09-02. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group.

orange.name: Orange!
orange.bio: Orange! is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-09-02 to 3308-09-02. Closely associated with Universal Cartographics, Independent Explorers Association.

governor-albrecht.name: Governor Albrecht
governor-albrecht.bio: Governor Albrecht is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-10-06 to 3301-10-06. A memorial was unveiled at Hart Station in Bast by Governor Albrecht to honor the over 100,000 victims of the devastating outbreak.

zahra-arias.name: Zahra Arias
zahra-arias.bio: Zahra Arias is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-21 to 3302-04-28. Closely associated with Sovereign Justice Collective, Pilots Federation.

margaux-hist.name: Margaux Hist
margaux-hist.bio: Margaux Hist is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-07-05 to 3304-08-02. Closely associated with Bonespire Publishing. Redcourt makes cryptic comments about being bounced across space and meat for the sausage factory, which his agent Margaux Hist dismisses as character development thinking. Agent Margaux Hist expresses hope the niche science-fiction genre will sell well enough to cover legal bills.
margaux-hist.bio_full:
Margaux Hist worked as a literary agent affiliated with Bonespire Publishing during the mid-3300s, representing authors operating within the niche science-fiction genre. Her professional responsibilities included managing client relationships, negotiating publishing contracts, and guiding the public presentation of her authors' work. In 3304, she found herself managing the increasingly erratic behaviour of Redcourt, an author whose cryptic public comments about being "bounced across space" and references to "meat for the sausage factory" raised concerns among readers and critics alike.

Hist's approach to these controversies reflected the pragmatism required of publishing professionals navigating unconventional talent. She dismissed Redcourt's more alarming statements as "character development thinking," while privately expressing hope that the book's sales would generate sufficient revenue to cover mounting legal bills. Her experience illustrated the challenges facing agents who represented artists whose creative impulses did not always align with conventional commercial or legal expectations.

megan-madigan.name: Megan Madigan
megan-madigan.bio: Megan Madigan is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-07-27 to 3305-07-27. Closely associated with Alliance.

commander-turjan.name: Commander Turjan
commander-turjan.bio: Commander Turjan is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-11-04 to 3302-11-04.

axel-cyprian.name: Axel Cyprian
axel-cyprian.bio: Axel Cyprian is a terrorist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3306-11-05 to 3306-11-12. Closely associated with L.Y.S Corp, LTT 1935 Confederacy, Imperial Internal Security Service.

kincaid.name: Kincaid
kincaid.bio: Kincaid is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-01-19 to 3307-01-19. Closely associated with Alliance.

jenson-zanetti.name: Jenson Zanetti
jenson-zanetti.bio: Jenson Zanetti is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-10-19 to 3301-10-19. Closely associated with Pilots Federation, Alliance, Alliance News Network. Jenson Zanetti, chairman of the Pilots Federation Safety Board, stated that implementing such lighting would massively decrease fatal collisions in and around space stations.

gudrun-vestergaard.name: Gudrun Vestergaard
gudrun-vestergaard.bio: Gudrun Vestergaard is a Emperor in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3309-01-16 to 3309-10-02. Affiliated with Imperial Herald, Imperial Palace. Notable activities include: Princess Aisling Duval publicly urges Emperor Arissa Lavigny-Duval to join the Alliance and Federation in reforming Aegis to combat the Thargoid th...; Princess Aisling Duval assumes oversight of the Empire's contributions to Aegis and defends her decision to defy the Emperor's isolationist decree.
gudrun-vestergaard.bio_full:
Gudrun Vestergaard is the royal correspondent for the Imperial Herald who has reported on major developments in Imperial politics and the Duval family. In January 3309, she commented on Princess Aisling Duval's public appeal to Emperor Arissa Lavigny-Duval to join the Alliance and Federation in reforming Aegis, noting that the move could cause friction between Aisling and her cousin Hadrian Duval.

Vestergaard observed that while both Aisling and Hadrian had previously enjoyed a close relationship — with Aisling even chosen as honour-mother to Hadrian's baby son Hector — their views on Imperial foreign policy "could not be more different." Her reporting on the Imperial family has provided insight into the tensions between reformist and isolationist factions within the Empire, particularly during the critical period when the Thargoid invasion forced a re-evaluation of Imperial non-intervention policies.

commander-corbin-moran.name: Commander Corbin Moran
commander-corbin-moran.bio: Commander Corbin Moran is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-24 to 3302-04-24. Closely associated with First Great Expedition.

commander-matzov.name: Commander Matzov
commander-matzov.bio: Commander Matzov is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-03-08 to 3302-03-14. Closely associated with Pan Galactic Mining Corp, Federal Bar Council.

delvin-hoorgan.name: Delvin Hoorgan
delvin-hoorgan.bio: Delvin Hoorgan is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-07-01 to 3302-07-01. Closely associated with Sirius Corporation. Artist Delvin Hoorgan created the sculpture using debris from the ship and light-bending meta-materials.

simion-petrescu.name: Simion Petrescu
simion-petrescu.bio: Simion Petrescu is a diplomat in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-09-17 to 3307-09-30. Closely associated with EG Union, Federation.

copper.name: Copper
copper.bio: Copper is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-05-20 to 3307-05-27. Developed or used by Edmund Mahon, Pilots Federation.

agronomic-treatment.name: Agronomic treatment
agronomic-treatment.bio: Agronomic treatment is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-08 to 3307-07-15. Developed or used by Archon Delaine, Kumo Crew, Blue Viper Club.

machinery.name: Machinery
machinery.bio: Machinery is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-11 to 3301-05-11. Developed or used by Broker Mrozak, Broker Del Boy, Alliance. The Green Party of Diso's rejuvenation project for Birmingham succeeded spectacularly when 5,187 commanders delivered over 15 million tonnes of machinery in just 65 hours.

decryption-key.name: Decryption key
decryption-key.bio: Decryption key is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-04-19 to 3307-04-27. Developed or used by Rex Trevelyan, Pilots Federation. Independent pilots report receiving anonymous instructions from a figure calling himself "Salvation," who provides a decryption key for the Adamastor's mysterious signal.

evacuation-shelters.name: evacuation shelters
evacuation-shelters.bio: Evacuation Shelters is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-12-21 to 3301-12-21. Developed or used by Ishmael Palin, Canonn Interstellar Research Group. Professor Ishmael Palin announces that his appeal for evacuation shelters to establish a research outpost on Maia b1ba was successful, and the new base should be operational within a week.

allied-solace.name: Allied Solace
allied-solace.bio: Allied Solace is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-12-06 to 3310-12-06. Developed or used by Wolf 359.

gilya-signature-weapons.name: Gilya signature weapons
gilya-signature-weapons.bio: Gilya signature weapons is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-06-30 to 3302-07-07. Developed or used by EG Pilots, Interstellar Communist Union, Trinity Avon. The first heat of the Rise to Power competition required pilots to deliver Gilya signature weapons to Gohar Station in the Jaradharre system.

power-generators.name: power generators
power-generators.bio: Power Generators is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-08 to 3301-05-08. Developed or used by Green Party of Diso. The party placed orders for 15 million tonnes of machinery including Atmospheric Processors, Crop Harvesters, Power Generators and Water Purifiers.

faulcon-delacy-ships.name: Faulcon DeLacy ships
faulcon-delacy-ships.bio: Faulcon DeLacy ships is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-05 to 3301-05-05. Developed or used by Zaonce Jet Gang, Alliance Elite Diplomatic Corps, Silver United Solutions. To celebrate, Silver United organised a discount on all Faulcon DeLacy ships at Ridley Scott Station, including a limited number of Pythons.

crop-harvesters.name: Crop Harvesters
crop-harvesters.bio: Crop Harvesters is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-08 to 3301-05-08. Developed or used by Green Party of Diso. The party placed orders for 15 million tonnes of machinery including Atmospheric Processors, Crop Harvesters, Power Generators and Water Purifiers.

guardian-urn.name: Guardian urn
guardian-urn.bio: Guardian urn is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-04-22 to 3307-06-24. Developed or used by Pilots Federation. Aegis and Taurus Mining Ventures launch rival Guardian artefact collection campaigns in PMD2009 48. Aegis launches an appeal for Guardian artefacts to support a new anti-xeno research programme.
guardian-urn.bio_full:
Guardian urns constitute a category of artefacts recovered from archaeological sites associated with the ancient Guardian civilisation, which flourished millions of years before human spaceflight before disappearing under mysterious circumstances. These vessels, typically found alongside other Guardian relics such as orbs, totems, and tablets, represent tangible connections to a species that achieved remarkable technological and cultural sophistication. Archaeological analysis suggests the urns may have served ceremonial, funerary, or commemorative functions, though their precise purpose within Guardian society remains subject to ongoing research and debate.

During mid-3307, Aegis and Taurus Mining Ventures launched competing collection campaigns focused on Guardian artefacts, including urns, from sites in the PMD2009 48 system. Aegis specifically sought these objects to support its anti-xeno research programme, hoping that understanding Guardian technology would yield insights applicable to the Thargoid threat. The rival collection efforts highlighted both the scientific value of Guardian materials and the intense competition among human organisations to unlock their secrets, as conventional approaches to the alien conflict proved increasingly inadequate.

guardian-tablet.name: Guardian tablet
guardian-tablet.bio: Guardian tablet is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-04-22 to 3307-06-24. Developed or used by Pilots Federation. Aegis and Taurus Mining Ventures launch rival Guardian artefact collection campaigns in PMD2009 48. Aegis launches an appeal for Guardian artefacts to support a new anti-xeno research programme.

adamastor-derelict-megaship.name: Adamastor derelict megaship
adamastor-derelict-megaship.bio: Adamastor derelict megaship is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-04-08 to 3307-04-19. Developed or used by Pilots Federation, Pharmasapien. A dormant communications beacon aboard the 200-year-old ghost ship Adamastor in the Chukchan system suddenly activates, receiving and rebroadcasting an encrypted interstellar signal. Independent pilots report receiving anonymous instructions from a figure calling himself "Salvation," who provides a decryption key for the Adamastor's mysterious signal.

thargoid-spire-sites.name: Thargoid spire sites
thargoid-spire-sites.bio: Thargoid spire sites is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3309-10-31 to 3309-12-07. Developed or used by Ishmael Palin, Aegis, Maximo Fonseca. Aegis prioritises research into rapidly evolving Thargoid spire sites, with Fonseca theorising about their purpose and Palin requesting samples. Professor Palin's biological contaminant successfully halts Thargoid spire site operations in the Hyades Sector ST-Q B5-5 system, confirming a vulnerability in Thargoid infrastructure.

guardian-modules.name: Guardian modules
guardian-modules.bio: Guardian modules is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-04-19 to 3310-07-06. Developed or used by Aegis, Alba Tesreau. Engineer Ram Tah and Aegis announce breakthrough modifications to immunise Guardian modules against anti-Guardian field effects, available at Ram Tah's workshop in Meene. Engineer Ram Tah perfects modifications to immunise all Guardian modules against anti-Guardian field effects without reducing weapon damage or functionality.

eagle-mk-ii.name: Eagle Mk II
eagle-mk-ii.bio: Eagle Mk II is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-09-10 to 3301-10-13. Developed or used by Imperial Navy, Gutamaya Shipyards, Core Dynamics. Gutamaya Shipyards unveiled the Imperial Eagle, a successor to the Eagle Mk II. Commander Kommodore returned from a ten-month journey to Sagittarius A* in an Eagle-class starship, cataloguing nearly 3,900 star systems and earning 123 million credits from Universal Cartographics.
eagle-mk-ii.bio_full:
The Eagle Mk II stands as one of the most iconic light fighters in human space, manufactured by Core Dynamics and later serving as the foundation for Gutamaya Shipyards' Imperial Eagle variant. Its design prioritised speed and manoeuvrability over armour and firepower, creating a vessel that rewarded skilled piloting while punishing mistakes harshly. The Mk II's affordability and accessibility made it a favourite among new pilots seeking to build combat experience before graduating to heavier platforms, while veteran fliers appreciated its responsiveness in high-intensity engagements.

The type's legendary status was cemented by Commander Kommodore's extraordinary ten-month journey to Sagittarius A* in an Eagle-class starship, during which he catalogued nearly 3,900 star systems and earned 123 million credits from Universal Cartographics. This achievement demonstrated that the Eagle's capabilities extended far beyond its intended combat role, proving that determination and skill could overcome apparent design limitations. The Mk II's enduring popularity across decades of production illustrated how a well-designed light fighter could remain relevant even as naval technology advanced around it.

attack-drones.name: attack drones
attack-drones.bio: attack drones is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3303-10-07 to 3303-10-07. Developed or used by Aden Tanner, Empire. Thargoid activity has escalated dramatically in the Pleiades Nebula, with Interceptor-class ships attacking Imperial, Federal and civilian vessels. Thargoids are now capturing occupied escape pods and deploying clusters of attack drones.

panther-clipper-mk-ii.name: Panther Clipper Mk II
panther-clipper-mk-ii.bio: Panther Clipper Mk II is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-07-17 to 3311-08-21. Developed or used by Zorgon Peterson, Mark Rennik.

titan-cocijo.name: Titan Cocijo
titan-cocijo.bio: Titan Cocijo is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-12-05 to 3311-06-18. Developed or used by Aegis, Federal Navy. The wreckage of Titan Cocijo above Earth became a popular destination for pilots seeking trophies, knowledge, and memorials, with Federal authorities struggling to enforce visitor limits. A memorial beacon near the Titan Cocijo wreckage draws visitors, while Commodore Morayo Orina honours the lost at a Sol memorial service.
titan-cocijo.bio_full:
Titan Cocijo was one of the massive Thargoid bio-mechanical vessels that spearheaded the alien invasion of the 3310s, serving as both a mobile base of operations and a weapon of unprecedented destructive capability. These Titans represented the apex of Thargoid engineering, combining organic growth patterns with integrated technology to create self-sustaining warships capable of deploying vast numbers of smaller craft. Their appearance above human worlds marked the most severe escalation in the centuries-long conflict between humanity and the Thargoids.

Following its destruction, the wreckage of Titan Cocijo settled into orbit above Earth, becoming an unintended monument to both the devastation of the invasion and humanity's eventual capacity to resist it. Federal authorities struggled to enforce visitor limits as pilots flocked to the site seeking trophies, scientific knowledge, and personal memorials. Commodore Morayo Orina later presided over a formal memorial service at a beacon near the wreckage, honouring those lost in the battles that brought the Titan down and acknowledging the complex emotions the site evoked for a species that had faced extinction.

engineered-seeds.name: Engineered seeds
engineered-seeds.bio: Engineered seeds is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-12 to 3307-07-23. Developed or used by Kumo Crew, Vox Galactica.
engineered-seeds.bio_full:
Engineered seeds represent an advanced biotechnology developed to accelerate agricultural production and enable crop cultivation in environments that would otherwise prove hostile to conventional farming. These genetically modified organisms can be tailored to thrive in thin atmospheres, extreme temperatures, or soil compositions that would kill natural varieties, making them invaluable for colony development and frontier settlement. Their deployment has significantly expanded the range of worlds capable of supporting human populations without extensive terraforming infrastructure.

In mid-3307, engineered seeds became entangled with criminal interests when the Kumo Crew syndicate became associated with their distribution or production, drawing coverage from Vox Galactica and other media outlets. This connection illustrated how advanced agricultural technologies could be co-opted by illicit networks for profit, whether through black-market distribution to restricted systems or integration into illegal drug production. The episode underscored the dual-use nature of biotechnological innovations, which could serve humanitarian purposes while also generating revenue for criminal enterprises.

guardian-shard-cannon.name: Guardian Shard Cannon
guardian-shard-cannon.bio: Guardian Shard Cannon is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-01 to 3307-07-01. Developed or used by Pilots Federation, Patience Middleton, Taurus Mining Ventures. Taurus Mining Ventures' campaign for Salvation collects more Guardian artefacts than Aegis's rival campaign. Patience Middleton congratulates supporters and offers top contributors a specially engineered Guardian Shard Cannon.

void-temple.name: Void-temple
void-temple.bio: Void-temple is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-19 to 3307-07-19. Developed or used by Pleiades Concordat, Federal Intelligence Agency, Erik Gunnarson.

communications-beacon.name: Communications beacon
communications-beacon.bio: Communications beacons are devices used to transmit signals across space. In the context of the Hesperus mystery, beacons deployed by the megaship nearly 200 years ago were used by pilots to track down the Proteus and locate the Guardian-Thargoid battlefield.
communications-beacon.bio_full: Communications beacons are signal transmission devices used for navigation, distress calls, and data relay across space. In the Hesperus mystery, beacons deployed by the megaship nearly 200 years ago proved critical to solving the case. Pilots tracked down a series of these ancient beacons following instructions provided by the anonymous Salvation, which led them to the Proteus Anaconda at a Guardian-Thargoid battlefield on Trapezium Sector YU-X c1-2 1a. The beacons' ability to survive for two centuries and still transmit usable data demonstrated remarkable engineering, though their original purpose—whether navigational markers or deliberate clues—remains debated.

corsair.name: Corsair
corsair.bio: The Corsair is a medium-sized multirole ship manufactured by Gutamaya Shipyards, introduced in April 3311 as the first commercially available Imperial vessel that required no Navy rank qualification for purchase. Princess Aisling Duval publicly endorsed the ship at its Capitol launch event, signalling a shift in Imperial industrial policy toward broader pilot markets.
corsair.bio_full:
In April 3311, Gutamaya Shipyards broke with decades of tradition by releasing the Corsair — the first commercially available multirole Imperial vessel that required no Navy rank qualification for purchase. Lead engineer Ines Allende declared the ship a 'significant milestone,' combining Gutamaya's characteristic elegant design with balanced hardpoint configuration, substantial cargo capacity, powerful thrusters, and four utility slots. The vessel's medium-size classification made it viable for trading with outposts inaccessible to larger Imperial ships, opening the manufacturer's market beyond military and aristocratic clientele.

Princess Aisling Duval's presence at the Capitol launch event provided the celebrity endorsement that Gutamaya clearly sought, with the Princess announcing she would add a Corsair to her personal fleet and praising the ship as proof of 'the Empire's commitment to innovation.' The release marked a subtle but significant shift in Imperial industrial policy: for the first time, one of the Empire's premier shipbuilders acknowledged that prestige and military exclusivity might be less profitable than selling versatile vessels to the broader pilot market.

muon-imager.name: Muon imager
muon-imager.bio: Muon imager is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-06-17 to 3307-06-24. Developed or used by Pilots Federation, Sinclair Faraldo.

beluga-luxury-liner.name: Beluga luxury liner
beluga-luxury-liner.bio: Beluga luxury liner is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-11-26 to 3302-11-26. Developed or used by Pilots Federation, Commander Duck of Death, Elite Travel Writers' Cooperative.

discovery-scanner.name: discovery scanner
discovery-scanner.bio: discovery scanner is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-07-21 to 3302-07-21. Developed or used by Imperial Senate, Captain Alexis Corvus, Commander Corrigendum.

steel-majesty-megaship.name: Steel Majesty megaship
steel-majesty-megaship.bio: Steel Majesty megaship is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-04-08 to 3307-04-20. Developed or used by Neo-Marlinist Order of Mudhrid, Arastin Delacroix, NMLA. Landgrave Delacroix evades capture and flees aboard the Steel Majesty. Survivors of the defeated Neo-Marlinist Order of Mudhrid arrive in the Marlinist Colonies aboard the Steel Majesty, requesting asylum.
steel-majesty-megaship.bio_full:
The Steel Majesty served as the mobile headquarters and refuge for the Neo-Marlinist Order of Mudhrid, a megaship that became synonymous with the faction's survival during the intense crackdowns of 3307. When Imperial forces moved to dismantle the Order following its exposure as a funding source for the NMLA terrorist network, Landgrave Arastin Delacroix evaded capture by fleeing aboard this vessel. The megaship's mobility and defensive capabilities made it a formidable sanctuary, capable of resisting conventional interdiction efforts while sustaining a substantial population of political refugees and loyalists.

Following the Order's military defeat, survivors arrived in the Marlinist Colonies aboard the Steel Majesty, requesting asylum from authorities who faced the difficult decision of whether to harbour remnants of an organisation linked to terrorist activities. The vessel's journey from military command centre to refugee transport illustrated the rapid reversals of fortune that characterised the Marlinist political movement. The Steel Majesty's story demonstrated how megaship technology could serve as both an instrument of insurgency and a lifeline for displaced populations.

artemis-exploration-suit.name: Artemis exploration suit
artemis-exploration-suit.bio: Artemis exploration suit is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3312-03-03 to 3312-03-03. Developed or used by Supratech, Zachary Rackham.

faulcon-delacy-anaconda.name: Faulcon DeLacy Anaconda
faulcon-delacy-anaconda.bio: Faulcon DeLacy Anaconda is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-04-23 to 3301-05-22. Developed or used by Buckyball Run, Léonard Chamberlain, Mirana Ortilano. At time of broadcast, Commander Anuranium held the record in a Faulcon DeLacy Anaconda. His first record was set in a Lakon Spaceways Asp named 'Big Bird'; his current record was achieved in a Faulcon DeLacy Anaconda named 'Rhonda'.

mk-ii-plasma-shock-accelerator.name: Mk II Plasma Shock Accelerator
mk-ii-plasma-shock-accelerator.bio: Mk II Plasma Shock Accelerator is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3312-02-24 to 3312-03-12. Developed or used by Core Dynamics, Owen McKenna. Three Mk II large hardpoints with Plasma Shock Accelerator compatibility.

fns-nevermore.name: FNS Nevermore
fns-nevermore.bio: FNS Nevermore is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-03-11 to 3301-03-19. Developed or used by Core Dynamics, Federal Navy. Core Dynamics and the Federal Navy announced the FNS Nevermore, a Farragut-Class Battlecruiser. President Halsey's declaration of war diverted the FNS Nevermore from its planned attack on Polahukuna to the offensive against Lugh.
fns-nevermore.bio_full:
The FNS Nevermore stands as a Farragut-class Battlecruiser, one of the most powerful vessels in the Federal Navy's inventory, constructed through a collaboration between Core Dynamics and Federal military engineers. These massive capital ships serve as fleet command centres, mobile shipyards, and overwhelming combat platforms capable of projecting Federal power across entire sectors. The Nevermore's commissioning represented a significant investment in Federal naval capability during a period of intensifying superpower competition.

In March 3301, the Nevermore became embroiled in the rapidly escalating conflict surrounding the Lugh system when President Jasmina Halsey's declaration of war diverted the vessel from its planned offensive against Polahukuna. This last-minute redirection illustrated the chaotic nature of Federal military decision-making during the crisis, as strategic priorities shifted in response to political developments. The Nevermore's diversion highlighted how even the most powerful naval assets could be subject to abrupt reallocations driven by executive orders rather than operational planning.

starship-one.name: Starship One
starship-one.bio: Starship One is a technology in Elite Dangerous, mentioned from 3301-05-27 to 3302-01-28. Used by Jasmina Halsey, Core Dynamics. Key developments: Three ships from Starship One's Guardian Wing made contact with Navy HQ but could not explain the disappearance.; Acting President Felicia Winters addressed Starship One's disappearance, stating early investigations suggested an explosive drive failure in hyper...
starship-one.bio_full:
Starship One is the presidential vessel of the Federation, a technologically advanced passenger liner that served as the primary transport for the Federal President. In May 3301, the ship disappeared during a voyage with President Jasmina Halsey aboard, triggering a massive search operation and one of the most significant political crises in Federal history.

The official investigation initially suggested an explosive drive failure in hyperspace, but in October 3306, Chief Technician Rory Webster was put on trial for mass murder and treason, charged with ordering his engineering team to sabotage Starship One's hyperdrive systems. During the trial, Webster changed his plea to guilty and claimed he had acted on "orders from the top" — a confession that threatened to expose high-level conspiracy. The case became deeply entangled with Federal politics, with President Zachary Hudson using the public outcry to reposition himself as "the Federation's strongman" while Shadow President Felicia Winters's acceptance of Marlinist refugees lost popularity. The destruction of Starship One and the subsequent trial exposed the fragility of Federal governance and the depths of political intrigue at the highest levels.

performance-enhancers.name: Performance enhancers
performance-enhancers.bio: Performance enhancers is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-08 to 3307-07-15. Developed or used by Archon Delaine, Kumo Crew, Blue Viper Club.

imperial-clipper.name: Imperial Clipper
imperial-clipper.bio: The Imperial Clipper is a prestigious vessel manufactured by Gutamaya for the Empire. It is available only to pilots who have achieved the rank of Baron or higher in the Imperial Navy. Known for its elegant design and impressive speed, the Clipper is a symbol of Imperial luxury and status.
imperial-clipper.bio_full: The Imperial Clipper is a prestigious medium-sized vessel manufactured by Gutamaya exclusively for the Empire. Available only to pilots who have achieved the rank of Baron or higher in the Imperial Navy, the Clipper combines elegant aesthetics with impressive speed and cargo capacity. Its sleek, curved design has made it an iconic symbol of Imperial luxury and status. While its manoeuvrability and firepower are balanced by relatively weak shields for its size, the Clipper remains a popular choice for traders, couriers, and pilots who value both performance and prestige.

thargoid-cyclops-tissue-sample.name: Thargoid Cyclops Tissue Sample
thargoid-cyclops-tissue-sample.bio: Thargoid Cyclops Tissue Sample is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3303-10-13 to 3303-10-13. Developed or used by Khun Independent Governance, Federal Times.

guardian-wing.name: Guardian Wing
guardian-wing.bio: Guardian Wing is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-27 to 3301-05-27. Developed or used by Jasmina Halsey, Core Dynamics, Federal Navy. Three ships from Starship One's Guardian Wing made contact with Navy HQ but could not explain the disappearance. A Guardian Wing crew member described a terrible shock wave during hyperspace entry that caused uncontrolled exit into deep space.

signal-beacon.name: Signal beacon
signal-beacon.bio: Signal beacons are devices that emit electromagnetic signals for detection and location. In the Hesperus mystery, Salvation directed pilots to track ancient signal beacons deployed by the megaship, which ultimately led to the discovery of the Proteus at a Guardian-Thargoid battlefield.
signal-beacon.bio_full: Signal beacons are electromagnetic transmission devices used to mark locations, relay information, or guide navigation. In the context of the Hesperus mystery, ancient signal beacons deployed by the megaship nearly 200 years ago became the key to unlocking the case. The anonymous figure Salvation provided instructions that allowed pilots to track these beacons across systems, following a trail that ultimately led to the discovery of the Proteus Anaconda at a Guardian-Thargoid battlefield. The beacons demonstrated remarkable longevity, continuing to transmit after two centuries of exposure to space, and their sequential deployment suggested a deliberate effort to document the Hesperus's final voyage.

hardpoint-configuration.name: hardpoint configuration
hardpoint-configuration.bio: hardpoint configuration is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-04-08 to 3311-04-08. Developed or used by Ines Allende, Imperial Navy.

asp-scout.name: Asp Scout
asp-scout.bio: Asp Scout is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-11-05 to 3302-11-05. Developed or used by Commander Lewis, Shanaeri Rynale. Amateur explorer Commander Lewis has returned to human-inhabited space after becoming stranded in a damaged Asp Scout approximately 65,000 light years from civilisation.

mk-ii-sco-enabled-frame-shift-drive.name: Mk II SCO-enabled frame shift drive
mk-ii-sco-enabled-frame-shift-drive.bio: Mk II SCO-enabled frame shift drive is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-12-02 to 3311-12-16. Developed or used by Zorgon Peterson.

osmium.name: osmium
osmium.bio: osmium is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-07-28 to 3302-07-28. Developed or used by 80 DD-D 774-CE-2. The 80 DD-D 774-CE-2 faction launches a campaign to establish a planetary outpost in Eol Prou RS-T d3-94 to support trade and exploration around Jaques Station, requesting mined osmium deliveries.

supercharged-frame-shift-drive.name: Supercharged Frame Shift Drive
supercharged-frame-shift-drive.bio: Supercharged Frame Shift Drive is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3312-02-24 to 3312-04-28. Developed or used by Zorgon Peterson, Core Dynamics. Supercharged FSD is a first for a small craft. Designed for extreme deep-space exploration with extended jump range and supercharged FSD.
supercharged-frame-shift-drive.bio_full:
The Supercharged Frame Shift Drive represents a major leap in deep-space propulsion technology, developed through collaboration between Zorgon Peterson and Core Dynamics to address the persistent challenge of traversing vast interstellar distances efficiently. Unlike standard FSD units that operated within established safety parameters, the supercharged variant could temporarily push beyond conventional limits, generating extended jump ranges that opened previously inaccessible regions to small craft. This capability transformed the economics of exploration by allowing vessels that would normally require fleet carrier support to operate independently in the deep frontier.

Introduced in early 3312, the technology was specifically designed for extreme deep-space exploration missions where conventional range limitations would prove prohibitive. Its deployment on appropriately engineered hulls enabled independent pilots to push the boundaries of the galactic map with unprecedented speed and autonomy. The supercharged FSD exemplified how advances in frame shift technology continued to expand humanity's effective sphere of influence, making regions that had required weeks of travel accessible in days.

antares-drive-technology.name: Antares drive technology
antares-drive-technology.bio: Antares drive technology is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-01-13 to 3302-01-13. Developed or used by Sirius Corporation, Li Yong-Rui. The Sirius Corporation confirmed the discovery of the Antares wreckage, an innovative passenger liner that disappeared over fifty years ago. CEO Li Yong-Rui stated that analysis confirms the hyperdrive component failure described in the ship's final status report caused the destruction.

dark-comms-network.name: Dark-comms network
dark-comms-network.bio: The dark-comms network is an encrypted communications system used by the Neo-Marlinist Liberation Army to coordinate terrorist operations across the galaxy. In 3307 it was identified by ACT investigators as bearing striking similarities to the Omega Grid employed by Imperial Intelligence, raising disturbing questions about how the NMLA obtained such sophisticated technology.
dark-comms-network.bio_full:
The NMLA's dark-comms network was the technological backbone of the most lethal terrorist campaign in galactic history, an encrypted communications system that allowed Neo-Marlinist operatives to coordinate starport bombings and political assassinations without detection for months. In early 3308, ACT co-leader Captain Saskia Landau revealed that the network bore striking similarities to the Omega Grid — a sophisticated system used exclusively by Imperial Intelligence to coordinate covert operations — suggesting that elements within the Empire's own security apparatus had enabled the terrorists.

ACT's subsequent campaign to locate and decipher Omega Grid beacons across systems such as HIP 290 exposed the technical sophistication of the NMLA's infrastructure. Partial cipher keys recovered from intercepted traffic allowed independent pilots to assist in decrypting the network, but the revelation that Imperial Intelligence technology had been turned against Imperial citizens remains one of the most disturbing unanswered questions of the NMLA crisis.

dredger-class-bulk-cruiser.name: Dredger-class bulk cruiser
dredger-class-bulk-cruiser.bio: Dredger-class bulk cruiser is a technology in Elite Dangerous, mentioned from 3307-04-12 to 3307-07-15. Used by Wallglass Investigations Agency, Francesca Wolfe, Pilots Federation. Key developments: Francesca Wolfe details the discovery of the Hesperus alongside the Scriveners Clan dredger in the Perseus Dark Region.; Pilots report new contact from 'Salvation' near the Hesperus and Adamastor.
dredger-class-bulk-cruiser.bio_full:
The Dredger-class bulk cruiser is a type of converted megaship used by nomadic clans that roam deep space, scavenging and occasionally raiding. Originally designed to convert natural and man-made minerals into raw resources for deep-space voyages, the design became redundant with improvements to hyperdrives and fuel-scooping systems. However, some were taken over by nomadic tribes and kept operational as generation ships.

Each dredger hosts tens of thousands of people whose cultures have evolved over decades or centuries. The clans act as scavengers, passing through systems to steal resources, with some taking more aggressive approaches such as raiding unprotected outposts. Notable clans include the Phagos, whose terrifying reputation inspired childhood nightmares, and the Scriveners Clan, which was discovered alongside the lost ship Hesperus in 3307. The Blue Viper Club later used a modernised dredger hyperdrive to support a coup attempt against Archon Delaine.

farragut-battle-cruiser.name: Farragut Battle Cruiser
farragut-battle-cruiser.bio: The Farragut-class Battle Cruiser is the primary capital ship of the Federal Navy. Massive and heavily armed, these vessels serve as flagships for Federal fleets and are capable of deploying fighter squadrons. They represent the pinnacle of Federal military engineering.
farragut-battle-cruiser.bio_full: The Farragut-class Battle Cruiser is the Federal Navy's primary capital ship and the largest vessel in its fleet. These massive warships serve as fleet flagships, capable of deploying squadrons of F63 Condor fighters and unleashing devastating broadsides. Their presence in a system signals serious Federal military commitment. Farraguts have been deployed in major conflicts including the fight against Thargoid forces and various system liberation campaigns. Despite their firepower, they have proven vulnerable to concentrated Thargoid attack, with several lost during the Titan War.

modules.name: modules
modules.bio: modules is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3303-01-11 to 3303-01-11. Developed or used by Independent engineers.

imperial-eagle.name: Imperial Eagle
imperial-eagle.bio: Imperial Eagle is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-09-10 to 3302-11-19. Developed or used by Imperial Navy, Gutamaya Shipyards, Core Dynamics. Gutamaya Shipyards unveiled the Imperial Eagle, a successor to the Eagle Mk II. Manufactured for the Imperial Navy, it requires Outsider rank or above and retails at 110,825 CR.
imperial-eagle.bio_full:
The Imperial Eagle represents Gutamaya Shipyards' refined interpretation of the classic Eagle Mk II light fighter design, re-engineered to meet Imperial Navy specifications while incorporating the aesthetic and performance priorities that distinguish Imperial craft. Unveiled in late 3301, the vessel featured enhanced manoeuvrability and speed that made it an exceptional interceptor and patrol craft, capable of engaging targets that heavier ships could not pursue effectively. Its streamlined profile and distinctive Imperial design language immediately established it as a recognisable symbol of Imperial naval presence.

Manufactured exclusively for the Imperial Navy and pilots who had attained at least Outsider rank within the Imperial hierarchy, the Imperial Eagle retailed at 110,825 credits — a price point that reflected both its specialised engineering and its role as a status marker for aspiring Imperial servants. The ship's association with Core Dynamics in its development hinted at the complex corporate relationships that underpinned even proudly Imperial military procurement. Through the Imperial Eagle, Gutamaya demonstrated how the Empire balanced practical combat requirements with the presentation of power that characterised its approach to military affairs.

energy-grid-assemblies.name: energy grid assemblies
energy-grid-assemblies.bio: energy grid assemblies is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-07-21 to 3302-07-28. Developed or used by Jaques.

shutdown-beams.name: shutdown beams
shutdown-beams.bio: shutdown beams is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3303-10-28 to 3303-10-28. Developed or used by Aden Tanner, Aegis.

caustic-sink-launcher.name: Caustic Sink Launcher
caustic-sink-launcher.bio: Caustic Sink Launcher is a technology in Elite Dangerous, mentioned from 3310-02-29 to 3310-12-12. Used by Aegis. Key developments: An urgent call to all pilots to participate in the assault on Titan Taranis, with Aegis removing material requirements for Thargoid Pulse Neutralis...; An urgent call to all pilots to participate in the final assault on Titan Leigong, the second Thargoid mothership.
caustic-sink-launcher.bio_full:
The Caustic Sink Launcher is an Aegis-developed ship module designed to protect vessels operating within the caustic environments of Thargoid Maelstrom clouds. In February 3309, Aegis launched an initiative to fast-track mass production of the module, with Professor Alba Tesreau announcing that Admiral Aden Tanner had personally tested the prototype.

The module works by channelling the electrochemical reactions within Maelstrom clouds into semi-liquid anodes for ejection, keeping ship hulls intact for considerably longer than unprotected vessels. Production required advanced catalysers, heatsink interlinks, palladium, and caustic tissue samples obtained from generators inside the Maelstroms — materials crowdsourced from independent pilots. Director Ivano Colombera of the Imperial Science Academy noted that the caustic sink launcher would allow more data on the Maelstroms to be gathered, furthering understanding of Thargoid capabilities. The module became one of three key technologies for the Titan assault campaign, alongside the Thargoid Pulse Neutraliser and the Guardian Nanite Torpedo Pylon, and represented Aegis's renewed operational model of collaborative, transparent research directly integrated with the galactic community.

thargoid-cyclops-tissue-samples.name: Thargoid Cyclops tissue samples
thargoid-cyclops-tissue-samples.bio: Thargoid Cyclops tissue samples is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3303-09-22 to 3303-09-22. Developed or used by Federal Times. Aegis recruits engineers Liz Ryder and Ishmael Palin to develop new defensive and offensive technologies against the Thargoids. Aegis has placed open orders for Thargoid materials, with deliveries directed to Awyra Flirble in Eurybia for Ryder and Obsidian Orbital in Maia for Palin.

lakon-type-9-heavy.name: Lakon Type-9 Heavy
lakon-type-9-heavy.bio: Lakon Type-9 Heavy is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-08-11 to 3301-08-11. Developed or used by Arnold Lowe, Federal Times, Elaine Boyd. Two transport safety officials died when their personal transport collided with a Lakon Type-9 Heavy vessel near Laphria Shipyard in the Artemis system. The Type-9 pilot was treated for shock.

trakmark-tyres.name: TrakMark tyres
trakmark-tyres.bio: TrakMark tyres is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-08-25 to 3302-08-25. Developed or used by Buckyball Racing Club, Alec Turner. The Buckyball Racing Club announced the Total Recall 2 race in the Cernobog system to demonstrate the durability of TrakMark SRV tyres.

sim-archive-technology.name: Sim-Archive technology
sim-archive-technology.bio: Sim-Archive technology is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3309-12-11 to 3309-12-11. Developed or used by Leon Banerjee, Torben Rademaker, Azimuth.

sco-frame-shift-drive.name: SCO frame shift drive
sco-frame-shift-drive.bio: SCO Frame Shift Drive is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-07-30 to 3310-07-30. Developed or used by Lakon Spaceways, Faulcon DeLacy, Devin Kaneda. Lakon Spaceways chairperson Naomi Landseer reveals the Type-8 was moved back to the theoretical stage to accommodate SCO drive stresses, resulting in the largest medium-class freighter frame. Lakon Spaceways releases the Type-8, a medium-class freighter optimised for SCO frame shift drive travel, boasting larger cargo capacity and greater resilience than competitors.

mictlan-megaship.name: Mictlan megaship
mictlan-megaship.bio: Mictlan megaship is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-06-12 to 3311-06-26. Developed or used by Archon Delaine, Arissa Lavigny-Duval, Jerome Archer. Imperial forces launch a surprise assault on Archon Delaine's flagship, the Mictlan, in Beta-3 Tucani. Imperial Intelligence forced the Mictlan megaship to retreat, and an agent hacked its internal holoscreens to display Imperial propaganda.

sacrosanct-megaship.name: Sacrosanct megaship
sacrosanct-megaship.bio: Sacrosanct megaship is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-22 to 3307-07-29. Developed or used by Pleiades Concordat, Pilots Federation. The Pleiades Concordat requests deliveries to support the Far God cult in outfitting missionary megaships. The Testament will spread the faith while the Perdition and Sacrosanct will carry worshippers on a pilgrimage into deep space.

claim-management-process.name: Claim Management Process
claim-management-process.bio: Claim Management Process is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-02-26 to 3311-02-26. Developed or used by Madelyn Teague, Brewer Corporation.

toxandji-virocide.name: Toxandji Virocide
toxandji-virocide.bio: Toxandji Virocide is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-11-10 to 3302-11-10. Developed or used by Revolution Incorporated.

hyperdrive.name: Hyperdrive
hyperdrive.bio: Hyperdrive is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-04-12 to 3307-04-12. Developed or used by Erik Gunnarson, Francesca Wolfe.

faulcon-delacey-viper-mk-iv.name: Faulcon DeLacey Viper Mk IV
faulcon-delacey-viper-mk-iv.bio: Faulcon DeLacey Viper Mk IV is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-01-04 to 3302-01-04. Developed or used by Diamond Frogs, Pilots Federation, Doot. Event organizers also offered new Pilots Federation members a Faulcon DeLacey Viper Mk IV and cash rewards up to 100 million credits for top contributors.

fsd-injection.name: FSD injection
fsd-injection.bio: FSD injection is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-11-26 to 3302-11-26. Developed or used by Institute for Galactic Exploration and Research, Commander Mad Billy. Commander Chiggy Vonrictofen conducted a dramatic rescue of Commander Felix Macedonica, who was stranded 65,000 light years from home without sufficient germanium to synthesise an FSD injection.

anti-guardian-fields.name: anti-Guardian fields
anti-guardian-fields.bio: anti-Guardian fields is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-04-19 to 3310-04-19. Developed or used by Alba Tesreau. Engineer Ram Tah and Aegis announce breakthrough modifications to immunise Guardian modules against anti-Guardian field effects, available at Ram Tah's workshop in Meene.

federal-dropship.name: Federal Dropship
federal-dropship.bio: Federal Dropship is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-03-11 to 3301-09-07. Developed or used by Core Dynamics, Federal Navy. Core Dynamics and the Federal Navy announced the FNS Nevermore, a Farragut-Class Battlecruiser. The FCB carries multiple squadrons of Federal Fighters and Federal Corvettes across hundreds of light years with extraordinarily heavy firepower.

shutdown-field-neutraliser.name: shutdown field neutraliser
shutdown-field-neutraliser.bio: shutdown-field neutraliser is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3303-10-13 to 3303-10-20. Developed or used by Aegis, Khun Independent Governance. Materials delivered by pilots will be used to test and mass-produce a shutdown-field neutraliser developed by engineer Elvira Martuuk to counter Thargoid immobilising fields.

testament-megaship.name: Testament megaship
testament-megaship.bio: Testament megaship is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-22 to 3307-07-29. Developed or used by Pleiades Concordat, Pilots Federation. The Pleiades Concordat requests deliveries to support the Far God cult in outfitting missionary megaships. The Testament will spread the faith while the Perdition and Sacrosanct will carry worshippers on a pilgrimage into deep space.

antares.name: Antares
antares.bio: Antares is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-09-02 to 3301-09-02. Developed or used by Core Dynamics, George Fallside, Federal Times. Core Dynamics responded to Federal Times allegations linking a board member to the Highliner Antares incident.

skimmers.name: skimmers
skimmers.bio: skimmers is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-09-15 to 3302-09-22. Developed or used by Chimechilo Empire League, Obotrima Organisation, Federal Navy.

memorial-beacon.name: memorial beacon
memorial-beacon.bio: memorial beacon is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-06-18 to 3311-06-18. Developed or used by Thargoid, Federal Navy, CMDR StellarCartographer. A memorial beacon near the Titan Cocijo wreckage draws visitors, while Commodore Morayo Orina honours the lost at a Sol memorial service.

cobra.name: Cobra
cobra.bio: Cobra is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3303-03-20 to 3303-03-20. Developed or used by Perry Hussein. Federal intelligence member Perry Hussein stated the telemetry indicates it was an older vessel, perhaps Cobra class, and the ship appears to have been destroyed.

rescue-ship-cavell.name: Rescue Ship Cavell
rescue-ship-cavell.bio: Rescue Ship Cavell is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-12-06 to 3310-12-06. Developed or used by Wolf 359. Seven of eight rescue megaships deployed near Sol are destroyed by Thargoid forces within minutes of arrival, leaving only Rescue Ship Hutner and Rescue Ship Cornwallis to continue evacuation efforts.

fer-de-lance.name: Fer-de-lance
fer-de-lance.bio: Fer-de-lance is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-08-10 to 3301-08-10. Developed or used by Judas Syndicate, Maugvahnna Rose. She eventually upgraded to the Dragon Queen, a highly customised Fer-de-lance.

auto-field-maintenance-unit.name: auto field maintenance unit
auto-field-maintenance-unit.bio: auto field maintenance unit is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-04-25 to 3301-04-25. Developed or used by Lance 'Spacecat' D.. He survived thanks to quick reflexes, an auto field maintenance unit and his Type-6 transporter, now nicknamed the 'Sundiver'.

explosive-device.name: Explosive device
explosive-device.bio: Explosive device is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-29 to 3307-07-29. Developed or used by Verity Dexter, Theta Seven, Marlinism Reformation Party.

nanites.name: nanites
nanites.bio: nanites is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-02-15 to 3310-02-15. Developed or used by Ishmael Palin.

guardian-orb.name: Guardian orb
guardian-orb.bio: Guardian orb is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-04-22 to 3307-06-24. Developed or used by Pilots Federation. Aegis and Taurus Mining Ventures launch rival Guardian artefact collection campaigns in PMD2009 48. Aegis launches an appeal for Guardian artefacts to support a new anti-xeno research programme.
guardian-orb.bio_full:
Guardian orbs constitute a distinctive category of artefacts recovered from sites associated with the ancient Guardian civilisation, which attained remarkable technological sophistication before its mysterious disappearance millions of years ago. These spherical objects, typically found alongside other Guardian relics such as totems, caskets, and tablets, represent some of the most visually striking remnants of a species that developed parallel to humanity but reached interstellar capability long before Earthly civilisations emerged. Archaeological analysis suggests the orbs may have served ceremonial, computational, or energy-storage functions, though their precise purpose remains subject to ongoing research.

During mid-3307, Aegis and Taurus Mining Ventures launched competing collection campaigns focused on Guardian artefacts, including orbs, from archaeological sites in the PMD2009 48 system. Aegis specifically sought these objects to support its anti-xeno research programme, hoping that understanding Guardian technology would yield insights applicable to the Thargoid threat. The rival collection efforts highlighted both the scientific value of Guardian materials and the intense competition among human organisations to unlock their secrets, as conventional approaches to the alien conflict proved increasingly inadequate.

type-6.name: Type-6
type-6.bio: Type-6 is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-04-25 to 3301-04-25. Developed or used by Lance 'Spacecat' D.. He survived thanks to quick reflexes, an auto field maintenance unit and his Type-6 transporter, now nicknamed the 'Sundiver'.

onionhead-lucan-strain.name: Onionhead Lucan strain
onionhead-lucan-strain.bio: Onionhead Lucan strain is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-12 to 3307-07-12. Developed or used by Scythe of Panem, Vox Galactica, Kumo Crew.

atmospheric-processors.name: Atmospheric Processors
atmospheric-processors.bio: Atmospheric Processors is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-08 to 3301-05-08. Developed or used by Green Party of Diso. The party placed orders for 15 million tonnes of machinery including Atmospheric Processors, Crop Harvesters, Power Generators and Water Purifiers.

mandalay.name: Mandalay
mandalay.bio: Mandalay is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-10-15 to 3310-10-31. Developed or used by Devin Kaneda, Zorgon Peterson, Faulcon DeLacy. Zorgon Peterson unveils the Mandalay, its first new vessel in six years, designed as a premium medium-sized exploration craft with SCO frame shift drive support. Zorgon Peterson's Mandalay exploration vessel, optimised for Achilles Aerospace's SCO frame shift drive, is now available for purchase at shipyards across the core systems.

palladium.name: palladium
palladium.bio: palladium is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-11-04 to 3301-11-04. Developed or used by Explorers' Association.

cobra-class-vessel.name: Cobra-class Vessel
cobra-class-vessel.bio: Cobra-class Vessel is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3303-02-24 to 3303-02-24. An unidentified Cobra-class vessel was involved, and investigations are ongoing.

orbis-starport.name: Orbis starport
orbis-starport.bio: Orbis starport is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-04-15 to 3307-04-30. Developed or used by Kumo Crew, Pilots Federation. The Kumo Crew syndicate launches a campaign to construct up to five new Orbis starports in uninhabited systems near key trading regions. The Kumo Crew's starport construction campaign concludes successfully.
orbis-starport.bio_full:
The Orbis starport represents one of the most recognisable and ambitious station designs in human space, characterised by its distinctive rotating wheel structure that generates artificial gravity for occupants. These massive installations serve as major trade hubs, shipyards, and population centres, capable of supporting millions of residents and handling the largest vessels in civilian service. Their construction requires extraordinary material investment and engineering expertise, making each Orbis a significant statement of economic and industrial capability.

In 3307, the Kumo Crew syndicate launched an audacious campaign to construct up to five new Orbis starports in uninhabited systems near key trading regions, aiming to establish permanent criminal infrastructure on a scale previously unmatched. The campaign concluded successfully, demonstrating that even the most complex station designs could be deployed by non-state actors given sufficient resources and logistical support. This development alarmed authorities across all superpowers, as it established that major criminal organisations could project power through fixed installations rather than relying solely on mobile fleets.

external-camera-modules.name: External Camera Modules
external-camera-modules.bio: External Camera Modules is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-01-29 to 3311-01-29. Developed or used by Federal Navy, Federal Times, Jason Nygaard.

sco-enabled-frame-shift-drives.name: SCO enabled frame shift drives
sco-enabled-frame-shift-drives.bio: SCO enabled frame shift drives is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-04-24 to 3311-04-24. Developed or used by Taron Raines, Faulcon DeLacy.

mk-iii-viper.name: Mk III Viper
mk-iii-viper.bio: Mk III Viper is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-11-06 to 3301-11-06. Developed or used by Imperial Inquisition, Princess Margaret Cancer Foundation, Mavia Kain.

guardian-nanite-torpedo-pylon.name: Guardian Nanite Torpedo Pylon
guardian-nanite-torpedo-pylon.bio: Guardian Nanite Torpedo Pylon is a technology in Elite Dangerous, mentioned from 3310-03-15 to 3310-12-12. Used by Aden Tanner. Key developments: An urgent call to all pilots to participate in the final assault on Titan Leigong, the second Thargoid mothership.; An urgent call to all pilots to participate in the final assault on Titan Oya, the third Thargoid mothership.
guardian-nanite-torpedo-pylon.bio_full:
The Guardian Nanite Torpedo Pylon is a specialised anti-Thargoid weapon developed for use in the assaults on Thargoid Titan motherships during the Second Thargoid War. Deployed alongside the Thargoid Pulse Neutraliser and Caustic Sink Launcher, the pylon fires torpedoes carrying Guardian-derived nanites designed to hamper a Titan's vents and render the massive vessel vulnerable to conventional damage.

The weapon was first deployed in March 3310 during the assault on Titan Leigong, the second Thargoid mothership to come under siege after Titan Taranis. Aegis made the module readily available at Rescue Megaships for participating pilots, establishing it as a standard component of Titan assault loadouts. The Guardian Nanite Torpedo Pylon represented the culmination of Aegis's research into Guardian technology, translating ancient xenoarchaeological discoveries into practical battlefield applications. Its effectiveness against the Titans' biomechanical architecture demonstrated how humanity's growing understanding of Guardian science could be weaponised against the Thargoids, even as the ethical implications of deploying extinct-civilisation technology in active warfare remained debated.

proteus-anaconda.name: Proteus Anaconda
proteus-anaconda.bio: Proteus Anaconda is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-06-18 to 3307-06-24. Developed or used by Pilots Federation, Patience Middleton. Pilots discover the Proteus, an Anaconda from the Hesperus, at a historical battlefield on Trapezium Sector YU-X c1-2 1a. Salvation claims exclusive rights to the Proteus battlefield site.

diamondback-explorer.name: Diamondback Explorer
diamondback-explorer.bio: Diamondback Explorer is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-01-31 to 3302-01-31. Developed or used by Chloe Anders. An unidentified Diamondback Explorer with the designation 'S6: 7' performed a high-speed pass and scanned Obsidian Orbital without responding to hails.

federal-corvette.name: Federal Corvette
federal-corvette.bio: Federal Corvette is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-07-02 to 3302-07-02. Developed or used by Commander Gan, Archon Delaine, Ferdinand Haim. Kumo Tribute Day saw representatives from systems under Archon Delaine present lavish gifts to the Pirate Lord, including a live barnacle and a gold-plated Federal Corvette.

engineered-detailed-surface-scanner-v1.name: Engineered Detailed Surface Scanner V1
engineered-detailed-surface-scanner-v1.bio: Engineered Detailed Surface Scanner V1 is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-06-15 to 3307-06-24. Developed or used by Sirius Corporation, Sirius Atmospherics, Pilots Federation. Sirius Corporation requests commodities to mass-produce the Engineered Detailed Surface Scanner V1, previously a limited reward from Sirius Atmospherics' terraforming programme. Marketing director Sinclair Faraldo announces the module will have twice the probe coverage of standard scanners.
engineered-detailed-surface-scanner-v1.bio_full:
The Engineered Detailed Surface Scanner V1 represents a significant advancement in planetary survey technology, originally developed as a limited reward from Sirius Atmospherics' terraforming programme before Sirius Corporation pursued mass production to meet broader market demand. The module's key innovation was its expanded probe coverage, delivering twice the survey efficiency of standard scanners and dramatically reducing the time required to map planetary surfaces for resource identification, geological features, and biological signatures. This capability proved invaluable for explorers, miners, and researchers who depended on accurate surface data to plan operations.

In mid-3307, Sirius Corporation launched a commodities appeal to support the transition from limited production to mass manufacture, with Marketing Director Sinclair Faraldo publicly confirming that the module would soon be available through human technology brokers. The decision to commercialise what had been an exclusive terraforming incentive reflected both the module's proven utility and the economic opportunity presented by the expanding exploration and mining sectors. The Engineered DSS V1 demonstrated how technologies initially developed for specific industrial applications could find wider markets when their broader utility became apparent.

imperial-fighter.name: Imperial Fighter
imperial-fighter.bio: Imperial Fighter is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-12-06 to 3301-12-06. Developed or used by Gutamaya Shipyards, Pascal Roux, Imperial Herald.

water-purifiers.name: Water Purifiers
water-purifiers.bio: Water Purifiers is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-08 to 3301-05-08. Developed or used by Kavanagh Spaceframes Ltd. The party placed orders for 15 million tonnes of machinery including Atmospheric Processors, Crop Harvesters, Power Generators and Water Purifiers.

torc-computing-system.name: Torc computing system
torc-computing-system.bio: Torc computing system is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3312-03-03 to 3312-03-03. Developed or used by Supratech, Zachary Rackham.

cobra-mk-iii.name: Cobra Mk III
cobra-mk-iii.bio: The Cobra Mk III is a classic multipurpose spacecraft manufactured by Faulcon DeLacy, renowned for its versatility and enduring popularity among independent pilots. An antique Cobra Mk III interred at the Tionisla Orbital Graveyard in 3302 became the subject of a mysterious encrypted transmission that attracted inter-superpower intelligence interest.
cobra-mk-iii.bio_full:
The Cobra Mk III has remained one of the most widely flown ships in the galaxy for decades, prized by traders, explorers, and combat pilots alike for its balanced performance characteristics and extensive customisation options. Its iconic status has made it a staple of independent operations across all three superpowers, and it continues to serve as a reliable workhorse for commanders of all experience levels.

In August 3302, an antique Cobra Mk III with the unusual hull registry "Cor meum et animam" was interred at the Tionisla Orbital Graveyard, where its onboard beacon briefly transmitted the repeating sequence "OTSEAFOTSEAF" before failing. Amateur groups later partially decrypted the signal, revealing a string of numbers of unknown significance, while Alliance, Empire, and Federation intelligence services investigated the message. The incident added to the catalogue of unexplained deep-space anomalies that continue to intrigue the galactic community.

electronic-countermeasure.name: electronic countermeasure
electronic-countermeasure.bio: electronic countermeasure is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-08-12 to 3302-08-12. Developed or used by Intergalactic Naval Reserve Arm, Arvan Corto, Sima Kalhana.

guardian-totem.name: Guardian totem
guardian-totem.bio: Guardian totem is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-04-22 to 3307-06-24. Developed or used by Pilots Federation. Aegis and Taurus Mining Ventures launch rival Guardian artefact collection campaigns in PMD2009 48. Aegis launches an appeal for Guardian artefacts to support a new anti-xeno research programme.
guardian-totem.bio_full:
Guardian totems constitute a category of artefacts left behind by the ancient Guardian civilisation, which thrived millions of years before human spaceflight before mysteriously vanishing. These objects, along with other Guardian relics, represent some of the most significant archaeological discoveries in human history, offering tantalising glimpses into a species that achieved technological sophistication comparable to or exceeding contemporary human capabilities. Their recovery and study have driven major research programmes across multiple scientific and military institutions.

During mid-3307, Aegis and Taurus Mining Ventures launched competing campaigns to collect Guardian artefacts, including totems, from sites in the PMD2009 48 system. Aegis specifically sought these objects to support a new anti-xeno research programme aimed at developing weapons and defensive technologies capable of countering Thargoid aggression. The rival collection efforts highlighted both the scientific value of Guardian technology and the strategic urgency of unlocking its secrets, as humanity confronted an alien adversary that conventional weaponry struggled to defeat.

python.name: Python
python.bio: Python is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-05 to 3301-05-05. Developed or used by Zaonce Jet Gang, Alliance Elite Diplomatic Corps, Silver United Solutions.
