To celebrate, Silver United organised a discount on all Faulcon DeLacy ships at Ridley Scott Station, including a limited number of Pythons.

sco-drive.name: SCO drive
sco-drive.bio: SCO drive is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-05-09 to 3310-06-20. Developed or used by Achilles Aerospace, Faulcon DeLacy, Namin Tirel. Achilles Aerospace releases the full range of Supercruise Overcharge drives and upgrades, with Dr. Namin Tirel revealing the technology was developed using Thargoid drive components recovered by independent pilots.

vr-streams.name: VR-Streams
vr-streams.bio: VR-Streams is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-16 to 3301-05-16. Developed or used by Utopixx Entertainment, Reynhardt IntelliSys. The company attributed losses partly to development of new VR-Streams including the latest CQC franchise instalment.

generation-ship.name: Generation ship
generation-ship.bio: generation ship is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-08-19 to 3302-08-19. Developed or used by Sima Kalhana, Erik Gunnarson. Historian Sima Kalhana discussed the history of generation ships, noting that approximately 70,000 are still traversing the galaxy.

abrasion-blaster.name: abrasion blaster
abrasion-blaster.bio: abrasion blaster is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3304-12-20 to 3304-12-20. Developed or used by Industrial Mining Guild. New tools include abrasion blasters for surface deposits, sub-surface displacement missiles for deeper deposits, and seismic charges for cracking rare asteroids open.

planetary-landing-suite.name: planetary landing suite
planetary-landing-suite.bio: planetary landing suite is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-01-08 to 3302-01-08. Developed or used by Arcanonn, Canonn Interstellar Research Group. The group is conducting a deep planetary survey of Merope and urges pilots with planetary landing suites to search for large barnacles across the Pleiades.

sothis-crystalline-gold.name: Sothis Crystalline Gold
sothis-crystalline-gold.bio: Sothis Crystalline Gold is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-09-25 to 3301-09-25. Scientists at Newholm Station in the Sothis system discovered a new metalloid called Sothis Crystalline Gold, produced by exposing ordinary gold to thermal vent gases on planets Sothis A5 and A6. Scientists are offering pilots quantities of the rare material in exchange for delivering gold to Newholm Station for further testing.

weapons.name: weapons
weapons.bio: weapons is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3303-01-11 to 3303-01-11. Developed or used by Independent engineers.

ammonia-atmosphere.name: Ammonia atmosphere
ammonia-atmosphere.bio: Ammonia atmosphere is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-19 to 3307-07-19. Developed or used by Pleiades Concordat, Federal Intelligence Agency.

proteus-wave.name: Proteus Wave
proteus-wave.bio: Proteus Wave is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-01-10 to 3311-06-03. Developed or used by Salvation, Aegis, Azimuth Biochemicals. Anti-xeno forces led by AXI and XSF planned a blockade to eliminate lingering Thargoid presence in HIP 22460, the staging ground for Salvation's disastrous Proteus Wave weapon.
proteus-wave.bio_full:
The Proteus Wave represented Salvation's most ambitious and ultimately catastrophic anti-Thargoid weapon, developed through research that drew upon both Aegis archives and Azimuth Biochemicals' proprietary technologies. Deployed in the HIP 22460 system, the weapon was designed to deliver a devastating energy pulse capable of neutralising Thargoid vessels across a wide area. Its construction reflected Salvation's growing influence over anti-xeno strategy and his willingness to pursue solutions that conventional military and scientific institutions considered too risky or ethically questionable.

The weapon's activation produced consequences far beyond its intended targets, triggering a disaster that reshaped the Thargoid conflict and exposed the dangers of relying on unaccountable actors for humanity's defence. Anti-xeno forces led by AXI and XSF subsequently planned blockades to eliminate lingering Thargoid presence in HIP 22460, the staging ground for the failed weapon. The Proteus Wave disaster served as a sobering reminder that technological superiority and good intentions could not guarantee success against an adversary whose capabilities and motivations remained fundamentally alien to human understanding.

kestrel.name: Kestrel
kestrel.bio: Kestrel is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3312-02-24 to 3312-03-12. Developed or used by Core Dynamics, Owen McKenna. Core Dynamics confirms Kestrel fighter exceeds expectations in field trials. Core Dynamics unveils the Kestrel, a pure combat fighter with speed, agility, and three Mk II large hardpoints.

mk-ii-modules.name: Mk II modules
mk-ii-modules.bio: Mk II modules is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3312-03-23 to 3312-03-23. Developed or used by Zorgon Peterson.

micro-controllers.name: Micro-controllers
micro-controllers.bio: Micro-controllers is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-05-20 to 3307-05-27. Developed or used by Edmund Mahon, Pilots Federation.

cobra-mk-v.name: Cobra Mk V
cobra-mk-v.bio: Cobra Mk V is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-04-24 to 3311-04-24. Developed or used by Taron Raines, Faulcon DeLacy. Faulcon DeLacy's Cobra Mk V enters full production, offering improved handling, modularity, and SCO drive compatibility.

tantalum.name: tantalum
tantalum.bio: tantalum is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-07-21 to 3302-07-28. Developed or used by Jaques.

thallium.name: thallium
thallium.bio: thallium is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-07-21 to 3302-07-28. Developed or used by Lavigny's Legion.

mk-ii-class-passenger-cabins.name: Mk II Class Passenger Cabins
mk-ii-class-passenger-cabins.bio: Mk II Class Passenger Cabins is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3312-04-28 to 3312-04-28. Developed or used by Zorgon Peterson. Zorgon Peterson releases the Lynx Highliner, a dedicated passenger vessel with record capacity, defensive hardpoints, and supercharged FSD.

hesperus-megaship.name: Hesperus megaship
hesperus-megaship.bio: The Hesperus is a 200-year-old ghost ship once owned by Azimuth Biochemicals. Launched in 3113, it was overtaken by saboteurs from rival Pharmasapien. The Scriveners Clan later salvaged it in the Perseus Dark Region, stripping its innards before departing and leaving a mostly intact hull.
hesperus-megaship.bio_full: The Hesperus is a 200-year-old megaship launched in 3113 by Azimuth Biochemicals for a secret research mission. The vessel was overtaken by saboteurs from rival corporation Pharmasapien during its voyage. Its secondary vessel, the Anaconda Proteus, escaped to a Guardian-Thargoid battlefield where the science team conducted research before perishing. The Hesperus drifted as a ghost ship for two centuries until the Scriveners Clan discovered it in the Perseus Dark Region KC-V c2-2 system in 3307. The nomadic clan stripped the megaship's innards for materials and data before departing abruptly, leaving behind a mostly intact hull that became a focal point for scientific and corporate claims.

dodec-starport.name: Dodec starport
dodec-starport.bio: Dodec starport is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-11-11 to 3312-05-07. Developed or used by Mark Rennik, Madelyn Teague, Brewer Corporation. The Dodec entered full production availability in May 3312, becoming widely available for purchase through Colonisation contacts.

hive-chapel.name: Hive-chapel
hive-chapel.bio: Hive-chapel is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-19 to 3307-07-19. Developed or used by Pleiades Concordat, Federal Intelligence Agency.

perdition-megaship.name: Perdition megaship
perdition-megaship.bio: Perdition megaship is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-22 to 3307-07-29. Developed or used by Pleiades Concordat, Pilots Federation. The Pleiades Concordat requests deliveries to support the Far God cult in outfitting missionary megaships. The Testament will spread the faith while the Perdition and Sacrosanct will carry worshippers on a pilgrimage into deep space.

large-mining-hardpoint.name: Large Mining Hardpoint
large-mining-hardpoint.bio: Large Mining Hardpoint is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-09-29 to 3311-10-13. Developed or used by Lakon Spaceways, Alioth Independents. Lakon Spaceways declared the Type-11 Prospector mining trials a success after pilots reported unprecedented fragment yields, and announced a permanent 8% boost to the Squadron mining perk.

meta-alloys.name: meta-alloys
meta-alloys.bio: meta-alloys is a technology in Elite Dangerous, mentioned from 3302-01-08 to 3303-10-12. Key developments: Dr Arcanonn of the Canonn Interstellar Research Group confirmed the discovery of alien 'barnacle' structures on at least two planets in the Pleiade...; Following the discovery of alien barnacles in the Pleiades Nebula, technical personnel at Obsidian Orbital conducted an eleventh-hour experiment us...
meta-alloys.bio_full:
Meta-alloys are a unique material produced by alien barnacle structures discovered in the Pleiades Nebula in 3302. These organic-metallic composites possess remarkable properties: they can repair Thargoid-induced station malfunctions, protect ship sensors from alien interference, and serve as a catalyst for advanced human technology. Professor Ishmael Palin's research established meta-alloys as humanity's first commercially viable alien product, transforming them from scientific curiosity into a strategically critical resource.

The discovery triggered an immediate superpower scramble for control of barnacle sites, with Federation, Empire, and Alliance forces all deploying to secure extraction rights. Meta-alloys proved dangerously disruptive — Thargoid vessels actively defended barnacle sites, and the rush to harvest brought independent pilots into direct conflict with alien defences. Though subsequent technological developments reduced humanity's dependence on meta-alloys, they remain a symbol of both the promise and peril of exploiting alien biology.

rescue-ship-cornwallis.name: Rescue Ship Cornwallis
rescue-ship-cornwallis.bio: Rescue Ship Cornwallis is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-12-06 to 3310-12-06. Developed or used by Wolf 359. Seven of eight rescue megaships deployed near Sol are destroyed by Thargoid forces within minutes of arrival, leaving only Rescue Ship Hutner and Rescue Ship Cornwallis to continue evacuation efforts.

crom-silver-fesh.name: crom silver fesh
crom-silver-fesh.bio: crom silver fesh is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-06-16 to 3302-06-16. Developed or used by Jimmy 'Ice Pick' Falcone, Crom Silver Boys.

escape-pods.name: escape pods
escape-pods.bio: escape pods is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3303-10-07 to 3303-10-07. Developed or used by Aden Tanner, Empire. Thargoids are now capturing occupied escape pods and deploying clusters of attack drones.

ceramic-composites.name: Ceramic composites
ceramic-composites.bio: Ceramic composites is a technology in Elite Dangerous, mentioned from 3307-04-15 to 3307-06-25. Used by Pilots Federation. Key developments: The Kumo Crew syndicate launches a campaign to construct up to five new Orbis starports in uninhabited systems near key trading regions.; The Kumo Crew's starport construction campaign concludes successfully.
ceramic-composites.bio_full:
Ceramic composites are advanced construction materials used in large-scale orbital infrastructure projects throughout the galaxy. In mid-3307, the Kumo Crew syndicate placed open orders for ceramic composites as part of a campaign to construct up to five new Orbis starports in uninhabited systems near key trading regions, demonstrating the material's importance in modern starport construction.

The composites — alongside polymers and other raw materials — form a critical component of the structural frameworks used in Orbis and Coriolis station designs. Their heat-resistant and high-strength properties make them essential for withstanding the thermal and mechanical stresses of orbital habitats. The Kumo Crew's successful starport construction campaign, which concluded with multiple new stations operational by June 3307, illustrated how even criminal syndicates could leverage industrial-scale material sourcing to establish permanent infrastructure.

sub-surface-extraction-missile.name: sub-surface extraction missile
sub-surface-extraction-missile.bio: sub-surface extraction missile is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3309-12-29 to 3309-12-29. Developed or used by Jade Sanderlyn.

trailblazer-fleet-megaships.name: Trailblazer fleet megaships
trailblazer-fleet-megaships.bio: Trailblazer fleet megaships is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-04-30 to 3311-04-30. Developed or used by Federal Times, Brewer Corporation, Irene Ralston.

imperial-interdictor-lucius.name: Imperial Interdictor Lucius
imperial-interdictor-lucius.bio: Imperial Interdictor Lucius is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-04-02 to 3301-04-02. Developed or used by Kahina Tijani Loren, Sol Herald.

thargoid-spire-compounds.name: Thargoid spire compounds
thargoid-spire-compounds.bio: Thargoid spire compounds is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3309-11-10 to 3309-11-10. Developed or used by Maximo Fonseca, Ishmael Palin, Aegis. Palin discovers genetic commonalities between spire compounds and Titan hull fragments, synthesising a biological contaminant to disrupt spire processing chains.

structural-regulators.name: structural regulators
structural-regulators.bio: structural regulators is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-07-21 to 3302-07-21. Developed or used by Jaques.

highliner-antares.name: Highliner Antares
highliner-antares.bio: Highliner Antares is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-27 to 3302-07-01. Developed or used by Jasmina Halsey, Felicia Winters. She drew parallels to the Highliner Antares disaster of 3251. The Sirius Corporation has unveiled a memorial to the victims of the Highliner Antares, which was destroyed in 3251.
highliner-antares.bio_full:
The Highliner Antares stands as one of the most infamous vessels in human history, a passenger liner destroyed in 3251 under circumstances that remain controversial and partially classified more than half a century later. The disaster claimed thousands of lives and became a touchstone for debates about corporate accountability, transportation safety, and the limits of human knowledge regarding anomalous phenomena. The official investigation attributed the destruction to a drive malfunction, though alternative theories persisted among researchers and conspiracy theorists who questioned whether the full truth had been disclosed.

In 3301, Sirius Corporation unveiled a memorial to the victims, acknowledging the enduring significance of the tragedy across generations. Political figures including Jasmina Halsey and Felicia Winters drew explicit parallels between the Antares disaster and contemporary policy challenges, using historical memory to shape present-day decision-making. The Highliner Antares thus functioned not merely as a historical event but as an active element in political discourse, a cautionary tale invoked whenever questions of corporate responsibility, technological risk, or governmental oversight arose in galactic affairs.

asp.name: Asp
asp.bio: Asp is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-03-18 to 3301-03-18. Developed or used by Virgil Kyle. Due to jump distances, the system is only reachable by Asps and Anacondas fitted for near-maximum jump ranges.

synthetic-molecules.name: Synthetic molecules
synthetic-molecules.bio: Synthetic molecules is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-20 to 3307-07-20. Developed or used by Kumo Crew, Blue Viper Club, Interstellar Health Organisation. The report finds the gamma strain uses genetically modified synthetic molecules that reduce hallucinogenic intensity while enabling mass production and longer storage life.

guardian-relic.name: Guardian relic
guardian-relic.bio: Guardian relic is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-04-22 to 3307-06-24. Developed or used by Pilots Federation. Aegis and Taurus Mining Ventures launch rival Guardian artefact collection campaigns in PMD2009 48. Aegis launches an appeal for Guardian artefacts to support a new anti-xeno research programme.
guardian-relic.bio_full:
Guardian relics comprise a broad category of objects recovered from archaeological sites left by the ancient Guardian civilisation, which achieved remarkable technological and cultural sophistication before its mysterious disappearance millions of years ago. These artefacts, which include orbs, urns, totems, caskets, and tablets, vary widely in form and apparent function, offering tantalising glimpses into a species that developed interstellar capability long before humanity. Their study has driven major research programmes across scientific, military, and corporate institutions seeking to understand both Guardian history and the practical applications of their technology.

During mid-3307, Aegis and Taurus Mining Ventures launched competing campaigns to collect Guardian relics from sites in the PMD2009 48 system. Aegis specifically sought these objects to support a new anti-xeno research programme aimed at developing countermeasures against Thargoid aggression. The rival collection efforts highlighted both the scientific value of Guardian materials and the intense competition among human organisations to unlock their secrets, as conventional approaches to the alien threat proved increasingly inadequate and the pressure for breakthrough solutions mounted.

colonisation-beacon.name: Colonisation Beacon
colonisation-beacon.bio: Colonisation Beacon is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-02-20 to 3311-02-20. Developed or used by Brewer Corporation, Mark Rennik. Brewer Corporation launched a campaign to supply new Trailblazer megaships for independent colonisation support, with COO Mark Rennik outlining beacon and suite module technology.

prospector-limpet.name: prospector limpet
prospector-limpet.bio: prospector limpet is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3304-12-20 to 3304-12-20. Developed or used by Industrial Mining Guild. Existing tools like scanners and prospector limpets have also been upgraded.

federal-corvettes.name: Federal Corvettes
federal-corvettes.bio: Federal Corvettes is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-03-11 to 3301-03-11. Developed or used by Core Dynamics. Core Dynamics and the Federal Navy announced the FNS Nevermore, a Farragut-Class Battlecruiser. The FCB carries multiple squadrons of Federal Fighters and Federal Corvettes across hundreds of light years with extraordinarily heavy firepower.

polymers.name: Polymers
polymers.bio: Polymers is a technology in Elite Dangerous, mentioned from 3307-04-15 to 3307-06-25. Used by Pilots Federation. Key developments: The Kumo Crew syndicate launches a campaign to construct up to five new Orbis starports in uninhabited systems near key trading regions.; The Kumo Crew's starport construction campaign concludes successfully.
polymers.bio_full:
Polymers are synthetic materials widely used in construction, manufacturing, and shipbuilding across the galaxy. In November 3305, polymers were among the commodities requested by both the Empire and Federation as part of their competing initiatives to provide a new home for the crew of the Golconda generation ship. The materials were delivered to megaships in the Upaniklis system to support the construction of either a planetary settlement or a modern outpost.

The material's versatility makes it essential for everything from habitat sealing to equipment fabrication. The Golconda resettlement effort — which saw millions of tonnes of polymers, CMM composites, titanium, beryllium, and thallium contributed by independent pilots — demonstrated how polymer supply chains could be mobilised for humanitarian purposes. Polymers have also featured in numerous other construction campaigns, including the Kumo Crew's starport building initiative in 3307, where they were used alongside ceramic composites for orbital infrastructure.

mk-ii-cargo-rack.name: Mk II cargo rack
mk-ii-cargo-rack.bio: Mk II cargo rack is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-10-30 to 3311-10-30. Developed or used by Zorgon Peterson. Zorgon Peterson confirmed the Panther Clipper has entered full production and is now available at core system shipyards, with over 1,200 tonnes cargo capacity and Mk II cargo rack compatibility.

sub-surface-displacement-missile.name: sub-surface displacement missile
sub-surface-displacement-missile.bio: sub-surface displacement missile is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3304-12-20 to 3304-12-20. Developed or used by Industrial Mining Guild. New tools include abrasion blasters for surface deposits, sub-surface displacement missiles for deeper deposits, and seismic charges for cracking rare asteroids open.

thanatos.name: Thanatos
thanatos.bio: Thanatos is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-07-04 to 3302-07-04. Developed or used by Federation, Commander BluWolve.

eagle.name: Eagle
eagle.bio: Eagle is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-12-06 to 3301-12-06. Developed or used by Gutamaya Shipyards, Pascal Roux, Imperial Herald.

farragut-class-battlecruiser.name: Farragut-class Battlecruiser
farragut-class-battlecruiser.bio: Farragut-Class Battlecruiser is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-03-11 to 3301-03-11. Developed or used by Federation, Zachary Hudson, Federal Navy. The Federation confirms that a Farragut-class Battlecruiser and accompanying vessels were destroyed by Thargoid Interceptor-class vessels in the Maia system. Lieutenant Jarah Kael of the Federal Navy addresses rumours that Thargoids attacked in self-defence, stating that black box data from the Farragut-class Battlecruiser proves the attack was unprovoked.

antares-hyperdrive.name: Antares hyperdrive
antares-hyperdrive.bio: Antares hyperdrive is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-01-21 to 3302-01-25. Developed or used by Sirius Corporation. The Sirius Corporation revealed the initial results of its analysis of the Antares wreckage. The corporation reiterated that a hyperdrive containment failure caused the explosion but maintained the precise cause remains under investigation.

guardian-energy-particles.name: Guardian energy particles
guardian-energy-particles.bio: Guardian energy particles is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3309-12-11 to 3309-12-11. Developed or used by Leon Banerjee, Torben Rademaker, Azimuth.

black-operations-megaships.name: black operations megaships
black-operations-megaships.bio: black operations megaships is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-07-03 to 3311-07-03. Developed or used by Jerome Archer, Li Yong-Rui, Empire.

thargoid-interceptor.name: Thargoid Interceptor
thargoid-interceptor.bio: Thargoid Interceptor is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3303-09-16 to 3303-10-14. Developed or used by Aden Tanner, Federation, Aegis. The Federation confirms that a Farragut-class Battlecruiser and accompanying vessels were destroyed by Thargoid Interceptor-class vessels in the Maia system. President Zachary Hudson declares the Thargoids an enemy of the Federation and grants Admiral Aden Tanner total authority and full Federal Navy resources to address the threat.
thargoid-interceptor.bio_full:
The Thargoid Interceptor represents a formidable class of alien vessel first encountered in significant numbers during the escalation of hostilities in 3303. Larger and more heavily armed than the initial scout craft that preceded them, Interceptors demonstrated capabilities that far exceeded human technological equivalents in several domains, including manoeuvrability, defensive shielding, and caustic weaponry. Their distinctive organic-mechanical design, featuring petal-like structures that open during combat, became an iconic and terrifying symbol of the alien threat.

A pivotal moment in human-Thargoid relations occurred in late 3303 when Federation authorities confirmed that a Farragut-class Battlecruiser and its accompanying vessels were destroyed by Interceptor-class ships in the Maia system. This catastrophe — the loss of one of humanity's most powerful warships to alien forces — prompted President Zachary Hudson to formally declare the Thargoids an enemy of the Federation and grant Admiral Aden Tanner total authority over Federal Navy resources dedicated to addressing the threat. The Interceptor's demonstrated ability to defeat capital ships fundamentally altered military planning across all superpowers.

guardian-artefacts.name: Guardian artefacts
guardian-artefacts.bio: Guardian artefacts is a technology in Elite Dangerous, mentioned from 3307-05-13 to 3307-07-27. Used by Aegis, Pilots Federation, Alba Tesreau. Key developments: Thargoid forces invade the Delphi system and multiple systems in the California, Coalsack and Pleiades Nebulas.; The Alexandria megaship jumps from Delphi to HIP 16538, triggering a Thargoid attack.
guardian-artefacts.bio_full:
Guardian artefacts are the remnants of the ancient Guardian civilisation, a technologically advanced species that existed millennia before human spaceflight. In 3305, Zende Partners established a weekly megaship transport service to Synuefe EN-H d11-96, an outpost in Guardian space, to support research and technology development based on recovered Guardian technology.

The artefacts have been used to develop advanced military modules and hybrid technologies, with corporations such as Zende Partners and Segnen Exchange competing for access to Guardian commodities. Guardian artefacts are distinct from Unknown Artefacts of Thargoid origin, though both represent alien technologies that have profoundly influenced human scientific and military development. The race to exploit Guardian technology accelerated following the Thargoid invasion, as superpowers sought any advantage against the alien threat.

system-colonisation-module.name: System Colonisation Module
system-colonisation-module.bio: System Colonisation Module is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-02-26 to 3311-02-26. Developed or used by Madelyn Teague, Brewer Corporation.

guardian-casket.name: Guardian casket
guardian-casket.bio: Guardian casket is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-04-22 to 3307-06-24. Developed or used by Pilots Federation. Aegis and Taurus Mining Ventures launch rival Guardian artefact collection campaigns in PMD2009 48. Aegis launches an appeal for Guardian artefacts to support a new anti-xeno research programme.
guardian-casket.bio_full:
Guardian caskets constitute a category of artefacts recovered from sites left by the ancient Guardian civilisation, which flourished millions of years before human spaceflight before disappearing under mysterious circumstances. These containers, along with totems, relics, and other objects, represent tangible connections to a species that achieved remarkable technological and cultural sophistication. Archaeological analysis suggests the caskets served ceremonial or commemorative functions, though their precise purpose within Guardian society remains subject to ongoing research and debate.

During mid-3307, Aegis and Taurus Mining Ventures launched competing collection campaigns focused on Guardian artefacts, including caskets, from sites in the PMD2009 48 system. Aegis sought these objects specifically to support anti-xeno research programmes aimed at developing countermeasures against Thargoid aggression. The rival efforts highlighted both the scientific significance of Guardian materials and the intense competition among human organisations to unlock their secrets, as the galaxy confronted an alien threat that conventional technology struggled to overcome.

cmm-composites.name: CMM composites
cmm-composites.bio: CMM composites are a high-grade construction material essential for building large-scale spacecraft and military vessels, most prominently used in Imperial Majestic-class Interdictors. They have also been requested for Aegis anti-Thargoid development initiatives, establishing them as a critical dual-use resource in both conventional and xeno-defence shipbuilding.
cmm-composites.bio_full:
CMM composites are a high-grade construction material essential for building large-scale spacecraft and military vessels, most prominently used in the construction of Imperial Majestic-class Interdictors. In July 3302, Lavigny's Legion launched a campaign to build three new Interdictors for the Imperial fleet, placing open orders for thallium, thermal cooling units, and CMM composites at Marker Depot in the Carthage system. Scores of independent pilots responded, delivering the materials needed to expand the Empire's capital ship force.

The material's strategic importance extended beyond Imperial shipbuilding. In September 3303, Aegis listed CMM composites among the resources required for its second anti-Thargoid development initiative, alongside tantalum and Thargoid tissue samples. This dual use — supporting both conventional military expansion and experimental xeno-defence research — established CMM composites as a critical industrial resource whose availability could determine the pace of humanity's military preparedness.

faulcon-delacy-cobra.name: Faulcon DeLacy Cobra
faulcon-delacy-cobra.bio: Faulcon DeLacy Cobra is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-06-18 to 3302-06-18. Developed or used by Commander Dr Simms, Commander Sid Solo.

chemical-weapon.name: chemical weapon
chemical-weapon.bio: chemical weapon is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3303-10-12 to 3303-10-12. Developed or used by Intergalactic Naval Reserve Arm. The outpost dates to the 3100s and was involved in developing chemical weapons against Thargoid technology.

titan-drive-components.name: Titan Drive Components
titan-drive-components.bio: Titan Drive Components is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-03-21 to 3310-04-04. Developed or used by Achilles Aerospace, Sirius Corporation. Achilles Aerospace announces their prototype Frame Shift Drive is nearly production-ready thanks to materials from Titan Taranis wreckage, while Sirius Corporation remains sceptical.

srv.name: SRV
srv.bio: SRV is a technology in Elite Dangerous, mentioned from 3302-06-18 to 3303-06-04. Used by Buckyball Racing Club, Commander Corrigendum, Jeremy Grant. Key developments: The Candy Crew Guild is dominating the midpoint of the Kick The Alien Buckyball race, with Commander Nookie Mr.; Unknown Ships have been observed interacting with barnacles in the Pleiades Sector OI-T c3-7 system, extracting matter with energy beams and causin...
srv.bio_full:
The Surface Reconnaissance Vehicle (SRV) is a planetary rover used for surface exploration, combat and troop support. In December 3307, Vodel officially released the Scorpion, the first new mass-production SRV model in many years, designed specifically for combat operations. The Scorpion's development was accelerated by Vodel's acquisition by Core Dynamics in 3305, which provided significant financial resources to Vodel's engineering teams.

The Scorpion features a two-crew cabin with additional protection, a plasma surge repeater and the proprietary Aculeus missile launcher for engaging shielded and armoured targets. Its raw power provides exceptional torque for handling harsh terrain and steep climbs. The SRV family represents a key technology for planetary operations, with the Scorpion marking a significant advancement in surface combat capabilities for both independent operatives and military forces.

anomalous-bulk-scan-data.name: Anomalous bulk scan data
anomalous-bulk-scan-data.bio: A data format that became the focal point of a 3307 Federal surveillance debate, with President Hudson seeking to exploit it for expanded monitoring while Shadow President Winters championed privacy-protection countermeasures.
anomalous-bulk-scan-data.bio_full:
The discovery of anomalous bulk scan data in 3307 sparked an immediate political contest over its application. President Zachary Hudson argued that analysing these datasets could dramatically expand the Federation's surveillance capabilities, framing the technology as essential for identifying terrorist networks and hostile infiltrators. His administration launched a data delivery campaign that encouraged pilots to contribute scan information from across inhabited space.

Shadow President Felicia Winters countered with a competing initiative focused on privacy-protection technology, warning that unrestricted bulk data analysis would erode civil liberties without demonstrable security benefits. When the campaigns concluded, Hudson's effort had significantly outperformed Winters' in terms of raw data collected — a result the administration cited as public endorsement of expanded monitoring, while civil liberties groups denounced it as evidence of creeping authoritarianism within the Federation.

exceptional-scrambled-emission-data.name: Exceptional scrambled emission data
exceptional-scrambled-emission-data.bio: Exceptional scrambled emission data is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-04-29 to 3307-05-06. Developed or used by Zachary Hudson, Pilots Federation. Hudson seeks data to expand surveillance capabilities while Winters aims to develop privacy-protection technology. President Hudson's data delivery campaign outperforms Shadow President Winters' competing privacy-protection initiative.

thargoid-pulse-neutraliser.name: Thargoid pulse neutraliser
thargoid-pulse-neutraliser.bio: Thargoid pulse neutraliser is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3309-12-29 to 3309-12-29. Developed or used by Aegis, Jade Sanderlyn. Jade Sanderlyn's year-end reflection on the Thargoid war, covering the Maelstrom arrivals, Titan revelations, technological breakthroughs, spire site victories, and the liberation of abductees. An urgent call to all pilots to participate in the final assault on Titan Leigong, the second Thargoid mothership.

nemesis-protocol.name: Nemesis protocol
nemesis-protocol.bio: Nemesis protocol is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3309-12-21 to 3309-12-21. Developed or used by Azimuth, Utopia, Caleb Wycherley. Seo Jin-ae returns from Utopia after discussing Salvation's Nemesis Failsafe with Pranav Antal, with both agreeing to keep their conclusions confidential.

hafnium-178.name: Hafnium 178
hafnium-178.bio: Hafnium 178 is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-07 to 3301-05-07. Developed or used by Canonn, Dr. Arcanonn, Federation. Despite tests including exposure to Hafnium 178, the object defies analysis.

imperial-sanctum.name: Imperial Sanctum
imperial-sanctum.bio: Imperial Sanctum is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-12-06 to 3310-12-06. Developed or used by Wolf 359.

palins-contaminant.name: Palin's contaminant
palins-contaminant.bio: Palin's contaminant is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3309-12-29 to 3309-12-29. Developed or used by Jade Sanderlyn.

mycoid-fungus.name: mycoid fungus
mycoid-fungus.bio: mycoid fungus is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3303-10-19 to 3303-10-19. Developed or used by Intergalactic Naval Reserve Arm, Nestor Cartesius. Further abandoned INRA outposts have been discovered, revealing that the mycoid fungus was an unplanned by-product of research and was tested on living Thargoid specimens.

anti-xeno-weaponry.name: Anti-xeno weaponry
anti-xeno-weaponry.bio: Anti-xeno weaponry is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-04-22 to 3307-04-29. Developed or used by Pilots Federation. Aegis launches an appeal for Guardian artefacts to support a new anti-xeno research programme. Aegis's anti-xeno research programme successfully collects mass deliveries of Guardian artefacts.

guardian-nanite-torpedo.name: Guardian Nanite Torpedo
guardian-nanite-torpedo.bio: Guardian nanite torpedo is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-02-15 to 3310-10-25. Developed or used by Aegis, Aden Tanner.

unknown-probes.name: Unknown Probes
unknown-probes.bio: Unknown Probes are alien objects related to Unknown Artefacts. When scanned with an advanced discovery scanner, they emit an electro-magnetic pulse that temporarily incapacitates the scanning ship, followed by a burst of sound containing an encrypted image of interstellar bodies.
unknown-probes.bio_full: Unknown Probes are alien objects closely related to Unknown Artefacts, representing another facet of Thargoid reconnaissance technology. When scanned with an advanced discovery scanner, a probe emits an electro-magnetic pulse that temporarily incapacitates the scanning vessel. This is followed by a burst of sound similar to the "chittering" produced by Unknown Artefacts. Canonn Interstellar Research Group scientist Commander Rizal72 discovered that these sound recordings contain an encrypted image interpreted as a depiction of interstellar bodies. The exact meaning of the image and the probes' ultimate purpose remain unclear, though their similarity to Unknown Artefacts suggests they serve a complementary scouting function in Thargoid intelligence gathering.

mk-ii-mining-multi-limpet-controller.name: Mk II Mining Multi-Limpet Controller
mk-ii-mining-multi-limpet-controller.bio: Mk II Mining Multi-Limpet Controller is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-09-29 to 3311-10-13. Developed or used by Lakon Spaceways, Alioth Independents. Lakon Spaceways declared the Type-11 Prospector mining trials a success after pilots reported unprecedented fragment yields, and announced a permanent 8% boost to the Squadron mining perk.

suspended-animation.name: Suspended animation
suspended-animation.bio: Suspended animation is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-19 to 3307-07-19. Developed or used by Pleiades Concordat, Federal Intelligence Agency, Erik Gunnarson.

fuel-scoop.name: Fuel scoop
fuel-scoop.bio: fuel scoop is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-17 to 3302-12-23. Developed or used by Cuthrick Delaney, Kahina Tijani Loren. Commander Allitnil has set a new record by travelling from Sol to Jaques Station in Colonia without stopping or equipping a fuel scoop, covering 5,489 hyperspace jumps in nine days aboard an Anaconda. Her ship has received significant modifications including a state-of-the-art fuel scoop and a custom Gutamaya discovery scanner.

guardian-relics.name: Guardian relics
guardian-relics.bio: Guardian relics is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-01-18 to 3310-02-15. Developed or used by Aegis, Ishmael Palin. Aegis launches an initiative to collect Guardian relics and Unclassified relics for Ram Tah's classified anti-Titan research, with Tesreau expressing encouragement after witnessing laboratory tests. Aegis confirms Guardian relic deliveries have boosted Ram Tah's anti-Titan research, with Palin joining the effort and Tanner managing expectations about the proposed weapon's capabilities.
guardian-relics.bio_full:
Guardian relics comprise a broad category of objects recovered from archaeological sites associated with the ancient Guardian civilisation, which attained remarkable technological and cultural sophistication before its mysterious disappearance millions of years ago. These artefacts vary widely in form and apparent function, ranging from ceremonial objects to components that may have served practical technological purposes. Their study has provided humanity with crucial insights into a species that developed parallel to human evolution but reached interstellar capability long before Earthly civilisations emerged.

In early 3310, Aegis launched a major initiative to collect Guardian relics alongside unclassified relics for Ram Tah's classified anti-Titan research programme. Alba Tesreau expressed encouragement after witnessing laboratory tests, while Ishmael Palin joined the effort and Admiral Tanner cautioned against premature optimism regarding the proposed weapon's capabilities. The campaign's success in boosting Ram Tah's research demonstrated both the continued scientific potential of Guardian materials and the high stakes involved in adapting ancient technology to address contemporary existential threats.

cqc-franchise.name: CQC franchise
cqc-franchise.bio: CQC franchise is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-16 to 3301-05-16. Developed or used by Utopixx Entertainment, Reynhardt IntelliSys. The company attributed losses partly to development of new VR-Streams including the latest CQC franchise instalment.

spaceflight-one.name: Spaceflight One
spaceflight-one.bio: Spaceflight One is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-26 to 3301-05-27. Developed or used by Jasmina Halsey, Federal Navy, Felicia Winters. Secretary of State Felicia Winters assumed the role of Acting President after contact was lost with Spaceflight One carrying President Halsey and Vice President Naylor. Despite extensive searches along Spaceflight One's secured route, no trace was found.

asp-explorer.name: Asp Explorer
asp-explorer.bio: Asp Explorer is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-07-01 to 3302-07-01. Developed or used by Federal Auxiliary Navy, Admiral Maxton Price. A Federal Auxiliary Navy captain flying an Asp Explorer was shot down by Federal vessels above Merope 2 A near a barnacle site. Pilots are gathering in Maia, with many flying Asp Explorers fitted for long-range trade.

adamastor-megaship.name: Adamastor megaship
adamastor-megaship.bio: Adamastor megaship is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-04-27 to 3307-06-18. Developed or used by Azimuth Biochemicals. Pilots report new contact from 'Salvation' near the Hesperus and Adamastor. Commander Tyler Thorsen describes receiving a request to locate old signal beacons that could help find survivors from the megaship.
adamastor-megaship.bio_full:
The Adamastor was a research megaship owned by Azimuth Biochemicals that vanished in 3111 after what may have been humanity's first recorded encounter with the Thargoids. The vessel reappeared in 3306 when it entered the Chukchan system on autopilot after nearly 200 years of sublight travel, with no sign of its crew.

Investigations revealed that the Adamastor had collected survivors from a planetary survey team in the Musca Dark Region PJ-P b6-1 system who had encountered Thargoid artefacts. The derelict's return triggered a chain of events that would reshape the anti-xeno war: a dormant communications beacon aboard the ship received a mysterious signal from the anonymous figure known as Salvation, leading to the discovery of the Hesperus and ultimately the Proteus research facility. The Adamastor's journey from 3111 to 3306 stands as one of the most remarkable ghost ship stories in galactic history.

unknown-artefacts.name: Unknown Artefacts
unknown-artefacts.bio: Unknown Artefacts is a technology in Elite Dangerous, mentioned from 3301-05-20 to 3302-08-30. Used by Canonn Interstellar Research Group, Dr. Arcanonn, Ishmael Palin. Key developments: The Canonn Interstellar Research Group decoded part of the transmissions from Unknown Artefacts (AEOs), discovering they contain schematic diagrams...; Dr Arcanonn of the Canonn Interstellar Research Group confirmed the discovery of alien 'barnacle' structures on at least two planets in the Pleiade...
unknown-artefacts.bio_full:
Unknown Artefacts — later identified as Thargoid Sensors — were the first alien objects encountered by humanity in the 34th century, predating the discovery of barnacles and active Thargoid vessels. These flower-like devices emitted distinctive sounds, caused ship malfunctions, and broadcast schematic diagrams when decoded by the Canonn Interstellar Research Group. Found primarily in the Pleiades Nebula and near Merope, they were humanity's first tangible evidence that the Thargoids were not merely legend.

The artefacts proved both scientifically invaluable and dangerously disruptive. Their electromagnetic emissions could disable starport systems, and their apparent sensitivity to human presence suggested an active — if incomprehensible — purpose. Research by Dr Arcanonn and Professor Ishmael Palin established that the artefacts were biological-mechanical hybrids pointing toward nearby celestial bodies, effectively serving as Thargoid navigation beacons. This early work laid the groundwork for all subsequent xeno-research and confirmed that humanity was dealing with a technologically superior species.

gutamaya-discovery-scanner.name: Gutamaya discovery scanner
gutamaya-discovery-scanner.bio: Gutamaya discovery scanner is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-17 to 3301-05-17. Developed or used by Cuthrick Delaney, Kahina Tijani Loren, Dr. Walden. Her ship has received significant modifications including a state-of-the-art fuel scoop and a custom Gutamaya discovery scanner.

biological-contaminant.name: biological contaminant
biological-contaminant.bio: biological contaminant is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3309-11-10 to 3309-12-07. Developed or used by Ishmael Palin, Aegis, Maximo Fonseca. Professor Palin's biological contaminant successfully halts Thargoid spire site operations in the Hyades Sector ST-Q B5-5 system, confirming a vulnerability in Thargoid infrastructure. Palin discovers genetic commonalities between spire compounds and Titan hull fragments, synthesising a biological contaminant to disrupt spire processing chains.
biological-contaminant.bio_full:
The biological contaminant developed by Professor Ishmael Palin represents a groundbreaking application of xenobiological research to military purposes, designed specifically to disrupt Thargoid infrastructure by exploiting genetic vulnerabilities in their organic-technological systems. Palin's research identified common genetic markers between compounds found in Thargoid spire sites and fragments recovered from Titan hulls, revealing underlying biological commonalities that could be targeted. From this discovery, he synthesised a specialised contaminant capable of interfering with the processing chains that sustained Thargoid spire operations.

In late 3309, the contaminant was successfully deployed in the Hyades Sector ST-Q B5-5 system, where it halted Thargoid spire site operations and confirmed a critical vulnerability in alien infrastructure. The breakthrough drew support from Aegis and collaboration with researchers including Maximo Fonseca, as Palin's work offered a promising avenue for countering Thargoid territorial expansion. The biological contaminant exemplified how scientific understanding of alien biology could be translated into practical defensive technologies, shifting the strategic balance by targeting Thargoid weaknesses rather than merely matching their conventional military capabilities.

federal-haven.name: Federal Haven
federal-haven.bio: Federal Haven is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-12-06 to 3310-12-06. Developed or used by Wolf 359.

nemesis-failsafe.name: Nemesis Failsafe
nemesis-failsafe.bio: Nemesis Failsafe is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3309-12-11 to 3309-12-21. Developed or used by Azimuth, Utopia, Caleb Wycherley. Pranav Antal discusses Utopia's analysis of Salvation's Nemesis Failsafe schematics, inviting Seo Jin-ae to collaborate while dismissing claims of Utopia's involvement. Seo Jin-ae returns from Utopia after discussing Salvation's Nemesis Failsafe with Pranav Antal, with both agreeing to keep their conclusions confidential.

lakon-type-6e.name: Lakon Type-6E
lakon-type-6e.bio: Lakon Type-6E is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-11-26 to 3302-11-26. Developed or used by Institute for Galactic Exploration and Research, Commander Mad Billy.

thargoid-scout.name: Thargoid Scout
thargoid-scout.bio: Thargoid Scout is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3303-10-14 to 3303-10-14. Developed or used by Aden Tanner, Pilots Federation, Alba Tesreau. A new alien ship discovered in HIP 17125 has been classified as a 'Thargoid Scout' by the Pilots Federation. Experts note structural similarities to the Interceptor and discuss the slow evolution of Thargoid ship design over the past century.

caustic-enzyme.name: Caustic enzyme
caustic-enzyme.bio: Caustic enzyme is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-05-24 to 3307-05-24. Developed or used by Sirius Inc, Pilots Federation, Engineers.

federal-fighters.name: Federal Fighters
federal-fighters.bio: Federal Fighters is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-03-11 to 3301-03-11. Developed or used by Core Dynamics. Core Dynamics and the Federal Navy announced the FNS Nevermore, a Farragut-Class Battlecruiser. The FCB carries multiple squadrons of Federal Fighters and Federal Corvettes across hundreds of light years with extraordinarily heavy firepower.

building-fabricators.name: building fabricators
building-fabricators.bio: building fabricators is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-07-28 to 3302-07-28. Developed or used by Future of Segovan.

supercruise-overcharge.name: Supercruise Overcharge
supercruise-overcharge.bio: Supercruise Overcharge is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-05-03 to 3310-05-07. Developed or used by Stent Jackson, Sirius Corporation, Achilles Aerospace.

mining-laser.name: mining laser
mining-laser.bio: mining laser is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-11-26 to 3302-11-26. Developed or used by Institute for Galactic Exploration and Research, Commander Mad Billy. Chiggy traveled to Colonia, fitted a mining laser, and crossed 30,000 light years to reach Felix within 48 hours.

imperial-cutter.name: Imperial Cutter
imperial-cutter.bio: Imperial Cutter is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-01-04 to 3302-11-25. Developed or used by Diamond Frogs, Pilots Federation, Doot. Commander Doot contributed 704 tonnes in an Imperial Cutter.
imperial-cutter.bio_full:
The Imperial Cutter stands as the largest and most prestigious vessel available to Imperial citizens, manufactured to exacting standards that reflect the Empire's emphasis on grandeur and uncompromising quality. Designed primarily as a heavy transport and trading platform, the Cutter boasts exceptional cargo capacity combined with shielding and speed that exceed most vessels in its class. Its acquisition requires demonstration of sufficient rank within the Imperial hierarchy, making ownership a visible marker of status and Imperial favour.

During early 3302, the vessel gained recognition in independent pilot circles when Commander Doot of the Diamond Frogs contributed 704 tonnes of materials in an Imperial Cutter during a community campaign. This contribution highlighted both the ship's substantial hauling capabilities and its presence within independent as well as Imperial fleets. The Cutter's distinctive profile — long, sleek, and unmistakably Imperial in design — has made it an iconic symbol of the Empire's technological and aesthetic priorities.

imperial-courier.name: Imperial Courier
imperial-courier.bio: Imperial Courier is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-08-06 to 3301-08-06. Developed or used by Gutamaya Shipyards, Imperial Navy. Gutamaya Shipyards has reinstated default rank-related restrictions on the Imperial Clipper and Imperial Courier following the Emperor's assassination. Last month, the restrictions were temporarily lifted allowing any pilot with active Imperial Navy rank to purchase the vessels.

rescue-ship-yoshida.name: Rescue Ship Yoshida
rescue-ship-yoshida.bio: Rescue Ship Yoshida is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-12-06 to 3310-12-06. Developed or used by Wolf 359. Seven of eight rescue megaships deployed near Sol are destroyed by Thargoid forces within minutes of arrival, leaving only Rescue Ship Hutner and Rescue Ship Cornwallis to continue evacuation efforts.

prisms-shades.name: Prism's Shades
prisms-shades.bio: Prism's Shades is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-22 to 3301-05-22. Developed or used by Aisling Duval. Aisling Duval attended the opening of 'Prism's Shades', a multi-sensory art installation on Emerald in Cemiess that uses experimental light and sound projection to stimulate empathic responses.

trailblazer-echo-megaship.name: Trailblazer Echo megaship
trailblazer-echo-megaship.bio: Trailblazer Echo megaship is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-01-30 to 3311-01-30. Developed or used by Universal Cartographics, Madelyn Teague, Brewer Corporation.

taipan-ax1.name: Taipan AX1
taipan-ax1.bio: Taipan AX1 is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3303-11-11 to 3303-11-11. Developed or used by Barr Winters, Aegis, Faulcon DeLacy. Faulcon DeLacy has teamed up with Aegis to produce the Taipan AX1, a new anti-Thargoid variant of its popular fighter.

harmonys-shield-megaship.name: Harmony's Shield megaship
harmonys-shield-megaship.bio: Harmony's Shield megaship is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-05-06 to 3307-05-06. Developed or used by League of Mandu, Hadrian Duval, Natalia Lee. Admiral Natalia Lee of the Harmony's Shield declares the Federation will enact justice for the NMLA bombings, while Hadrian Duval calls for Imperial defence under the Treaty of Paresa.

nanite-clusters.name: nanite clusters
nanite-clusters.bio: nanite clusters is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-04-19 to 3310-04-19. Developed or used by Alba Tesreau.

capital-ships.name: capital ships
capital-ships.bio: capital ships is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3303-10-28 to 3303-10-28. Developed or used by Aden Tanner, Aegis.

deep-space-probes.name: deep-space probes
deep-space-probes.bio: deep-space probes is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-10-07 to 3302-10-07. Developed or used by Sirius Corporation, Mars High Astrocartography.

vulture.name: Vulture
vulture.bio: Vulture is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-10-13 to 3301-10-13. Developed or used by Canonn Interstellar Research Group, RedWizzard. Commander Mike Juliett Kilo made the breakthrough by feeding a pre-recorded AEO signal into an antique scanner display, revealing a Vulture schematic matching his own ship at the time.

lynx-highliner.name: Lynx Highliner
lynx-highliner.bio: Lynx Highliner is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3312-04-28 to 3312-04-28. Developed or used by Zorgon Peterson, Lhou Mans Security. Zorgon Peterson releases the Lynx Highliner, a dedicated passenger vessel with record capacity, defensive hardpoints, and supercharged FSD.

alignment-thruster.name: Alignment thruster
alignment-thruster.bio: Alignment thruster is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-05-24 to 3307-05-24. Developed or used by Sirius Inc, Pilots Federation, Engineers. Independent pilots evacuate thousands of civilians while engineers patch alignment systems.

f63-condor.name: F63 Condor
f63-condor.bio: F63 Condor is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-12-06 to 3301-12-06. Developed or used by Gutamaya Shipyards, Pascal Roux, Imperial Herald.

sub-surface-extraction-missiles.name: sub-surface extraction missiles
sub-surface-extraction-missiles.bio: sub-surface extraction missiles is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3309-10-05 to 3309-10-30. Developed or used by Aegis, Aden Tanner. Aegis deploys sub-surface extraction missiles to rescue captives from Thargoid Titans, with Tanner explaining the dangerous extraction process. The first humans rescued from Thargoid Titans arrive and survive extraction, with Dr Grey observing their physical and psychological state.
sub-surface-extraction-missiles.bio_full:
Sub-surface extraction missiles represent a specialised technology developed for penetrating the hardened biological and structural materials of Thargoid Titans, the massive alien vessels that served as mobile bases during the invasion of the 3300s. Unlike conventional weaponry designed for surface engagement, these missiles were engineered to burrow into Titan hulls and internal chambers, creating breaches that allowed rescue teams to extract human captives held within the alien vessels. Their development marked a significant advancement in counter-xeno technology, addressing the unique challenge of operating within active alien megastructures.

Aegis deployed these missiles during rescue operations in late 3309, with Admiral Aden Tanner explaining the hazardous extraction process to participating pilots. The first successful rescues produced survivors who arrived in critical condition, prompting medical teams led by Dr Grey to assess their physical and psychological states. The extraction missile programme demonstrated both the technical ingenuity required to counter Thargoid capabilities and the extraordinary risks that rescue personnel accepted to recover those trapped behind alien lines.

thargoid-titan-wreckage.name: Thargoid Titan wreckage
thargoid-titan-wreckage.bio: Thargoid Titan wreckage is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-10-16 to 3310-10-16. Developed or used by Shamus Madigan, Achilles Aerospace, Aegis.

rescue-ship-foerster.name: Rescue Ship Foerster
rescue-ship-foerster.bio: Rescue Ship Foerster is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-12-06 to 3310-12-06. Developed or used by Wolf 359. Seven of eight rescue megaships deployed near Sol are destroyed by Thargoid forces within minutes of arrival, leaving only Rescue Ship Hutner and Rescue Ship Cornwallis to continue evacuation efforts.

mk-ii-exploration-modules.name: Mk II exploration modules
mk-ii-exploration-modules.bio: Mk II exploration modules is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-12-02 to 3311-12-16. Developed or used by Zorgon Peterson.

specialised-legacy-firmware.name: Specialised legacy firmware
specialised-legacy-firmware.bio: Specialised legacy firmware is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-04-29 to 3307-05-06. Developed or used by Zachary Hudson, Pilots Federation.

imperial-freedom.name: Imperial Freedom
imperial-freedom.bio: Imperial Freedom is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-04-13 to 3301-04-13. Developed or used by Denton Patreus, Aisling Duval. Afterward, the pair reportedly retired to Patreus's ship, the Imperial Freedom, which departed Capitol for Eotienses with Aisling onboard.

wolf-fesh.name: wolf fesh
wolf-fesh.bio: wolf fesh is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-06-09 to 3302-06-16. Developed or used by Crom Silver Boys.

onionhead-beta-strain.name: Onionhead beta strain
onionhead-beta-strain.bio: Onionhead beta strain is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-12 to 3307-07-12. Developed or used by Scythe of Panem, Vox Galactica, Kumo Crew.

superconductors.name: Superconductors
superconductors.bio: Superconductors are advanced materials essential for the construction of large-scale spacecraft and military vessels, particularly Farragut-class Battlecruisers. In August 3302 they were among the key resources requested by the Federation for a naval expansion initiative intended to add three new capital ships to the Federal fleet.
superconductors.bio_full:
Superconductors are high-grade materials critical to the construction of capital ships and advanced military infrastructure, most notably the Federation's Farragut-class Battlecruisers. In August 3302, Federal President Zachary Hudson placed an open order for superconductors alongside autofabricators and tantalum as part of a campaign to expand the Federal Navy with three new battlecruisers, authorising the Workers of Gooheimar Alliance to reward pilots who delivered the materials to Brady Horizons.

The campaign concluded successfully after hundreds of independent pilots contributed, allowing construction to begin on the first vessel. The demand for superconductors in this and similar initiatives highlights their strategic importance in the superpower arms race, where access to these materials directly determines the pace at which navies can field new capital ships.

full-spectrum-system-scanner.name: Full Spectrum System Scanner
full-spectrum-system-scanner.bio: Full Spectrum System Scanner is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3308-09-05 to 3308-09-30. Developed or used by Pilots Federation, Universal Cartographics, Eva Llewellyn. Independent explorers report an unexplained reddish-orange flare near Barnard's Loop that produces strange FSS scanner feedback, with no official scientific explanation yet.
full-spectrum-system-scanner.bio_full:
The Full Spectrum System Scanner represents a revolutionary advancement in deep-space exploration technology, developed through collaboration between the Pilots Federation and Universal Cartographics. Unlike previous generations of system scanners that detected only the most prominent stellar bodies, the FSS generates detailed frequency analyses capable of identifying planets, rings, resource concentrations, and anomalous signals across entire star systems from a single vantage point. This capability transformed exploration from a painstaking planet-by-planet process into a systematic survey methodology accessible to independent pilots.

In late 3308, explorers using the FSS reported an unexplained reddish-orange flare near Barnard's Loop that produced strange scanner feedback with no official scientific explanation. Researcher Eva Llewellyn was among those investigating the phenomenon, which generated significant interest within the exploration community. The incident demonstrated both the scanner's sensitivity to previously unobservable phenomena and the ongoing capacity of the galaxy to surprise even its most experienced observers, reinforcing the value of distributing advanced survey technology across the independent pilot network.

bio-storage-capsules.name: bio-storage capsules
bio-storage-capsules.bio: bio-storage capsules is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3309-10-05 to 3309-10-10. Developed or used by Aegis, Aden Tanner.

synthetic-reagent.name: Synthetic reagent
synthetic-reagent.bio: Synthetic reagent is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-06-17 to 3307-06-24. Developed or used by Pilots Federation, Sinclair Faraldo.

point-defence-module.name: Point Defence module
point-defence-module.bio: Point Defence module is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-07-17 to 3311-07-17. Developed or used by Zorgon Peterson.

pulsar-fsd-boost.name: Pulsar-FSD boost
pulsar-fsd-boost.bio: Pulsar-FSD boost is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-10-21 to 3302-10-21. Developed or used by Commander Parabolus.

rescue-ship-seacole.name: Rescue Ship Seacole
rescue-ship-seacole.bio: Rescue Ship Seacole is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-12-06 to 3310-12-06. Developed or used by Wolf 359. Seven of eight rescue megaships deployed near Sol are destroyed by Thargoid forces within minutes of arrival, leaving only Rescue Ship Hutner and Rescue Ship Cornwallis to continue evacuation efforts.

onionhead-alpha-strain.name: Onionhead alpha strain
onionhead-alpha-strain.bio: Onionhead alpha strain is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-12 to 3307-07-12. Developed or used by Scythe of Panem, Vox Galactica, Kumo Crew.

supercruise-overcharge-frame-shift-drive.name: Supercruise Overcharge Frame Shift Drive
supercruise-overcharge-frame-shift-drive.bio: Supercruise Overcharge Frame Shift Drive is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-05-09 to 3310-05-09. Developed or used by Achilles Aerospace, Faulcon DeLacy, Namin Tirel. Achilles Aerospace releases the full range of Supercruise Overcharge drives and upgrades, with Dr. Namin Tirel revealing the technology was developed using Thargoid drive components recovered by independent pilots.

python-mk-ii.name: Python Mk II
python-mk-ii.bio: Python Mk II is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-05-07 to 3310-10-31. Developed or used by Sirius Corporation, Achilles Aerospace, Faulcon DeLacy. Faulcon DeLacy releases the Python Mk II, the first ship built entirely around Achilles' SCO Frame Shift Drive, featuring improved heat management and breaking speed records.

knowledge-core.name: Knowledge Core
knowledge-core.bio: Knowledge Core is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-09 to 3307-07-09. Developed or used by Scriveners Clan, Pilots Federation.

rescue-ship-hutner.name: Rescue Ship Hutner
rescue-ship-hutner.bio: Rescue Ship Hutner is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-12-06 to 3310-12-06. Developed or used by Wolf 359. Seven of eight rescue megaships deployed near Sol are destroyed by Thargoid forces within minutes of arrival, leaving only Rescue Ship Hutner and Rescue Ship Cornwallis to continue evacuation efforts.

supercruise-overcharge-capable-frame-shi.name: Supercruise Overcharge capable Frame Shift Drive
supercruise-overcharge-capable-frame-shi.bio: Supercruise Overcharge capable Frame Shift Drive is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-06-20 to 3310-06-20. Developed or used by Engineers. Achilles Aerospace's Alioth facility producing SCO frame shift drives is attacked by unidentified saboteurs posing as engineers, with no survivors and no impact on manufacturing.

anti-thargoid-technologies.name: anti-Thargoid technologies
anti-thargoid-technologies.bio: anti-Thargoid technologies is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3303-10-06 to 3303-10-13. Developed or used by Aegis, Aden Tanner. Aegis's appeal for Thargoid-related materials concluded successfully, with hundreds of pilots delivering materials to Chelbin Service Station for anti-Thargoid technology development. Professor Alba Tesreau confirmed the materials are being sent to engineering contractors for anti-Thargoid device development.

rescue-ship-kisseih.name: Rescue Ship Kisseih
rescue-ship-kisseih.bio: Rescue Ship Kisseih is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-12-06 to 3310-12-06. Developed or used by Wolf 359. Seven of eight rescue megaships deployed near Sol are destroyed by Thargoid forces within minutes of arrival, leaving only Rescue Ship Hutner and Rescue Ship Cornwallis to continue evacuation efforts.

radicoida-unica.name: Radicoida unica
radicoida-unica.bio: Radicoida unica is a technology in Elite Dangerous, mentioned from 3311-11-13 to 3312-04-15. Used by October Consortium, Holloway Bioscience Institute, Alliance. Key developments: All major Powers deploy fleets to the HIP 87621 enclave after Radicoida unica's discovery, triggering the largest mobilisation since the Second Tha...; Licensed Commanders entered HIP 87621 exclusively and discovered Radicoida unica, an exobiological flora unlike any previously catalogued.
radicoida-unica.bio_full:
Radicoida unica is a colossal plant species unique to the HIP 87621 system that has attracted intense scientific and military interest since its discovery. In January 3312, Dr Roy Casimir of the Holloway Bioscience Institute published the first public study of the plant, based on data provided by the October Consortium which claims legal ownership of the system.

Casimir described the plant's genetic composition as "mercurial," with remarkable cellular resilience and adaptability. October Consortium researchers observed that Radicoida unica may form symbiotic relationships with biological creatures with prolonged exposure, and appears aware of activity around it. During its flowering season, the plant produces seed pods whose flesh contains compounds that improve physical performance and reduce thinking time in laboratory subjects. These properties triggered a major powers conflict, with all major superpowers deploying fleets to the HIP 87621 enclave after the plant's discovery — the largest mobilisation since the Second Thargoid War. The October Consortium's redaction of some research data hints at proprietary applications, raising questions about whether the plant's compounds will see widespread medical use or restricted military deployment.

unusual-encrypted-files.name: Unusual encrypted files
unusual-encrypted-files.bio: Unusual encrypted files are a category of digital data used in high-level security and surveillance research across the galaxy. In early 3307 they were among the data types requested by both President Zachary Hudson and Shadow President Felicia Winters for rival Federal initiatives concerning the Proactive Detection Bureau and privacy-protection technology.
unusual-encrypted-files.bio_full:
Unusual encrypted files represent a specialised class of digital intelligence data that has been used in major Federal security and infrastructure projects. In April 3307, both President Zachary Hudson and Shadow President Felicia Winters requested deliveries of this data type as part of competing community initiatives — Hudson seeking to expand the Proactive Detection Bureau's surveillance capabilities, while Winters aimed to develop technology to protect personal communications from government intrusion.

Beyond the Federal political rivalry, unusual encrypted files have also been sought by neutral parties such as Sirius Corporation and the Utopia commune for security planning, including preparations to host the Galactic Summit. Their recurring demand across multiple high-stakes projects underscores the value of advanced cryptographic datasets in galactic diplomacy and counter-terrorism efforts.

emergency-power-cells.name: Emergency power cells
emergency-power-cells.bio: Emergency power cells is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-22 to 3307-07-29. Developed or used by Pleiades Concordat, Pilots Federation.

mycoid-virus.name: mycoid virus
mycoid-virus.bio: mycoid virus is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-08-12 to 3302-08-12. Developed or used by Intergalactic Naval Reserve Arm, Arvan Corto, Sima Kalhana. Historian Sima Kalhana reviewed the history of Thargoid encounters, from the first reported interdictions in 3125 to the INRA's alleged development of the mycoid virus.

farragut-battlecruiser.name: Farragut battlecruiser
farragut-battlecruiser.bio: Farragut battlecruiser is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-12-05 to 3310-12-05. Developed or used by Aden Tanner, Felicia Winters.

federal-gunship.name: Federal Gunship
federal-gunship.bio: Federal Gunship is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-09-07 to 3301-09-07. Developed or used by Core Dynamics, Federal Navy. Core Dynamics unveiled the Federal Gunship, a combat vessel designed as a superior fighter escort for the Federal Navy.

xihe-companions.name: Xihe Companions
xihe-companions.bio: Xihe Companions is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-11-26 to 3301-11-26. Developed or used by Federal Times, Revolutionary Noti Values Party.

anti-guardian-field-resistant-nanite-clu.name: Anti-Guardian field resistant nanite clusters
anti-guardian-field-resistant-nanite-clu.bio: Anti-Guardian field resistant nanite clusters is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-07-06 to 3310-07-06. Developed or used by Aegis. Engineer Ram Tah perfects modifications to immunise all Guardian modules against anti-Guardian field effects without reducing weapon damage or functionality.

anaconda.name: Anaconda
anaconda.bio: A heavy multipurpose starship renowned for its exceptional jump range and cargo capacity, the Anaconda became the vessel of choice for deep-space explorers and endurance racers in the early 3300s.
anaconda.bio_full:
The Anaconda established itself as the definitive deep-space exploration vessel long before the major colonisation waves of the 3300s. Its combination of exceptional jump range, massive fuel reserves and generous internal compartments allowed pilots to reach destinations that smaller ships simply could not access. In December 3302, Commander Allitnil demonstrated these capabilities by setting a new endurance record: travelling from Sol to Jaques Station in Colonia without stopping or equipping a fuel scoop, covering 5,489 hyperspace jumps in nine days.

The Buckyball Racing Club and explorers like Virgil Kyle further cemented the Anaconda's reputation by using it to push the boundaries of what was possible in long-distance travel. Certain remote systems became reachable only by Anacondas and Asp Explorers fitted for near-maximum jump ranges, creating an elite tier of destinations accessible exclusively to pilots wealthy enough to afford the galaxy's most capable exploration platforms. The Anaconda's legacy is inseparable from the map of human expansion itself.

mkii-cargo-rack.name: MkII cargo rack
mkii-cargo-rack.bio: MkII cargo rack is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-07-22 to 3311-07-24. Developed or used by Zorgon Peterson, Brewer Corporation.

decontamination-limpet.name: Decontamination Limpet
decontamination-limpet.bio: Decontamination Limpet is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3304-01-13 to 3304-01-13. Developed or used by Aegis. Aegis has released the decontamination limpet, a new device designed to counter the caustic properties of Thargoid enzyme missiles.

onionhead-gamma-strain.name: Onionhead gamma strain
onionhead-gamma-strain.bio: Onionhead gamma strain, commonly known as 'helix', is a genetically modified variant of the onionhead narcotic mass-produced by the Kumo Crew in 3307.
onionhead-gamma-strain.bio_full:
Onionhead gamma strain, commonly known as 'helix', is a genetically modified variant of the onionhead narcotic developed for mass production and wider distribution. Unlike the alpha, beta and Lucan strains, which rely on naturally grown seeds from the Panem system, the gamma strain uses synthetic molecules that reduce hallucinogenic intensity while enabling artificial cultivation and longer storage life.

The Interstellar Health Organisation confirmed in 3307 that the gamma strain was engineered for commercial scalability — a sophistication that suggested development by an unidentified research facility rather than the nomadic Blue Viper Club who initially distributed it. The Kumo Crew syndicate under Archon Delaine subsequently mass-produced helix through a partnership with the Club, prompting system-wide crackdowns. The gamma strain represents a troubling evolution in narcotics trafficking: a designer drug engineered by advanced corporate laboratories and distributed through pirate networks.

pulse-wave-xeno-scanner.name: pulse wave xeno scanner
pulse-wave-xeno-scanner.bio: pulse wave xeno scanner is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3309-10-05 to 3309-12-29. Developed or used by Aegis, Aden Tanner.
pulse-wave-xeno-scanner.bio_full:
The pulse wave xeno scanner represents a specialised detection technology developed by Aegis to identify and analyse Thargoid biological and technological signatures within operational environments. Unlike general-purpose scanners designed for stellar cartography or mineral prospecting, this device emits calibrated energy pulses that interact with Thargoid materials to reveal structural weaknesses, organic vulnerabilities, and technological subsystems. Its development required reverse-engineering principles from recovered alien artefacts combined with conventional sensor engineering expertise.

Aegis deployed these scanners during the intensifying conflict of late 3309, with Admiral Aden Tanner overseeing their integration into anti-xeno operations. The technology proved essential for pilots engaging Thargoid vessels and installations, providing tactical intelligence that conventional scanning equipment could not generate. The pulse wave xeno scanner exemplified how humanity's military-technological response to the Thargoid threat evolved through adaptive innovation, transforming captured alien knowledge into practical tools that independent pilots could deploy against a technologically superior adversary.

frame-shift-drive.name: Frame Shift Drive
frame-shift-drive.bio: frame-shift drive is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-07 to 3301-05-07. Developed or used by Sirius Corporation, Achilles Aerospace. While similar individual failures had occurred before, each previously caused drive shutdown rather than entry into hyperspace. Achilles Aerospace announces their prototype Frame Shift Drive is nearly production-ready thanks to materials from Titan Taranis wreckage, while Sirius Corporation remains sceptical.

type-9-heavy.name: Type-9 Heavy
type-9-heavy.bio: Type-9 Heavy is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-08-11 to 3301-08-11. Developed or used by Arnold Lowe, Federal Times, Elaine Boyd. Two transport safety officials died when their personal transport collided with a Lakon Type-9 Heavy vessel near Laphria Shipyard in the Artemis system. The Type-9 pilot was treated for shock.

seismic-charge.name: seismic charge
seismic-charge.bio: seismic charge is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3304-12-20 to 3304-12-20. Developed or used by Industrial Mining Guild. New tools include abrasion blasters for surface deposits, sub-surface displacement missiles for deeper deposits, and seismic charges for cracking rare asteroids open.

mycoid-bioweapon.name: mycoid bioweapon
