mycoid-bioweapon.bio: mycoid bioweapon is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3308-06-03 to 3308-06-03. Developed or used by INRA, Alliance, Empire. Professor Alba Tesreau presents evidence that Salvation is Dr Caleb Wycherley, former Azimuth Biochemicals researcher and INRA collaborator who helped develop the mycoid bioweapon.

insulating-membrane.name: Insulating membrane
insulating-membrane.bio: Insulating membrane is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-22 to 3307-07-29. Developed or used by Pleiades Concordat, Pilots Federation.

utility-slots.name: utility slots
utility-slots.bio: utility slots is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-04-08 to 3311-04-08. Developed or used by Ines Allende, Imperial Navy.

unknown-probe.name: Unknown Probe
unknown-probe.bio: Unknown Probe is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-08-20 to 3302-08-20. Developed or used by Canonn Interstellar Research Group. The Canonn Interstellar Research Group decrypted a tight-beam transmission from an Unknown Probe directed at Merope 5c.

tritium.name: Tritium
tritium.bio: Tritium is a technology in Elite Dangerous, mentioned from 3307-05-21 to 3307-07-27. Used by Pilots Federation, Alliance. Key developments: The Alexandria megaship jumps from Delphi to HIP 16538, triggering a Thargoid attack.; The superpowers jointly suspend Aegis operations and authorise an inquiry into the Alexandria's disappearance.
tritium.bio_full:
Tritium is a radioactive isotope of hydrogen that serves as the primary fuel for fleet carriers, the massive mobile starports introduced by Brewer Corporation in the late 3300s. The isotope's properties make it ideal for powering the long-range jump drives that allow fleet carriers to traverse vast distances across the galaxy.

In September 3306, Brewer Corporation partnered with Kavanagh Spaceframes Ltd and Steel Castle Inc to upgrade refinery outposts into full starports specifically to improve fleet carrier refuelling access, after customers raised concerns that large ships such as Anacondas, Corvettes, and Clippers could not dock with refinery outposts to take on Tritium fuel. The construction initiative expanded refuelling infrastructure across ten systems, with new Orbis and Coriolis stations operational by October 3306. Tritium mining and transport became a major economic activity, with Torval-Mastopolos Mining and other extraction companies running large-scale campaigns to supply the growing demand from fleet carrier owners.

ocellus-starport.name: Ocellus starport
ocellus-starport.bio: The Ocellus starport is a spherical station design prioritising research facilities, exemplified by The Oracle in the Pleiades.
ocellus-starport.bio_full:
The Ocellus starport is a distinctive station design characterised by its spherical main body and external docking arms, giving it the appearance of a massive mechanical sea urchin. The design prioritises research and scientific facilities, making Ocellus stations popular choices for deployment near sites of scientific interest.

The most famous Ocellus station is The Oracle, which relocated to the Pleiades Sector IR-W d1-55 in 3303 to establish a dedicated research centre at a Thargoid structure site. Administrator Ahmed hoped the facility would help answer fundamental questions about Thargoid intentions and communication. The Oracle later suffered heavily during the Thargoid escalation, becoming one of the most prominent civilian casualties of the early Thargoid war. The Ocellus design remains in use across the galaxy, valued for its research capabilities and distinctive profile.

thermal-cooling-units.name: thermal cooling units
thermal-cooling-units.bio: thermal cooling units is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-07-21 to 3302-07-28. Developed or used by Lavigny's Legion.

cortical-implant.name: Cortical implant
cortical-implant.bio: cortical implant is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3308-06-10 to 3311-06-03. Developed or used by Aegis, Alba Tesreau, Seo Jin-ae.

rescue-ship-bertschinger.name: Rescue Ship Bertschinger
rescue-ship-bertschinger.bio: Rescue Ship Bertschinger is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-12-06 to 3310-12-06. Developed or used by Wolf 359. Seven of eight rescue megaships deployed near Sol are destroyed by Thargoid forces within minutes of arrival, leaving only Rescue Ship Hutner and Rescue Ship Cornwallis to continue evacuation efforts.

soontill-relics.name: Soontill Relics
soontill-relics.bio: Soontill Relics is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-18 to 3301-05-18. Developed or used by Jean Molyneaux, Lyran Betar. Scientific tests on Soontill relics sold on the open market proved inconclusive.

liquid-oxygen.name: Liquid oxygen
liquid-oxygen.bio: Liquid oxygen is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-08 to 3307-07-15. Developed or used by Archon Delaine, Kumo Crew, Blue Viper Club.

majestic-class-interdictor.name: Majestic-class Interdictor
majestic-class-interdictor.bio: Majestic-class Interdictor is a technology in Elite Dangerous, mentioned from 3302-07-21 to 3303-10-12. Used by Empire, Federation. Key developments: Political commentators review the deteriorating Federal-Imperial relationship, tracing it from the Beta Hydri battlecruiser construction in March t...; The Empire deployed an Imperial deputation including a Majestic-class Interdictor to the Pleiades Sector AB-W B2-4 system over the non-human shipwr...
majestic-class-interdictor.bio_full:
The Majestic-class Interdictor is the Empire's primary capital ship, a massive vessel designed for system control and fleet command. In late 3306, the Imperial Navy completed construction of four new Majestic-class Interdictors as part of a parallel military build-up with the Federation, which simultaneously commissioned five Farragut-class Battle Cruisers.

The Majestic-class Interdictor features advanced medical facilities capable of treating critical casualties, as demonstrated when Princess Aisling Duval transported Imperator Hadrian Duval to a Majestic-class medical bay following an NMLA assassination attempt in November 3306. The vessel serves as both a mobile command centre and a symbol of Imperial military power, with new ships conducting shakedown cruises in systems such as Chimechilo, Orannika, Theta Indi and Zelano.

lakon-spaceways-asp.name: Lakon Spaceways Asp
lakon-spaceways-asp.bio: Lakon Spaceways Asp is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-22 to 3301-05-22. Developed or used by Commander Alot, Buckyball Run, Commander Kligg. His first record was set in a Lakon Spaceways Asp named 'Big Bird'; his current record was achieved in a Faulcon DeLacy Anaconda named 'Rhonda'.

trailblazer-megaships.name: Trailblazer megaships
trailblazer-megaships.bio: Trailblazer megaships is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-02-20 to 3311-03-19. Developed or used by Brewer Corporation, Mark Rennik. Brewer Corporation launched a campaign to supply new Trailblazer megaships for independent colonisation support, with COO Mark Rennik outlining beacon and suite module technology. A community campaign successfully upgraded Brewer Corporation's Trailblazer fleet, adding five new megaships to support colonisation efforts.
trailblazer-megaships.bio_full:
Trailblazer megaships represent a class of mobile installations developed by Brewer Corporation specifically to support independent colonisation efforts across the galaxy. These massive vessels combine the mobility of megaships with specialised modules including navigation beacons and suite facilities designed to establish footholds in uninhabited or minimally developed systems. Their purpose is to provide the essential infrastructure that colonists need to survive and prosper in regions lacking permanent starports or established supply chains.

In early 3311, Brewer Corporation launched a campaign to expand its Trailblazer fleet, with Chief Operating Officer Mark Rennik detailing the beacon and suite module technologies that distinguished these vessels from standard megaship designs. A subsequent community campaign successfully funded the addition of five new Trailblazer megaships to the corporation's colonisation support fleet. This expansion reflected both the continued growth of human settlement beyond the core worlds and the corporate sector's recognition that colonisation support represented a viable and expanding market.

anomalous-extraterrestrial-object.name: Anomalous Extraterrestrial Object
anomalous-extraterrestrial-object.bio: Anomalous Extraterrestrial Object is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-09-13 to 3301-09-20. Developed or used by Ishmael Palin, Homeland Scientific Council. The Federal research programme studying anomalous extraterrestrial objects was abruptly terminated by Fort Harrison station governor Aoishe Quaid only one week after its inauguration. The quasi-organic objects, capable of broadcasting location data across vast distances, were considered the scientific find of the decade.

advanced-discovery-scanner.name: advanced discovery scanner
advanced-discovery-scanner.bio: advanced discovery scanner is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-07-19 to 3302-07-19. Developed or used by Commander Rizal72, Canonn Interstellar Research Group.

computer-components.name: Computer Components
computer-components.bio: Computer Components is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-11-12 to 3301-11-12. Developed or used by Explorers' Association, Universal Cartographics. The Explorers' Association announces the final phase of Ocellus starport construction in the Pleiades Nebula, asking pilots to deliver Computer Components to Neville Horizons in Kaushpoos.

semiconductors.name: Semiconductors
semiconductors.bio: Semiconductors is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-04-15 to 3307-04-22. Developed or used by Kavanagh Spaceframes Ltd.

auto-fabricators.name: Auto fabricators
auto-fabricators.bio: Auto fabricators is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-22 to 3307-07-29. Developed or used by Pleiades Concordat, Pilots Federation.

caustic-enzyme-bomb.name: Caustic enzyme bomb
caustic-enzyme-bomb.bio: Caustic enzyme bomb is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-29 to 3307-07-29. Developed or used by Verity Dexter, Theta Seven, Marlinism Reformation Party. The NMLA bombs Stillman Hub in HIP 22550 and Tilman Point in Hyades Sector RO-P b6-6, killing tens of thousands.

type-10-defender.name: Type-10 Defender
type-10-defender.bio: Type-10 Defender is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3303-12-17 to 3303-12-22. Developed or used by Lakon Spaceways, Alliance. The Alliance has commissioned Lakon Spaceways to produce the Type-10 Defender, a comprehensive revision of the Type-9 Heavy, in response to recent Thargoid attacks in the Pleiades. Lakon Spaceways has announced that the Type-10 Defender is now available to the public.

wells-class-carrier.name: Wells-class Carrier
wells-class-carrier.bio: The Wells-class Carrier is a mobile fleet carrier design used by the Federation. These massive vessels can travel between star systems and serve as mobile bases for squadrons of smaller ships.
wells-class-carrier.bio_full: The Wells-class Carrier is a massive mobile fleet carrier design operated by the Federation. These vessels are capable of travelling between star systems and serve as mobile bases for squadrons of fighters and smaller ships. Unlike stationary installations, Wells-class carriers can reposition to support operations across vast distances, making them invaluable for extended military campaigns. Their deployment has been particularly significant in anti-xeno operations, where the ability to establish forward operating bases in threatened systems provides a tactical advantage against Thargoid forces.

federal-battlecruiser.name: Federal battlecruiser
federal-battlecruiser.bio: Federal battlecruiser is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-07-13 to 3302-07-13. Developed or used by Empire, Admiral Denton Patreus, Zemina Torval. Following Senator Zemina Torval's criticism of the Federal blockade in Merope, Admiral Denton Patreus announced that an Imperial fleet will be dispatched to the system under his personal command. Patreus did not clarify whether the fleet would engage Federal forces or establish a counter-blockade.

salvations-superweapons.name: Salvation's superweapons
salvations-superweapons.bio: Salvation's superweapons is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-12-09 to 3307-12-09. Developed or used by Alliance Defence Force, Morag Halloran, Pilots Federation. Salvation requests urgent deliveries of classified experimental equipment to three megaships in Delphi, Maia and Merope to deploy anti-xeno superweapons against Thargoid invasions.

starflight-one.name: Starflight One
starflight-one.bio: Starflight One is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-26 to 3301-05-26. Developed or used by Maisy Stevenson, Saga Republic Party, Jasmina Halsey. Maisy Stevenson, leader of the Saga Republic Party, stated that Starflight One failed to arrive 38 hours prior and that Mars claimed the President took a last-minute detour.

type-8.name: Type-8
type-8.bio: Type-8 is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-07-30 to 3310-10-31. Developed or used by Lakon Spaceways, Naomi Landseer, Engineers. Lakon Spaceways chairperson Naomi Landseer reveals the Type-8 was moved back to the theoretical stage to accommodate SCO drive stresses, resulting in the largest medium-class freighter frame. Lakon Spaceways releases the Type-8, a medium-class freighter optimised for SCO frame shift drive travel, boasting larger cargo capacity and greater resilience than competitors.
type-8.bio_full:
The Type-8 represents Lakon Spaceways' ambitious entry into the medium-class freighter market, designed specifically to capitalise on the emerging supercruise overcharge frame shift drive technology that promised to revolutionise deep-space freight transport. Under the leadership of chairperson Naomi Landseer, the project was moved back to the theoretical stage to accommodate the unique structural stresses imposed by SCO drive operations, resulting in a hull design that prioritised resilience alongside cargo capacity. This decision, though costly in terms of development timeline, produced what Lakon claimed was the largest and most capable medium-class freighter frame in production.

When released in late 3310, the Type-8 boasted greater cargo capacity and enhanced structural integrity compared to competitors in its class, positioning it as the preferred choice for pilots seeking to maximise freight efficiency without upgrading to heavy-class vessels requiring higher-ranked permits. The ship's integration with SCO technology demonstrated how frame shift drive innovations could reshape entire vessel categories, as manufacturers redesigned hulls around new propulsion capabilities rather than simply retrofitting existing models. Through the Type-8, Lakon Spaceways reinforced its reputation for producing reliable, purpose-built transport vessels that served the practical needs of the galactic trading community.

anti-xeno-modules.name: Anti-Xeno modules
anti-xeno-modules.bio: Anti-Xeno modules is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-05-16 to 3311-05-16. Developed or used by Edmund Mahon, Ainsley Niven, Alliance.

type-11-prospector.name: Type-11 Prospector
type-11-prospector.bio: Type-11 Prospector is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-09-29 to 3312-01-22. Developed or used by Lakon Spaceways, Alioth Independents. Lakon Spaceways declared the Type-11 Prospector mining trials a success after pilots reported unprecedented fragment yields, and announced a permanent 8% boost to the Squadron mining perk. Lakon Spaceways' Type-11 Prospector enters full distribution.
type-11-prospector.bio_full:
The Type-11 Prospector represents Lakon Spaceways' dedicated entry into the specialised mining vessel market, designed to address the unique demands of deep-core and surface extraction operations that general-purpose ships could not efficiently perform. During extensive trials throughout late 3311, pilots reported unprecedented fragment yields from mining lasers and seismic charges, validating the design's focused optimisation for resource extraction. The vessel's hull configuration and internal layout prioritise cargo capacity, refinery integration, and manoeuvrability in dense asteroid fields over the combat or passenger capabilities that characterise multipurpose designs.

Lakon Spaceways declared the mining trials a success and announced both full distribution of the Type-11 Prospector and a permanent eight percent enhancement to the Squadron mining perk available to affiliated pilots. The ship's entry into core system shipyards in early 3312 marked a significant expansion of Lakon's product line beyond their traditional transport and exploration vessels. The Type-11 Prospector's development illustrated how ship manufacturers responded to evolving market demands as mining became an increasingly sophisticated and lucrative profession requiring purpose-built equipment rather than adapted generalist designs.

banshee-drone.name: Banshee drone
banshee-drone.bio: Banshee drone is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3309-10-31 to 3309-10-31. Developed or used by Maximo Fonseca, Ishmael Palin.

sidewinder.name: Sidewinder
sidewinder.bio: Sidewinder is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-08-10 to 3301-08-10. Developed or used by Judas Syndicate, Maugvahnna Rose, Federal State Police. Eschel quit the force, acquired a Sidewinder, and built a reputation as a cautious, dangerous, and law-abiding bounty hunter.

panther-clipper.name: Panther Clipper
panther-clipper.bio: Panther Clipper is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-07-22 to 3311-10-30. Developed or used by Zorgon Peterson, Brewer Corporation. Zorgon Peterson confirmed the Panther Clipper has entered full production and is now available at core system shipyards, with over 1,200 tonnes cargo capacity and Mk II cargo rack compatibility.
panther-clipper.bio_full:
The Panther Clipper represents a heavy cargo vessel manufactured by Zorgon Peterson, designed to address the persistent demand for bulk transport capabilities that exceeded existing freighter classes. With a cargo capacity exceeding 1,200 tonnes and compatibility with Mk II cargo rack systems, the vessel filled a significant gap in the civilian shipping market, enabling operators to move unprecedented volumes of goods in single journeys. Its introduction reflected the ongoing expansion of galactic trade networks and the corresponding need for larger, more efficient transport solutions.

Zorgon Peterson confirmed full production of the Panther Clipper in mid-3311, making the ship available at core system shipyards across Federal, Imperial, and independent territories. The announcement represented a major product launch from a manufacturer already known for producing reliable, utilitarian vessels favoured by traders and miners. The Panther Clipper's arrival demonstrated how shipbuilding technology continued to evolve in response to economic demands, even as the galaxy grappled with the ongoing challenges of the Thargoid conflict and political instability.

black-market.name: Black market
black-market.bio: Black market is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-04-30 to 3307-04-30. Developed or used by Archon Delaine, Kumo Crew, Kay Volantyne. Arch-Corsair Kay Volantyne claims they encourage legitimate trade, though neighbouring systems fear black market activity.

project-seraph.name: Project Seraph
project-seraph.bio: Project Seraph is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-10-18 to 3311-06-03. Developed or used by Aegis, Seo Jin-ae, Alba Tesreau. Seo, the sole survivor of Project Seraph's 197 test subjects, reveals her intent to find and shut down Salvation, whom she believes exists beyond physical death in HIP 22460.
project-seraph.bio_full:
Project Seraph stands as one of the most disturbing chapters in Aegis's history, a classified research programme that subjected nearly two hundred human test subjects to experimental procedures intended to develop anti-Thargoid capabilities. The project represented the darker side of wartime scientific urgency, where ethical boundaries were crossed in pursuit of perceived survival imperatives. Only one subject survived the trials: Seo Jin-ae, whose experiences would transform her into one of the most determined adversaries of the programme's architect, Salvation.

In late 3310, Seo revealed the full scope of Project Seraph's atrocities and declared her intent to find and shut down Salvation, whom she believed had transcended physical death to persist as a consciousness within the HIP 22460 system. Her revelations, supported by Aegis figures including Alba Tesreau, exposed how the organisation had permitted or actively supported research that treated human beings as disposable experimental material. Project Seraph thus became a symbol of the moral corruption that could emerge when fear of an external threat justified any means of response, leaving lasting scars on both survivors and the institutions that had enabled such practices.

diso-ma-corn.name: Diso Ma Corn
diso-ma-corn.bio: Diso Ma Corn is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-11 to 3301-05-11. Developed or used by Broker Mrozak, Broker Del Boy, Alliance. The Green Party of Diso's rejuvenation project for Birmingham succeeded spectacularly when 5,187 commanders delivered over 15 million tonnes of machinery in just 65 hours. An increased supply of Diso Ma Corn has been released to markets aboard Shifnalport to stimulate the Old World sector economy.

holographic-technology.name: holographic technology
holographic-technology.bio: holographic technology is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-11-26 to 3301-11-26. Developed or used by Federal Times, Revolutionary Noti Values Party.

unclassified-relics.name: Unclassified relics
unclassified-relics.bio: Unclassified relics is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-01-18 to 3310-01-25. Developed or used by Aegis, Alba Tesreau. Aegis launches an initiative to collect Guardian relics and Unclassified relics for Ram Tah's classified anti-Titan research, with Tesreau expressing encouragement after witnessing laboratory tests.

trailblazer-megaship.name: Trailblazer megaship
trailblazer-megaship.bio: Trailblazer megaship is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-08-21 to 3311-11-11. Developed or used by Mark Rennik, Brewer Corporation. Brewer Corporation announced the Trailblazer megaship fleet would be withdrawn beginning November 11th, declaring independent colonies self-sufficient after a year of logistical support.
trailblazer-megaship.bio_full:
The Trailblazer megaship represents Brewer Corporation's innovative approach to supporting independent colonisation, designed as a mobile infrastructure platform that could establish temporary footholds in uninhabited systems. These vessels carried the equipment, supplies, and technical expertise necessary to sustain colonists during the critical early phases of settlement, bridging the gap between initial arrival and the completion of permanent installations. Their deployment marked a significant shift in how frontier expansion was organised, reducing dependence on slow, expensive construction campaigns by bringing essential services directly to nascent colonies.

In late 3311, Brewer Corporation announced that the Trailblazer fleet would begin withdrawal on November 11th, declaring that supported independent colonies had achieved self-sufficiency after a year of logistical assistance. Chief Operating Officer Mark Rennik framed the withdrawal as evidence of the programme's success rather than its conclusion. This milestone demonstrated that the megaship-based support model could achieve its intended purpose, enabling colonies to transition from dependent outposts to autonomous settlements capable of sustaining themselves without continuous external support.

suite-module.name: Suite Module
suite-module.bio: Suite Module is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-02-20 to 3311-02-20. Developed or used by Brewer Corporation, Mark Rennik. Brewer Corporation launched a campaign to supply new Trailblazer megaships for independent colonisation support, with COO Mark Rennik outlining beacon and suite module technology.

caspian-explorer.name: Caspian Explorer
caspian-explorer.bio: Caspian Explorer is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-12-02 to 3312-03-23. Developed or used by Zorgon Peterson. Zorgon Peterson confirmed the Caspian Explorer exceeded all internal projections during two-week field trials, with CMDR BitNick contributing the most exobiological data. Zorgon Peterson's Caspian Explorer enters full production.
caspian-explorer.bio_full:
The Caspian Explorer represents Zorgon Peterson's entry into the specialised exobiology vessel market, designed to support the scientific study of alien lifeforms across diverse planetary environments. During extensive field trials in late 3311 and early 3312, the ship exceeded all internal performance projections, with independent pilots including CMDR BitNick contributing substantial quantities of exobiological data that validated the design's research capabilities. The vessel integrated advanced sampling equipment, specialised laboratories, and habitat modules optimised for extended operations in remote systems.

Zorgon Peterson confirmed full production of the Caspian Explorer in early 3312, making it available to the independent pilot community that had proven essential to its development through participation in trial programmes. The ship's success demonstrated the growing commercial viability of scientific exploration as a profession distinct from either pure cartography or resource extraction. Through the Caspian Explorer, Zorgon Peterson established a presence in a niche that bridged industrial manufacturing with the expanding frontiers of xenobiological research.

federal-politics.name: Federal Politics
federal-politics.description: The turbulent political landscape of the Federation, marked by presidential succession crises, constitutional power struggles, and the shifting balance between Hudson's Republican Party and Winters' Liberal Party.
federal-politics.summary: The Federal political landscape from Halsey's presidency through Hudson's rise and his subsequent attempts to consolidate power beyond constitutional limits.
federal-politics.outcome: Hudson remains president. Winters leads opposition. The eight-year term limit was challenged but remains contested.

falisci-conflict.name: Falisci Conflict
falisci-conflict.description: The Federation's military intervention in the Falisci system to suppress a democratic uprising, demonstrating the limits of Federal tolerance for independence movements.
falisci-conflict.summary: The Federation's military suppression of a democratic uprising in the Falisci system, ending hopes for Falisci independence.
falisci-conflict.outcome: Federal forces crushed the independence movement. Falisci remained under Federal control. The Falisci Democracy faction was defeated.

halsey-presidency.name: Halsey Presidency
halsey-presidency.description: The presidency of Jasmina Halsey, her controversial disappearance aboard Starship One, and the subsequent political upheaval that reshaped Federal politics.
halsey-presidency.summary: The presidency and mysterious disappearance of Jasmina Halsey aboard Starship One, and the conspiracy theories that followed.
halsey-presidency.outcome: Halsey survived the Starship One disaster and eventually returned to public life as a Federal Ambassador, advocating for inter-superpower cooperation.

lugh-independence.name: Lugh Independence
lugh-independence.description: The Crimson State Group's bid to secure independence for the Lugh system from Federal control. With 87% popular support, they appeal to the Alliance for diplomatic recognition, framing their struggle as one of self-determination against Federal military occupation.
lugh-independence.summary: The Crimson State Group's bid for independence from Federal control in the Lugh system, testing Alliance-Federation relations and frontier sovereignty.
lugh-independence.outcome: The Federal Navy crushed the independence movement. The Alliance declined full intervention, and Lugh remained under Federal control.

onionhead-conflict.name: Onionhead Conflict
onionhead-conflict.description: The struggle over the cultivation, distribution, and legality of Lucan Onionhead — a psychoactive plant native to Kappa Fornacis. The conflict pits Federal authorities, who ban the drug, against frontier farmers and criminal organisations who see it as a lucrative cash crop.
onionhead-conflict.summary: The struggle over Lucan Onionhead cultivation and distribution, pitting Federal drug enforcement against frontier farmers and criminal organizations.
onionhead-conflict.outcome: Onionhead remains banned in Federation space but thrives in independent systems. The conflict set precedents for Federal drug enforcement policies.

pleiades-expansion.name: Pleiades Expansion
pleiades-expansion.description: The scramble by all three superpowers to establish military and research outposts in the Pleiades Nebula following the discovery of Thargoid barnacles and alien activity.
pleiades-expansion.summary: The superpower race to colonise and militarise the Pleiades Nebula after barnacle discoveries and Thargoid activity made the region strategically vital.
pleiades-expansion.outcome: The Pleiades became a contested military zone. Aegis established research outposts. All three superpowers maintain permanent military presence.

prism-senator.name: Prism Senator
prism-senator.description: The controversial tour and subsequent disappearance of Senator Kahina Tijani Loren of the Prism system, whose Federation visit and mysterious activities foreshadowed her later role as the revolutionary Commander Salomé.
prism-senator.summary: Senator Kahina Tijani Loren's Federation tour, her cryptic statements, and subsequent disappearance—events that presaged her transformation into the revolutionary figure known as Salomé.
prism-senator.outcome: Senator Loren disappeared under mysterious circumstances, later reappearing as Commander Salomé. She was eventually arrested for the attempted assassination of Admiral Patreus and stripped of her title.

alliance-expansion.name: Alliance Expansion
alliance-expansion.description: The Alliance's gradual expansion from a loose trade confederation into a major superpower, marked by diplomatic absorption of independent systems and competition with the Federation and Empire for frontier territory.
alliance-expansion.summary: The Alliance's transformation from a trade confederation into a major superpower through diplomatic expansion, scientific outposts, and economic campaigns.
alliance-expansion.outcome: The Alliance absorbed numerous independent systems, established presence in the California Nebula, and became a recognized third superpower.

unknown-artefacts.name: Unknown Artefacts
unknown-artefacts.description: The mystery of Unknown Artefacts—later identified as Thargoid sensors—recovered from Federal Navy convoys by the Canonn research group. Their discovery of star system coordinates encoded in the artefacts' signals, and the devices' corrosive effect on starport systems, foreshadowed the Thargoid return.
unknown-artefacts.summary: The mystery of Unknown Artefacts—later identified as Thargoid probes—that caused equipment malfunctions and hinted at alien presence before open contact.
unknown-artefacts.outcome: Unknown Artefacts were identified as Thargoid probes. They were harbingers of the Thargoid return and are now studied for intelligence value.

kumo-crew-rise.name: Kumo Crew Rise
kumo-crew-rise.description: The rise of Archon Delaine's Kumo Crew from a pirate confederation to a quasi-state power controlling the Pegasi Sector, complete with its own economy, military, and political structures.
kumo-crew-rise.summary: Archon Delaine's transformation of the Kumo Crew from a loose pirate confederation into an organised political and military force controlling the Pegasi Sector.
kumo-crew-rise.outcome: The Kumo Crew controls the Pegasi Sector, operates starports, and maintains a military capable of both anti-xeno operations and territorial expansion.

antares-mystery.name: Antares Mystery
antares-mystery.description: The disappearance of the Highliner Antares during its maiden voyage in 3251, the most infamous spacegoing accident before Starship One, with no confirmed wreckage ever found despite multiple claims of discovery.
antares-mystery.summary: The disappearance of the Highliner Antares during its maiden voyage in 3251, a mystery that spawned conspiracy theories and multiple false claims of wreckage discovery.
antares-mystery.outcome: No confirmed wreckage has ever been found. Sirius Corporation denies responsibility. The incident led to enhanced hyperdrive safety features.

cerberus-plague.name: Cerberus Plague
cerberus-plague.description: A devastating infectious disease outbreak originating at Newton Dock in BD-02 4304, spreading to multiple systems before a cure was discovered in Ceremonial Heike Tea.
cerberus-plague.summary: A deadly plague that threatened multiple systems and was ultimately cured by an unexpected source—Ceremonial Heike Tea.
cerberus-plague.outcome: The Cerberus Plague was contained using Ceremonial Heike Tea, which contained ingredients that cured the pathogen. The outbreak was halted before becoming a galactic pandemic.

imperial-succession.name: Imperial Succession
imperial-succession.description: The brewing political crisis surrounding Emperor Hengist Duval's failing health. With the Emperor unable to rule and no clear succession plan, Imperial power brokers manoeuvre for position while Chancellor Blaine struggles to maintain order.
imperial-succession.summary: The crisis surrounding Emperor Hengist Duval's failing health and the power vacuum it created among Imperial senators and Chancellor Blaine.
imperial-succession.outcome: Emperor Hengist Duval eventually recovered temporarily, then died. Arissa Lavigny-Duval was crowned Emperor, stabilizing the succession.

cayutorme-conflict.name: Cayutorme Conflict
cayutorme-conflict.description: The Imperial Navy's campaign to disband the mercenary Cayutorme Syndicate, a fleet of independent pilots operating as a criminal organisation in the Cayutorme system.
cayutorme-conflict.summary: The Imperial Navy's military campaign against the Cayutorme Syndicate, a mercenary fleet that refused disbandment and engaged Imperial forces.
cayutorme-conflict.outcome: The Cayutorme Syndicate was defeated. Order was restored to the Cayutorme system. Kyle Kurowski's fate remains unclear.

barnacle-meta-alloy.name: Barnacle Meta Alloy
barnacle-meta-alloy.description: The discovery of Thargoid barnacles in the Pleiades Nebula and the subsequent race between superpowers to control access to meta-alloys, the only known material capable of repairing Thargoid-corroded starports.
barnacle-meta-alloy.summary: The discovery of alien barnacles producing meta-alloys sparked a superpower race for control and became a flashpoint in human-Thargoid relations.
barnacle-meta-alloy.outcome: Meta-alloys became strategically vital. The Pleiades region became contested territory. Barnacle sites remain active.

thargoid-contact.name: Thargoid Contact
thargoid-contact.description: Humanity's first encounters with the Thargoids in the 33rd century, from the discovery of Unknown Artefacts and barnacles to the confirmation of Thargoid identity and the beginning of active hostilities.
thargoid-contact.summary: The progressive revelation of Thargoid presence, from mysterious artefacts and barnacles to open confirmation of alien ships and the beginning of active hostilities.
thargoid-contact.outcome: Thargoid identity was confirmed. Active hostilities began. Aegis was formed to coordinate research and defense.

jaques-station.name: Jaques Station
jaques-station.description: The epic saga of Jaques Station, the galaxy's only travelling starport. Its ambitious attempted jump to Beagle Point ended in disaster and disappearance, but the station was eventually rediscovered in what became the Colonia region, sparking a new wave of colonization.
jaques-station.summary: The epic journey of Jaques Station, a mobile Orbis starport that was accidentally launched into deep space and later recovered, becoming a symbol of human resilience.
jaques-station.outcome: Jaques Station was located in the Colonia region. The rescue effort established the Colonia Connection highway and sparked colonization of the region.

raxxla-mystery.name: Raxxla Mystery
raxxla-mystery.description: The enduring mystery of Raxxla—a mythical world or location said to hold alien technology or a portal to another place—and the organisations that have searched for it across centuries.
raxxla-mystery.summary: The centuries-old search for Raxxla, a mythical world said to hold alien secrets, and its connection to the Dynasty Project and Salomé's claims.
raxxla-mystery.outcome: Raxxla has never been found. The Children of Raxxla continue their search. Connections to the Dynasty Project suggest the myth may have basis in fact.

guardian-ancients.name: Guardian Ancients
guardian-ancients.description: The archaeological effort to understand the extinct Guardian civilization and their ancient war with the Thargoids, yielding recovered technology that reshaped anti-xeno warfare and corporate competition.
guardian-ancients.summary: The archaeological investigation of the extinct Guardian civilization, their ancient war with the Thargoids, and the corporate and military race to exploit recovered alien technology.
guardian-ancients.outcome: Guardian technology was successfully integrated into human ship modules. Corporate competition for Guardian commodities led to open conflict in Synuefe EN-H d11-96.

salome-conspiracy.name: Salome Conspiracy
salome-conspiracy.description: The transformation of Senator Kahina Tijani Loren into the revolutionary Commander Salomé, her campaign of destabilisation, and her eventual arrest for the attempted assassination of Admiral Denton Patreus.
salome-conspiracy.summary: Senator Kahina Loren's transformation into Commander Salomé, her links to revolutionary organisations, and her arrest for attempting to assassinate Admiral Denton Patreus.
salome-conspiracy.outcome: Kahina Loren was found guilty, stripped of her rank, and imprisoned. Her claims about the Dynasty Project were later partially validated.

inra-exposed.name: Inra Exposed
inra-exposed.description: The rediscovery of abandoned INRA outposts revealing the organisation's covert development of chemical weapons against Thargoids, including the mycoid fungus tested on living specimens.
inra-exposed.summary: The rediscovery of INRA bases and logs revealing covert chemical weapons research, including the mycoid fungus tested on living Thargoids, sparking galactic ethical debate.
inra-exposed.outcome: INRA's activities were publicly exposed. Galactic leaders condemned the organisation. The mycoid fungus became a focal point for debates about anti-xeno warfare ethics.

spy-robot-scandal.name: Spy Robot Scandal
spy-robot-scandal.description: The Federal Times exposes a corporate espionage operation where Mars Tribune owner Kingsley Cordova blackmailed an Achilles Corporation engineer into installing surveillance programs on PA912 household robots belonging to prominent figures in the Sol system.
spy-robot-scandal.summary: A corporate blackmail scheme using hacked household robots to spy on Sol system's elite, exposed by the Federal Times.
spy-robot-scandal.outcome: Achilles Corporation remotely purged the spy software. Kingsley Cordova's scheme was exposed, and the Mars Tribune closed.

sources.name: Frontier Forums — Distant Worlds 3: The Narrative
sources.author: CMDR Erimus Kamzel

nova-imperium.name: Nova Imperium
nova-imperium.description: A violent isolationist movement within the Empire that rejected cooperation with other superpowers and sought to install Hadrian Duval as Emperor, culminating in open military conflict and a brutal Senate purge.
nova-imperium.summary: The Nova Imperium uprising—an isolationist faction that challenged Emperor Arissa Lavigny-Duval's authority, demanded Hadrian Duval's ascension, and was crushed through military defeat followed by mass executions in the Imperial Senate.
nova-imperium.outcome: Nova Imperium was militarily defeated at Paresa. Imperator Mordanticus was executed on the Senate floor by Senator Patreus. Hadrian Duval survived but was politically sidelined until later rehabilitated.
phases: Phase 3: Blood on the Senate Floor (3305-01-25)

blight.name: Blight
blight.description: A devastating crop disease of unknown origin that spread across multiple agricultural worlds, threatening billions with famine before an agronomic treatment was developed and distributed.
blight.summary: A devastating crop blight that threatened galactic food security, traced to a synthetic contaminant, and ultimately cured through scientific collaboration and mass distribution of an agronomic treatment.
blight.outcome: The agronomic treatment eliminated the mutated blight pathogen. Mass production and distribution prevented widespread famine, though affected systems required months to fully recover.

galactic-summit.name: Galactic Summit
galactic-summit.description: An unprecedented attempt to hold face-to-face diplomatic talks between all three superpowers, hosted by Sirius Corporation, which ended in catastrophe when the NMLA launched coordinated terrorist attacks across nine starports.
galactic-summit.summary: The first ever face-to-face summit between Alliance, Empire, and Federation leaders, cancelled by NMLA terrorist attacks that killed thousands and became known as the Nine Martyrs incident.
galactic-summit.outcome: The summit was cancelled. The NMLA claimed responsibility for simultaneous bombings in nine systems including superpower capitals. Inter-superpower cooperation was set back years.

nmla-terrorism.name: Nmla Terrorism
nmla-terrorism.description: The Neo-Marlinist Liberation Army's campaign of terror against the Empire, including the Nine Martyrs attack and the assassination of Prince Harold Duval, culminating in the Battle of Summerland and exposure of the Lords of Restoration.
nmla-terrorism.summary: The NMLA's terrorist campaign against the Empire, from the Nine Martyrs attack to their defeat at Summerland and the exposure of Imperial senators who secretly funded them.
nmla-terrorism.outcome: The NMLA was defeated at Summerland. Darkwater Inc was destroyed. The Lords of Restoration were exposed. Emperor Arissa was rescued.

formidine-rift.name: Formidine Rift
formidine-rift.description: The discovery of the Dynasty Project—a covert mission in the 3270s to install beacons in the Formidine Rift, Conflux, and Hawkin's Gap—and the subsequent search for what happened to the fleet.
formidine-rift.summary: The search for the truth behind the Dynasty Project, a covert mission to install beacons in remote galactic regions whose ships never returned.
formidine-rift.outcome: The Dynasty Project was confirmed. Shipwrecks, beacons, and abandoned settlements from the 3270s were discovered. The Zurara megaship was found with its crew dead.

salvation-azimuth.name: Salvation Azimuth
salvation-azimuth.description: The rise of the anonymous scientist Salvation, his anti-xeno superweapons derived from Guardian technology, and the revelation that he was Dr Caleb Wycherley of Azimuth Biochemicals—a man with a two-century history of unethical research.
salvation-azimuth.summary: The mysterious scientist Salvation's development of anti-xeno superweapons, his manipulation of superpowers, and his death during the catastrophic Proteus Wave activation.
salvation-azimuth.outcome: Salvation was identified as Dr Caleb Wycherley and confirmed dead. The Proteus Wave failed catastrophically. Azimuth Biotech continued operations under new leadership.

marlinist-refugee.name: Marlinist Refugee
marlinist-refugee.description: Hundreds of thousands of Marlinist refugees fled Imperial persecution following anti-terrorism lockdowns, creating a diplomatic crisis as the Empire demanded extradition while the Federation and Alliance offered sanctuary.
marlinist-refugee.summary: The mass exodus of Marlinist refugees from the Empire following anti-terrorism crackdowns, creating an inter-superpower crisis over extradition, asylum, and accusations of harbouring terrorists.
marlinist-refugee.outcome: Marlinists were granted asylum in Federation and Alliance space. The Marlinist Parliament established colonies with Sirius Corporation support. NMLA terrorists were later identified among refugee populations.

scriveners-clan.name: Scriveners Clan
scriveners-clan.description: The nomadic Scriveners Clan and their salvage of the 200-year-old Hesperus megaship, revealing connections to Azimuth Biochemicals and the ancient Guardian-Thargoid war before the clan abandoned the site.
scriveners-clan.summary: The Scriveners Clan—a nomadic dredger tribe—salvaged the 200-year-old Hesperus megaship, revealing Azimuth Biochemicals' connection to the Guardian-Thargoid war before abandoning the site under pressure.
scriveners-clan.outcome: The Scriveners stripped the Hesperus's innards and departed. The mostly intact hull was left behind. Orion University later attempted to claim the site.

thargoid-titan-war.name: Thargoid Titan War
thargoid-titan-war.description: The Thargoid Titan invasion of human space, the deployment of Maelstroms, the abduction of human captives, and the desperate efforts to develop effective countermeasures.
thargoid-titan-war.summary: The Thargoid Titan invasion, including Maelstrom deployment, human abductions, and the development of extraction technologies and countermeasures.
thargoid-titan-war.outcome: Human forces developed methods to extract captives from Titans. The war continues with no clear resolution.

trailblazer-colonisation.name: Trailblazer Colonisation
trailblazer-colonisation.description: Brewer Corporation's deployment of the Trailblazer megaship fleet to support independent colonisation at the edge of inhabited space, enabling rapid frontier expansion before the fleet was withdrawn and repurposed.
trailblazer-colonisation.summary: Brewer Corporation's Trailblazer fleet supported independent colonisation at the edge of core systems, enabling rapid settlement before being withdrawn as a 'vote of confidence' in colony self-sufficiency.
trailblazer-colonisation.outcome: Thousands of new colonies were established. The Trailblazer fleet was withdrawn and refitted for other duties, including staging for the HIP 87621 enclave conflict.

hip-87621-conflict.name: Hip 87621 Conflict
hip-87621-conflict.description: The unfolding mystery surrounding the permit-locked HIP 87621 system, the disappearance of exobiologist Terri Tora, and the October Consortium's controversial legal ownership of the system. Billionaire Zachary Rackham's involvement and conflicting claims fueled widespread speculation.
hip-87621-conflict.summary: A permit-locked system mystery that sparked speculation about hidden superpower projects and alien encounters, remaining largely classified.
hip-87621-conflict.outcome: The October Accords placed HIP 87621 under corporate custodianship, with the October Consortium chairing neutrality between Imperial, Alliance, and independent powers. The Federation was excluded, having lost its foothold during the conflict.

lady-zi-pirate-coalition.name: Lady Zi Pirate Coalition
lady-zi-pirate-coalition.description: A rogue pirate admiral known as Lady Zi unites a coalition of pirate ships under a single criminal syndicate, conducting coordinated military-style raids across core systems using twin-axe malware as a calling card.
lady-zi-pirate-coalition.summary: The emergence of Lady Zi as a coordinated criminal threat in the core systems, beginning with raids on military outposts and escalating to full starport attacks in Lhou Mans. The twin-axe malware signature and probing tactics suggest a highly organised, military-style pirate coalition.
lady-zi-pirate-coalition.outcome: Defence forces successfully repelled the Lhou Mans attackers, completed civilian evacuation, and restored all damaged starports to full operation. However, Lady Zi remains at large and analysts warn the attacks were merely a 'test run' for larger operations.
phases: Phase 1: Coordinated Raids on Military Outposts (3312-04-23)
Phase 4: Starport Recovery and Return to Operation (3312-05-21)
